This means if a table spends £100 and does not tip, the waiter has to pay £4 from their own money. This creates a greedy culture and leads to bad service. If a table does not tip, the waiter feels the company is taking their money and may feel angry at customers.

I usually get about £60 in tips per shift. On a good night, it can be over £100, and on a bad night, about £40. About half of a waiter’s income comes from tips. All restaurants should have to show their tipping rules clearly. In America, everyone tips, and the system works well.

2. Elle, 22, Edinburgh: "We never know whether it’s fair"
Average tips: £20 per eight-hour shift

I think waiters are treated best in France.

I work three part-time jobs in catering and hospitality, all on zero-hours contracts. My main day job is in a café where the small team works both in the kitchen and with customers, so we put all tips together and share them equally. My main evening job is at a restaurant where we do not get tips, but our pay is minimum wage plus £2.50 per hour (which is supposed to cover average tips shared with kitchen staff). My third job is in events catering, and nobody tips there.

In restaurants, many customers add tips by card, so staff never see how much is tipped. We do not know if we get our fair share. The system seems better in France, where people do not tip much, but waiting tables is seen as a real job with job security and good pay.

3. Ashley, 22, London: "Tips go towards customer breakages"
Average tips: £10-15 per eight-hour shift

I think waiters are treated best in Australia.

I work in a pub in south-east London in the evenings and in a local restaurant during the day. In both places, all tips are collected and shared at the end of the night. Money from the tip jar is also used to pay for things broken by staff or customers. If someone leaves early, they usually do not get their tips because tips are shared just before closing.

It is very unfair that tips are shared, especially if one team member does not work hard. Also, if someone does very well, they do not get the tips they earned. It is also unfair that tips are used to pay for things broken by customers. Managers should pay for broken glasses and plates, not take it from our tips. I usually make about £20 in tips per shift, but only get £10-15 after sharing. When I get good tips, it really helps my finances. Sometimes I earn over £50 in one night, which almost doubles my pay for that day, but I never get more than £30 after sharing. I really need tips because I only earn £7 an hour.

I would prefer to have a good basic wage, like in Australia, so I would not have to depend on tips to get by.

4. Tom, Manchester: "A big night of tips can help pay the rent"
Average tips: £40 per eight-hour shift

I think waiters are treated best in Italy.

At my old job, floor staff kept 80% of cash tips and 40% of card tips. The other 20% of cash tips went to junior waiters and the bar. The 60% of card tips went into a tronc system, which helped pay kitchen staff more. I am not sure if this was to pay their salary or as a bonus.

It is hard to say how much I earned per shift, maybe about £40, with £20 from card tips. Tips can make a big difference to your weekly money. Sometimes, people need a good night of tips to pay their rent.

In Italy, they have a good system. People do not add a service charge, but usually round up the bill. For example, if the meal is €19, they leave €20 and do not ask for change. They respect the staff, and you often see people making a career out of waiting, and they are very experienced.

In homes and cafes across Britain, tea, baked beans on toast, and fish and chips have been important foods for a long time. However, a new dataset from the National Food Survey shows how British eating habits have changed over the years. The survey started in 1940 because the government was worried about people’s health and food supply.

Even though British people are known for loving tea, they now drink much less than before. Since the 1970s, tea drinking has dropped by more than half, from 68 grams per person per week to only 25 grams. Since one cup of tea uses about 3 grams, people now drink about eight cups a week, compared to 23 cups in 1974. Tea is still the most popular hot drink, but people now spend more money on coffee.

The data comes from 150,000 households who took part in the survey between 1974 and 2000, plus more information from 2000 to 2014. It was published by the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. The data shows that people are eating healthier in some ways, such as drinking more low-calorie soft drinks, switching from whole milk to skimmed milk, and eating more fresh fruit. However, people are also eating more chips, pizza, crisps, and ready meals each week.

People have also changed the type of bread they eat, moving from white bread to brown, wholemeal, and other types. But the amount of bread eaten has dropped from 25 slices a week to 15 slices over the last 40 years, based on a 40-gram slice. People are eating 20% less baked beans in sauce, even though they are eating more other convenience foods, especially Italian dishes. Adults now eat about 75 grams of pizza each week, compared to none in 1974, and pasta eating has almost tripled.

Fresh potatoes are not as important as before, with a 67% drop since 1974, when adults ate about 188 grams every day. Other vegetables like cucumbers, courgettes, aubergines, and mushrooms are now more common. Takeaway food eating has almost doubled since 1974, from 80 grams per person per week to 150 grams. Of this, 33 grams are chips and 56 grams are meat, with kebabs (10 grams), chicken (7 grams), burgers (5 grams), and “meat-based meals” (32 grams) being especially popular.

Some trends show that British people are making healthier choices, as fruit eating has gone up by 50% since 1974. In 2014, adults ate about 157 grams of fruit per day, which is almost two of the five recommended daily portions. Bananas have been the most popular fruit since 1996, with 221 grams per adult per week in 2014, more than apples (131 grams) and oranges (48 grams). In 2014, low-calorie soft drinks made up half of all soft drinks for the first time.

The survey also shows other social changes. For example, questions about keeping chickens and collecting your own eggs were removed in 1991, and that year they also stopped asking only the “housewife” to fill out the survey. Today, British people spend a smaller part of their income on food—11% compared to 24% in 1974.

The UK Environment Secretary, Elizabeth Truss, said that food is very important in British society. She said the data shows how eating habits have changed over 40 years, with people caring more about where their food comes from, buying food online, and trying new foods from around the world. She also said that by sharing this data, people can learn more about how eating habits have changed and use this information for things like local food maps, school projects, and predicting new food trends. She hopes the data will help people learn about the past and help the food and farming industry grow in the future.

Agios Efstratios is a very remote island. It is so far away and forgotten by banks, the government, and most of the modern world that there is no mobile data, no ATM, and no credit card machine on the island. Before Greece’s financial crisis, people living on this quiet island in the northern Aegean Sea managed well. They did their banking at the post office, and every summer, the few rooms for rent were full of visitors who heard about the island’s beautiful empty beaches, clear sea, and fresh seafood from friends.

But now, because the island still uses only cash, the closing of banks across Greece has been very hard for them. People have to travel nine hours to the nearest big island just to get cash. Greek tourists say they cannot get enough money to visit. “Tourist numbers are down 80% this year,” said Mayor Maria Kakali, in her office in the village where she grew up, which has about 200 people. “Even people who were born here and now live in Athens, who have their own houses on the island, are not coming.”

Kakali has asked the government and a big Greek bank to put an ATM on the island soon, but she thinks it might be too late for this tourist season. Tourism is much bigger than the other two sources of income: fishing and farming. “We have almost no bookings for August, when usually people call us looking for a room and we cannot help them.” This winter might be a little better because 50 workers will stay in the village to help expand the harbor, but there is a bigger problem coming. The government has said it will end a special tax break for islands that has lasted for decades.

This lower sales tax was created to help island communities survive when many people were leaving. It made living costs lower in places where everything has to be brought in from outside, and it made tourism cheaper. Popular islands like Mykonos are worried that losing the tax break will make it hard to compete with Turkey, but for Agios Efstratios, it is an even bigger danger. “If we have to pay a 23% tax, I’m sorry to say it, but we will all die on the island,” says Kakali.

Food and fuel are already more expensive than on the mainland. There are no big shops and not much economic flexibility on an island that, even in summer, has only three shops, two restaurants, and no official hotel. “This is an expensive island. Everything, even milk or bread, is sold three or four times before it gets to us, and each seller takes a profit,” said Provatas Costas, a 58-year-old fisherman.

For Agios Efstratios and its nearest big neighbor, Lemnos, the timing of the crisis is especially bad. For years, they were not well known because the ferries were slow and unreliable. In 2015, the government finally gave the ferry contract to a new, better company, and many new visitors started coming to see the islands’ hidden beauty—until the bank controls started.

“It started as the best season in 30 years and, in one week, became the worst,” said Atzamis Konstantinos, a travel agent in Lemnos. He used to earn €15,000 a month as a ship captain but came home because he missed the island. “I always loved this island, even when I was young. I would arrive in Athens, get my pay, and take the first boat here. People said, ‘You’re crazy. You can go anywhere,’ but I only wanted to come here.”

Lemnos has many wild beaches where, even in the middle of summer, you can swim and sunbathe almost alone. It has a small nightlife and many cultural sites. It is the eighth largest island in Greece, so it will be one of the first to get the tax increase in autumn 2015, but it is much less rich than many smaller islands. It has just over 3,000 beds for visitors, while an island like Rhodes has tens of thousands. The local leaders say they will fight the tax rise, but they do not know how. “We have had economic problems in recent years and now we will have more,” said Lemnos Mayor, Dimitris Marinakis. “When there is not enough money, people spend less, and the whole economy gets worse.”

The crisis has been especially hard for people under 40, who often do two or three jobs just to survive and still feel they cannot afford to have a family. Young people are afraid they are losing their friends, who are leaving the island like their grandparents did when they moved to America, Australia, and Canada. “What is the future for our generation?” said Katerina Fikari, who feels lucky to work for the local government in Lemnos. “If you work only to pay your bills, how can you have dreams for your future?”

If taxes go up, even more young people will leave, warns Mayor Kakali. She has spent her year in office trying to improve education on the island to make it a better place for families. Because Agios Efstratios is one of the smallest islands, it has until 2017 before the tax rise comes, so Kakali hopes that changes in Greek politics might save them. If not, she plans to go to Athens to remind the government what the tax rise would mean.

“The truth is the government does not pay much attention to the islands of the north Aegean,” she said. “So I would take all the children from our school to the gates of parliament, to tell them: ‘There is still life on these islands.’”

Scientists have connected the brains of two animals so they can share sensory information. This is an important step towards what researchers call the world’s first “organic computer.”

A team in the US put special devices, called brain-to-brain interfaces, on two rats. These devices let the rats work together on simple tasks to get rewards, like a drink of water. In one experiment, the scientists used the internet to connect the brains of two rats that were far apart—one was at Duke University in North Carolina, USA, and the other was in Natal, Brazil.

The team was led by Miguel Nicolelis, who is known for making devices that help paralyzed people control computers and robotic arms with their thoughts. The researchers say their new work could let many brains connect and share information. Nicolelis said, “These experiments showed that we have made a direct and advanced communication link between brains. Basically, we are creating what I call an organic computer.”

First, the scientists showed that rats can share and use each other’s sensory information. They did this by connecting the rats’ brains with tiny electrodes placed in the motor cortex, the part of the brain that controls movement.

The rats were trained to press a lever when a light above it turned on. If they did this correctly, they got a drink of water. To test if the rats could share brain information, the scientists put them in separate compartments. Only one compartment had a light above the lever. When that rat pressed the lever, its brain activity was sent electronically to the other rat’s brain. In tests, the second rat pressed the lever correctly 70% of the time after receiving the brain signal.

Surprisingly, the communication worked both ways. If the second rat failed the task, the first rat did not get a drink and seemed to change its behavior to help its partner do better. In more experiments, the rats worked together on a task where they had to tell the difference between narrow and wide openings using their whiskers.

In the final test, the scientists connected rats on different continents and sent their brain activity back and forth over the internet. Miguel Pais-Vieira, the main author of the study, said, “Even though the animals were on different continents, and there was noise and delays in the signals, they could still communicate. This shows we could make a network of animal brains in many places.”

Nicolelis said the team is now trying to connect several animals’ brains at the same time to solve harder tasks. He said, “We cannot even guess what new things might happen when animals start working together as a ‘brain-net.’ In theory, a group of brains could solve problems that one brain alone cannot.” The research was published in the journal Scientific Reports.

Anders Sandberg, who studies the ethics of brain technology at Oxford University, said this work is very important for understanding how brains store information. He also said the technology could have many uses in the future. Sandberg explained, “Humans are very good at communicating and working together. That is why we control the planet. Without this, even though we are smart, we would not be in charge.”

He added, “I don’t think there’s any danger of super-smart rats from this. Sharing sensory information is very different from being able to plan. I am not worried about a group of ‘rat multiborgs’ taking over.”

Very little is known about how thoughts are stored and how they could be sent to another person’s brain, so this is not possible soon. Also, much of what we think is just a “draft” of what we might do. Sandberg said, “Often, we don’t want to share these drafts; it would be embarrassing and confusing. Many drafts are changed before we act. Most of the time, we would be glad not to be inside someone else’s head.”

Thousands of people protested on beaches in Australia against killing sharks in Western Australia. They asked the state’s prime minister to stop killing the sharks. RSPCA Australia and Richard Branson, the owner of Virgin Atlantic, also criticized the plan. The government started catching and killing sharks longer than three metres after several shark attacks happened on the coast of Western Australia. In November 2013, a 35-year-old surfer was killed by a shark. He was the sixth person to die from a shark attack in two years.

However, in all of Australia, there has been only one shark-related death per year on average for the last 50 years. Kate Faehrmann, from the Sea Shepherd Conservation Society, spoke at a protest in Perth, the capital of Western Australia. She said, “We have always said this idea will not work. Drumlines, which are used to catch sharks, kill sharks of all sizes, and also dolphins, turtles, and other animals. That is why we do not want the cull.”

People protested on beaches in Perth, Sydney, Adelaide, and also in Victoria and Queensland. Faehrmann said the protests showed that Australians want to protect sharks. She said, “It is amazing that so many people in Australia love sharks. This shows that even though people are scared, thousands are coming out to say, ‘The ocean belongs to sharks. We respect them, we love them, and we do not want you to kill them.’” Anthony Joyce, a surfer who once had his foot bitten by a shark, said, “Killing these sharks will not make any difference.”

The state government will not say how many sharks they have killed. Some people say that sharks smaller than three metres were released after being caught on drumlines. Drumlines are floating drums attached to the sea floor with baited hooks. Conservationists say there is no proof that killing sharks will reduce shark attacks on people, because no other cull has used only drumlines. Researchers at the University of Western Australia say that more shark attacks may be happening because Western Australia’s population is growing faster than anywhere else in Australia, not because there are more sharks.

Richard Peirce, from the UK charity the Shark Trust, said the cull will not work and could bring more dangerous animals closer to the coast. He said, “What is happening in Western Australia is making the problem of shark attacks worse. It is sad that the government has ignored good advice and chosen a method that does not work and makes things worse. Even if they watch the drumlines during the day, leaving them in the water at night could attract other dangerous animals, because they are attracted by the injured sharks and other animals caught on the hooks.”

In 2012, there were 80 shark attacks worldwide. Seven of these attacks were deadly. In comparison, humans kill nearly 100 million sharks every year. RSPCA Australia says the cull is wrong. “There is no proof that more shark attacks are happening because there are more sharks. We think it is because there are more people and more people are swimming in the water,” they said.

Richard Branson said the plan is not working. “I think one reason Western Australia’s Premier, Colin Barnett, did this was to help tourism. But I think it will do the opposite. You are making a big problem out of something that is not really a problem, and you will stop people from wanting to visit Perth and the beautiful areas around it. I think all you will do is make people worry.”

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has asked the United States to fix its financial problems after the US avoided a debt default and hundreds of thousands of government workers returned to their jobs following a 16-day government shutdown.

US President Barack Obama said, “We need to stop running the government by crisis.” The IMF’s leader, Christine Lagarde, also asked for more stability. She said it is important to reduce uncertainty by raising the debt limit in a way that lasts longer. She also encouraged the US to approve a budget for 2014, to replace the automatic spending cuts (called the sequester) with slower changes that would not hurt the economic recovery, and to make a balanced, long-term financial plan.

A peace deal written by the Senate, which gave almost nothing to the conservatives who caused the crisis, was passed by the Republican-controlled House of Representatives just hours before the deadline to raise the US debt limit. The World Bank also said it was relieved that the world economy had avoided a possible disaster. Its president, Jim Yong Kim, asked leaders in all countries to keep making policies that help economic growth and create jobs and opportunities for everyone.

Stock markets in Japan, China, Hong Kong, and South Korea first showed relief after Republicans gave up their attempt to stop Obama’s healthcare reforms. However, in Asia and Europe, stock markets did not react much, as traders expected another political fight in Washington in early 2014.

The shutdown is estimated to have cost the US $24 billion, according to the ratings agency Standard & Poor’s. China’s official news agency, Xinhua, accused Washington of putting other countries’ dollar investments at risk. China is the largest lender to the US government.

Obama signed the law to prevent a default just after midnight on Thursday, after Republicans in the House of Representatives split. The bill passed easily in the Senate, with support from both Democrats and Republicans, who made the agreement together. The law is only a temporary solution: it funds the government until January 15 and raises the debt ceiling until February 7.

But Obama made it clear he did not want another difficult budget fight or shutdown in 2014. Speaking at the White House before the House vote, Obama said he hoped the deal would “lift the cloud of uncertainty” that had been over the country in recent weeks. He said, “Once this agreement arrives on my desk, I will sign it immediately. Hopefully, next time it won’t be at the last minute. We need to stop running the government by crisis.”

As he left the stage after his speech on Wednesday night, a journalist asked Obama if the crisis would happen again in a few months. Obama answered, “No.”

Earlier, Republican Senator Mike Lee spoke strongly, suggesting there could be more problems in the future. He said, “The media keeps asking: ‘Was it worth it?’ My answer is, it is always worth it to do the right thing. This is not over.”

However, the political deal was very bad for the Republicans. They did not achieve any of their goals, and polls showed that most voters blamed them for the crisis.

What does it feel like to see the last of something? To think about a special animal that will soon disappear forever? Sudan is the last male northern white rhino in the world. If he does not have a baby soon with one of the two female northern white rhinos at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya, there will never be any more northern white rhinos, male or female. But this is not likely, because Sudan is old—42 years—and all attempts to help him have babies have failed. Besides these three rhinos, there are only two other northern white rhinos left in the world. Both are females and live in zoos.

Sudan is watched and protected by armed guards who care for him. This looks like a sign of human kindness, but it is also a sign of violence. Even now, when there are so few northern white rhinos left, Sudan is still in danger from poachers. Poachers kill rhinos and cut off their horns to sell them in Asia for medicine, even though Sudan’s horn has already been removed to stop them.

Sudan does not know how important he is. His eye looks sad in his big, wrinkled face as he walks around the reserve with his guards. His head is large and strong, showing his power. But it is sad that such a strong animal can also be so weak and in danger. He lowers his head under the dark sky, as if he feels the weight of his fate. He looks like an old warrior, tired and no longer wanting to fight.

His huge shoulders and thick legs make him look like a tank. The way his front leg comes out from his thick skin reminds us that people have always been amazed by rhinos. Sudan looks much like the rhino that the artist Albrecht Dürer drew in 1515. Both have small legs and big bodies, and both lower their heads in the same thoughtful way. Dürer was a Renaissance artist who drew a rhino from faraway lands that Europeans were just starting to learn about. In 1515, a live Indian rhino was sent from the ruler of Gujarat in India to the king of Portugal, who then sent it to the Pope. But the rhino died in a shipwreck on the way.

Humans often destroy the things they love. We have done this since the Ice Age. There are beautiful pictures of woolly rhinos in caves in France, painted up to 30,000 years ago. These ancient rhinos were related to Sudan and were also big, strong, and gentle. A woolly rhino in Chauvet Cave looks young and full of life. But the same people who painted these rhinos also helped to kill them. When the climate changed at the end of the Ice Age, humans probably finished killing off the woolly rhinos with their spears.

Today, people care a lot about rhinos, but more and more are being killed. The northern white rhino is the rarest type of African rhino. There are many more southern white rhinos and black rhinos. But in some countries, people believe rhino horn can cure many illnesses, from the flu to cancer. This belief has caused more poaching. In 2007, only 13 rhinos were killed by poachers in South Africa. But by 2014, 1,215 rhinos were killed for their horns in South Africa. In 2015, the number was expected to be even higher.

The northern white rhino has almost disappeared because of hunting, even with guards and guns to protect them. Other African rhinos are also being hunted by poachers, and the problem is out of control. The Javan rhino is also close to extinction. India has managed to protect the Indian rhino after it was almost killed off by British hunters during colonial times, but poaching is still a big problem there too. Rhinos are amazing animals, but humans keep destroying them. Have we learned nothing since the Ice Age?

James Bond is the main character in one of the world’s longest and most successful film series. There are 23 Bond movies, and together they have made more than $6 billion at the global box office. James Bond movies are still very popular. After the huge success of Skyfall in 2012, the Bond brand became even stronger. Skyfall became the biggest film ever at the UK box office and earned $1.1 billion worldwide. It is now the ninth highest-earning film of all time.

Because of this, there was a lot of excitement when more details about the 24th Bond film were announced, including its official title, Spectre. The main question is: Can Spectre be as successful as Skyfall? Will Skyfall stay as the best Bond movie, or can Spectre do even better?

Charles Gant, the film editor for Heat magazine, says things look good for Spectre. He says Skyfall was a smart move because it was both modern and old-fashioned at the same time. It attracted new fans from the Daniel Craig era and also brought back older fans who liked the classic Bond movies. Gant thinks the new title, Spectre, shows that the filmmakers want to keep both older and younger Bond fans interested.

Eon Productions, the company that has made all the official Bond movies since 1961, is working hard to make Spectre as successful as Skyfall. Daniel Craig will continue to play Bond at least until the 25th movie, and the same writers are working on the script.

The return of director Sam Mendes gives fans the most hope. Mendes, known for movies like American Beauty and Revolutionary Road, has taken the Bond series to new heights. Gant says Mendes was able to connect with both new and old Bond fans and also brought in top actors like Ralph Fiennes. To get actors like Fiennes, the director must be very good.

Skyfall almost doubled the box office earnings of the previous Bond film, Quantum of Solace, which made $586 million in 2008. No one expects Spectre to double the last film’s earnings, but Eon Productions will not take success for granted.

The Bond series was not in trouble before Mendes and Craig joined, but at the end of Pierce Brosnan’s time as Bond, the movies started to feel a bit old and less exciting. The films had already stopped following the original Ian Fleming stories, and they needed new energy.

This is not unusual for Bond movies. The series has always had ups and downs, often depending on who played Bond. The actors have been Sean Connery, George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan, and now Daniel Craig. Each new actor was chosen to help the series at that time, and some were more successful than others.

Lazenby only played Bond once. Dalton made two films, The Living Daylights and Licence to Kill, during a time in the late 1980s when Hollywood action movies were more popular. Gant says that the last Roger Moore films and Dalton’s films did not excite audiences much. Brosnan’s movies did better at the box office, and Craig has taken the series to new levels. However, the early Bond films were also very popular, exciting, and different from other movies at the time.

It is important to note that, even though Skyfall made more money than any other Bond film, some Bond movies from the 1960s were almost as successful if you adjust for inflation. Thunderball, released in 1965, earned almost as much as Skyfall. Goldfinger and You Only Live Twice also did better than most of Craig’s films, as did The Spy Who Loved Me and Live and Let Die from the 1970s. Licence to Kill is the least successful Bond film, and A View to a Kill is second to last.

Even so, the Bond brand has stayed very strong over the years. Eon Productions has had to fight off other companies trying to make money from Bond’s popularity. Because of complicated rights issues, other versions of Casino Royale (in 1967) and Thunderball (as Never Say Never Again in 1983) were made by different companies. After many legal battles, Eon now controls both stories.

Casino Royale’s rights were sold by Ian Fleming in 1955 and finally went to Eon in 1999 after an agreement between MGM and Sony. This allowed Eon to make the 2006 version. Thunderball’s rights were disputed because writer-producer Kevin McClory helped Fleming create the story and claimed ownership for many years. He made Never Say Never Again because of this. After McClory died in 2006, his family settled with MGM and Eon’s parent company in 2013.

The first wave of excitement for Bond movies lasted through the 1960s and into the 1970s, but after Licence to Kill did poorly, the series almost stopped. Goldeneye, the first Brosnan film, brought new life to the series, not just because of a new actor, but also because of the director.

After a six-year break, Eon hired Martin Campbell, an experienced British director, who created one of the most exciting stunts in Bond history. In the famous opening scene of Goldeneye, Bond jumps into a pilotless plane, which helped make the series feel fresh and modern again. Also, a very popular Goldeneye video game brought Bond to a new generation and helped people see Bond movies as exciting and up-to-date.

An international agreement to make Bangladesh’s clothing factories safer is facing legal problems because factory owners want money to cover the costs of closing and repairing their factories. Some repairs will take months, and factory owners say they cannot afford to pay workers while the factories are closed, as well as pay for the expensive repairs needed to make the buildings safe. These repairs are happening after the Rana Plaza building collapsed in Dhaka, Bangladesh, in 2013, killing 1,138 people.

The problem comes as hundreds of Bangladeshi clothing factories are being checked every month for fire safety and building problems under the Accord on Fire and Building Safety in Bangladesh. This Accord is supported by more than 170 international brands, like Primark and Marks & Spencer, and international trade unions, such as IndustriALL.

The owner of a factory in Dhaka called Softex Cotton has threatened to take legal action against the Accord after his factory was closed because of building problems. He is asking for $100 million in compensation. Another factory owner, who did not want to give his name, said that if a factory closes, even for a short time, it will lose orders and may have to close forever. He said the Accord did not clearly say who should pay for the costs of closing factories, because they wanted as many brands as possible to join the agreement after the Rana Plaza disaster. He said there is no clear process for handling these costs.

Jenny Holdcroft, policy director for IndustriALL, which is involved in the Accord, said the agreement makes sure that factories will not lose orders during closure because brands have promised to keep giving them orders for two years. So far, the Accord has found 12 factories that need major repairs, but Holdcroft said many of these only need to close part of the building so work can continue on other floors. The Accord also legally requires brands to make sure workers are paid during factory closures. She said the agreement did not say exactly who should pay, so that factory owners who can afford it will help pay for repairs and workers’ compensation.

She said, “This was always going to be something to discuss. Brands do not want to pay so that rich factory owners, who have made money for years without fixing their factories, can keep doing that. There was always going to be some problems. If there were no problems, nothing would change.” A spokesman for the Accord said that arguments about payments and legal action would not stop their work to make factories safer.

However, there is more pressure on the Accord to help pay workers who lose their jobs during repairs because another group, the Alliance for Bangladesh Worker Safety, which is supported by US retailers like Walmart and Gap, has set aside $5 million to help pay workers for up to two months while their factories are being repaired. So far, the Alliance has found five factories in four buildings where work needs to stop.

Shaidullah Azim, a director of the Bangladeshi Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association, said, “The Alliance is sharing workers’ salaries with factory owners, so now there is confusion. We had a big meeting with the Accord to tell them they need to help, or how can we support our workers?”

Oxfam says that the huge wealth of the world’s 100 richest billionaires is making inequality worse and stopping the world from fighting poverty. The charity explains that these billionaires are getting richer in ways that often hurt poor people, such as by not providing secure jobs or good wages. This makes it harder for people who live on aid or low pay to improve their lives and escape poverty.

Oxfam says that if the richest 100 billionaires gave away the money they earned in 2012, it would be enough to end extreme poverty four times over. In 2012, these billionaires made $240 billion. Oxfam does not blame any one person, but says this money could help the world’s poorest people many times.

Usually, charities do not criticize rich people because they often give money to good causes. For example, Bill Gates and Warren Buffett are two of 40 American billionaires who have promised to give away much of their wealth to help others. However, there is not much information about how much they give each year, and billionaires from Russia, the Middle East, or China have not made similar promises.

Oxfam’s report, called The Cost of Inequality: How Wealth and Income Extremes Hurt Us All, was published before the World Economic Forum in Davos. The report asks world leaders to reduce extreme differences in income and to bring inequality back to the levels seen in 1990.

The report found that the richest 1% of people have increased their incomes by 60% in the last 20 years. The financial crisis made this happen even faster. Barbara Stocking, Oxfam’s Chief Executive, said that extreme wealth is bad for the economy, politics, society, and the environment. She said that when workers get a smaller share of the total income, countries have less investment and slower growth. She also said that we cannot keep believing that making a few people rich will help everyone else, because often the opposite happens.

The report says that inequality is a problem everywhere. In the UK, inequality is now as high as it was in the 1800s. In China, the richest 10% take almost 60% of all income. China’s inequality is now similar to South Africa, which is the most unequal country in the world and is even more unequal than it was at the end of apartheid.

In the US, the share of national income going to the top 1% has doubled since 1980, from 10% to 20%. For the richest 0.01%, their share is now higher than it was in the 1920s.

The World Bank and International Monetary Fund say that extreme income inequality is bad for economic growth. They have tried to make their loans depend on countries having programs to reduce inequality.

The richest 1% are estimated to use up to 10,000 times more carbon than the average American.

Oxfam says world leaders should learn from countries like Brazil, which has grown quickly while also reducing inequality.

Barbara Stocking said that the world needs a new global agreement to undo years of growing inequality. As a first step, she says world leaders should promise to reduce inequality to the levels seen in 1990. She also said that closing tax havens, which may hold up to $31 trillion (about one third of all global wealth), could bring in $189 billion more in tax money.

David Cameron said there was a “clear result” in the Scottish independence referendum. Scotland voted by a margin of 10.6 points to stay in the 307-year-old union with England and Wales. The prime minister promised big changes in how Great Britain is governed. He said English MPs would vote on English issues in Westminster, and welcomed Scotland’s choice to stay in the UK. Cameron said, “There can be no disputes, no reruns – we have heard the settled will of the Scottish people.”

Earlier, Scotland’s first minister, Alex Salmond, spoke at a sad Scottish National Party rally in Edinburgh. He said he accepted that Scotland had not chosen independence “at this stage.” He called the vote a “triumph for democratic politics” and said he would work with Westminster for the good of Scotland and the UK. He warned the leaders of the three main parties to keep their promises to give Scotland more powers. “We have reached people who have never been interested in politics before,” he said.

The yes campaign had four big wins, getting 53% of the vote in Glasgow, 57% in Dundee, and 51% in North Lanarkshire. But the no campaign won in 28 areas. It did very well in places like Edinburgh, Aberdeenshire, and the Borders, and also won in places that could have voted yes, like the Western Isles. In the end, the no side got 2,001,926 votes (55.3%) and the yes side got 1,617,989 votes (44.7%).

In his speech, Cameron said that changes to the constitution, including in Scotland, would happen after the general election. He said changes for Scotland would happen at the same time as changes for England. “We have heard the voice of Scotland and, now, the millions of voices of England must be heard,” he said.

Cameron also said, “The people of Scotland have spoken and it is a clear result. They have kept our country of four nations together and, like millions of other people, I am delighted. As I said during the campaign, it would have broken my heart to see our United Kingdom come to an end. I know many people here and around the world feel the same because of what we have achieved together and what we can do together in the future. Now, it is time for our United Kingdom to come together and move forward. A big part of that will be a fair agreement for people in Scotland and also for everyone in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.”

Ed Miliband, the Labour leader, said the referendum showed that Scottish people want change. “We know our country needs to change in how it is governed and who it is governed for. We will give stronger powers to the Scottish parliament, a strong Scotland.” He said this change would also happen in England, Wales, and the whole UK.

Nick Clegg, the deputy prime minister, said the referendum “marks not only a new chapter for Scotland within the UK but also wider constitutional reform across the union.” He agreed with the SNP that a vote against independence was “clearly not a vote against change.” He said, “We must now deliver on time and in full the radical package of newly devolved powers to Scotland.”

However, the result could cause more problems. Some MPs from Cameron’s Conservative Party threatened to rebel against his promise to quickly give more powers to the Scottish parliament while protecting its spending.

Nigel Farage, leader of the UK Independence Party, said Cameron’s offer of more powers for England was not enough. “The English are 86% of this union by population. They have been left out for the last 18 years. We still have a situation where Scottish MPs can vote in the House of Commons on English-only issues. I think most English people want a fair agreement,” he said.

Cameron and the Queen will both try to calm tensions by making statements about the result. The prime minister will try to make the no vote stronger by explaining how he will give more powers over tax and welfare to the Scottish Parliament in Edinburgh.

The Queen, who has watched the referendum closely, will make a written statement. It is believed her words will focus on bringing people together. The prime minister wants to act quickly to show that the three main UK party leaders will keep their promises made during the campaign to give Scotland more control, which former prime minister Gordon Brown called “home rule” within the UK.

Ministers think it is important to move fast to avoid what happened after the 1980 referendum in Québec. There, the way Ontario acted made separatists stronger, and they almost won a second referendum in 1995.

For the no campaign, there was relief. In the last days of the campaign, many polls showed the vote was very close, and Yes Scotland almost won after a big increase in support.

Anitta is Brazil’s newest funk music star. She has become very popular by bringing the music of the favelas (poor neighborhoods) to the mainstream. However, there is a debate about her skin color.

Some anti-discrimination activists and social commentators say that Anitta had to give up her black identity to become successful with Brazil’s mostly white, middle-class audience. This debate started after people saw photos of Anitta from before and after she became famous. In the first photo, when she was not well-known, her skin looked darker. In the second photo, taken after she signed with Warner and became famous, her skin looked lighter. Some people think this change is because of skin whitening products or cosmetic surgery, but it is more likely due to Photoshop. This difference has started a new discussion about whether people need to have lighter skin to succeed in Brazil.

Jarid Arraes, a psychology student and blogger, wrote a post criticizing the hidden racism in the media and marketing. She said that Anitta’s lighter image shows that Brazilian society does not really support diversity. She explained that in Brazil, white is seen as rich, successful, and good, while black is seen as the opposite.

Anitta’s real name is Larissa de Macedo Machado. As a child, she sang in a church choir. In her teenage years, she became known in Rio de Janeiro’s baile funk scene as a dancer and singer. Now, she is very famous, with a hit album and a popular song, “Show das Poderosas,” which was number one on the charts and got 52 million views on YouTube.

Anitta is loved as a pop star with a strong message and catchy songs. Her supporters say she connects the mostly black and mixed-race people in the favelas with the richer, whiter people in the city. She has made her music and image less sexual and less focused on gangs, to appeal to a wider audience. Now, some people wonder if she or her marketing team have changed her image too much to attract richer fans. Arraes said that pop stars with curly hair feel forced to straighten it, and those with big noses feel forced to get nose surgery. She said this creates a bad cycle for self-esteem.

This is a sensitive issue in Brazil, which has a mixed-race population. Brazil was one of the last countries to end slavery and has the largest African-descended population outside Africa. In Brazil, skin color is more important than race or ancestry. Even though Brazil wants to be a multiracial democracy, there is a clear link between skin color and inequality.

In Brazilian cities, white workers earn about twice as much as black workers. Until 2011, black or mixed-race students also spent two years less in school on average. The government says this gap is getting smaller because of university quotas and other programs, but the difference is still very clear. Most business and government leaders are white, while most low-paid jobs are done by black and mixed-race people. In rich neighborhoods, it is common to see black nannies with white children, but not the other way around.

Defining color in Brazil is complicated. In the 2010 census, people who called themselves white were a minority for the first time. Out of 197 million people, 82 million said they were “pardo” (mixed race), 15 million black, two million Asian, and 0.5% indigenous.

Sylvio Ferreira, a psychology teacher at the Federal University of Pernambuco, thinks Anitta became popular with the middle class by making rebellious music more acceptable to everyone. He does not think this happened because of racial whitening, but because Anitta moved from the poor areas to the center of society.

Others also think the issue of color is exaggerated. Maycon de Mattos Batista, a financial analyst who worked with Anitta, said her image changed a lot, but not her color. He thinks the change is because of makeup, hair styling, and clothes, not because of pressure. He said Anitta always liked to perform, and her success is because she is naturally talented.

Leandro Silva de Souza, a racial equality activist in Salvador, said the problem is not with society, but with music producers and media bosses. He said the public cares about music itself, as shown when Ellen Oléria, a black lesbian, won the talent show The Voice Brazil.

The Guardian could not contact Anitta for comment. But in a recent interview, she said that people should define their own identity. She said, “A powerful woman does not need to be beautiful, but she has so much attitude that she is wonderful and powerful. I try to show in my work that we can be whoever we want.”

He arrived in 2005 and called himself “a simple, humble worker in God’s vineyard.” On a cold, windy Monday in February, Pope Benedict XVI ended his time as Pope in the same way: like an old worker who can no longer ignore his back pain or rely on his strength. As usual for this very traditional Pope, he spoke in Latin. He was the first German Pope in modern times and planned his resignation carefully. He told the cardinals in the Vatican, “From 28 February 2013, at 8:00 p.m., the seat of Rome, the seat of Saint Peter, will be empty, and a meeting to choose the new Pope must be called by those who are responsible.”

One of the people there was Monsignor Oscar Sanchéz Barba from Guadalajara, Mexico. He was in Rome to hear the date for a canonization he was involved in. He said, “We were all in the Sala del Concistoro in the Apostolic Palace. After giving the date for the canonization, the twelfth of May, the Pope took a piece of paper and read from it.”

“We were all left…” Sanchéz Barba searched for the right word, standing in St Peter’s Square, as speechless as the cardinals who had just heard the man they believe is God’s representative on earth give up his position. “The cardinals were just looking at each other,” he said.

Angelo Sodano, the Dean of the College of Cardinals, who probably knew in advance, gave a short and maybe quickly written speech. He told the Pope that the cardinals listened “with a sense of bewilderment, almost completely incredulous.” After his speech, the Pope blessed everyone and left. “It was so simple; the simplest thing imaginable,” said Sanchéz Barba. “Then we all left in silence. There was absolute silence… and sadness.”

John Thavis, who reported on the Vatican for 30 years and has a book coming out called The Vatican Diaries, said he had a feeling the Pope might resign and returned to Rome from the US for this reason. Another Vatican expert confirmed this. Thavis remembered that in a long interview published as Light of the World in 2010, Benedict said he thought it would be right to leave if he felt he could not do the job anymore. Thavis said, “I asked myself: if I were Pope and wanted to resign, when would I choose? He has finished his books and most of his projects. Also, there were no events in his calendar that he had to attend. I thought the most likely date was 22 February, the Feast of the Chair of St Peter. So I got it wrong.”

Soon after the announcement, the Vatican said the Pope’s decision was brave. According to this view, Benedict, who was never afraid to make surprising decisions, wanted the Church to face reality: that modern medicine can keep people alive long after they are able to run a huge global organization. Thavis agreed: “What I find especially brave is that he is leaving now, when he is not sick, and he is doing it because he is tired, not because he is very ill.” But is that the whole story? Does he know more about his health than the Vatican has said?

Benedict explained that he thought about both his physical and mental health: “To lead the Church and spread the Gospel, you need strength of mind and body, strength which in the last few months has become weaker in me, so I have had to admit I cannot do the job well enough.” Other ideas will probably be discussed in the Vatican in the coming days and weeks, just as they were after Pope John Paul I died in 1978, only 33 days after becoming Pope. Some people are already guessing that something about Benedict’s past was about to be revealed. The Vatican will surely deny these ideas strongly. But these thoughts are understandable, because what Benedict has done is extremely important.

After leaving St Peter’s Basilica, Julia Rochester from London, who said she was a lapsed Catholic, was still thinking about what the Pope’s resignation meant. “If you’re God’s chosen one, how do you choose not to be chosen?” she wondered. Many Catholics will be asking their priests this question in the coming weeks. In his first speech as Pope, Benedict said he was not sure he was good enough for the job, but he was comforted because he believed God could work even with weak tools. It seems that, after eight years, he stopped believing that was true.

The roof of the school is made of plastic and is supported by a crooked tree trunk. The desks are just a mix of old chairs, but the students at Chemin des Dunes school study very hard, just like students at Oxford University. They hope to start a new life in France.

Kamal, a refugee from Darfur in Sudan, says, “The French language is very difficult, but we try hard. If we come every day, maybe we can reach our dreams.” Kamal comes to class for three or four hours every day. He says, “It’s good to keep your brain active.”

Kamal is 29 years old and used to be an electrical engineer. He is one of many refugees living in the “jungle” camp outside Calais. They have asked for asylum in France and want to learn French, the language of their possible new home.

Kamal and other students feel upset that the media only talks about people in the camp who try to secretly travel to the UK by hiding in trucks or trains. Kamal says, “I want people in the UK to know that not everyone wants to go there. Many people here want to stay in France.”

According to the United Nations, France already has more than 250,000 refugees. This is more than twice as many as the UK, even though both countries have about the same number of people. There are also 56,000 people waiting for their asylum requests to be processed in France, which is the second highest number in Europe. In the UK, there are 36,000 people waiting.

While they wait for an answer, France does not give asylum seekers any money or let them work. The process can take many months. The jungle camp gives them one free meal a day and a plastic roof, so many people choose to stay in these simple conditions for a few more months instead of risking their asylum request by working illegally.

The idea for the school started at the beginning of the summer. Some people were bored of waiting and worried about starting a new life in France without knowing the language. The school opened on July 11.

Zimarco Jones, from Nigeria, started the school. He arrived in Calais in 2013 and is still waiting for his asylum request to be processed. He says, “We made the school to bring the ‘brothers’ together and to help them learn French. Now, we need to build another one.”

The small classroom sometimes has 30 students, sitting in five rows in front of a big green chalkboard and pictures of cartoon animals for each letter of the French alphabet. There are also classes in English, art, and t’ai chi, but most people come for the French lessons, which are taught by volunteers from Calais and other places.

George, another refugee from Darfur, says, “French is not as easy as English, but two weeks ago, I decided I would not try to go to the UK.” He speaks English well, but now he is happy to stay in France because of the language classes. He says, “Anywhere there is peace, I can stay, no problem.” He often waits at the classroom more than half an hour before the teachers arrive.

George says he does not know much about France, but the classes are helping him learn about the country and the language.

Many volunteers at the school are local teachers who give up their summer holidays to help. Jenny Flahaut, 33, works at a children’s home. She decided to volunteer after seeing an ad on Facebook. She says, “I saw these people in Calais every day and wanted to help them.”

Jenny feels upset about how the media and politicians talk about migrants, especially people like David Cameron, the British prime minister, who called them “swarms” in a speech. She says, “They don’t know these people and have a bad opinion, but they are not like that. Most are very good people. They are welcoming and friendly. They want to improve their lives, and learning is part of that.”

The teachers and Zimarco now want to make a separate classroom for about 200 women and 24 children. There are about ten men for every woman in the camp, and most women do not feel comfortable going to class with men they do not know.

When that classroom is finished, Zimarco, who used to work in a hotel, has more plans to make the camp a better place to live. People in the camp call the school “Zimarco’s school.” He wants to start a football team for migrants and even wants to change the camp’s name. He does not like the name “the jungle” because it makes people think the residents are not human.

He says, “We have a discotheque, a house, a mosque, a school, shops. We are not animals.”

In Canada’s Arctic, summer days are very long, with sunlight for more than 20 hours each day. Some people enjoy this after the dark winter, but for the small and growing Muslim community in Iqaluit, Nunavut, it is difficult during Ramadan. During Ramadan, Muslims usually fast from sunrise to sunset.

Abdul Karim, 29, moved from Ottawa to Iqaluit in 2011. He is one of the few people in the city who fasts according to the Arctic sun. This year, he eats his pre-dawn meal at about 1:30am before the sun rises and breaks his fast at about 11pm when the sun sets. He says he will only stop fasting if it hurts his health, but he jokes that he is healthy enough to continue.

As Ramadan ends, Muslims around the world focus on community work, prayer, and reflection. This is the same in the Arctic, but the long days mean Muslims there must change how they fast. Most Muslims in Iqaluit follow the fasting times of Ottawa, which is about 1,300 miles south. Muslim scholars advise people in the far north to use the timetable of Mecca or the nearest Muslim city. This still means fasting for about 18 hours a day, says Atif Jilani, who moved from Toronto to Iqaluit in 2015. He says the days are long, but it is easier than following the local sun.

Many of the 100 Muslims in Iqaluit break their fast together in the city’s new mosque, which was finished in February when temperatures were as low as -50°C with wind chill. They eat traditional foods like dates and goat or lamb curries, even though the sun is still shining through the windows.

This happens in other northern Canadian mosques too. In Yellowknife, Northwest Territories, there are about 300 Muslims. Nazim Awan, president of the Yellowknife Islamic Centre, says people have several options for fasting. Some exceptions are made for pregnant or sick people. Some people try to fast for 23 hours, but most follow the times of nearby cities or Mecca and Medina. Recently, most people in Yellowknife use the Ramadan timetable of Edmonton, Alberta. Awan, who has two children, including a 12-year-old who just started fasting, follows Mecca’s times. He wants his son to have an easier fast of about 15 hours, instead of 18 hours in Edmonton.

Awan jokes that if he fasted using Yellowknife or Edmonton times, his son would think he was crazy. In Inuvik, a small town 125 miles north of the Arctic Circle, about 100 Muslims also follow Edmonton’s timetable. Ahmad Alkhalaf says, “We currently have 24 hours a day of sun. There’s no sunrise or sunset.”

When Alkhalaf moved from Toronto to Inuvik in 2001, the community was already using Edmonton’s schedule. His first Ramadan there was in December, when it is dark all day and night, so they used Edmonton time. He says it can be hard to follow the clock instead of the sun. Usually, Muslims break their fast at dusk, but in Inuvik, they eat while the sun is still up. The Muslim community in Inuvik tries to mix Ramadan with local culture. Their iftar meal includes dates, curries, and local game like reindeer, prepared according to Islamic law. “We make soup or curry with reindeer instead of beef,” he says.

In Iqaluit, as Ramadan ends, some people think this year has been especially hard because the days are so long. This is true for people like Karim, who fast according to the local sunrise and sunset. But Karim says his effort will be rewarded in the future because Ramadan moves each year with the lunar calendar. One day, Ramadan will be in winter, when the sun rises and sets within a few hours. He laughs and says he will follow those short hours too.

The Senate Intelligence Committee has approved a bill that would make the National Security Agency’s (NSA) collection of US phone records more open to the public, but would still allow the NSA to keep collecting this data. The bill, led by Chairwoman Dianne Feinstein, lets the NSA continue to collect phone metadata from millions of Americans for 90 days at a time, and the government can keep this data. Some lawmakers suggested that phone companies should keep the metadata instead. The committee passed the bill with 11 votes in favor and 4 against, so now the full Senate will vote on it.

The bill allows NSA analysts to search the data if they have a “reasonable suspicion” that someone is linked to international terrorism. It also lets the NSA keep watching foreigners who come into the US for up to 72 hours, if the surveillance started while they were outside the country.

This bill is different from another bill by Senator Patrick Leahy, which would stop the collection of Americans’ phone records. Senator Mark Udall, a top member of the Intelligence Committee, opposed the bill, saying it does not do enough. He said, “The NSA’s invasive surveillance of Americans’ private information does not respect our constitutional values and needs fundamental reform, not small changes. The bill passed by the Senate Intelligence Committee does not go far enough to fix the NSA’s overreaching domestic surveillance programs.”

Another committee member, Ron Wyden, said the bill keeps things the same and is not real reform. Feinstein defended the NSA’s collection program, saying it is legal and watched closely by Congress and the courts, and that it helps national security. She also said more should be done to make the program more open and to protect privacy.

Feinstein said the bill would also improve transparency and oversight of the NSA by:
- Requiring a yearly public report on how many times the NSA’s phone metadata database is searched, and how often it leads to an FBI investigation or a court order.
- Requiring the foreign intelligence surveillance court to limit how many NSA staff can approve or search the call-records database.
- Creating criminal penalties of up to ten years in prison for anyone who intentionally accesses data without permission under the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA).
- Requiring the FISA court to limit how many contacts an analyst can get from a search of bulk communication records.

After the committee meeting, Feinstein strongly supported the NSA’s main domestic program. She told reporters that people misunderstand the NSA database program and that it is very important for protecting the country.

Some legal experts are worried about the committee’s bill. They said there will now be a conflict with the USA Freedom Act, a bill by Leahy and Jim Sensenbrenner, which would stop the bulk collection of Americans’ phone records.

Elizabeth Goitein from the Brennan Center for Justice said, “The Intelligence Committee bill and the USA Freedom Act show two different ideas about how the government should treat law-abiding Americans. The main question is: should the government need a reason to suspect someone before collecting Americans’ private information? Leahy and Sensenbrenner say yes; Feinstein says no.” Wyden said that recent news about NSA spying on foreign leaders has taken attention away from the real issue of mass surveillance of Americans. He said, “My top priority is ending the mass digital surveillance of millions of law-abiding Americans.”

Feinstein also said she is “totally opposed” to the NSA spying on foreign leaders like German Chancellor Angela Merkel, even though she supports the NSA’s collection of Americans’ phone records.

Wyden said, “Americans are making it clear that they never agreed to give up their constitutional rights for the appearance of security. We will keep fighting this battle. It will be a long one.”

Feinstein also said that James Clapper, the Director of National Intelligence, agreed to give her a written statement about a Washington Post story that said the NSA had intercepted data between Google and Yahoo data centers. She said she would wait to see Clapper’s response before making a judgment. Her strong support for collecting domestic phone records shows that she is not ready to criticize the NSA more, even though she now opposes spying on foreign allied leaders.

Wyden did not comment on the Washington Post report about Google and Yahoo. But he said that spying on foreigners could now affect Americans’ privacy because global communications are more connected. He said, “Decades ago, countries had their own communication systems. Now, with global communications, there will be more challenges with spying on foreigners that could affect US citizens.”

Noise from passing ships may disturb animals like killer whales and dolphins much more than we thought before. New research shows that this noise can make it harder for these animals to talk to each other and find food. The low sound from ships has been known to bother large whales for a long time. But now, US researchers have found that ships also make noise at medium and high frequencies, including at 20,000Hz, which is the frequency killer whales, or orcas, hear best.

This noise could make it difficult for killer whales to communicate and use echolocation. Echolocation is when whales use sound to find objects like prey. Dolphins and porpoises, which also use high frequencies, may have the same problems. The research suggests that this noise could hurt the endangered killer whales that live near busy shipping lanes. There are only 84 killer whales that hunt along the US west coast and in Puget Sound.

Scott Veirs of Beamreach, who led the research, said, “Even a small increase in sound can make echolocation harder for whales. This is worrying because their main food, chinook salmon, is already rare. Hearing the sound from a salmon is one of the hardest things a killer whale does, and it gets even harder with more noise.”

The researchers used underwater microphones to measure the noise from about 1,600 ships passing through Haro Strait in Washington State. The study lasted two years and recorded sounds from 12 types of ships, including cruise ships, container ships, and military ships. About 20 ships passed through the strait each day.

Some ships are quieter than others, but the average noise next to all ships was 173 underwater decibels, which is like 111 decibels in the air—the same as a loud rock concert. Whales are usually not right next to ships, so they hear noise between 60 and 90 decibels, which is about as loud as a lawnmower or vacuum cleaner.

Veirs said that scientists already know underwater noise affects baleen whales, which are the largest animals on Earth. But this new research shows that smaller whales, dolphins, and porpoises are also at risk. He explained, “Ships were thought to make only low-frequency noise, like trucks or trains. Most noise is low-frequency, but the ocean’s background noise is also higher at high frequencies. This could be a big problem that we need to study more.”

A noisy ocean can cause several problems. Whales may have to stay closer together to hear each other. If they cannot find food easily, they will use up their fat stores, called blubber. This is a problem because blubber often contains manmade chemicals that are poisonous to whales if released into their bodies.

Veirs said more research is needed to see how much noise affects whales and to make ships quieter. “It should be easy to reduce noise pollution,” he said. “Military ships are much quieter, and we could use their technology for commercial ships. Another way to reduce noise is to slow down. If ships go six knots slower, the noise could be cut in half.”

Some whale species, like humpbacks and blue whales, are doing better now that whaling has decreased. But other whales are still in danger from many threats. The US government recently protected almost 40,000 square miles of the Atlantic Ocean to help save the North Atlantic right whale, which has only about 500 left.

In Europe, killer whales have very high levels of banned chemicals called PCBs in their blubber. Scientists are still trying to find out if pollution caused the deaths of five sperm whales that washed up on the east coast of Britain in January 2016. Around Australia, whales face more danger from ship strikes, oil and gas drilling, and Japan’s recent decision to start whaling again in Antarctic waters.

The lottery balls have dropped, and all six numbers match. Now it’s time to buy that Audi, book a holiday in the US, and call the estate agent. This is what most lottery millionaires do, according to a study about how jackpot winners spend and invest their money.

Since the lottery started in 1994, it has made 3,000 people millionaires. Together, they have won more than £8.5 billion, with each winner getting about £2.8 million on average. Because of their winnings, they have also helped create 3,780 more millionaires among their children, family, and friends, according to Oxford Economics, the authors of the study.

Most winners (59%) stop working right away, but 19% keep their jobs, and 31% do unpaid volunteer work. Almost all the money (98%) that winners spend stays in the UK. By spending on houses, cars, and holidays, each winner helps keep six people in full-time jobs for a year.

Winners have added almost £750 million to the UK’s gross domestic product (GDP) and have paid more than £500 million in taxes. Most of the money goes to property, with £2.72 billion spent on main homes and £170 million used to pay off debts and mortgages.

Keeping their income safe is important to winners, so they have spent £2.125 billion on investments. They have given £1.17 billion as gifts to family and friends, and spent £680 million on cars and holidays.

The study was done by Camelot, the company that runs the UK National Lottery, to celebrate 3,000 winners. It was based on research from 100 people who won more than £1 million. The study found that the 3,000 winners have bought 7,958 houses or flats in the UK, which is about 2.7 homes each, spending £3.3 billion. Most winners (82%) moved to a new main home, spending an average of £900,000.

Many new homes have special features. Almost a third (29%) of winners bought a hot tub. A walk-in wardrobe was important for 28%. Nearly a quarter (24%) chose a home with electric gates, 22% wanted a games room, and 7% put in a snooker table.

Bigger homes need more care. About 30% of winners hired a cleaner, and 24% hired a gardener. A small number (5%) hired a beautician.

For cars, 16% of winners chose Audis. Range Rovers and BMWs were also popular (11% each), as well as Mercedes (10%) and Land Rovers (5%). Winners spent £463 million on 17,190 cars, with their favorite cars costing an average of £46,116.

Holidays are also important. Most winners (68%) stay in five-star hotels abroad. The US is the top choice for 27% of winners, followed by the Caribbean (9%). In the UK, caravan sales have also gone up. In the last 18 years, 10% of millionaires have bought a caravan, spending about £7.4 million.

Some winners (15%) have started their own businesses, 9% have helped others start businesses, and 6% have invested in or bought other people’s businesses. Businesses started or supported by lottery winners employ 3,195 people.

Andy Logan, the author of the report, said: “The effect of a win is bigger than we thought. It changes the lives of friends and family, and each win has a clear effect on the UK economy, especially because so much is spent in the UK. Each win creates a ripple effect that can last for this generation and often the next.”

DNA from the wisdom tooth of a European hunter-gatherer has given scientists a new look at modern humans before farming began. This man, who lived in Spain about 7,000 years ago, had blue eyes, black or brown hair, and dark skin, according to his DNA. 

He probably could not digest milk (lactose intolerant) and had more trouble eating starchy foods than the farmers who came later. When farming started, people and animals lived closer together, and humans developed stronger immune systems to fight new diseases from animals. However, scientists may have thought farming changed the immune system more than it really did. Tests on the hunter-gatherer’s DNA showed he already had gene changes that helped fight many diseases. Some of these gene changes are still found in Europeans today. “Before we started, I had some ideas about what we would find,” said Carles Lalueza-Fox, who led the study in Barcelona. “Most of those ideas were completely wrong.”

The Spanish team began their work after cavers found two skeletons in a deep cave in the Cantabrian Mountains in northwest Spain in 2006. The skeletons, from two men in their early 30s, were very well preserved because of the cool cave. Carbon dating showed the remains were about 7,000 years old, before farming reached Europe from the Middle East. This matched with old objects found at the site, like reindeer teeth with holes, which were worn as decorations.

The scientists focused on the better-preserved skeleton. After several tries, they managed to rebuild the man’s whole genome from DNA in a wisdom tooth. This is the first time scientists have gotten the complete genome of a European who lived before farming began.

The DNA results were surprising. Lalueza-Fox found that, instead of light skin, the man had genes for much darker skin. “This man had to be darker than any modern European, but we don’t know exactly how dark,” he said.

Another surprise was that the man had blue eyes. This was unexpected because scientists thought the gene for blue eyes appeared after the gene for light skin. The results suggest blue eyes came first in Europe, and lighter skin developed later, during the Mesolithic period.

Because of these findings, artists may need to change how they draw ancient people. “You often see pictures of these people with light skin, looking like modern Europeans. You never see a Mesolithic hunter-gatherer with dark skin and blue eyes,” Lalueza-Fox said.

The Spanish team also compared the hunter-gatherer’s DNA to modern Europeans from different places. They found the ancient DNA was most similar to people living in northern Europe, especially Sweden and Finland.

Finding immune system gene changes in this ancient man suggests that not all changes in European immunity genes came from farming. Some of these changes are much older. “We don’t know what diseases affected these people,” said Lalueza-Fox.

Martin Jones, a professor at Cambridge University, said the immunity genes were the most interesting result. “There is a simple story that moving from hunting and gathering to farming was bad for our health at first. Many things caused this, like living close together with people and animals, having less variety in food, and sharing water. The authors are showing that diseases were already important before farming, and that is interesting.”

This is what happens to modern chemists: you wait a long time for a new element, and then four appear at once. Scientists from Japan, Russia, and the US discovered these four new elements. They are the first new elements added to the periodic table since 2011, when elements 114 and 116 were included. The new elements do not last long and are very radioactive. They complete the seventh row of the periodic table, which means science textbooks around the world are now out of date.

The International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC), which is the main group that decides chemical names and rules, confirmed the new elements on December 30, 2015. They checked studies going back to 2004. The scientists who discovered the elements now need to choose official names to replace the temporary Latin names: ununtrium, ununpentium, ununseptium, and ununoctium. These names are based on their atomic numbers: 113, 115, 117, and 118. The atomic number is the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.

IUPAC said that a team of Russian and American scientists at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna and the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in California had enough proof to claim the discovery of elements 115, 117, and 118. For element 113, which was also claimed by the Russians and Americans, IUPAC gave credit to a Japanese team from the RIKEN Institute. This means Japan is the first Asian country to name an element. According to IUPAC rules, new elements can be named after mythological ideas, minerals, places or countries, or scientists.

When elements 114 and 116 got their official names in 2012, they were called flerovium and livermorium. These names come from the Flerov Lab in Dubna and the Lawrence Livermore Lab in the US, where the elements were discovered. Kosuke Morita, the leader of the RIKEN team, said his group now plans to search for element 119 and beyond. Jan Reedijk, president of the Inorganic Chemistry Division of IUPAC, said that chemists are excited to see the periodic table finally complete its seventh row.

The Japanese team is thinking about three possible names for ununtrium: japonium, rikenium, and nishinarium. Nishinarium is named after the Nishina Center for Accelerator-Based Science, where the element was found. Polly Arnold, a chemistry professor at Edinburgh University, said the team has probably been thinking about the name for a long time. She said this careful work helps us understand nature, radioactive decay, and can help us deal with nuclear waste. It also leads to new technology for making these discoveries.

The scientists also need to suggest two-letter symbols for the new elements. After IUPAC gets their suggestions, the names and symbols will be open for public review for five months. This gives scientists and others a chance to object if they have a problem with the names. For example, in 1996, the symbol Cp was suggested for copernicium (element 112), but it was changed to Cn because Cp was already used for another substance.

To find the new elements, scientists at the three labs smashed lighter atomic nuclei together and looked for special radioactive decays that would show a new element was made. Ununtrium and ununpentium are probably metals. Ununseptium might be a metalloid, which means it has some properties of metals. The fourth element, ununoctium, could be a noble gas, like helium, neon, and argon. It is hard to know for sure because only a few atoms of each element have ever been made.

Paul Karol, the head of the IUPAC group that checked the new elements, said that for now, nuclear scientists will use these discoveries to better understand the structure and stability of very heavy atomic nuclei. They are looking for the "island of stability," which might be around element 120 or 126. Elements in this area might last long enough for scientists to study their chemistry in detail. However, practical uses for the new elements are far away because they are very hard to make.

Prince Harry has left Afghanistan after a four-month tour. During this time, he said he killed insurgents while flying his Apache helicopter. He also talked openly about the stress and problems of being a royal who wants a normal life away from the public eye.

Harry said he does not trust some parts of the media and does not like how they report on him. He also said his father often tells him to act more like a royal. As a commander of the army’s advanced attack helicopter, Harry said he fired at the Taliban to help ground troops and to rescue injured Afghan and NATO soldiers. He said most of the time, the helicopter was used to scare the enemy rather than attack. Harry said he was just doing his job, but his comments might make insurgents more angry at Britain.

While at Camp Bastion in Helmand Province, Harry gave several interviews. He talked about how hard it is to balance his different roles. In the army, he is called Captain Wales. He explained that he has “three mes”: one in the army, one in his private life, and one with his family. He said he changes between these roles when needed.
