Harry admitted that sometimes he behaves badly, which he thinks is because he acts “too much like a soldier and not enough like a prince.” He said he deserves privacy too.

Harry also strongly criticized the media, especially the Sun, the Daily Mail, and the Daily Telegraph, which usually support the royal family. He was upset by articles that compared his job as an Apache co-pilot to Spitfire pilots in World War II. He said, “No, it’s not like that at all.”

Harry said he does not trust the media because of how they treated his family when he was a child. Still, he reads stories about himself. He said, “Of course I read them. If something is written about me, I want to know what it says. But it just makes me upset and angry that people can write such things and get away with it—not just about me, but about everyone. My father always says, ‘Don’t read it.’ Everyone says, ‘Don’t read it, because it’s always rubbish.’”

Harry was sent to Afghanistan last September to command a £45 million Apache helicopter, one of the army’s most advanced and powerful aircraft. During his tour, the Apaches helped NATO troops fighting the Taliban and flew with British and American medical helicopters to evacuate injured people.

Four years ago, Harry had to leave Afghanistan quickly during his first tour because an Australian magazine broke a media ban. This time, the Ministry of Defence told the public about his deployment, but asked newspapers and TV not to report on his daily life so he could do his job. Crews from the BBC, Sky, and ITN each visited once to report, and a photographer and reporter from the Press Association joined all three visits.

When asked if he feels more comfortable as Captain Wales than as Prince Harry, he said this shows a lot about his relationship with his father, Prince Charles. He said, “Definitely. I’ve always been like that. My father always tries to remind me who I am. But it’s easy to forget when I’m in the army. Everyone wears the same uniform and does the same job. I get along with the guys and I enjoy my work. It’s really that simple.”

Just before going to Afghanistan, Harry was in the news again when photos came out of him naked at a private party in Las Vegas. Harry said he let himself and others down, but also blamed the media. He said, “I probably let myself down, my family down, and other people down. But I was in a private place and should have had some privacy. It was probably a classic example of me being too much like a soldier and not enough like a prince. It’s as simple as that.

“The newspapers knew I was going to Afghanistan, so the way they treated me was not acceptable.” He added, “Some people remind me, ‘Remember who you are, so don’t always let your guard down.’”

When asked why he and his brother like helicopters, he said, “Probably because only a few people can fit in a helicopter, so no one can follow us, like you reporters.”

A new scientific study says that if climate change is not controlled, temperatures will rise to the highest levels predicted. The lead scientist, Professor Steven Sherwood from the University of New South Wales in Australia, said that if greenhouse gas emissions are not reduced, the Earth will warm by at least 4°C by the year 2100. This is twice as high as what world governments consider dangerous.

The study found that as the planet gets warmer, fewer clouds form. This means less sunlight is reflected back into space, causing temperatures to rise even more. How clouds affect global warming has been the biggest unknown in predicting future climate change. Professor Sherwood said the study is important because it shows what controls cloud changes and suggests that the lowest estimates of future warming are unlikely, while higher and more dangerous estimates are more likely.

Sherwood explained that a 4°C rise would probably be catastrophic, not just dangerous. For example, it would make living in much of the tropics very hard or even impossible. It would also cause the Greenland and some Antarctic ice sheets to melt, raising sea levels by several meters.

Other scientists said this research is a big step forward because it reduces the uncertainty about how much warming will happen as carbon emissions rise. Hideo Shiogama and Tomoo Ogura from Japan’s National Institute for Environmental Studies said the explanation of how fewer clouds form as the world warms is convincing. They agreed that future climate change will likely be worse than expected, but more work is needed to make predictions even more accurate.

Scientists measure how sensitive the Earth’s climate is to greenhouse gases by estimating how much the temperature will rise if the amount of CO2 in the atmosphere doubles compared to before the industrial age. This doubling is likely to happen in the next 50 years if current trends continue. For the past 20 years, estimates of temperature rise have ranged from 1.5°C to 5°C, which is a wide range. The new study narrowed this range to between 3°C and 5°C by looking closely at clouds, which are the biggest source of uncertainty.

The key was to make sure that computer models of the climate show how clouds really form in the world. These models are the only way scientists can predict future temperatures. When water evaporates from the oceans, the vapor can rise high into the sky to form rain clouds that reflect sunlight, or it can rise only a little and fall back down without making clouds. Both things happen in reality. Climate models that include both processes predict much higher future temperatures than those that only include the high clouds.

Sherwood said that climate skeptics often criticize climate models for being wrong, and he agrees that they are not perfect. However, he said that the models that predict less warming are the ones making mistakes, not the ones that predict more warming. He also said that skeptics talk about the “pause” in temperature rise since the late 1990s, but there is more and more evidence that this pause is not seen in other climate measurements and is almost certainly temporary.

Since 1998, global average air temperatures have increased slowly, partly because of the El Niño ocean event. However, measurements show that greenhouse gases are still trapping more heat, with over 90% of it going into the oceans.

A study in November 2013 suggested that the “pause” in warming may not be real, but instead is because there are not enough temperature readings from the polar regions, where warming is happening fastest. Sherwood admits that his team’s work on clouds cannot completely rule out the chance that future temperature rises will be at the lower end of predictions. But, he said, for this to happen, there would have to be a major unknown factor that scientists have not found yet, which is unlikely.

He added that if global average temperatures rise by at least 4°C by 2100, it will have serious effects on the world and the economies of many countries, unless we urgently start to reduce our emissions.

From glow-in-the-dark trees to underground bike storage and solar-powered bins, we look at some unusual ideas to make our cities better places to live.

Living in a city has many good points, but living in a way that is good for the environment is becoming harder. People in cities have to deal with problems like pollution, traffic, and fewer green spaces.

Inventors are trying to help. Here are ten creative ideas to make cities more livable:

1. Pop-up parks
Many cities are designed more for cars than for people. A pop-up park is a simple idea: take an empty parking space, some coins, and a few plants, and make your own small park. The PARK(ing) project started as an art experiment in San Francisco and has now spread around the world. People have also created temporary urban farms and ecology demonstrations as part of this movement, which celebrates a special day every September.

2. Underground bike storage
Not everyone in the city drives a car. More people are using bikes, but where can they keep them safe? A company in Tokyo called Giken has designed an “ecocycle, anti-earthquake underground bicycle park.” This round storage space is only seven meters wide but goes deep underground and can hold 204 bikes. Owners can get their bike back by pressing a button, and the system brings it up in about 13 seconds.

3. Glow-in-the-dark trees
Most people think of Christmas trees when they hear about trees that glow in the dark. But Dutch designer Daan Roosegaarde has created a “bioluminescent” plant. This new technology mixes DNA from glowing sea bacteria with a plant’s DNA to make it shine like a jellyfish. Tests are happening now to see if this technology can be used on a large scale. Roosegaarde hopes it could one day replace normal street lights.

4. Footfall harvesting
Every day, many people walk on a raised walkway near West Ham underground station in east London. Most do not notice that the floor is a bit springy. Even fewer know that the five-millimeter movement in the rubber floor helps power the streetlights above. The walkway has special tiles that collect energy from people’s footsteps and turn it into electricity. The company Pavegen, which made this system, has also installed it at London’s Heathrow Airport and other places around the world.

5. Supertrees
There are now man-made trees. In Singapore’s Gardens by the Bay, there are several of these “supertrees.” They are up to 50 meters tall and have steel frames. Flowers and ferns grow on them, and their metal tops help absorb and spread heat. They also collect rainwater and help provide air for two large greenhouses below. Eleven of the 18 supertrees have solar panels on their branches.

6. Water-producing billboard
We see many billboards in cities, but researchers at Lima’s University of Engineering and Technology have made a special one. This billboard uses condensers and filters to collect water from the air. It can make about 96 liters of drinking water every day, and people can take the water for free.

7. Neo-walled gardens
Gardens are not just for front lawns anymore. Roof gardens were popular for a while, but now people are making gardens on walls. Thanks to hydroponics (growing plants without soil), more buildings like libraries, offices, shops, and hotels have walls covered in plants. The UK company Biotecture is a leader in this area. Their “vertical gardens” can be seen at the Taj Hotel in London and at Edgware Road Tube Station. Besides looking nice, green walls help reduce air pollution and improve air quality.

8. Algae-powered building
Hamburg’s International Building Exhibition shows another use for “living walls.” Instead of flowers, the south side of a zero-carbon apartment building is covered with green algae. The building’s outside has a “bio-skin” made of hollow glass panels where the algae grows. Sometimes, the algae is collected and used in a biogas plant to make electricity.

9. Smart rubbish bins
Instead of using big, polluting garbage trucks and dirty skips, many cities now use solar-powered “trash compactors.” These bins can hold 150 gallons of rubbish and have a motor that pushes the rubbish down when the bin is almost full. The motor gets its power from solar panels on the lid. The newest BigBelly bins also have a wireless system that tells rubbish collectors when the bin is full.

10. Spray paint
Sometimes, city officials have to find quick solutions. In Chengdu, one of China’s fastest-growing cities, the landscaping department started spraying yellow grass with green paint to make the city look better. The non-toxic green spray is now also used in Tianjin and other cities in northwest China.

We do not have flying cars yet, like in the 1985 movie Back to the Future II, but smartphones and new technology are making life very exciting and sometimes surprising. Experts say that changes in the economy, population, technology, and the environment are changing how we travel. Robert Puentes from the Brookings Institution says that now, people are paying more attention to how transportation affects the economy of cities and people’s lives.

As people in the US spend more time commuting and the country’s roads and bridges get older, cities must rethink transportation. City planners and experts now understand that just building more roads for cars is not enough to solve problems like more people living in cities and pollution from cars. Transportation is now a key part of making cities more environmentally friendly.

Big cities like Los Angeles, Seattle, and Chicago are trying to use their streets better. They are adding more bus lanes, making better sidewalks for people to walk, and building more train lines. At the same time, they are working with private companies to develop new technology, like cars that can drive themselves and talk to other cars and the road. This is called “intelligent transportation.” Puentes says, “The best places to live have many ways to travel.” He also says, “A city cannot compete globally if it does not have a strong transportation system.”

Experts say there are three main trends that will change transportation in the next few years.

First, ride-sharing services like Uber and Lyft, which are like taxis you order with your phone, and apps like Waze, which shows the fastest way to drive using real-time traffic information, are changing how people travel and how traffic moves in cities. Allan Clelland, a transportation technology expert, says that communication between riders, drivers, cars, and the roads is bringing transportation into a new era.

A recent study from UCLA’s Institute of Transportation Studies found that millennials (people born between the early 1980s and early 2000s) drive less than older generations. People born in the 1990s make 4% fewer car trips and travel 18% fewer miles each year than people from older generations did at the same age.

People who still drive are seeing less traffic because of Waze. Experts say Waze has helped reduce traffic jams on highways and made trips faster, but it has also caused more cars to drive through quiet neighborhoods. This has made some residents unhappy because more traffic on their streets makes life less pleasant.

This trend may continue as cars and roads start to share more information. Right now, a traffic light can only tell if a car is coming. In the future, companies want to make technology so cars can tell traffic lights where they are going and how fast they are moving.

Driverless cars have been in the news since Google started testing them in 2012, but no one knows when they will be common. However, some cars are already partly automated. Alexandre Bayen from the University of California thinks automation will happen step by step: first, there may be self-driving buses in their own lanes, then self-driving trucks in ports or mining towns, where vehicles travel in a line and are connected electronically.

A fully automated transportation system is interesting because it could make travel safer by removing human mistakes. It could also help car owners use their time better during long trips, reduce pollution and traffic jams, and help more people use cars. But even if driverless cars were ready now, it would take a long time for everyone to use them because the average car in the US is 11.5 years old.

To see what driverless cars might look like, you can watch the video at: vimeo.com/37751380.

As the world tries to stop dangerous climate change, and as countries and cities try to lower pollution, these new rules will also change transportation. They will encourage things like cars that do not pollute, and apps that help people walk, bike, or share rides more often.

Sharon Feigon, head of the Shared Use Mobility Center, imagines a future where one transit pass lets you use many types of transport in one day. For example, if your train is late, you could use the same pass to take a city bike, a shuttle, or rent a car. She says, “We will see these systems joined together, making it easy for people to switch between them.”

When thinking about the future of transportation, it is also important to remember why people travel: to go to work, meet friends or family, or go shopping. New technology and trends that help people avoid these trips, like virtual meetings or working from home, could also change transportation a lot.

In the past, flying cars seemed like the most advanced idea, but the new technologies being developed now may be even more advanced and more helpful for solving the social and environmental problems we will face in the coming years.

Every morning, before it gets hot in India’s capital, a small group of old friends meet. They gather on the dry grass near the India Gate monument in the center of Delhi to stretch, breathe, and meditate.

“It is the only healthy way to start the day. Much better than an egg or a sandwich or a cup of tea,” said Arvind Singh at 6:15am while doing his breathing exercises on a bench.

Singh, who is 42 years old and works as a salesman, is not alone. All over India, in crowded cities and on any green space left, many people do the same thing.

On June 21, which is now the International Day of Yoga, India’s prime minister, Narendra Modi, hopes people around the world will join in. The grass near India Gate will become the place for what they hope will be the biggest yoga session ever, with up to 45,000 people doing a 35-minute routine.

People taking part will include 64-year-old Modi, most of his government, and, they hope, some famous people. Officials have asked for volunteers from many countries to show that yoga is an international practice from India.

Getting Indians and others to do yoga has become important for Modi, who led his Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) to a big election win in 2014. In May 2015, schools were told to make sure students went to yoga events at the same time as the big session in Delhi, even though it is on a Sunday.

Officials have already said that yoga will be required for India’s police officers, who are known for being out of shape. They also said that free daily yoga lessons will be given to three million government workers and their families. Air India, the national airline, said it will start yoga for new pilots. Some top politicians in India have even said that more yoga could help reduce the high levels of sexual violence in the country.

Modi, who lives simply, is a vegetarian and enjoys yoga himself. He suggested an international yoga day when he spoke at the United Nations in New York in 2014.

“Yoga is a valuable gift from India’s ancient tradition. It brings together mind and body, thought and action, self-control and happiness, and harmony between people and nature. It is a complete way to be healthy and well. Yoga is not just exercise, but a way to feel connected with yourself, the world, and nature,” Modi said. He also said yoga could help fight climate change.

Yoga is between 3,000 and 6,000 years old and started somewhere in the Indian subcontinent, maybe with religious people who lived simply. Its meditation and physical exercises have long been part of local religions like Buddhism, Jainism, and the Hinduism followed by 80% of Indians.

Modi, who began his career in a strong Hindu nationalist group, has been criticized before for promoting Indian culture in a way that does not include other traditions. One writer called the June 21 event “a mix of cultural nationalism, business, and gentle pressure.”

Novelist Ajaz Ashraf wrote on the Scroll website in India: “The real hope is to bring modern-day yoga teachers and their many followers, who are mostly from the city middle class, into the BJP’s group.”

Others point to a recent US court decision that said yoga is not always religious. A court in California said, “While yoga can be religious in some situations, yoga classes in the [San Diego] district are, as the court said, ‘without any religious, mystical or spiritual parts.’” This was after two parents said yoga in schools promoted Hinduism and hurt Christianity.

Amish Tripathi, who writes popular novels set 4,000 years ago in India and retells Hindu stories, said characters in his books do yoga.

“In ancient India, yoga was part of daily life, both for the body and the mind. Every culture has given something to the world, and this is our gift,” Tripathi said.

Suneel Singh, a yoga teacher in south Delhi, also said yoga does not belong to one religion: “Is t’ai chi only Chinese? Is football only English? It is the same with yoga. Yoga is for everyone’s body and is a cheap way to stay healthy and strong.”

According to Harvey Goldsmith, a top British music promoter and manager, the era of big summer music festivals in the UK, like Glastonbury, is ending. Goldsmith has worked with many famous music stars, such as The Who, The Rolling Stones, Queen, Madonna, Bob Dylan, and Luciano Pavarotti. He says the main problem is that there are not enough new big bands to replace the old ones.

Goldsmith spoke at the Hay Festival of Literature and Arts in Wales. He said, “The festival scene reached its highest point about two years ago. Now, there are too many festivals and not enough big acts to headline them. This is a big problem for our industry. We are not creating a new generation of big acts like The Rolling Stones, Muse, or even Arctic Monkeys that can headline festivals.”

He explained that there were about 900 music festivals in the UK between May and September 2014, and it is impossible for all of them to continue. Goldsmith believes that music festivals have probably finished their best days. In the future, he thinks there will be more events that mix music with other things, like poetry, books, or magic shows. There will be many small festivals that offer something extra, not just people standing in a big field, afraid to leave for the toilet because they might miss the band.

Goldsmith also said that the way people listen to music has changed. People do not want to listen to a whole album anymore. Most rock bands became famous by making several albums and improving their music over time, but young people today prefer to listen to one song and then move on to the next. Pop music is everywhere, and while there is nothing wrong with pop, Goldsmith thinks rock music will become popular again, but it will take time.

Goldsmith, who is 69 years old, also shared that he is working with Robin de Levita, a Dutch producer, to open a new 1,100-seat theatre in Wembley. This theatre will be ready for the first stage version of the popular teen book and movie series The Hunger Games in June 2016.

De Levita will bring his special SceneAround idea to London. In this type of theatre, the audience sits on seats that turn around to face different scenes built in a circle, with images shown on screens. This idea was first used in an aircraft hangar near Amsterdam and was very successful.

Goldsmith is also planning to bring a play about Anne Frank to the new theatre. He said, “It’s a completely different way of making shows.”

During his talk at the Hay Festival, Goldsmith shared some secrets from his long career in music. He told stories about Keith Moon putting dynamite in a hotel toilet in Sydney to unblock it, and about John Lennon’s extreme stage fright before a show at Madison Square Garden in 1974, when Lennon had to be dragged out of his dressing room while he was vomiting. Goldsmith said it is strange how many artists get very scared before going on stage, but once the music starts, they are fine.

Goldsmith also solved a long-running mystery about why Elvis Presley never performed outside North America. Elvis’s manager, Colonel Tom Parker, told Goldsmith that the real reason was that Parker was an illegal Dutch immigrant and did not want to risk leaving the US. It was not because of Elvis.

When asked about the best rock performer, Goldsmith said, “Freddie Mercury was our most powerful stage performer, the best live performer we’ve ever had. At Live Aid, he went out and took control of the audience.”

However, Goldsmith said there is no new band like Queen being formed now. “We are not creating a new generation of these kinds of acts. Coldplay is probably the last big band to appear, and that was ten years ago. There are not many new bands that look like they will become the next big stars.”

“So, with no big acts to headline, there are no big shows. Glastonbury cannot find enough big acts anymore, and that is the top festival. The big festival era is really over.”

When two people living on an island saw a small fibreglass boat washed up on a faraway Pacific atoll, they went to look at it. Inside, they found a very thin man with long hair and a beard. He said he had been drifting at sea for 16 months after leaving Mexico, which is more than 12,500 km away. His story was similar to the famous book and movie Life of Pi.

The man was only wearing old underpants. He told the people who found him that he had been drifting in the 7.3-metre fibreglass boat since he left Mexico for El Salvador in September 2012. The boat’s engines had no propellers. He also said that a friend who was with him had died at sea several months before.

Ola Fjeldstad, a Norwegian student studying people on the isolated Ebon Atoll in the Marshall Islands, said, “His condition isn’t good, but he’s getting better.” The man said his name was José Ivan. He explained that he survived by catching turtles and birds with his hands, but he only spoke Spanish, so it was hard to get more information. There was no fishing equipment on the boat, but there was a turtle inside when it arrived. Fjeldstad said, “The boat is really scratched and looks like it has been in the water for a long time.”

The islanders took the man to the main island in the atoll. This place is so far away that it has only one phone line and no internet. They took him to see the mayor, Ione de Brum, who then called the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Majuro, the capital of the Marshall Islands. Officials said they were waiting for more information and planned to bring the man to the capital.

The only government plane that can land at Ebon is being repaired and will not be ready for a few days. Officials are thinking about sending a boat to pick up the man. Fjeldstad said, “He’s staying at the local council house and a family is giving him food.” The man had a basic health check. He had low blood pressure, but he did not have any life-threatening problems and could walk with help from the islanders. Fjeldstad added, “We’ve been giving him a lot of water and he’s getting stronger.”

Fraser Christian, who teaches people how to survive at sea in England, said the man’s story would be amazing if true, but not impossible. He said it is possible to catch turtles or small fish by hand because “they are curious and come close to small boats to hide under them.” Christian tells his students that if they have to eat turtles, they should start with the eyes because they have a lot of liquid, and then drink the blood.

The biggest problems the man would have faced were being exposed to the weather and not having enough water. Christian said, “The basic rule is: no water, no food. You need water to digest protein. If you have no fresh water and it doesn’t rain for a few days, you are in trouble.” He also said that some people are better at surviving than others, and that mental strength is very important. “The mental part is key and depends on how people deal with hard situations in life.”

Stories about surviving in the Pacific Ocean are not rare. In 2006, three Mexicans were found drifting in a small fibreglass boat near the Marshall Islands. They said they survived for nine months at sea by drinking rainwater and eating raw fish and seabirds. They kept their hope by reading the Bible. But Cliff Downing, who teaches sea survival, said he did not fully believe the new story. “It just doesn’t sound right to me. There are many dangers that make surviving for so long very unlikely. We need to know much more.”

Other stories of castaways include Poon Lim, a Chinese sailor from a British ship that was sunk by a German submarine in 1942. He survived 133 days on a wooden raft in the South Atlantic before Brazilian fishermen rescued him. In 1971, a Scottish sailor named Dougal Robertson and his family were sailing to the Galápagos Islands from Panama when killer whales sank their boat. They survived 38 days on a lifeboat before a fishing boat rescued them.

In 2006, three Mexican fishermen were found drifting in a small boat near the Marshall Islands, nine months after they started a shark-fishing trip. They survived by drinking rainwater and eating raw fish and seabirds. Before the US coastguard rescued them, they stayed alive by eating tuna. In 2012, a Panamanian fisherman sued Princess Cruises after one of their ships ignored his cries for help when he and two friends were stranded in a broken boat. He survived 28 days at sea, but his two friends died of thirst.

SeaWorld’s profits have dropped by 84% because many customers have stopped visiting the park after claims that it mistreated orca whales. SeaWorld is known for training dolphins and killer whales to do tricks for large crowds. The company has seen fewer visitors, lower sales, and less profit because of ongoing problems with its public image.

SeaWorld has been in the news since the 2013 documentary Blackfish, which said that the way SeaWorld treated orca whales made them act violently and may have caused the deaths of three people. After the documentary came out, fewer people visited SeaWorld, the company lost more than half its value on the stock market, and its former CEO had to leave.

To fight back against animal rights activists, SeaWorld started a big marketing campaign across the country. The campaign tries to answer claims that captive orcas die younger than wild orcas. SeaWorld also lowered ticket prices and spent $10 million on advertising, showing its veterinarians taking care of whales. Still, CEO Joel Manby admitted that the company is having a hard time convincing people that it treats its whales well.

Manby said, “We know we have a lot of work to do to get more visitors, make more money, and do better as a company. It will take time and money to get back to where we were before. People have said good things about our new campaign, but we know it will take a lot of effort to fix our reputation, especially in California.”

He also said, “We will keep sharing the facts because the facts support us,” during a call with reporters and analysts.

Manby became CEO in 2015 to help improve SeaWorld’s image. He said he will share his plans for the company’s future at a special event on November 6. SeaWorld is already planning a new shark exhibit in Orlando and a new attraction in San Antonio where visitors can swim with dolphins in a more natural setting.

SeaWorld’s financial report, released on August 6, showed that its net income for the second quarter fell from $37.4 million in 2014 to $5.8 million in 2015, an 84% drop. Revenue went down from $405 million to $392 million. Attendance fell by more than 100,000, from 6.58 million to 6.48 million. Experts will be watching SeaWorld’s sales and visitor numbers in the third quarter, which is usually the company’s best time because of the summer holidays.

Attendance might also be hurt by a new scandal in July 2015, when a SeaWorld worker was accused of joining animal rights protest groups against the company. Jared Goodman, a lawyer for People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA), which leads campaigns against SeaWorld, said: “SeaWorld is in a spying scandal, animals are dying in its tanks, and many people are against its plan to build a new orca tank. So it’s not surprising that SeaWorld’s profits have dropped again. Families don’t want to buy tickets to see orcas suffering in small tanks. SeaWorld’s profits, like the orcas, won’t get better until the park releases its animals and builds safe places for them by the coast.”

SeaWorld’s shares, which were worth $39 in 2013, were selling for just under $18 in August 2015.

It was a beautiful summer evening when I decided to go swimming near Doolin Pier in County Clare, Ireland, where I had moved in 2012. In the water, there was a woman with Dusty, a dolphin who often swims with a group of people she knows well.

Dusty came to Doolin around 2008, and since then, hundreds of people have swum with her. This makes people think she is completely tame. She was even in an Irish tourist advertisement where a girl says she wants to touch a dolphin.

That evening, the woman was tickling Dusty’s stomach, and it looked very nice. About 20 tourists and local people were on the pier, watching this beautiful scene. After I got into the water, Dusty left the woman and suddenly became very aggressive. Later, I learned that Dusty is very protective when she is with someone. Her tail was moving wildly. At first, I thought she was just showing off, but then I realized she might be angry. I knew I had to get out of the water, so I swam towards the pier. But in just a moment, Dusty hit me hard with her nose. It was very strong and painful, and she was very fast. I was pushed forward quickly.

Everyone on the pier was looking at me with their mouths open. Dusty was still in the water next to me, her tail moving crazily. That was the scariest part. I thought if she hit me with her tail, I could go under the water and drown.

I reached the pier but could not get out because I was hurt. I was very scared. I shouted for help, and a man reached down and pulled me onto the steps. Then another man came and said he was an orthopaedic surgeon who specialized in sea injuries. He had been driving into Doolin when he saw what was happening. I was very cold and worried because I did not know how badly I was hurt. My biggest fear was that I was bleeding inside. The doctor checked me and said he did not think I was bleeding inside, but I probably had broken bones. Later, I found out I had six broken bones in my spine, three broken ribs, and a damaged lung.

I stayed in the hospital for five days. I had to wear a back brace for several weeks and could not work for five months because I could not move well, and I had pain and stiffness. Later, I was told I had post-traumatic stress. After almost dying, I became very anxious and reacted strongly to things that never bothered me before. I felt people were looking at me strangely, I had trouble with loud noises, and I started to forget things. Three months before the accident, I had opened a health-food shop, but I had to close it because I could not work anymore. It was the hardest year of my life, but now it is over. I had special treatments like craniosacral therapy, osteopathy, and massage, and now I am starting my own osteopathy business. I understand my patients better now because I have been a patient myself.

I am thankful that I am healthy now, and I want to stop other people from getting hurt. People think dolphins are always friendly and safe—who would think a dolphin could attack a person? If you see a dangerous animal with its teeth showing, you know it is scary, but dolphins always look like they are smiling.

I am not angry at Dusty. I respect her. But I was in her space, and she is a wild and unpredictable animal. People need to know this. Many people come here to swim with her, but they do not understand how dangerous it can be. I heard that several people were hurt by Dusty that summer.

After the man pulled me out of the water, Dusty swam away, but then she came back and floated upright next to me, looking at me. We looked into each other’s eyes, and I felt she was sorry. She was a completely different dolphin; her anger was gone. The people on the pier were amazed. When I had that moment with her, my fear ended. I made peace with her.

Seeing colleagues and friends use e-cigarettes is now very common. But have we reached the highest point of vaping? Statistics show that vaping among smokers and recent ex-smokers, who make up most vapers, might already be going down. Big e-cigarette companies, who have spent millions to promote vaping, will watch these numbers closely because they thought vaping was becoming more popular.

In 2014, the health charity Action on Smoking and Health (ASH) said that the number of adults in Britain using e-cigarettes—devices that do not have tobacco and make vapor instead of smoke—grew from about 700,000 in 2012 to 2.1 million in 2014.

However, the Smoking Toolkit Study, a research group supported by the Department of Health, gives updates on smoking trends every three months. Their numbers show that vaping may be losing its appeal. The number of smokers and ex-smokers who vaped went up until the end of 2013, when about 22% of them were vaping. But this number stayed the same during 2014 and then dropped to 19% at the end of 2014. Early signs show the drop continued into 2015. Professor Robert West from University College London, who collects these numbers, said the drop is “statistically significant.”

Smokers are the most important group for e-cigarette companies because seven out of ten vapers are smokers. Only about 1% of people who have never smoked have tried an e-cigarette. West said, “The number of people who use e-cigarettes while still smoking is going down. We have only been watching vaping for just over a year, so it is a short time, but we do not see more long-term ex-smokers or people who never smoked using e-cigarettes. This could change, but for now, the numbers are staying the same.”

The slowing down of vaping in the UK seems different from what is happening in the US, where e-cigarettes are advertised a lot and seem to be getting more popular. But West questioned the US data, saying it does not clearly show the difference between people who only tried an e-cigarette once and those who use them regularly.

Experts say fears that vaping will become popular among young people who never smoked are not true. The ASH study found that only 1.8% of children use e-cigarettes regularly. Instead, e-cigarettes are most popular with adults who want to quit smoking. James Dunworth, director and co-founder of ecigarettedirect.co.uk, said, “While the latest numbers show that e-cigarette use by smokers has stopped growing, they also show a big increase since May 2011. Our customers are still happy with the product, and new technology is making e-cigarettes better and helping people switch from normal cigarettes.”

West agreed, saying, “E-cigarettes are like a stronger nicotine patch. They are more popular than nicotine patches and may or may not work better. One-third of people trying to quit smoking use e-cigarettes, making them the most popular way to stop.”

Hazel Cheeseman, policy director at ASH, said it is too early to say if vaping has reached its highest point. “Even though the market has not grown in the UK for about a year, there does not seem to be a drop in the number of people using e-cigarettes to help them quit smoking. Using an e-cigarette is safer than smoking. Some people find them helpful to quit, and there is little evidence that they are making more young people start smoking.”

Recently, it was reported that the European Commission (EC) is thinking about raising taxes on e-cigarettes, which could affect how popular they are. A new EC law starting in 2016 will limit the amount of nicotine in e-cigarettes to less than current levels. This could mean vapers will need to use more to get the same effect, which could make e-cigarettes more expensive.

West said that lawmakers should see e-cigarettes as a way to help people quit smoking and not treat them the same as cigarettes. “Some local authorities and organizations want to treat e-cigarettes like cigarettes and ban them in public places and outside,” he said.

Scarlett Johansson is suing a French writer for €50,000 because she says his novel makes false claims about her private life.

The book, called "La Première chose qu’on regarde" ("The First Thing We Look At") by Grégoire Delacourt, is about a French model who looks so much like Scarlett Johansson that the main male character thinks she is the real actress. In the story, men only see the model as a sex object, and women are jealous of her. The model has many adventures while pretending to be Johansson, but in the end, people find out the truth and she dies in a car accident.

Johansson is not happy about this popular book. Her lawyer, Vincent Toledano, told the newspaper Le Figaro that Delacourt’s novel is a “violation and fraudulent and illegal use of her name, reputation, and image.” He also said the book has “defamatory claims about her private life.” Johansson is now trying to stop the book from being translated or made into a movie. The court case started in Paris on Wednesday, but neither Johansson nor Delacourt was there.

Toledano said, “The freedom of expression that she supports as an artist is not the problem. These actions are only for money and have nothing to do with creativity.”

Delacourt explained that he used Johansson in his book because she is “the example of beauty today.” He said, “I wrote a work of fiction. My character is not Scarlett Johansson.”

Recently, Delacourt spoke on French radio and said the lawsuit was “rather sad.” He said, “It scares me to think that judges can get involved when you write about a character in a novel.”

Delacourt is a very popular writer in France. His last book, "My List of Desires," was translated into 47 languages and is being made into a film. He said he was “speechless” when he learned Johansson was suing him.

“I thought she would contact me to have coffee together. I didn’t write a novel about a celebrity,” he said. “I wrote a real love story and a tribute to female beauty, especially inner beauty.

“If writers can’t mention things around us—like a beer brand, a monument, or an actor—it will be hard to write fiction.

“It’s shocking, especially because I don’t think she has even read the book, since it hasn’t been translated yet.”

Emmanuelle Allibert, who speaks for the publisher JC Lattès, said the lawsuit was “crazy.” “We have never seen anything like this. It is even more surprising because the novel is not about Scarlett Johansson. It is about a woman who looks like her.”

Delacourt’s lawyer, Anne Veil, who also represents the publisher, said the accusations were “totally shocking.” “This is a literary, not a commercial, work. She has not been used as a product,” she said. “Grégoire Delacourt is not a paparazzo; he’s a writer!”

Ironically, the legal situation would be easier for Delacourt if he had published the book in the United States instead of France. Lloyd Jassin, a lawyer in New York, told Time magazine that the case would probably not happen in the US because the book would be protected by the First Amendment.

“The First Amendment does not see most books as commercial products,” he said. “If her name or image is important to the story and has literary value, the First Amendment protects it.” But in France, the law is more complicated and people’s rights to their own image are taken “much more seriously,” Jassin said.

Delacourt said, “I thought she might send me flowers because it was a declaration of love for her, but she didn’t understand. It’s a strange situation—but a very American one.”

Young Cubans are rushing to use the first free, open-access internet service in Cuba. This is possible because of one of Cuba’s most famous artists. A small cultural center in Havana, the capital city, now offers free wi-fi. The well-known Cuban artist Kcho is giving this service. Surprisingly, his spokesman said the state-owned phone company, Etecsa, allowed it.

The internet is very slow, especially when many people are there. But in Cuba, only about 5% of people have full access to the internet. So, a place that is both free and without restrictions is seen as something new and very special.

People are excited to visit international news websites, talk to friends and family in other countries, and use Facebook and Twitter. “I come as often as I can,” said Adonis Ortiz, 20, while video-chatting with his father in the US, whom he has not seen in nine years.

The slow end of the long freeze between the US and Cuba may soon let American tech companies like Google and Apple enter the Cuban market. For now, Cuba has a fast undersea cable from Venezuela and some Chinese internet equipment.

Another estimate says a quarter of Cubans have internet access, but this is usually a limited local network with only some websites and email. This is still one of the lowest rates in the Western Hemisphere.

Kcho is letting the public use his own internet connection. But instead of being a rebel against the government, Kcho may have been chosen as a safe person to show the government is slowly accepting the internet.

Kcho, who is close to the Cuban government, said the Ministry of Culture approved his actions. He wants Cubans to get used to the internet. “It’s only possible if you want to do it and pay the costs,” Kcho told the Associated Press. “It is expensive but the benefit is huge. I have something great and powerful. I can share it and I am doing so.”

Kcho’s real name is Alexis Leiva Machado. He became famous for his paintings, sculptures, and drawings after winning a big art prize in South Korea. He is now preparing for the Havana art show in May. Born on one of Cuba’s small islands, he is known for modern art with simple, seaside, and patriotic themes.

In the center’s courtyard, young people who know about technology sit all day in wicker chairs under a white cover or outside when it is full, using laptops, tablets, or smartphones.

Cuba has some of the lowest internet access in the world. Dial-up accounts are tightly controlled, and home broadband is almost never seen, except for foreigners who pay hundreds of dollars a month. The average Cuban salary is between $17 and $20 a month. Kcho is paying about $900 a month to provide the free wi-fi.

Since 2013, the Cuban government has opened hundreds of internet centers, where one hour online costs $4.50, and the speed is much slower than at Kcho’s studio, which is about 2mbps. In 2014, Akamai Technologies reported that the average internet speed was 10.5mbps in the US, 23.6mbps in South Korea, and 3.9mbps worldwide.

With many users at the same time, Kcho’s wi-fi signal gets weaker. One user said he sometimes comes in the middle of the night, when no one else is there, and finds the internet very fast.

Scott Kelly, an astronaut, spent 340 days in space and said that looking at Himalayan lakes, doing spacewalks, and following the presidential primaries helped him stay sane. After returning to Earth, he told reporters that the mission felt very long, even though he had been to space before. He joked that sometimes you might go a little crazy during such a long time in space.

Kelly and Russian astronaut Mikhail Kornienko stayed on the International Space Station (ISS) for almost a year. They did this to help scientists learn how weightlessness, radiation, and living in a small space affect the human body. NASA thinks this research is important for future trips to Mars.

Kelly said the hardest part was how long the mission lasted. When he came back to Earth, he felt much more sore than after shorter trips. He and his twin brother Mark, who is also a retired astronaut, have been doing many physical and mental tests for the past year. These tests will continue so NASA can learn more about how the body handles the stress of space travel.

Kelly said he had aches and very sensitive skin after returning, but his balance was mostly okay. However, he missed the first thing he tried to throw on a table because he forgot how strong gravity is. In space, he grew 1.5 inches taller, but gravity made him return to his normal height. Even though coming back was uncomfortable, he was amazed when he landed in Kazakhstan. When the capsule opened, he smelled fresh air mixed with the sweet, burnt smell of the spacecraft.

As he moved away from the capsule, he realized how big the mission was: 340 days on a 15-year-old space station that weighs a million pounds, is as big as a football field, and has as much space inside as a six-bedroom house. The ISS uses solar power and was built by an international team with money from millions of taxpayers.

Kelly said there are still things to learn from the space station that we do not know yet. He compared the research there to the early days of computer science at NASA. He also said the view from space is amazing.

He shared many beautiful photos of Earth on social media, showing cities, landscapes, oceans, and the atmosphere. He said Earth is a beautiful planet, with bright colors in the Bahamas and rainbow-colored lakes in the northern Himalayas. He would like to visit that area, but first needs to find out which country owns those lakes. He also noticed how thin and fragile the atmosphere looks from space, and he saw large areas of pollution, which worried him.

Kelly could see pollution from wildfires in the US and areas in Asia with pollution almost all year. He said the message "we need to save the planet" is not quite right, because the planet will recover, but humans might not survive if we destroy the environment. Seeing how thin the atmosphere is made him care more about protecting the environment.

He said it is up to us to take care of the air and water, and he believes we can make a difference if we choose to. Kelly became very popular online because of his social media posts, which he made with his girlfriend. But he did not pay much attention to this, as he was more interested in the 2016 presidential election. One of the first things he asked after landing was about "Super Tuesday," a big day in the election.

When asked about his opinion on politicians like Donald Trump and Bernie Sanders, Kelly said he could not comment because, as a government worker, he is not allowed to talk about politics in public.

Besides following the news, Kelly said that having regular work helped him stay sane. He looked forward to things like the next crew arriving, the next spacewalk, or the next science experiment. This helped him keep his mind healthy. He said being back on Earth with other people still felt strange, and he expected to feel some culture shock soon.

A NASA scientist said Kelly has the right qualities for a mission to Mars, but Kelly himself thinks he probably will not fly with NASA again. Still, he said he would not say he is completely finished, especially with private space companies like SpaceX becoming more successful. He joked that maybe in the next 20 years, people will be able to buy cheap tickets to visit space, and companies might need someone like him.

Junior Smart knows a lot about gangs. He is now 36 years old, and his life has two main parts. He explains that in his late teens, after his mother died, he joined a gang in south London. At that time, the gang gave him support he was missing. 

“They became my new support group,” he says. “At first it was just fun, but then it became more serious and focused on making money. They started doing crimes. That’s how it was.” At school, Smart failed his GCSE exams, but he took them again at college and passed all of them. He got a full-time job in administration and also worked as a DJ. But at the same time, he was making money illegally with the gang.

Eventually, he was arrested for serious drug crimes and sent to prison for 12 years. He says that being arrested destroyed his feeling that nothing could hurt him. “The first night after I was arrested was the biggest wake-up call of my life,” he says. “I had been living two lives. I was one person with my friends and another person with my friends’ enemies. I spent a long time trying to fix myself.”

Today, Junior Smart leads a team of 12 full-time workers and six volunteers. Their goal is to help young criminals and gang members leave crime behind. Most of the people working with him are also ex-offenders. Some are still serving their sentences but are allowed out during the day to help because they have changed. They work with the police, the probation service, and other organizations to help people who feel trapped and scared in violent gangs across London.

For Smart, the big change from gang member to mentor started when he saw, from inside, that the prison system was failing its prisoners. He remembers a drug addict he became friends with, who kept coming back to prison. “I was touched by the people who kept coming back in,” he says. “I couldn’t believe nothing was being done to help them. I talked to the prisoners, and they knew what needed to change in their lives, but the prison system only deals with the crime they were caught for.”

“One man had a cocaine habit that cost £300 a week, which he paid for by stealing from houses. He told me how he would go into houses even when people were there. But his drug problem was never treated. The thing that shocked me was that it was just a cycle.”

That case and many others made Smart decide to become a prison “listener”—a prisoner who helps new arrivals and talks to them during their first days in prison. From there, he made his own “little plan” to start a project after leaving prison, using ex-offenders’ experience to help others avoid going back to prison again and again. He was released early, after five years. “At the end of my sentence, I got a chance to try my little plan,” he says.

So what does he think now? After the riots last August and the government’s promise to fight gangs, does he think things are getting better? He gives some praise to the police and says much of their work in arresting gang members has been good. But overall, he is very critical of the government’s approach. He says the government thinks that arresting a gang leader solves the problem, but it does not. He agrees with a report that says arresting gang leaders can even make things worse. He says that removing the leader often makes the whole gang unstable.

He draws a diagram of the gang’s structure. “When you arrest the top person, people start fighting for position. Who was the most loyal? Who had the most respect? It’s a bit like a family. They are more likely to use violence. So arresting the gang leaders has not had a long-term effect. It has not even given the community a break.”

Can it actually make the streets more dangerous? “It can, because when there is no leader, recruiting and using young people becomes even more common, creating new lower levels in the gang. People take sides. If one gang or street group knows that a leader has been arrested, they think that gang is weak. Then we have fights between different areas. And what happens when that leader is in prison? He makes friends with other gang members, or when he gets out, he tries to take control again. That’s when violence happens.”

To spread the risk, gangs are now recruiting much younger children, even in primary schools. The youngest members are called “tinies.” “In the last years, we have seen more and more of this. The tinies can be as young as eight to eleven years old.” The young are used to protect the older members from risk. Often, they are the ones who do street dealing or even stabbing, he says.

Smart says that, because there is not enough government money or commitment to long-term help, the challenges are very big, especially now with the economy being bad. “I try to help a young person who has been earning £300 a week illegally. It was hard before to convince him to stop. But with high unemployment and cuts to benefits, it is even harder.”

Still, his project, which has helped over 1,000 people, is getting results. Fewer than 20% of those who come for help commit crimes again. From his own experience, Smart refuses to give up on anyone, and that is what keeps him going. “I don’t think anyone is beyond help,” he says.

Wales will be the first country in the UK where people are assumed to agree to donate their organs after death unless they say they do not want to. The Welsh Assembly has voted for this new "opt-out" system. This means hospitals can think that people who die want to donate their organs unless those people have clearly said no.

The final vote for this new law was 43 in favor, 8 against, and 2 people did not vote. Some religious groups did not agree with the law because of moral reasons and because they worry it could make things harder for families who are already sad.

The Welsh Health Minister, Mark Drakeford, said, “This is a big day for Wales and for the 226 people in Wales waiting for an organ transplant. I am proud that Wales is the first country in the UK to do this. We want to help more people get organ transplants and give hope to those waiting.”

He explained that many families say no to organ donation because they do not know what their loved one wanted. Families are very important in the donation process. The new law wants to respect what the person who died wanted. But if family or friends know that the person did not want to donate, they can say so. When families know their loved one wanted to donate, they usually agree. The new law will help make people’s wishes about organ donation clearer and should increase the number of people who donate.

Drakeford said, “Today is an important day for Wales, and I think the rest of the UK will watch closely when the law starts in 2015.”

Some people do not agree with the new law. They worry that the need for more organs will mean the wishes of the dead person or their family might not be respected. But the government says there will be protections. Some people may not have time to say they do not want to donate. Because of this, the government said families will have a bigger role. Families will have a clear right to object and can show that the person who died did not want to donate.

Wales is making this change because there are not enough organs for people who need them. Drakeford said, “We do not have enough organs for people who need them. About one person every week dies in Wales while waiting for a transplant. We have tried to improve organ donation and have had some success, but we want to do more.”

About one third of people in Wales are on the organ donor register, but more than two thirds say in surveys that they are happy to donate. The other third are people who have not signed up yet. The new law hopes to help with this.

The new law will be for anyone over 18 who has lived in Wales for at least one year before they die. Donated organs can go to people in Wales or anywhere in the UK.

Doctors are happy about the new law. The British Medical Association has wanted an opt-out system for a long time because more people need transplants now. This is because medical science has improved and more transplants are possible.

The number of young organ donors went down a lot after seatbelt laws were introduced. In recent years, there have been big efforts to get more people to carry organ donor cards, and hospitals have improved how they talk to families when someone dies and it is not clear what they wanted. But there are still not enough organs for everyone who needs them.

Some religious groups do not agree with the new law. They say it could make things harder for families who are already sad. The Muslim Council of Wales and the South Wales Jewish Representative Council have concerns. The Archbishop of Wales, Barry Morgan, said that organ donation should be a gift of love and generosity. He said if organs can be taken unless someone has clearly said no, it is not really a gift, but just a medical use of the body.

A lonely old man living in a crater on the moon is the surprising main character of John Lewis’s Christmas advert for 2015. This year, the department store is using its big Christmas campaign to help charity. 

John Lewis’s Christmas advert is very popular and often marks the start of the Christmas shopping season. This year, the store wants to use its advert to raise hundreds of thousands of pounds for Age UK, a charity that helps older people. John Lewis will also ask its staff and customers to work with their local Age UK branch to help elderly people who might be alone during the holidays.

The company spent £7 million on the campaign. It includes a high-quality TV advert, a smartphone game, and special products like glow-in-the-dark pyjamas. Eleven stores will have areas decorated to look like the surface of the moon.

In the past two years, John Lewis’s adverts showed cute animals—a bear and a hare, then a penguin. This year, the advert tells a touching story about a young girl named Lily. She sees an old man living alone on the moon through her telescope. Lily tries to send him a letter and even shoots a note with a bow and arrow, but these do not work. Finally, she sends him a present—a telescope tied to balloons. This gift helps them make contact.

The advert’s message is: “Show someone they’re loved this Christmas.” This is similar to Age UK’s message: “No one should have no one at Christmas.” Profits from three products—a mug, a gift tag, and a card—will go to Age UK.

Rachel Swift, head of marketing at John Lewis, said the charity is important to people at Christmas. She said the advert makes people think about someone in their neighborhood who might be alone.

The advert uses the song “Half the World Away” by Oasis, sung by a little-known Norwegian singer named Aurora.

The advert cost £1 million to make. The moon scenes were filmed at Warner Bros Studios, where the Harry Potter movies were made. The special set was built by someone who worked on the latest Star Wars film, The Force Awakens.

Like in recent years, John Lewis created excitement for the advert with a teaser campaign on TV and social media, using the hashtag #OnTheMoon. There will be a full moon on Christmas Day 2015, but this is just a coincidence.

In 2014, John Lewis also spent £7 million on a campaign with a realistic animated penguin and a young boy, using the song “Real Love” by John Lennon, sung by Tom Odell. By early January, the advert had 22 million views on YouTube. This was more than Sainsbury’s Christmas advert, which had 16.6 million views and showed First World War soldiers sharing chocolate.

Rachel Swift said that, even with all the excitement, John Lewis has used the same plan for the last five years. She said, “It’s all about thoughtful gifts and doing something extra for someone you love at Christmas. We just want to do something right for the brand and hope customers love it.”

Sarah Vizard, news editor of Marketing Week, said John Lewis’s campaign is a bit smaller in stores this year, even though there are more competitors. She said many brands tried to copy John Lewis by making emotional and creative adverts, but now most focus on what you can buy in the store. She said John Lewis is still the best at making emotional adverts and that this campaign will connect with customers. She thinks people will find it very cute.

Other companies are also trying to get attention with their Christmas adverts. Waitrose, which is part of the same company as John Lewis, launched its advert online before showing it on TV during The X Factor. The same agency made both adverts.

Burberry released its second Christmas film, with Romeo Beckham and Elton John. Currys, an electronics store, used Jeff Goldblum in its first Christmas advert. Asda, Lidl, and Morrisons also started their Christmas campaigns at the beginning of November.

Marc Bolland, the boss of Marks & Spencer, said that in the first week of September, the most searched word on their website was “Christmas.” Boots, another store, also started its Christmas campaign in early November. This year, Boots is using a more traditional advert, after a popular advert in 2014 that showed a family working hard to be together at Christmas.

Europe will be the first place in the world to require car makers to do 'real-world' emissions tests. This is a new way to fight air pollution. The new rules will make car companies test how much pollution their cars produce while driving on real roads and in traffic, not just in perfect lab conditions like before.

The European Commission, led by Vice President Frans Timmermans, approved these tests. The goal is to make sure cars do not release more than 80 milligrams of nitrogen oxide per kilometer. Right now, only one out of every sixteen cars meets this limit, according to researchers. Other countries like China and Korea are also thinking about using real-world emissions tests and are watching Europe closely.

Pollution from diesel engines, such as nitrogen oxide, carbon monoxide, and small particles, is believed to cause at least one quarter of the 29,000 deaths related to pollution each year in the UK. This number may go up when a committee publishes new evidence about the health dangers of nitrogen oxide later in 2015.

The current lab test, called the 'New European Drive Cycle,' is 25 years old and does not match new car technology. Studies show that car makers can cheat these lab tests by taping doors and windows to reduce air resistance, driving on very smooth roads, and testing at high temperatures. Some car makers also program their cars to produce less pollution when the front wheels are spinning and the back wheels are still, which only happens in lab tests.

Lucia Caudet, a spokesperson for the Commission, said they are finishing a plan to start the new real-world emissions tests. The plan still needs approval from other commissioners and a technical committee, but an EU source said they do not expect big problems.

Greg Archer, who works for Transport and Environment, said, “One main reason why air pollution kills 400,000 people each year is because car makers cheat the tests for diesel cars, causing much more pollution on the road.” He said the new real-world test is an important step to reduce air pollution in cities and that EU countries should support the new rules, even if car makers say they are too strict.

A 2014 study by the International Council on Clean Transportation found that real nitrogen oxide emissions from cars are seven times higher than the 80mg/km limit, and some cars are 22 times over the limit. Only one out of sixteen cars met the target. About one third of all nitrogen oxide pollution comes from road transport, mostly diesel cars, and in cities, this can be as high as 64%, according to the European Environment Agency.

Campaigners say the car industry has tried to delay these new tests, but car industry groups deny this. They say they need five years to prepare for technical and economic reasons. Cara McLaughlin, a spokesperson for the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA), said the new Real Driving Emissions (RDE) rule will require big changes to cars, even during their production. However, ACEA agrees that RDE will apply to new car types from September 2017.

In a rare move, the car association sent their own draft regulation to Timmermans. Their version would have covered fewer pollutants, delayed the rules until 2020, shortened test distances from 1,300 meters to less than 700 meters, raised the minimum test temperature from -7°C to -3°C, and used more rural roads. Greg Archer said, “The lobbyists were everywhere. This was a real attempt to change the law for their own benefit.”

After Timmermans rejected the ACEA proposal, the regulation will now go to commissioners for final approval and to member states for last changes before it is expected to start in September. By 2017, the first real-world car emissions tests should begin. There will also be a similar debate about testing CO2 emissions at the end of 2015, and other countries are watching what Europe does next.

Some cities have pigeons, but Lima has black vultures, also called gallinazos. These birds fly in groups above the city and sit on famous old buildings, like old churches and buildings from the 1700s in the city center. 

With their wrinkled heads and sharp eyes, the vultures remind people in Lima of the parts of their city they want to forget, like poverty, dirt, and neglect. However, these birds, which eat dead and rotting things, are now being seen in a better way. Environmental authorities are giving the vultures a new image by putting GoPro cameras and GPS trackers on them. The vultures now help find places where people dump rubbish illegally.

Samuel is one of ten healthy black vultures in the project. He wears a tracker and is released over the city to find illegal rubbish dumps. When he finds one, his GPS records the location on a live map.

Samuel’s trainer at Lima’s Huachipa Zoo, Alfredo Correa, is proud of the birds. He says, “They can eat dead animals because their bodies protect them from viruses and bacteria. They have some of the strongest stomach bacteria in nature.” The project is a partnership between USAID and the Peruvian Environment Ministry to help solve Lima’s rubbish problem.

Other vultures in the project have special names, like Capitan Huggin, Capitan Fenix (named after the mythical bird that rises from ashes), and Capitana Aella (“Whirlwind”). A funny video was made with a dramatic voice, showing the “noble” vultures fighting against disease, while people ignore the problem. But the project is serious. Lima has almost ten million people but only four official landfills. Many illegal dumps exist, and about 20% of the city’s rubbish ends up there. Waste from these dumps pollutes Lima’s main water source, the Rimac river, and also the Chillon and Lurin rivers, which flow into the Bay of Lima.

The environmental agency OEFA says that three poorer neighborhoods have the most illegal rubbish, even though they only have 12% of Lima’s people: Villa Maria del Triunfo (39.4%), Villa El Salvador (25.3%), and El Agustino (18.3%). One reason is that many people, especially in poorer areas, do not pay taxes. Because of this, some of the 43 district governments do not have enough money for basic services like rubbish collection.

This also means that sometimes nobody cleans up the rubbish that the vultures find. “We share the vulture’s GPS locations with the local governments,” says Javier Hernandez, the project director. “It is their job to collect the rubbish and try to change people’s habits.”

The project also wants citizens to help, like “vultures on the ground.” People are encouraged to report illegal dumping, reduce their own waste, and recycle. Some residents are helping by posting photos of illegal dumps on Twitter and Facebook. The idea for the project started at the 2014 United Nations Climate Change Conference in Lima. “We wanted to involve not just the authorities but also the people, to raise environmental awareness,” says Hernandez.

Artist Cristina Planas put large vulture head sculptures on 25 dead palm trees in a wetland area in the south of Lima. Rich people did not like it and thought it was ugly, but Planas invited people to “adopt a vulture” to support conservation and recycling.

“We are a little afraid of how the vulture looks,” she said. “But really, he is helping us. He is out there recycling in the places where we throw our rubbish.”

Up to one billion people will still live in extreme poverty by 2030 unless countries focus on reducing inequality and deal with social, economic, and cultural problems that keep people poor or push them back into poverty, a major report warns. The report, made by the Chronic Poverty Advisory Network (CPAN), says that many people may rise above the poverty line of $1.25 a day, but can easily fall back into poverty if they face problems like drought, illness, insecurity, or conflict.

Using household surveys, the report found that in some parts of rural Kenya and South Africa, 30 to 40% of people who escaped poverty became poor again. In some areas of Ethiopia, this number was as high as 60% between 1999 and 2009. Even in successful countries like Indonesia and Vietnam, about 20% of people who escaped poverty fell back. Individual stories show how easy it is to become poor again.

Amin, 61, from rural Bangladesh, has seen his income go down because of his and his wife’s illnesses, the cost of his son’s marriage, his father’s death, and losing things like fishing nets. Lovemore, 74, from Zimbabwe, is now one of the poorest in his village. He lost his job as a car-park attendant because of bad health and had to care for his five grandchildren after his daughters died.

“We need to make sure that people who get out of poverty stay out of poverty for good. Too many families are taking 'two steps forward, one step back' as they try to recover from personal or bigger problems. Governments should not think that just because someone’s income reaches $1.25 a day, the job is finished,” said Andrew Shepherd, a research fellow at the Overseas Development Institute, a CPAN partner, and the main author of the report.

A UN high-level panel looking at a new development plan after the Millennium Development Goals in 2015 said that ending extreme poverty by 2030 is possible. However, the report says that doing the same things as before will not be enough.

Even though extreme poverty fell from 1.9 billion people in 1990 to 1.2 billion in 2010, the report says that progress in the next 15 years will be much harder. The big improvements in China are not likely to happen in other places, and climate problems and deep poverty in parts of sub-Saharan Africa will slow progress. The report says we need to focus more on the chronically poor—people who are poor for many years or all their lives—and on stopping people from becoming poor. “Governments have been good at helping people cross the poverty line because that is easier—they pick the low-hanging fruit. But they have avoided the harder job of dealing with chronic poverty,” said Shepherd.

The report says that while progress in reducing poverty has been impressive, it has helped the chronically poor less than those who were already closer to the poverty line. It says we cannot end poverty unless policies focus on people living in chronic poverty. Policymakers should aim for a “zero tripod” with three connected goals: fight chronic poverty, stop people from becoming poor, and help people stay out of poverty. The report suggests three main policies, all needing large global investment.

The first is social assistance—a safety net—to help the poorest people reach a decent standard of living. For example, Ethiopia’s productive safety net program helped thousands of vulnerable families survive drought without cutting spending on education. The second is education, from early childhood to starting work, to help people escape and stay out of poverty. Education is also useful everywhere. The third is economic growth policies that help the poorest people, making sure that as countries get richer, the very poor also benefit.

“Economic growth is very important, but not just any growth,” Shepherd said. “It must create not just jobs, but good jobs, not just insecure, low-paying work. There are ways to do this, like India’s rural employment guarantee scheme, which has raised wages in both cities and the countryside.” Another example is South Africa’s extension of the minimum wage to groups like domestic workers.

All this will need money, and the report says that stronger tax systems and more tax income will be needed. Aid will also be needed to start social assistance, provide universal health care, and pay for education, including scholarships for the poorest children. “Aid will still be very important in the next 20 years, as many developing countries spend less than $500 per person each year. Even Nigeria, with its oil wealth, spends only $650 per person,” Shepherd said.

With crises in Syria, South Sudan, and the Central African Republic, the report says that conflict and environmental disasters must be addressed. It is essential that governments work to reduce the risk of conflict and create peace agreements that include everyone.

Who are the 'chronically poor'? They are people who are poor for many years or all their lives.

The report says that making “reducing income inequality” a goal after 2015 would help the world focus on the right things, because reducing inequality makes economic growth help poor people faster. The report says that if the inequalities that affect the poorest people—like access to land, jobs, and the power differences between men and women—are fixed, this would help reduce both chronic poverty and inequality.

The authors ask governments to make national development plans that include everyone and to work with civil society to make sure the poorest people have a political voice. They also say governments should challenge difficult social traditions, like dowries and witchcraft, that add to extreme poverty: “This often means changing or removing parts of the current system and is a big change from 'business as usual'.”

The bestselling book on Amazon in the US is not Harper Lee’s new novel, Go Set a Watchman, or George RR Martin’s Song of Ice and Fire series, or even Zoella’s popular young adult book, Girl Online. Instead, Scottish illustrator Johanna Basford is at the top with her colouring books for adults. Her books are the bestsellers on Amazon.com.

Basford’s book Secret Garden, which has detailed drawings of plants and animals, has sold 1.4 million copies around the world. Her new book, Enchanted Forest, has already sold almost 226,000 copies. Many famous people like these books, including Zooey Deschanel, who shared a link to the book on Facebook, and South Korean pop star Kim Ki-Bum, who posted a picture of it on Instagram for his 1.6 million followers.

Eleanor Blatherwick, head of sales and marketing at the publisher Laurence King, said, “It’s been crazy. The last few weeks since Enchanted Forest came out have been very busy, but fantastic. We knew the books would look beautiful, but we didn’t expect them to be such a huge success.”

It is not only Basford who is doing well because of adults who want to colour. In the UK, Richard Merritt’s Art Therapy Colouring Book is number four on Amazon’s bestseller list. Millie Marotta’s Animal Kingdom, which has detailed animal pictures to colour, is number seven, and a mindfulness colouring book is number nine. Basford’s books are in second and eighth place. This means that half of Amazon.co.uk’s top ten books are colouring books for adults.

At the UK publisher Michael O’Mara, which has sold almost 340,000 adult colouring books, Ana McLaughlin, head of publicity, marketing, and online, says the popularity is because colouring is now seen as a way to relax. “The first book we did was in 2012, Creative Colouring for Grown-Ups. It sold well and we printed more, but in 2014, with Art Therapy, it really became popular. Selling the idea that colouring helps with stress made people feel it was okay to enjoy something they thought was just for children,” she said.

The Mindfulness Colouring Book especially promotes this idea. The publisher tells readers that the book has beautiful and detailed patterns, and that colouring them can help you relax and feel calm. They encourage people to take a few minutes each day to colour and find peace.

Basford said, “I think it is really relaxing to do something with your hands, to unplug from technology. It’s creative. For many people, a blank page is scary, but with a colouring book, you just add colour. Also, it reminds people of their childhood.
