In the Central African Republic, people do not live as long. Girls live to 49 and boys to 44. In most countries, except places like Lesotho where there are problems with HIV and violence, people are living longer. The best news is that fewer small children die now than forty years ago. In 1970, 16.4 million children under five died. In 2010, this number was 6.8 million. This is a 60% drop.

In the market square of Rjukan, there is a statue of the town’s founder, Sam Eyde. He was a respected Norwegian engineer and businessman. The statue faces north, looking at a mountain. Behind the statue, to the south, is Gaustatoppen, a mountain that is 1,800 meters high. Between these mountains, in the narrow Vestfjord valley, is the small town that Eyde built over 100 years ago for the workers in his factories.

Eyde used the power of the 100-meter-high Rjukanfossen waterfall to make hydroelectricity in what was then the world’s biggest power plant. However, he could not change the sun. Because Rjukan is deep in a valley and surrounded by high mountains, the town and its 3,400 people are in shadow for half the year. From late September to mid-March, during the day, the town is not completely dark, but it is not bright either. Rjukan is about three hours northwest of Oslo.

Now, high on the mountain opposite Eyde’s statue, 450 meters above the town, there are three large mirrors. These mirrors are powered by solar energy and controlled by computers. They follow the sun’s movement and reflect sunlight down onto the square, filling it with bright light.

“It’s the sun!” says Ingrid Sparbo, smiling and closing her eyes as she enjoys the light. She is a retired secretary who has lived in Rjukan all her life. She says people get used to the shade and stop thinking about it, but the sunlight from the mirrors feels warm, not just on the body but also in the mind.

Two young mothers bring their children to the square to stand in the sun. On a cold day, an old couple sit on a new bench, smiling as they feel the warmth on their faces. Children smile, many people take photos, and a shop assistant named Silje Johansen says, “It’s awesome. Just awesome.”

Electrical engineer Eivind Toreid is more careful. He says, “It’s a funny thing. Not real sunlight, but very similar. Like a spotlight.”

Heidi Fieldheim says she heard about the mirrors on the radio, but seeing them is much better than she expected. She believes the mirrors will bring a lot of happiness.

Across the road, in the Nye Tider café, sits Martin Andersen, the man who created this new happiness. Andersen is a 40-year-old artist who moved to Rjukan in 2001. He got the idea for the “Solspeil,” or Sun Mirror, at the end of a September. He says that every day, he and his family had to walk further down the valley to find the sun. By September 28, the sun disappears from Rjukan’s market square and does not return until March 12.

Between September and March, Andersen says, they could see blue sky and the sun high on the mountain, but the only way to feel the sun was to leave town. He thought it was sad that people had to leave Rjukan to feel the sun.

Twelve years after Andersen first had his idea, a German company that specializes in concentrated solar power brought the three 17-square-meter glass mirrors to Rjukan by helicopter. Andersen says it took longer than they thought, but now the mirrors work. Even people who were against the idea at first now agree that it works.

Nils Eggerud admits he was strongly against the mirrors. He thought the money should have been spent on other things, like more carers for old people, better schools, bike paths, or roads. He still worries about the cost of keeping the mirrors working and who will pay for it. But he says it feels nice to stand in the sunlight, and you just have to look at people’s happy faces.

In his office overlooking the square, Rjukan’s young mayor, Steinar Bergsland, is more interested in the benefits the mirrors bring than the cost. He says more visitors are coming to Rjukan than usual, and shopkeepers are earning more money. A high-tech company is interested in moving to Rjukan because of the new technology and the attention it has brought.

Bergsland says the mirrors are a powerful symbol for Rjukan. With help from government grants and a donation from a local business, the town only had to pay 1 million krone (about 100,000 euros) of the total 5 million krone cost. He says, “Just look out of the window. Look at those happy faces. Now it’s here, people love it.”

"Fit in four minutes" sounds like something from a health magazine or a late-night TV ad that is too good to be true. But when you try Dr. Izumi Tabata’s training program—20 seconds of very hard exercise, 10 seconds of rest, repeated eight times—you realize it is real after you collapse from exhaustion.

Tabata has seen this reaction before. He laughs when he remembers the first time he tested his system on his university students in the early 1990s. After four minutes of hard exercise, they were completely tired. But after six weeks, they saw surprising results. Everyone was surprised.

Tabata started his research after watching Japan’s speed skating team in the early 1990s. He noticed that short periods of very hard exercise seemed to work as well as hours of moderate training. To prove this, he did a simple experiment. One group of students did an hour of steady exercise on a bike five times a week. The other group did a ten-minute warm-up, then four minutes of Tabata training, four times a week, plus one 30-minute steady session with two minutes of Tabata.

The results were surprising. After six weeks, the Tabata group, who exercised only 88 minutes a week, increased their anaerobic capacity by 28% and their VO2 max (which shows heart and lung health) by 15%. The control group, who trained for five hours a week, also improved their VO2 max, but only by 10%, and their training did not improve anaerobic capacity. Tabata also says they saw heart size increase after three weeks of the exercises.

But you must work very hard. You cannot just sit on a machine, chew gum, and read a magazine. The program needs very intense effort on a bike or rowing machine, or explosive exercises like sprints. Think about how you felt after running 100 meters at school. Now imagine doing that eight times with only ten seconds to rest each time.

Tabata says the program is based on working at 170% of your VO2 max. If you feel okay after, you did not do it right. The first three rounds feel easy, but the last two feel almost impossible. The goal is to do eight rounds, but some people can only do six or seven.

Someone online wrote, “When done correctly you should meet God. Most people cannot do it correctly and should not try.” Tabata does not fully agree. He says everyone can do it, but beginners should start with a trained coach to make sure they work at the right level. He also says his program burns an extra 150 calories in the 12 hours after exercise, even when resting. So, while most people use it to get fit or fitter, it also helps burn fat.

It is surprising that only serious athletes use the program now. But this may change because Tabata has agreed to create a network of instructors and release DVDs later this year. He says, “I decided to do this because I see people on YouTube doing it wrong. They do not know how hard they need to work.”

Should everyone try this plan? Richard Scrivener, a former rugby fitness coach, says the benefits are clear, but Tabata training should be added to your favorite sport or training, not replace it. For example, runners need to practice running skills and run many miles, but they could do fewer long runs and add Tabata training. This would give their joints time to rest and recover, especially if they have had injuries, and they might get more benefit from the long runs they do.

People who go to the gym can do three strength sessions and three Tabata sessions a week. The rest of us can slowly add more sessions, but it will never get easier because every session needs maximum effort. That is the tough but smart part of the program: it is hard, but it works.

In 2005, BlackBerry made instant messaging possible on mobile phones. At that time, BlackBerry was becoming very popular, and its smartphone was one of Canada’s biggest exports. The iPhone did not exist yet, but BlackBerry’s new ideas made its phone special.

Six years later, in 2011, there were riots in London and other UK cities. BlackBerry Messenger (BBM) was so good at helping people organize that politicians wanted to shut it down for a while. But two years after that, users themselves started to stop using BBM.

Fewer people want BlackBerry phones now. Many other apps have appeared, like Facebook’s and Apple’s instant messaging, and independent apps such as WhatsApp and Kik (which is also Canadian). These apps are free to download and use. They use the internet to send text messages, pictures, voice clips, stickers, and videos between most types of phones.

To keep its customers, BlackBerry made BBM available on Android and Apple phones. Even though there is a lot of competition, more than 20 million people downloaded BBM. However, many people think this is not enough to save BBM. James Gooderson, an 18-year-old student who writes about technology, says that bringing BBM to the iPhone is four or five years too late. WhatsApp has made BlackBerry phones unnecessary for young people.

BBM says it has 80 million users each month after its update, but WhatsApp has 300 million. Other apps show what BBM cannot do: BBM does not have video or voice calls like Skype and Viber; it does not have location sharing like Path; it does not have video sharing like iMessage; and it does not have stickers, which are popular with kids. Even the contacts and calendar sharing that BBM had on BlackBerry phones are missing from the Apple and Android versions.

Messaging is changing from words to pictures. People upload photos to Instagram and get quick comments. Snapchat lets people send pictures that disappear after ten seconds. Like BBM, all these services are free for any phone with internet. In 2011, BBM was so powerful that it helped start a revolution in Egypt, and during the London riots, it gave news faster than TV.

Jean-Pierre Moore, 28, manages a youth club in Stockwell, south London, an area with high crime and poverty. He remembers that during the riots, people could see where the rioters were going next on BlackBerry messages, while TV news was four hours behind. Now, Moore mostly uses an iPad. He does not think shutting down BBM would have stopped the looting. He says social networking was not the reason for the riots.

Almost 80% of young smartphone owners use a social networking app regularly, and two-thirds use more than one. Among 16- to 24-year-olds, 60% use Facebook every day, but 46% use other apps too. Benedict Evans, a digital media expert, says the environment is more complex now. All these apps use your phone’s contacts and photos. Some apps, like Instagram, last a long time; others disappear quickly.

Thirteen-year-old Bennett has three phones. He uses his BlackBerry for messaging, an iPhone for games, and an Android phone for calls. His friends still use BBM. With a few clicks, he can send a message to all his contacts on BlackBerry—sometimes several hundred people. On WhatsApp, the limit for a group message is 50. But for Bennett, Instagram is now very important. He says Instagram is like Facebook without parents. When he saw his mother on Facebook, he deleted his account.

BlackBerry is still cheap to buy and use. Anyone with a secondhand phone and a £7-a-month plan can send unlimited BBM messages. But people do not trust BBM’s privacy anymore. Before, people thought messages sent through BlackBerry’s secure servers could not be traced. After the riots, arrests and court cases showed this was not true.

In South Kensington, a rich part of London, older students outside a private school all have Apple phones and use WhatsApp. For many, BBM is just a memory. One teenager says he still has a BlackBerry, but he is the only one. When asked how he feels, he says, “Isolated.”

The right of Bolivia’s indigenous Indian tribes to chew coca leaves, which are the main ingredient in cocaine, has caused big arguments between countries. This disagreement could change global drug policies. Bolivia has received a special exception from the 1961 Convention on Narcotic Drugs, which controls international drug rules. This exception allows Bolivia’s indigenous people to chew coca leaves.

Bolivia said that the convention was against its new constitution, which was adopted in 2009. The constitution says Bolivia must protect native and traditional coca as part of its cultural heritage. Bolivia also says that coca leaves in their natural form are not a drug.

A company from the Netherlands wants to make the dream of going to Mars come true. The company, called Mars One, plans to send four astronauts to Mars in 2023 to start a human colony. However, there are some big problems.

First, the gravity on Mars is only 38% of Earth’s gravity. This means the astronauts’ bodies will change a lot. Their bones, muscles, and blood circulation will become so different that they might not be able to live on Earth again. Second, because of this, the astronauts will have to say goodbye to their families and friends forever, as there is no way to come back.

The Mars One website says that a return trip is not possible or expected. To come back, they would need a rocket with enough fuel, life support for seven months, and the ability to leave Mars’ gravity. They would also need to connect with a space station near Earth or land safely on Earth.

Even with these problems, about 10,000 people have already applied, according to Mars One’s Medical Director, Norbert Kraft. He told The Guardian that the applicants are between 18 and 62 years old. Most are men, but some women have also applied.

People have different reasons for wanting to go. For example, Cynthia, a 32-year-old American woman, said it was her childhood dream to go to Mars. She said, “When I first heard about the Mars One project I thought, this is my chance. That childhood dream could become a reality. I could be one of the first people to build a colony on Mars and show people on Earth that there are still new places for humans to explore.”

Mars One is looking for astronauts who are strong, flexible, curious, able to trust others, and good at solving problems. They must also be over 18 years old.

Mars One says that the basic things needed for life are already on Mars. For example, water can be taken from ice in the ground, and Mars has nitrogen, which is the main part of the air we breathe. The colony will use special solar panels for power.

The project will cost about $6 billion. Bas Lansdorp, the founder of Mars One, hopes to get some of this money by selling TV rights. He said that the money made from broadcasting the London Olympics was almost enough to pay for a mission to Mars.

Paul Römer, who helped create the reality TV show Big Brother, is also supporting the project. He said that this mission to Mars could be the biggest media event in the world, like a reality show with no end and everyone watching.

Mars One’s goal is to build a permanent human colony on Mars. The first team will land in 2023 to start building, and every two years, four more astronauts will join them.

Some people do not believe the project will work. They worry about how the astronauts will get to Mars and build a colony with everything they need to survive.

The mission hopes to inspire people to believe that anything is possible, like the Apollo moon landings. Mars One says it is not only possible but also necessary to build a permanent colony on Mars. This will help us learn more about how the solar system was formed, where life comes from, and our place in the universe.

A special press conference at Leicester University has revealed who the man with the twisted spine found in the car park was. It also told about his terrible last moments and how his body was treated badly after his death. People cheered when Richard Buckley, the leader of the archaeologists, finally said they were sure they had found the body of Richard III.

There was a lot of strong evidence. Scientists did DNA tests, experts used computer technology to study the bones closely, genealogists found a distant family member with matching DNA, and researchers looked at old texts about the king’s death and burial. All of them shared their results.

Plans have started for a new tomb for Richard III in Leicester Cathedral, only 100 yards from where they found the body. There will be a ceremony to bury him there, probably next year. Leicester’s Museums Service is also planning a new visitor centre in an old school building near the site.

Richard III died at the Battle of Bosworth on 22 August 1485. He was the last English king to die in battle. For the first time, researchers explained how he died. People gasped when they saw a picture showing the bottom of his skull cut off by a strong blow, probably from a sharp iron axe on a wooden pole. The blade went several centimetres into his brain. Experts say he was knocked out immediately and died almost at once.

This injury matches the story that he died in the middle of the battle and without his horse, as in Shakespeare’s play: “A horse! A horse! My kingdom for a horse!” Another sword cut also went through his skull and into his brain, which would have killed him too. Many other injuries happened after he died, showing that his naked body was damaged as it was taken back to Leicester.

One very bad injury happened after death and could not have happened if he was wearing armour. This supports the story that his naked body was brought back on a horse and was treated badly. Bob Savage, an expert on medieval weapons, said this injury was probably made by a sharp knife or dagger, not a weapon used in war.

Michael Ibsen, a furniture maker born in Canada, was found to be a descendant of Richard’s sister. He heard the news on Sunday and listened to the evidence in shock. He said, “My head is no clearer now than when I first heard the news.” He also said that many people died in that battle. Richard was a king, but just one of the dead. He lived in violent times, and these deaths were not quick or easy.

Mathew Morris was the first to find the body, in the first hour of the first day of digging. He did not believe he had found the king at first. A machine was still removing the car park surface, in a place that local historians and the Richard III Society thought was the site of the lost church of Grey Friars. The priests of Grey Friars bravely took the king’s body and buried him quickly, probably still naked, but in a place of honour near the main altar of their church. The leg bones, which were just showing in the soil, were covered up again.

Ten days later, on 5 September, after more digging showed Morris had found the right place, he came back with Lin Foxhall, the head of archaeology, to dig up the body. They did it in the usual way, lifting the arms, legs, and skull first, and then the rest of the body. When they finally saw the twisted spine, Morris thought, “My word, I think we’ve got him.”

For Philippa Langley of the Richard III Society, Richard was the true king, the last king of the north, and a brave leader who became a victim of very clever propaganda, especially by Shakespeare. There is still the dark story of the little princes in the tower. In Richard’s time, the child Edward V and his brother Richard were declared illegitimate when Richard III became king. They were put in the Tower of London and never seen alive again. It is not certain that the bones found in the tower many years later are theirs, so more DNA tests may be needed.

Scientists have put a false memory into the brains of mice in an experiment. They hope this will help explain why people sometimes remember things that never happened.

False memories are a big problem in court cases. Witnesses often give evidence that leads to guilty verdicts, but later, new evidence like DNA shows the person was innocent.

Susumu Tonagawa, a brain scientist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), and his team wanted to learn how false memories form in the human brain. They created memories in mice by changing single brain cells. Memories are made from different parts, like objects, places, and times. These parts are stored as physical and chemical changes in brain cells and their connections. Tonagawa says that both real and false memories use the same brain systems.

In the experiment, the team put mice in a box and let them explore. While the mice explored, their brain cells made a memory protein. The next day, the mice were put in a second box and given a small electric shock to make them afraid. At the same time, the scientists shined light into the mice’s brains to turn on their memory of the first box. This made the mice connect the fear of the shock with the memory of the first box.

In the last part of the experiment, the mice were put back in the first box. The mice froze in fear, even though they had never been shocked in that box.

A similar thing may happen when strong false memories are made in humans. Humans have strong imaginations, said Tonagawa. So, like the mice, we can connect what we are thinking about with good or bad events. This means we might connect something in our mind with something that did not really happen.

He also said that false and real memories are made in almost the same way in the brain. It is hard for people with false memories to tell the difference. He hopes that future research will help legal experts understand how unreliable memory can be.

Chris French, from the University of London, is an expert in false memories in people. He said these results are an important first step in understanding false memories. Memory experts know that memory does not work like a video camera. Instead, memory is built from pieces of real memories and sometimes from other information.

He warned that the false memories made in the mice were much simpler than the complex false memories seen in people, such as false memories of childhood abuse, alien abduction, or past lives. These complicated false memories use many parts of the brain, and we still do not fully understand how they form.

Mark Stokes, a brain scientist at Oxford University, said the experiments were a big success, but we should remember that these results are still very different from how most people think about memory. The new memories in the mice were made by artificial stimulation, not by real experiences.

The mouse models made by the MIT team will help scientists ask more difficult questions about human memory. Now that we can change memories in the brain, we can ask questions that used to be only for philosophers, said Steve Ramirez, a colleague of Tonagawa at MIT. For example: Are there many ways to make false memories? Can we create false memories on purpose? Can we make false memories about objects, food, or other mice? These are questions that can now be tested in the lab.

As the technology improves, French said, scientists must think carefully about how to use it. When we create false memories, we must be very careful about the ethical problems. There is a big risk that these techniques could be misused.

Scientists have made mice remember something that did not really happen. They hope this experiment will help explain why people sometimes remember things that are not true.

False memories can be a problem in court. Sometimes, people who see a crime give wrong information. This can make someone go to jail, but later, new evidence like DNA can show they were not guilty.

In the experiment, the scientists put mice in a box and let them look around. The mice made a memory of this box. The next day, the scientists put the mice in a different box and gave them a small electric shock, which scared them. At the same time, the scientists used light to make the mice remember the first box. Because of this, the mice started to feel afraid when they remembered the first box, even though nothing bad happened there.

Later, the scientists put the mice back in the first box. The mice were scared and did not move, but they had never been shocked in that box. They were afraid because of the false memory.

Something like this can happen to people. Tonagawa said that humans can also connect things in their minds with good or bad events, even if those things did not really happen. He said that false memories and real memories use almost the same parts of the brain, so it is hard to tell them apart. He hopes that future experiments will help lawyers and judges understand that memory is not always reliable.

Chris French, a scientist from the University of London, studies false memories in people. He said this experiment is an important first step to understand false memories. He explained that memory does not work like a video camera. We do not remember everything exactly. Instead, we remember small parts and fill in the rest with other information.

French also said that the false memories in the mice were much simpler than the false memories people can have. People can have false memories about things like childhood abuse, being taken by aliens, or past lives. These memories are very complex and use many parts of the brain. French said it will take a long time to understand how these memories are made.

The mouse experiment from MIT will help scientists ask more questions about memories in people. For example, can we make false memories about things, food, or other mice? These questions used to be science fiction, but now scientists can study them in the lab.

Music subscription services like Spotify and Deezer have made more than $1 billion in sales worldwide, as more people pay to listen to music online.

In 2013, money from streaming and subscriptions went up by over 50% to $1.1 billion. For the first time in 12 years, sales of recorded music in Europe also increased, according to numbers published in March.

Many people still listen to music for free, but more fans are now paying because they want more choices. In three years, the number of paying subscribers grew from 8 million to 28 million, according to the 2014 digital music report from the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI).

Subscription services are easy to use on smartphones and tablets. They are popular with people who want to listen to new music without buying a download or a CD. People like these services because they are cheap, easy to use, and legal, unlike pirated downloads. IFPI Chief Executive Frances Moore said that streaming and subscription are now a normal way to do business in music.

The IFPI also said that One Direction was the best-selling artist of 2013, with 4 million physical and digital sales for their album Midnight Memories. Katy Perry’s album Prism was the best-selling album by a female artist, and was sixth overall, behind Eminem, Justin Timberlake, Bruno Mars, and Daft Punk.

Technology companies are also joining the music streaming trend. Apple has iTunes Radio, Google has the Play Store, and smaller companies like Beats Music are joining too.

In Britain and America, streaming may soon make more money for the music industry than downloads from online stores like Apple’s iTunes. Subscription services now make up one third of all digital music sales worldwide, with downloads making up the rest. However, the IFPI data shows that streaming and downloads are growing at different speeds.

In the US, the percentage of people using subscription services and streaming went up from 19% in 2012 to 23%, while the percentage of people downloading music went down from 28% to 27%. In Britain, the number of people downloading stayed the same at one third, but subscribers grew from 19% to 22%. In Sweden, France, and Italy, streaming is already more popular than downloading.

Digital music now makes up 39% of all music sales, or almost $5.9 billion out of $15 billion. Sales of physical formats like CDs and vinyl dropped a lot in 2013, but they still make up just over half of the music industry’s income.

Vinyl records became more popular again in some countries. Sales of vinyl went up by 32% in America and by 101% in the UK in 2013.

Inside one of Britain’s most expensive houses, there is a thick layer of bird droppings. Pigeon skeletons are on the floor with broken mirrors, and water runs through damaged walls. This place is called The Tower, a 30-million-pound palace on Billionaires Row in north London. Its ruined state has been a secret until now.

The Tower is one of ten mansions in the middle of The Bishops Avenue that have been almost empty for about 25 years. It is believed they were bought for members of the Saudi Arabian royal family. The Greek-style columns are breaking, and the swimming pools with mosaic tiles are full of rubbish. Nature has taken over, and owls now live there.

This sad scene is common along the avenue, which Lloyds Bank says is the second most expensive street in Britain. While more people in London struggle to buy homes as prices rise by 11.2% each year, 16 mansions on the most expensive part of The Bishops Avenue are empty. Many are behind locked gates, with overgrown gardens guarded by dogs.

Across the street, there is another empty mansion worth 18 million pounds, with broken windows and walls covered in anti-climb paint. Another house, sold for 20 million pounds, has metal bars on the windows.

Seeing these empty, ruined houses is painful for people who have trouble finding a place to live in one of the world’s most expensive cities. A security guard working on the avenue said it was frustrating to see so many houses—enough for dozens of people—falling apart.

Rich royals from Nigeria and Saudi Arabia were some of the first to buy houses on this road near Hampstead Heath. Iranians came after the fall of the shah. Now, Chinese buyers are joining Russians and Kazakhs who have spent millions to get an address that estate agents say is as famous as the Champs Élysées or Rodeo Drive. Recently, two mansions were for sale for 65 million and 38 million pounds, offering Italian marble, leather-covered lifts, and luxury panic rooms.

But in the gardens of the empty mansions, stone fountains are falling apart. Inside one house, water drips through a large crystal chandelier onto a thick carpet that is rotting under a collapsed ceiling. Moss grows through broken bricks, and mirrored tiles are on the bathroom floor. The swimming pool is full of dirty water and flowers are growing through the tiles. The wood in the sauna is coming off the walls.

The Tower is the most dramatic ruin. This grand mansion is surrounded by many trees. Its large halls with high ceilings are full of pigeons, and the walls are bright green from algae. There are unopened wooden boxes marked “bullet-proof glass,” showing the old owners were worried about security.

Today, very few people live on The Bishops Avenue all the time. A security guard outside one mansion said the owners were not there. Another guard outside Royal Mansion would not say if anyone was home. A staff member at another mansion only warned the Guardian about the guard dogs. Magdy Adib Ishak-Hannah, who is worth 45 million pounds, said he is one of the few people who live there all the time.

“It’s not a friendly place where you can talk to your neighbours,” he said. “To be honest, I have never seen what my neighbours look like. Next door, a Saudi princess spent 35 million pounds on a new house and I’ve never seen her. About three houses are lived in all the time, and half of the properties are used for three to six months a year. The other half, I don’t know if anyone comes or not.”

These expensive ruins show a property culture where the world’s richest people see British houses as investments.

Still, people on the avenue are talking about building 5-million-pound apartments instead of 50-million-pound mansions to bring people back.

Anil Varma, a local property developer, has decided to rebuild one of the most valuable sites on the avenue as 20 apartments with a concierge, maid service, a 25-metre pool, spa, and cinema.

“If you build a big house and try to sell it for 30 to 40 million pounds, it won’t sell,” he said. “Local people won’t buy, so you have to find buyers from other countries.”

But nobody plans to use the empty houses on the avenue to help with the housing crisis. Andrew Harper, a local Conservative politician, laughed when asked if some of the empty houses could become cheap homes. He said the land is far too expensive.

Their gates are locked, and there are guard dogs in the gardens, which are full of weeds.

Across the street, there is another empty mansion worth £18 million. It has broken windows and the walls have special paint to stop people from climbing. Another mansion, which sold for £20 million, has metal bars on the windows.

For people who find it very hard to have a home in one of the world’s most expensive cities, seeing these empty houses is sad. One security guard who works on the avenue said it was annoying to see so many big houses—enough for many people—falling apart.

Rich royal families from Nigeria and Saudi Arabia were the first to come to this road near Hampstead Heath. Iranians came after the shah lost power. Now, Chinese buyers are coming, following Russians and Kazakhs who have spent millions to get an address that estate agents say is as famous as the Champs Elysées or Rodeo Drive. Recently, two mansions have been for sale for £65 million and £38 million.

But in the gardens of the empty mansions, stone fountains are breaking. Inside one mansion, the ceiling has fallen down and water drips through a big crystal light onto a thick carpet, which is rotting. Moss is growing through the bricks, and broken mirrors are on the bathroom floor. The swimming pool is full of dirty water and flowers are growing in it. The wood in the sauna is coming off the walls.

But the most dramatic ruin is The Towers, a grand mansion. There are pigeons in its big halls with high ceilings, and the walls are bright green with algae.

Today, very few people live on The Bishops Avenue all the time. A security guard outside one mansion said the owners were not there. Another guard outside Royal Mansion would not say if anyone was home. A worker at another mansion warned the Guardian about the guard dogs.

Magdy Adib Ishak-Hannah, who has £45 million, said he is one of the few people who lives there all the time.

“I have never seen what my neighbours look like. Next door, a Saudi princess spent £35 million on a new house and I’ve never seen her. There are about three houses where people live all the time, and half of the houses are lived in for three to six months a year. The other half, I don’t know if anyone comes or not,” he said.

The reason for these very expensive empty houses is that some of the richest people in the world see British houses as a way to invest their money.

Anil Varma, who builds and sells homes, wants to build £5 million apartments instead of £50 million mansions to try to bring people back.

He has decided to rebuild one of the most expensive places on the avenue as a group of 20 apartments with a concierge, maid service, a 25-metre pool, a spa, and a cinema.

For Tua Pittman, a traditional navigator from Raratonga in the Cook Islands, a canoe is much more than just a way to travel. He says, "The canoe is like our island, the crew is our community, and the navigator is the leader." He explains that on a canoe, you do not just travel from one place to another using the stars, moon, sun, and birds. Navigation also means using leadership skills to guide your crew and help them in life.

It has been a busy week for the crews of four sailing canoes since they arrived in Sydney for the start of the World Parks Congress. Tua’s journey started in the Cook Islands on September 25. The islanders sailed to Samoa, then Fiji, Vanuatu, and the Gold Coast, before going south to Sydney. About 100 crew members took part in the trip, and they tried to use only traditional navigation methods. However, Tua said they sometimes had to use modern navigation tools to reach Australia on time for the Congress.

The official name of the trip is the Mua Voyage. It is a partnership between the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Oceania Regional Office and five Pacific Island countries: Samoa, Tonga, New Zealand, the Cook Islands, and Fiji. The main goal of the 6,000-nautical-mile (11,000 km) journey was to bring an important message to the World Parks Congress.

The message said: We see signs that we are using too many resources. We do not see as many fish and other sea animals as before. Foreign fishing boats are taking our resources. Our coral reefs and places where fish lay eggs are disappearing. Our ocean is big, but it is not endless. More people in the world and bad development are making it harder for the ocean to support life.

The Pacific Islanders worked hard to bring this urgent message to the Congress. But even with this message, the Congress spent a lot of time discussing how much of the ocean should be protected in marine sanctuaries. In 2013, the IUCN said that less than three percent of the world’s oceans were in protected areas, and less than one percent of that was “no-take” (no fishing allowed). This was much less than the 20-30% no-take target set by the last World Parks Congress in 2003.

Marine scientist Professor Callum Roberts helped set the 20-30% target in 2003, but he said it is not enough. He thinks the IUCN should now increase the target from 30% to 33%. New research shows we need to protect even more of the ocean. If we do less now, it will be very bad for our oceans.

After difficult talks, the World Parks Congress delegates agreed on a new plan that will change how we protect the oceans. Instead of the old 20-30% target, the IUCN now says that each marine habitat should have at least 30% strictly protected areas. These areas should protect both different kinds of life and the services that ecosystems provide.

Tua Pittman was very happy that a strong decision to protect the world’s oceans was made at the Congress. He said, "It’s a huge reward for all the effort we made to be here and to be heard. Hearing about this decision is fantastic. It’s a step in the right direction."

He also said he is 55 years old and has already seen that it is much harder to catch fish in the open ocean. He said pollution is getting worse, especially near big cities like Sydney. Climate change is also starting to seriously affect Pacific Islanders. He said that decisions made by big countries affect small countries much more than they affect large, developed nations.

Tua said the Mua Voyage was a huge job to organize. It took years of planning and navigation work. It was very important to the voyagers that the world listened to their message and took action. He said leaders of rich countries should think more like traditional navigators, who know their boats are very small in a huge sea. Most importantly, Tua says politicians must look for a new way. The world needs to find a different path.

The Chief Medical Officer for England has said that antibiotic resistance is as dangerous as international terrorism. In reality, antibiotic resistance kills many more people each year than terrorist attacks do.

The World Health Organization says that, for tuberculosis alone, more than 150,000 people die each year because the bacteria are resistant to many drugs. Antibiotic resistance is now a serious problem; it is like a war.

In the last 100 years, life has changed a lot. In the early 1900s, men in the UK lived about 47 years and women about 50 years. Many children died before age five, mostly from infections. Now, a child born in Britain has more than a one in four chance of living to 100 years old. This is because of public health systems, vaccines, and antibiotics. These things have helped us win the fight against many diseases.

In intensive care units, where I work, antibiotic-resistant bacteria are most common. Here, we use strong antibiotics to treat very sick people. These drugs kill normal bacteria, but some strong bacteria survive and learn how to resist the drugs.

When I became a doctor in the late 1990s, I learned about MRSA (Methicillin Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus). This bacteria cannot be killed by methicillin or other penicillins. We had a few drugs, like vancomycin and teicoplanin, to fight it. But over time, more bacteria became resistant, and new types of resistance appeared. We started using drugs we had not used before. The problem slowly got worse, and it became a constant battle between us and the bacteria.

The situation has changed because we have used antibiotics too much in hospitals and clinics. Even worse, antibiotics have been used in farming, added to animal food. We thought antibiotics would always work, and we believed drug companies would always make new ones.

But now, this is not true. New, stronger bacteria have appeared. Vancomycin, which we used for MRSA, stopped working. Vancomycin Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus (VRSA) was found in hospitals. Other bacteria also became resistant. Now, infections with resistant bacteria are common, and drug companies are not making enough new antibiotics. It is getting harder to create new drugs that work. Every time a new drug is made, bacteria quickly find a way to resist it. We have already tried all the easy solutions. Antibiotics are expensive to make, used only for short times, and quickly stop working because of resistance. Because of this, drug companies do not have much reason to make new antibiotics.

Antibiotics started being used in the 1940s, and soon after, bacteria started to resist them. Now, resistance is a normal problem in medicine. Less than 100 years after penicillin was discovered, we are starting to lose the fight.

Since the first MRSA deaths in healthy children in the US in 1998, the number of deaths from MRSA in the US has grown to tens of thousands each year, which is more than the number of deaths from AIDS. Bacterial resistance is everywhere in hospitals. This is a different kind of war. Doctors need to change how they give antibiotics, and we must use fewer antibiotics in farming. We also need to find a way to encourage drug companies to make new antibiotics, even if they are not very profitable.

If we do not make big changes, we could return to the time before antibiotics, when many more people died from infections. Losing our advantage against bacteria would be a disaster.

The World Health Organization says that more than 150,000 people die each year from tuberculosis because antibiotics do not work. This is like a war.

One hundred years ago in the UK, men lived about 47 years and women about 50 years. Many young children died. About 30% of all deaths were children under five years old, mostly because of infections.

Today, a child born in Britain has more than a 25% chance to live to 100 years old. This is because of good public health, vaccines, and antibiotics.

In intensive care units, bacteria that resist antibiotics are very common. Strong antibiotics are used a lot here. These drugs kill normal bacteria, but they cannot kill strong bacteria that have learned to survive.

When I became a doctor in the 1990s, I learned about MRSA. MRSA is a bacteria that does not die from methicillin or other penicillins. Only a few drugs, like vancomycin and teicoplanin, could kill it. But more and more bacteria became resistant to antibiotics.

In hospitals and doctor’s offices, we use antibiotics too much. We also use antibiotics when we grow food and give them to farm animals.

We thought we could always use antibiotics and that companies would always make new ones. But this is not true now. We have found new bacteria that are even more resistant. Vancomycin, which we used for MRSA, stopped working. We found VRSA, a bacteria that does not die from vancomycin, in hospitals. Other bacteria are also becoming resistant.

Today, infections with very resistant bacteria are common, but there are fewer new antibiotics. It is harder to make new drugs that can kill these bacteria. Antibiotics are expensive to make, used for only a short time, and stop working quickly because of resistance.

This fight against bacteria is not like other wars. Doctors need to change how they give antibiotics, and we need to use fewer antibiotics in farming. We also need to give companies reasons to make new antibiotics, even if they do not make much money from them.

Now, antibiotic resistance is a normal problem. Less than 100 years after penicillin was discovered, we are starting to lose the fight against bacteria.

People from all over Rwanda, and even from parts of Burundi, are coming to the southern town of Butare to visit a small shop called Inzozi Nziza, which means Sweet Dreams. They come to try something new—sweet, cold ice cream, which most of them have never tasted before.

This is the first ice cream shop in Rwanda. Here, customers can buy scoops of ice cream in flavors like sweet cream, passion fruit, strawberry, and pineapple. They can add toppings such as fresh fruit, honey, chocolate chips, and granola. The shop also sells black tea and coffee.

The shop has signs that say “ice cream, coffee, dreams.” Louise Ingabire, the manager of Inzozi Nziza, says the shop is using people’s curiosity about ice cream to change lives. She says, “Ice cream is important. Some Rwandans like ice cream, but it is something new. We still need to tell more people that they will enjoy it.”

The shop is helping people’s dreams come true. Ingabire, who is 27 years old, says, “Before, I did not have a job. I just stayed at home. Now, I have hope for the future. I am earning money and I can help my family.”

Butare has 89,600 people and is 135 kilometers south of the capital city, Kigali. It is also the home of the National University of Rwanda. Inzozi Nziza has become a popular place for tired students who want to enjoy something cool and different.

Kalisa Migendo, a 24-year-old agriculture student, says, “It brings people together. If you want to meet a friend, a girl or a boy, you come to Inzozi Nziza for ice cream.”

Most of the ingredients for the ice cream come from local sources. The milk comes from nearby Nyanza, but the vanilla beans and cocoa are imported.

Inzozi Nziza was started by Odile Gakire Katese, a theatre director. She met Alexis Miesen and Jennie Dundas, who started Blue Marble Ice Cream in Brooklyn, New York. Together, they opened the shop in 2010.

Katese believed that an ice cream shop could help people feel better and bring back hope and family traditions. At first, Miesen and Dundas owned the shop together with the staff, and everyone had shares in the business. The shop is a cooperative and does not make a profit. After 18 months, Miesen and Dundas gave their shares to the women, who had shown they could run the business.

Ice cream is new in Rwanda. To make the business work, the women had to learn many new skills and help people get used to eating and selling ice cream, which is not part of Rwandan culture.

The shop in Butare employs nine women. In their free time, they practice with Ingoma Nshya, Rwanda’s first and only female drumming group, which Katese started ten years ago.

The drummers are Hutu and Tutsi women. Some survived the 1994 genocide, when almost a million Tutsis and Hutus were killed. Some members of Ingoma Nshya are widows, and some are orphans.

In the past, Rwandan women were not allowed to drum, and many people thought the drums were too heavy for women. But Ingabire says drumming brings people together.

Ingabire’s father, two siblings, and many cousins were killed in the genocide. She says, “When I am drumming, it gives me strength because we are still alive and we are survivors.”

The ice cream shop is featured in a documentary by filmmakers Rob and Lisa Fruchtman. The film, called Sweet Dreams, tells the story of how the women have built a better future after the genocide. It also shows the female drummers.

The film has been shown in more than twelve countries, including the US, UK, and several African countries. Lisa Fruchtman says, “We think the film is about strength, hope, courage, creativity, and the ability to change your own life.”

A report from the World Health Organization (WHO) says that 35.6% of all women in the world will experience physical or sexual violence in their lives, usually from a male partner. The report shows that many women are attacked by the men they live with, and 30% of women are attacked by their partners. It also says that 38% of women who are murdered are killed by their partners.

The highest rates of violence against women are in Africa, where almost half of all women (45.6%) will suffer physical or sexual violence. In low- and middle-income countries in Europe, the rate is 27.2%. But richer countries are not always safer. In high-income countries, about one in three women (32.7%) will experience violence at some point in their lives. Of the women who experience violence, 42% are injured. These injuries often bring them to hospitals or clinics, which is often the first time healthcare workers find out about the violence and can offer help. Violence has a big effect on women’s health. Some women come to the hospital with broken bones, while others have problems related to pregnancy or mental health issues.

The WHO has published two reports. One report is about how common violence is, and the other gives advice to healthcare workers on how to help women. These reports were written by Dr. Claudia Garcia-Moreno, a specialist in gender and health at WHO, and Professor Charlotte Watts, an expert in gender, violence, and health from the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine.

Dr. Garcia-Moreno said that, for the first time, they have compared data from all over the world about violence from partners and from other people, and how this violence affects health. The health problems include HIV and other sexually transmitted infections, depression, alcoholism, unwanted pregnancies, and babies born with low weight.

The rates of violence against women are different in different parts of the world, but Garcia-Moreno said that in every region, the rates are too high. Data from 81 countries shows that even in rich countries, 23.2% of women will suffer physical or sexual violence from a partner. The worldwide number for women attacked by partners is 30%.

More sexual attacks and rapes by people who are not partners are reported in rich countries than in other places. The report says that 12.6% of women in rich countries will be sexually attacked by someone who is not their partner, which is higher than the rate in Africa (11.9%). However, not all regions collect good data about these crimes.

The authors say that their earlier research shows that women who are better educated and women who work are less likely to suffer violence, but this is not true everywhere. Watts said that society needs to think about its views on violence against women. In some places, violence is not accepted, but not everywhere.

Garcia-Moreno said that these numbers should make everyone pay more attention to the problem. In the last ten years, more people have started to recognize the problem, but it is complicated. There is no simple solution like a vaccine or a pill.

The new WHO guidelines say that healthcare workers should be trained to see the signs of domestic violence and sexual assault, but they do not suggest asking every woman who comes to a clinic if she has suffered violence. Garcia-Moreno said that if a woman comes back many times with injuries she does not explain, healthcare workers should ask about domestic violence. She said that when she was in medical school, she did not learn about this problem. Later, she sometimes felt that something else was wrong with a woman she was talking to, but did not know it was domestic violence. Now, she would do the interview very differently.

Women in rich countries report more sexual attacks and rapes by people they know or by strangers than in other places. The report says that 12.6% of women in rich countries will be sexually attacked by someone who is not their partner. In Africa, the number is 11.9%.

The report says that earlier research shows that women with more education and women who work are less likely to have violence, but this is not true everywhere. Garcia-Moreno said that the numbers show we must pay more attention to this problem. In the last ten years, more people see that there is a problem, but “it is a difficult problem. We do not have a vaccine or a pill.”

The auction of a Banksy mural that was taken from a shop wall in north London was suddenly stopped just before it was going to be sold.

The artwork, called Slave Labour, is a spray painting of a child making British flags. It is seen as a comment on last year’s diamond jubilee. The mural was expected to sell for about $700,000 at a street and contemporary art auction in Florida.

Frederic Thut, the auctioneer and owner of Fine Arts Auction Miami, had refused to say who was selling the mural. He announced that Slave Labour and another Banksy artwork would not be sold at the auction. He did not give a reason for this decision.

Community leaders in Haringey, London, had campaigned to stop the sale of the mural, which was taken from a Poundland shop in Wood Green. They were very happy with the news. Alan Strickland, a Haringey councillor, said, “One of our two demands was that it doesn’t sell and the other was that we get it back again, so we’re halfway there.” He said he would write to the auction house to find out what happened and what will happen next. He also said the community campaign in London had made a difference in the US, calling it a victory for the people.

Claire Kober, the leader of Haringey Council, wrote to Arts Council England and the Mayor of Miami, Tomás Regalado, asking them to stop the sale. However, it seems the gallery owners decided to remove the mural from the auction.

A few hours after the auction, the auction house said it had convinced the owners of the two Banksy artworks to remove them from the sale. The auction house said there were no legal problems with selling the two Banksy pieces, but they still asked the sellers to take them out of the auction.

Some people accused the auction house of selling stolen property, but Thut said the seller, who is a well-known collector, was the rightful owner and the sale was legal. Thut also said his gallery had received many emails and phone calls from the UK. He supported selling the artworks because he believed it would help protect them.

The second Banksy artwork, called Wet Dog, was painted in 2007 and taken from a wall in Bethlehem. It is thought to be worth up to $800,000. It was removed from the auction house’s online catalogue, but Slave Labour was still listed for sale until the auction started at 3pm.

Thut said the two artworks, which came from different owners (neither of them British), were important in the street art world and should go to buyers who care about art and its protection.

A spokesperson for Poundland said they did not know who removed the 4ft by 5ft mural from the side of their shop in London.

Banksy has not commented on the Slave Labour case, but in the past he has spoken against people selling his art. In 2011, he spoke out before five of his pieces were going to be sold at an auction in New York, but none of them were sold.

Stephan Keszler, the dealer at that auction, believes it is legal to sell Banksy’s works without his permission. He said, “He does something on other people’s property without asking. The owner of the property can do whatever they want with it.”

On an important day at Liverpool Cathedral, the families of the 96 people who died at Sheffield Wednesday’s Hillsborough football ground often repeated one phrase: the truth. This phrase was also used in a headline by The Sun newspaper. We now know that the South Yorkshire Police gave this story to the newspaper to blame the innocent victims for the disaster.

Margaret Aspinall’s son James, who was 18, died at the match between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest. She said the families had to fight for 23 years to find out the truth. Aspinall, who leads the Hillsborough Family Support Group, said their loss would never go away, but she was happy that the Prime Minister gave a deep apology for Hillsborough.

An independent group looked at 450,000 documents from the police, Sheffield Wednesday, and other responsible groups. They wrote a 395-page report that criticized official mistakes and showed that the victims and other fans were not to blame. Some causes of the disaster were already known, but the report showed how deeply the police tried to hide the truth, especially by blaming the supporters.

The group found that the South Yorkshire Police, led by Chief Constable Peter Wright, told a story that drunken or ticketless supporters caused the disaster. The police tested the victims’ blood for alcohol, which was not normal, and there was no good reason for it. If victims had alcohol in their blood, the police checked if they had criminal records. The report found no proof of serious drunkenness, lack of tickets, or violence among Liverpool fans.

The report said that Wright met with his police group in a Sheffield restaurant to prepare a strong defense and a clear story. This meeting happened just four days after the disaster, on the same day The Sun newspaper published its headline “The Truth,” based on lies from four senior South Yorkshire police officers.

The group found that police statements were changed to remove criticism of the police and to focus on bad behavior by supporters. Out of 164 statements, 116 were changed to remove or change negative comments about the South Yorkshire police. The police said they only removed opinions, but the group was sure they did more than that. The changes were made to hide criticism of the police.

This false information did not convince the first investigation. In August 1989, it found that the police stories about fan drunkenness and bad behavior were not true, and it criticized the police for making these claims. The investigation also showed that Sheffield Wednesday’s football ground was unsafe, and the Football Association chose it for the match without checking if it had a valid safety certificate (it did not).

The main cause of the disaster was poor crowd control by the police, led by an inexperienced Chief Superintendent, David Duckenfield. The police lost control outside the ground, where 24,000 Liverpool fans had to use only 23 turnstiles. Duckenfield then ordered a large exit gate to be opened, letting many people in. His mistake, according to the investigation, was not closing the tunnel that led to the central area behind the goal, which was already too crowded.

Even after this, the police repeated their claims at the inquest. The coroner decided not to look at what happened after 3:15 pm on the day of the disaster, so the poor emergency response was not examined. The group found that 41 of the 96 people who died might have been saved if the police and ambulance service had done their jobs properly.

After the group’s report, the Attorney General will decide if there should be a new inquest. There may also be legal action against Sheffield Wednesday, South Yorkshire Police, and Sheffield City Council, which did not make sure the football ground was safe. Trevor Hicks, President of the Hillsborough Family Support Group, whose two teenage daughters died in the disaster, said: “The truth is out today. Tomorrow is for justice.”

Ninety-six people died at Hillsborough Stadium in Sheffield in 1989. Twenty-three years later, the families of the victims met at Liverpool Cathedral to see a report about the disaster. The most important thing for them was to know the truth. The Sun newspaper wrote a headline called "The Truth," but now we know the story was not true. The police gave the newspaper the false story.

Margaret Aspinall’s son James, who was 18 years old, died at the football match between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest. She said the families had to fight for 23 years to find out the truth. She said the families will always be sad, but she is happy that the Prime Minister said sorry for what happened at Hillsborough.

The report said that the police and others made mistakes and that the victims and other fans were not to blame. We already knew why the disaster happened, but we did not know that the police tried so hard to hide the truth. It is shocking that the police blamed the football fans for the disaster.

Trevor Hicks, whose two daughters died in the disaster, said: “The truth is out today. Tomorrow is for justice.”

Facebook has lost millions of users each month in its biggest countries. In the last six months, Facebook lost almost 9 million monthly users in the US and 2 million in the UK.

Studies show that Facebook’s growth in the US, UK, and other big European countries has stopped. Last month, Facebook lost 6 million users in the US, which is a 4% drop, according to Socialbakers. In the UK, 1.4 million fewer people used Facebook in March, a 4.5% drop.

People are also leaving Facebook in Canada, Spain, France, Germany, and Japan, where Facebook is very popular.

Ian Maude, a new media expert at Enders Analysis, says that in the US and UK, most people who want to join Facebook have already joined. He says people get bored and want to try new things.

Other social networks are becoming more popular with young people. Instagram, a photo-sharing site, got 30 million new users in the 18 months before Facebook bought it.

Path, a mobile social network started by former Facebook worker Dave Morin, only lets users have 150 friends. Path is getting 1 million new users every week. It now has over 9 million users, and 500,000 people in Venezuela downloaded the app in one weekend.

Facebook is still growing quickly in South America. In Brazil, monthly users went up 6% last month to 70 million, according to Socialbakers. In India, users went up 4% to 64 million. This is still a small part of India’s population, so Facebook can still grow there.

But in richer countries, other experts are also seeing fewer people use Facebook.

Jefferies bank analysts saw Facebook’s global monthly users reach 1.05 billion in January, but then fall by 20 million in February. The numbers went up again in April. Research company Nielsen says Facebook has lost almost 2 million users in the UK since December, and the total number of UK users is now 27 million, the same as last year.

Americans are also spending less time on Facebook. In December 2012, Americans spent 121 billion minutes on Facebook, but this dropped to 115 billion minutes in February, according to comScore.

Facebook has said that people are spending less time on Facebook on their computers because they now prefer to use smartphones and tablets.

Although the time people spend on Facebook using smartphones has doubled in a year, to 69 minutes a month, this may not make up for the drop in computer use.

Facebook will soon tell investors how it did in the last three months. Wall Street expects Facebook to make about $1.44 billion, up from $1.06 billion a year ago.

Shareholders want to know how quickly the number of mobile Facebook users is growing, and if advertising money is growing at the same speed.

At the end of 2012, almost a quarter of Facebook’s advertising money came from mobile users, and Facebook had 680 million mobile users each month in December.

The company said it might be losing young users to other products and services that are similar to Facebook.

Facebook’s founder, Mark Zuckerberg, has started new projects to attract smartphone users. One project, Facebook Home, is software for Android phones that shows news, photos from friends, and ads directly on the phone’s locked home screen.

Vienna is the best city in the world to live in, while Baghdad is the worst, according to an international study about quality of life. London, Paris, and New York are not even in the top 35 cities.

Cities where people speak German are at the top of the list in the 18th Mercer Quality of Life study. Vienna is joined by Zurich, Munich, Dusseldorf, and Frankfurt in the top seven cities.

Paris has dropped ten places to 37th, just above London at 39th. This is mostly because of terrorist attacks in Paris.

The study looked at social and economic conditions, health, education, housing, and the environment. Big companies use this study to decide where to open offices and factories and how much to pay their workers.

Helena Hartlauer, a 32-year-old from Vienna, said she was not surprised that her city is number one. Vienna’s government has spent a lot of money on good social housing, so living in Vienna is cheaper than in other big cities.

She said, “I live in a 100-square-metre apartment in a good area, about 20 minutes’ walk from the city centre. My rent is just 800 euros (£625) a month. A similar apartment in London would cost over 2,000 euros, and even more in New York, which is 44th on the list.”

US cities do not do well in the study, mostly because of problems with safety and crime. The best US city is San Francisco at 28th place; Boston is 34th. Canadian cities, led by Vancouver, do much better than US cities.

Hartlauer said, “You don’t realize how safe Vienna is until you travel to other countries. We also have great public transport. The underground runs 24 hours on weekends and costs only 1 euro per trip.”

Vienna became much more important after the Berlin Wall fell. It became a gateway to Eastern European countries, which often have historic links to the old Austro-Hungarian empire.

Martin Eichtinger, the Austrian ambassador to London, said, “Our big unique selling point is our location.” He explained that the fall of the Berlin Wall helped Vienna become a centre for companies wanting to do business in Central Europe.

According to the World Bank, Austria has one of the highest GDP (gross domestic product) per person in the world. It is just behind the US and ahead of Germany and Britain, but lower than Switzerland.

Mercer says Zurich in Switzerland has the world’s second highest quality of life, but people in Vienna say their city is more fun. Hartlauer said, “There are more students in Vienna than in any other German-speaking city. It’s a fast-growing, young, and lively city.”

British tourists often ignore Vienna for weekend trips. They usually go to Barcelona or Berlin and think of Austria as a place for skiing, lakes, and mountains.

But now, with more cheap flights from British cities like Manchester and Edinburgh, Vienna is becoming more popular. In 2015, 588,000 British people visited Vienna, which is 18% more than the year before.

Mercer said Vienna has been number one for the last seven years. Vienna scores high in many areas: it is safe and stable, has excellent public transport, and good places for fun and relaxation.

London has never been in the top ten for quality of life. This is because of bad air pollution, traffic jams, and weather. After London, Edinburgh is the next best British city, at 46th place.

Paris has dropped the most in the latest rankings. Mercer said, “Paris was stable for several years but this year dropped ten places, mostly because of the terrorist attacks in 2015. Safety is a very important part of the survey.”

Auckland in New Zealand is the highest English-speaking city in the survey, at third place. Vancouver in Canada is fifth. Australian cities also do well, with Sydney at 10th and Melbourne at 15th.

War and political problems are the main reasons for the lowest-ranked cities. Surprisingly, Damascus is only the seventh worst city. It is ranked better than Baghdad, Bangui (Central African Republic), Sanaa (Yemen), Port-au-Prince (Haiti), Khartoum (Sudan), and N’Djamena (Chad).

The Moroccan city of Ouarzazate is used to big film productions. It is on the edge of the Sahara Desert and is the center of Morocco’s film industry, called “Ouallywood.” Many famous movies and TV shows, like Lawrence of Arabia, The Mummy, The Living Daylights, and Game of Thrones, were filmed there.

Now, Ouarzazate is also the center of a group of four large solar power plants. Together with hydro and wind power, these plants will help Morocco get almost half of its electricity from renewable energy by 2020. This project is an important part of Morocco’s plan to use its deserts to become a world leader in solar energy.

When the whole complex is finished, it will be the largest concentrated solar power plant in the world. The first part, called Noor 1, will be ready in November 2015. It uses special mirrors, which are less common and more expensive than the solar panels you see on roofs. However, this technology can keep making electricity even after the sun goes down.

People have known for a long time that deserts have a lot of solar power potential. After the Chernobyl nuclear accident in 1986, a German scientist named Gerhard Knies calculated that the world’s deserts get enough energy in a few hours to power the whole world for a year. The problem is how to collect this energy and send it to where people need it.

As engineers finish Noor 1, its 500,000 curved solar mirrors shine in the desert. The 800 rows of mirrors follow the sun across the sky, moving quietly every few minutes.

When all four plants in Ouarzazate are finished, they will cover an area as big as Morocco’s capital city, Rabat, and will produce 580 megawatts of electricity. This is enough to power one million homes.

Morocco’s environment minister, Hakima el-Haite, thinks solar energy could change the region as much as oil did in the last century. But she says the $9 billion project started because Morocco has to import 94% of its energy as fossil fuels, which costs a lot of money. “So, when we heard about the possibilities of solar energy, we thought, Why not?” she told the Guardian.

By 2020, solar energy will make up one third of Morocco’s renewable energy. Wind and hydro power will make up the other two thirds. “We are very proud of this project,” el-Haite said. “I think it is the most important solar plant in the world.”

Technicians say that the Noor 2 and 3 plants, which will open in 2017, can store energy for up to eight hours. This means it could be possible to have solar energy available all day and night in the Sahara and nearby areas.

The first part of the project is almost finished, and Morocco has bigger plans. “We are already working on power lines to cover the south of Morocco and Mauritania,” says Ahmed Baroudi, manager of the national renewable energy investment company. He says the project could also affect other regions, even the Middle East.

The Moroccan solar energy agency (Masen) says exporting solar energy could help bring stability to countries in the region. Morocco is making plans with Tunisia, and sending energy north to Europe is a main goal. “We believe it’s possible to export energy to Europe, but first, we have to build the connections, which don’t exist yet,” said Maha el-Kadiri, a Masen spokeswoman.

For now, Morocco is focused on using solar energy for its own needs. In the future, this could include using solar power to turn seawater into drinking water, which is important because Morocco is having more droughts as the climate gets warmer.

About $9 billion has been invested in the Noor Complex, mostly from international organizations like the European Investment Bank and World Bank, with support from the Moroccan government. Energy subsidies from King Mohammed VI have stopped the costs from being passed on to ordinary people.

More than a thousand workers, mostly Moroccan, are still working to finish the project. They are fixing electric wires, taking down scaffolding, and insulating steel pipes. They work in yellow and orange safety vests, 12 hours a day, under the Atlas mountains. They wear hard hats, safety shoes, and ear plugs.

“We’ve finished the construction, and now we will see how these projects work when they start,” says Hajar Lakhael, a 25-year-old environment and safety manager from Meknes. “It is just like getting ready for a big show.”

People around the world are watching with interest.
