Galina Zaglumyonova was woken up in her apartment in central Chelyabinsk by a huge explosion. The blast broke her balcony windows and smashed her plant pots. When she got out of bed, she saw a big white trail in the morning sky and heard car alarms on the street.

“I didn’t understand what was happening,” Zaglumyonova said. “There was a big explosion and then several smaller ones. I first thought it was a plane crash.”

But what she saw was actually a ten-ton meteorite falling to Earth in several fireballs just after sunrise.

Officials said almost 1,200 people were hurt, and more than 40 were taken to hospital. Most people were injured by flying glass from windows broken by the loud sound made by the meteorite. No one died.

The meteorite entered the atmosphere at a speed of at least 33,000 miles per hour. It broke into pieces between 18 and 32 miles above the ground, according to the Russian Academy of Sciences.

The event caused panic in Chelyabinsk, a city with more than one million people, south of Russia’s Ural mountains. A video showed the meteorite pieces shining brighter as they got closer to the ground. The white trail in the sky could be seen for hundreds of miles, even in nearby Kazakhstan.

Tatyana Bets was working at the front desk of a hospital clinic in the city center when the meteorite hit. “First we noticed the wind, then the room was filled with a very bright light, and we saw a cloud of smoke in the sky,” she said. “Then, after a few minutes, the explosions happened.”

The Ministry of the Interior said at least three craters were found. One crater was more than six meters wide, and another piece of the meteorite broke through thick ice on a nearby lake.

In Chelyabinsk, schools and universities were closed, and many workers were told to go home early. About 200 children were among the injured.

Many people with small injuries, mostly cuts from flying glass, came to the clinic where Bets works. She said a nearby student building was badly damaged, and many students were brought in. “There were a lot of girls in shock. Some were very pale, and many fainted,” she said.

Early reports said more than 100,000 square meters of glass were broken and 3,000 buildings were damaged. The total cost of the damage in the city was estimated at more than one billion roubles (about 20 million dollars).

The meteorite over Chelyabinsk came less than a day before asteroid 2012 DA14 was expected to pass very close to Earth (about 17,510 miles away). But experts said the two events were not connected.

However, there were many rumors and conspiracy theories in the first few hours after the event. Russian state TV and local news said the meteorite was destroyed by local air defense units more than 15 miles above the ground.

Vladimir Zhirinovsky, the leader of Russia’s Liberal Democrat party, said it was not a meteorite but a military attack by the United States. “It’s not a meteorite falling—it’s a test of new American weapons,” Zhirinovsky said.

Some people tried to make money quickly. They started selling pieces of meteorite on the internet just a few hours after the impact.

President Vladimir Putin and Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev were told about the event. Putin called a meeting with the head of the Emergency Situations Ministry. At an economic forum in Siberia, Medvedev said, “It’s proof that not only are economies vulnerable, but the whole planet is.”

Galina Zaglumyonova was sleeping in her apartment in the center of Chelyabinsk when a very big explosion woke her up. The explosion broke her balcony windows and broke the pots with her houseplants. When she got out of bed, she saw a big white line in the morning sky and heard car alarms on the street.

“I didn’t know what was happening,” said Zaglumyonova. “There was a big explosion and then many small explosions. I first thought it was a plane crash.” But it was really a ten-tonne meteorite that came to Earth in many pieces.

Almost 1,200 people were hurt. More than 40 people went to the hospital. Most people were hurt by flying glass. Nobody died.

The meteorite came into the air at a speed of at least 33,000 miles per hour. It broke into pieces between 18 and 32 miles above the ground.

People in Chelyabinsk, a city with more than one million people south of Russia’s Ural mountains, were very scared. People could see the white line in the sky for hundreds of miles, even from the country next to Russia, Kazakhstan.

Tatyana Bets was working at the front desk of a hospital in the city center when the meteorite came. “First we felt the wind, then the room was very bright and we saw smoke in the sky,” she said. After a few minutes, the explosions started.

At least three holes were found in the ground. One hole was more than six meters wide. Another piece of meteorite broke the thick ice on a lake.

In Chelyabinsk, schools and universities closed and people were told to go home early. About 200 children were hurt.

Many people, mostly with cuts from flying glass, came to the hospital where Bets works. She said many students from a nearby college came to the hospital. “There were a lot of girls who were very scared,” she said.

More than 100,000 square meters of glass were broken and 3,000 buildings were damaged. The total cost of the damage in the city is probably more than one billion roubles (£20 million).

The meteorite came one day before asteroid 2012 DA14 passed very close to Earth (about 17,510 miles away). But experts said these two things were not connected.

There were many rumors in the first hours after the event. Some Russian TV and local news said the Russian army destroyed the meteorite. A Russian politician, Vladimir Zhirinovsky, said it was not a meteorite. He said it was a weapons test by the United States.

Some people started selling pieces of the meteorite on the internet just a few hours after it hit.

Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev said this shows that the whole planet can be in danger.

Glastonbury Festival wants to stop the use of plastic water bottles as part of its plan to become the most environmentally friendly outdoor music festival in the world.

The festival organizers are focusing on disposable plastic bottles, which are a big part of the throwaway culture. Every year, the 900-acre festival area is left with a lot of plastic waste. About one million plastic bottles are used during the festival.

To help solve this problem, 2,000 road crew and band members will get stainless-steel reusable bottles. Many more reusable bottles will be sold to festival-goers so they do not have to use plastic bottles. The 140,000 people with tickets are also being asked to bring their own reusable bottles, which they can fill at 400 water taps around the festival site.

Lucy Smith, who is in charge of green issues at Glastonbury, said, “We have great water quality in the UK, but everyone wants to drink bottled water.” She also said that in 2015, Glastonbury plans to replace all plastic cups and cutlery with reusable ones.

Environmentalists say there are now 150 million tonnes of plastic waste in the world’s land and oceans. This plastic is poisoning nature and killing animals.

The festival organizers hope to make Glastonbury the greenest festival in the world. They want to be like the Burning Man festival in Nevada, USA, where people must take away everything they bring and leave no trace.

People going to Glastonbury are also being asked to use public transport or share cars with friends to get to the festival. Smith said, “We want to be as sustainable as possible. We do everything we can, but cleaning up after 140,000 people is difficult. We can’t put bins everywhere.”

Plastic water bottles can take hundreds or even thousands of years to break down. Making these bottles is also bad for the environment because it uses millions of barrels of oil. Transporting bottled water around the world also creates more carbon emissions.

About 13 billion plastic water bottles are sold in the UK every year, but only one in five is recycled.

Smith said that instead of buying bottled water, people at the festival should use the water from taps, which comes from large underground reservoirs. The charity WaterAid will also have water kiosks at the festival, where people can buy reusable bottles and cups and get free refills.

Organizers say that almost half of all rubbish left at the festival was recycled in 2013. In 2014, there will be 15,000 recycling bins across the festival grounds.

Even though Glastonbury is becoming more environmentally friendly, some people say it is becoming too commercial. Bruce Dickinson from the band Iron Maiden said he would never bring his band to Glastonbury, calling it “the most bourgeois thing on the planet.”

The world shares William Shakespeare, and London says he belongs to them, but Stratford-upon-Avon wants to celebrate Shakespeare as their own in 2016. Shakespeare, known as the bard of Avon, was born in this small town in Warwickshire in 1564 and died there 400 years ago.

Paul Edmondson, head of learning and research at the Shakespeare Birthplace Trust, says Stratford was very important to Shakespeare during his life. Many people think Shakespeare left Stratford and his family to make money in London and only returned to die. But Stratford is where he bought land and houses, kept his library, and spent time reading and thinking. This year, Stratford wants to remind everyone how important the town was to Shakespeare.

The anniversary of Shakespeare’s death, who is the most famous and most performed playwright in the world, will be celebrated all over Britain and the world. Macbeth will be performed in Singapore, and Romeo and Juliet in Brussels. Shakespeare’s Globe theatre is finishing the first world tour in theatre history, taking Hamlet to every country except North Korea. In London, there will be a special cinema with 37 screens, one for each of Shakespeare’s plays.

The National Theatre, the Royal Shakespeare Company, and almost every other theatre company in the country will join the celebrations. There will be many different versions of the plays, from traditional to experimental. There will also be hundreds of lectures, readings, international conferences, films, concerts, operas, and big exhibitions.

Even though Shakespeare was famous when he was alive, there is not much written evidence about his life. His plays might not have survived if his friends and fellow actors had not collected every piece they could find—drafts, scripts, actors’ notes, and 17 plays not known in any other version—and published them in the First Folio in 1623, seven years after Shakespeare died.

The actor Mark Rylance has called the First Folio his favorite book in the world. Most of the surviving First Folios will be shown to the public, including copies from the British and Bodleian libraries, and a damaged copy recently found in France. Some of the most valuable documents will be shown together at an exhibition at Somerset House in London, including four of Shakespeare’s six known signatures, which are all a little different.

The exhibition, called By Me, William Shakespeare, will include his will, court papers about the time Shakespeare and his fellow actors took apart a theatre on the north side of the Thames and rebuilt it as the Globe on the South Bank, and records showing payments from the royal treasury for performances for King James I and Queen Anne on Boxing Day.

Dominic Dromgoole, the director of the Globe, recently joked that Shakespeare was a true Londoner. However, Stratford will insist that the town made and educated Shakespeare. They are fixing up his old school room, which will open as a permanent place for visitors.

Shakespeare bought New Place, the second best house in Stratford, where he died. According to legend, he died on St George’s Day, 23 April, the same day he was born. Paul Edmondson says, “You don’t buy a house like New Place and not live there.” He believes that many people, including academics, have not understood how important Stratford was to Shakespeare.

Edmondson thinks that after Shakespeare bought New Place in 1597, he spent all his thinking time there, and that his later plays, including The Tempest, were at least planned and probably written in his library there. The Shakespeare Birthplace Trust calls New Place the most important part of the 400th anniversary celebrations.

However, Shakespeare’s house was destroyed 300 years ago, and the house built after it was also destroyed in 1759 by a priest named Francis Gastrell, who was angry about taxes. He had already cut down Shakespeare’s mulberry tree, where Shakespeare is said to have sat and worked, because he was annoyed by tourists looking into his garden.

The empty space where the house was has never been filled. But when news spread that Shakespeare’s kitchen was found in the partly surviving cellars, it was reported around the world. The whole site will be shown to the public for the anniversary, with the foundations marked and the garden restored. Edmondson says that without Stratford, there would have been no Shakespeare.

On one day in August, one out of every seven people in the world—1 billion people—used Facebook, according to its founder Mark Zuckerberg. In ten years, Facebook has completely changed how people connect, how they think about privacy, how businesses work, how news is shared, and even the meanings of some common words. It has also helped end some governments.

Zuckerberg wrote that a more open and connected world is a better world. He said it brings stronger relationships, a better economy with more chances for people, and a stronger society.

Here are some ways Facebook has changed things, both in good and bad ways:

1. Facebook has changed the meaning of "friend"
Now, "to friend" is a verb. On Facebook, it is easy to "unfriend" someone, which means to remove them from your Facebook friends list. This word was created to describe ending a Facebook friendship if you do not want to see their posts anymore.

The words "share" and "like" are still similar to their old meanings, but Facebook has made them more important in our lives.

School and university reunions are not needed anymore because you already know what is happening in your old friends’ lives. You know whose job is going well, who has broken up, and you have seen pictures of their babies. If you see an ex-boyfriend or ex-girlfriend with someone new, you are not surprised because you have already seen their romantic photos online.

On Facebook, all your friends seem to have the same importance. A classmate you have not seen for 15 years, a friend of a friend from a party, or a colleague you have never spoken to in real life are all Facebook friends, just like your closest friend, your husband or wife, or your mother.

But this does not mean we feel the same about all of them. Professor Robin Dunbar, who is known for his research, says that people can only have about 150 people in their real social group. He thinks Facebook has not changed this yet. But he worries that because it is so easy to end friendships on Facebook, people might not learn how to get along with each other in real life.

2. We care less about privacy
It is surprising that Facebook users are happy to give away their personal information. The Pew Research Center found that most young people are willing to share their details. 91% post a photo of themselves, 71% share the city or town where they live, more than half give their email addresses, and one fifth give their phone number.

Because people share so much online, Facebook lets them create a certain image of themselves and get fans. Experts call this the "Facebook self."

More than 80% of Facebook users list their interests, which helps companies target them with ads. But most young users limit who can see their profiles, with 60% allowing only friends to see them.

3. Facebook has created millions of jobs—but not in its own offices
Facebook gives jobs to many people who help companies use Facebook for their brands.

Michael Tinmouth, a social media expert who has worked with big companies like Vodafone and Microsoft, says Facebook is a special tool. Marketers now know more about their customers than ever before. The information they get is amazing. They know who their customers are, who their friends are, and how they interact with the brand.

Advertisers pay a lot for this information. Facebook said its advertising income went up by 46%, reaching $3.32 billion.

But Facebook can also be difficult for brands. Now, customers do not just complain by phone or on small websites. Angry customers can post their complaints for hundreds of friends to see, or even on the brand’s own Facebook page.

4. Facebook has helped organize revolutions
Facebook has changed how people organize protests and direct action. Olga Onuch from Manchester University found that Facebook was the main way to reach half of all the Euromaidan protesters in Ukraine.

Many people in Onuch’s research said they used Facebook to find out the truth about what was happening because they did not trust traditional news.

5. Facebook makes news, breaks news, and decides what is news
About 71% of people aged 18 to 24 say the internet is their main source of news, and 63% of all users say the same, according to the Pew Research Center. About one third of Facebook users post about politics and government.

Most people first read breaking news on Facebook or other social media, usually on their phones.

Facebook has also changed how journalists write stories. Many reporters now cannot work without it. For better or worse, Facebook is a place to find information about almost anyone, even people who suddenly become the center of a big news story.

6. Users are changing Facebook
Facebook started as a site for students at top US universities.

In 2014, ten years after it started, 56% of internet users aged 65 and older had a Facebook account. Also, 39% of users are connected to people they have never met in real life.

Now, Facebook is not just a way to connect with friends, but also a way to reach the rest of the internet.

David Kirkpatrick, author of The Facebook Effect, said we should get used to Facebook. He said it might disappear one day, but something this big will take a long time to go away. He told BBC Radio 4’s Today programme that Facebook has shown it can change and will continue to be very important.

On one day in August, one in seven people in the world, or 1 billion people, used Facebook. Mark Zuckerberg, the founder of Facebook, said this. In ten years, Facebook has changed how people make friends, how they keep things private, how they do business, how they get news, and even helped to end unfair governments. Facebook has also changed the meaning of some common words.

Low-income countries will continue to suffer the most from climate change caused by humans over the next 100 years. These countries will face rising sea levels, stronger storms, hotter days and nights, more unpredictable rain, and longer, more intense heatwaves, according to a recent report.

The last big United Nations (UN) report in 2007 said temperatures could rise by 6°C or more by the end of the century. Scientists now think this is unlikely, but land and sea temperatures are still expected to rise, possibly reaching 4°C above today’s levels. This would be enough to destroy crops and make life in many cities extremely hot.

As temperatures and ocean heat increase, tropical and subtropical areas will see big changes in yearly rainfall, says the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) report, released in Stockholm and online in September.

East Africa will likely get more short rainfalls, and West Africa should expect heavier monsoons. Burma, Bangladesh, and India can expect stronger cyclones. Other parts of southern Asia will probably have heavier summer rains. Indonesia may get less rain from July to October, but coastal areas near the South China Sea and Gulf of Thailand can expect more extreme rainfall when cyclones hit.

In the long term, rainfall patterns will change. Northern countries, like those in Europe and North America, are expected to get more rain. However, many dry and semi-dry areas in the subtropics will probably get less rain, according to the report’s authors.

They also said the monsoon season will likely start earlier and last longer.

Scientists and experts in developing countries welcomed the report, saying it matches what they have already seen.

The IPCC says climate change is real and happening faster than before. We are already seeing its effects in Bangladesh and across South Asia. This is not new for us. Most developing countries are already facing climate change. They do not need the IPCC to tell them the weather is changing, said Saleemul Huq, director of the International Centre for Climate Change and Development.

Scientists have also lowered their predictions for sea-level rise. Depending on future greenhouse gas emissions, sea levels are expected to rise by 40 to 62 centimeters by 2100. However, there will be big differences in different places. Many millions of people living in large cities in developing countries, such as Lagos and Calcutta, are at risk.

The report also says that weather disasters are more likely in a warmer world. Even though the total number of tropical cyclones may decrease or stay the same, they could become stronger, with higher winds and heavier rain.

Life in many cities in developing countries could become unbearable, especially since city temperatures are already much higher than in the countryside. Much higher temperatures could shorten the growing season in some parts of Africa by up to 20%, the report said.

The charity Oxfam said world hunger will get worse because climate change will hurt crop production and lower incomes. They said the number of people at risk of hunger could rise by 10% to 20% by 2050.

Oxfam said the changing climate is already putting progress against hunger at risk, and it will likely get worse. A hotter world is a hungrier world.

Sometimes, men feel sadder and think more about death as they get older. At this time, some men make big changes in their lives, like spending all their money on a sports car. These big and sometimes bad decisions are common during what people call a "midlife crisis." If the midlife crisis is real, humans might not be the only animals to have it.

Now, a group of scientists from different countries says they have found signs of a "midlife crisis" in chimpanzees and orangutans. They found that these apes are less happy in the middle of their lives. The scientists say this is similar to the human midlife crisis.

The study was published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. It suggests that the midlife crisis might come from something in our biology that we share with apes, our closest relatives.

Alex Weiss, a psychologist at Edinburgh University, said that people usually believe there is a drop in happiness in middle age. He and his team wanted to know if this also happens in other animals, not just humans.

The team from the US, Japan, Germany, and the UK asked zookeepers and people who work with apes to fill out forms about the animals. The forms had questions about each ape’s mood, how much they enjoyed being with others, and how well they reached their goals. The last question asked how the zookeeper would feel about being that ape for a week, with answers scored from one to seven.

The study included more than 500 apes in three groups. Two groups were chimpanzees, and the third group was orangutans from Sumatra or Borneo. The apes lived in zoos, sanctuaries, and research centers in the US, Australia, Japan, Canada, and Singapore.

When the scientists looked at the answers, they saw that the apes’ happiness was lowest in middle age and got better as they got older. In captivity, great apes often live to 50 years or more. The lowest happiness was at about 28.3 and 27.2 years old for chimpanzees, and 35.4 years old for orangutans.

Weiss said, “In all three groups, we find that happiness is lowest in chimpanzees and orangutans at an age that is about the same as midlife in humans. On average, happiness scores are lowest when the animals are around 30 years old.”

Robin Dunbar, a professor at Oxford University, did not fully believe the results. He asked what could make apes feel more or less happy at different ages, since apes do not think much about the future like humans do.

Alexandra Freund, a professor at the University of Zurich, also did not believe in the midlife crisis. She said there is no proof for it.

But Weiss thinks the study could help us understand why some men have emotional problems in middle age. He said, “If we want to know what happens during the midlife crisis, we should look at what is the same in middle-aged humans, chimps, and orangutans.”

Alexandra Freund, a professor at the University of Zurich, also did not agree. She said, “In my opinion, there is no proof of the midlife crisis.”

But Weiss thinks the study can help us understand why some men feel sad in the middle of their lives. He said, “If we want to know what happens in the midlife crisis, we should look at what is the same in middle-aged humans, chimps, and orangutans.”

When you hear the word Amazon, what do you think of first—the world’s biggest forest, the longest river, or the largest online shop? Which one do you think is most important?

These questions are part of a debate about changing the rules of the internet. Brazil and Peru have complained about a request from the big US online company Amazon. Amazon wants to use .amazon as a new internet address ending.

Amazon, which is based in Seattle, wants its brand to be a top-level domain name, like .com. But the governments of Brazil and Peru say this would stop people from using .amazon for things like protecting the environment, helping indigenous people, and other public uses.

There are other arguments about names like .patagonia. These issues are important in the debate about what the internet is for and who controls it.

Until now, it was easy to see if an internet address was for a business, a government, or something else, because of endings like .com, .gov, and about 20 others.

But now, these endings—called generic top-level domains (gTLDs)—are about to grow more than ever before.

The Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN) is a US non-profit group that helps manage the internet. ICANN has received requests for hundreds of new gTLDs, each costing almost $200,000, to add to the 22 that already exist.

Amazon has asked for many new domain names, like .shop, .song, .book, and .kindle. But the most talked about is .amazon, which is the company’s own name.

Brazil and Peru want Amazon to cancel its request for .amazon. They say a private company should not get a name that is also the name of a very important place. The Amazon is a region that goes through their countries and is used for some organizations that work across borders.

The Brazilian Ministry of Science and Technology said, “Letting private companies use geographical names as gTLDs to make their brand stronger or to make money from these names is not in the public interest.”

Brazil also said that other countries in the Amazon Cooperation Treaty—Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Suriname, and Venezuela—agree with them.

There are other complaints about new top-level domains that use geographical, cultural, or disputed brand names.

Argentina is unhappy because the US clothing company Patagonia wants to use .patagonia as a domain name. Patagonia is a region in Argentina that is famous for its beauty and has its own parliament. Argentina does not want the .patagonia domain to be approved. Patagonia is important for Argentina’s economy because of oil, fishing, mining, and farming. It also has a strong local community and is a popular place for tourists.

These arguments will be discussed again at a meeting of ICANN’s Governmental Advisory Committee in Durban in July. The first new domain names will probably be used before the end of 2013.

He is not the first person to doubt Mars One, a private project that wants to send people to live on Mars starting in 2025. But Joseph Roche is different from most critics because he is one of the people chosen as possible astronauts for the mission.

Roche is an astrophysicist at Trinity College Dublin. In February, he was named as one of the 100 people shortlisted for Mars One. He wrote in the Guardian about his doubts that Mars One can really work.

Roche says the way Mars One chose people was not as careful as the way other astronaut programs do it. He also says the Dutch Mars One team is a bit naive because they think they can do the $6 billion mission alone. He believes they should now accept that it is very unlikely to happen.

Roche is also worried about how the mission organizers made a top-ten list of candidates. He says this list does not show who the best astronauts are. It only shows who got the most supporter points.

These points show how much money each supporter gave to Mars One, for example by buying official Mars One products.

The official plan for the mission says they want to send a lander and a satellite to Mars in 2018, a rover in 2020, and cargo missions starting in 2022. People would start arriving in 2025, and groups of four would go every two years to join the settlement. They would not come back to Earth.

In February, Gerard 't Hooft, a Dutch Nobel Prize winner in physics who supports the project, said he does not believe this plan is realistic. He said it will take much longer and cost much more money. When they first asked him to help, he told them, "You have to put a zero after everything."

Roche also said that Mars One did not get 200,000 astronaut applications, as they claimed. There were only 2,761.

He explained more about the selection process: "I have not met anyone from Mars One in person. At first, there were supposed to be regional interviews. We would travel there, be interviewed, and be tested for several days. That sounded like a real astronaut selection process to me.

But suddenly, it changed from a real interview over several days to just a ten-minute Skype call."

Roche told the Guardian he does not want to give more interviews because he does not want to sound negative about space travel.

He wrote, "I am passionate about science, and that is why I liked the big idea of Mars One. But Mars One was never likely to solve the money and technical problems in their timeline. Still, it was nice to hear a new idea that makes us think about our own part in the future of space exploration."

He said that being part of the public discussion about future missions has been one of the most interesting and enjoyable parts of his time with Mars One. He also said, "If a one-way mission to Mars ever became possible, I would always volunteer. For an astrophysicist, that is not a hard choice." But he does not think there will be a one-way mission in his lifetime.

The small room looks like a classroom. On its metal walls, there are educational posters, the alphabet, and a map of Bangladesh.

But it is hard to focus because there is always loud hammering and the air has chemicals that hurt the throat and eyes. Still, the children who study in this three-square-metre room are lucky. They do not have to work in the factories across the street.

For 14 years, SOHAY, a local non-governmental organization (NGO) supported by the Global Fund for Children and Comic Relief, has worked in the slums of Dhaka to help child workers go to school. SOHAY helps children who work in dangerous jobs.

This classroom is one of 23 urban development centres that SOHAY has opened in the city. The centres help children catch up on their education so they can go to primary school. After they start primary school, the centres help them with their homework.

Alamin, who is ten years old and used to work in a plastic factory, goes to one of these centres. His father sells things on the street and his mother works part-time as a house cleaner. They are all happy that Alamin is now in school and not doing dangerous work. His friend Rabi says he wants to forget his time in the factory. "I like school," he says.

The urban development centres want to help the community see education as important and change how people think about children, says SOHAY’s programme manager, Mohammed Abdullah al-Mamun. SOHAY also has meetings for parents and employers to stop child labour and gives skills training to help families earn more money.

Getting working children into regular school is very hard, says Mamun. These children are different from others. After they stop working, they sometimes have trouble making friends and getting used to school. It is also hard to keep them in school—many of these children do not finish.

Seven-year-old Zhorna Akter Sumayya has two older brothers who both work (one in a restaurant, one at a local club). After learning at one of SOHAY’s centres, she now goes to a government primary school. Her family lives in the slum and her parents need the money her brothers earn. Her father works in a rickshaw garage and her mother is a house cleaner, but they wanted their daughter to go to school.

In 2015, SOHAY helped 1,540 children leave dangerous work and helped 2,125 more children who were at risk of starting work to go to school. About 780 more children are getting ready to start school in 2017. The organization is also helping 635 children who work in dangerous jobs to learn about their rights.

The Labour Law of Bangladesh 2006 says children under 14 cannot work, but UNICEF says 4.7 million children under 14 are working, and 1.3 million children aged five to 17 work in dangerous industries.

It was hard to get children into school without paying them for their time, says Sadia Nasrin, who leads Sonjag, another local NGO in Dhaka. To fix this, Sonjag started working closely with the slum communities where the children live.

The organization talked to the community about why school is important for children. They chose volunteers who wanted to help children and made groups with social workers, community leaders, mothers, young volunteers, and local government.

These groups are very important—they encourage employers to let children leave work for two to three hours a day to go to school and make sure the workplace is safe for children, says Nasrin.

When children miss starting school at age five, it is a race against time to stop them from growing up without education. When they are older, it is very hard to get them to go to school, says Mamun. Children are just waiting to do dangerous work instead of learning. We are working to stop child labour.

A senior US researcher warns that today’s generation might lose the peaceful sounds of nature because people ignore the noises around them. In some places, background noise is getting louder, making it hard for people to notice the pleasant sounds of birds singing, water flowing, and trees moving in the wind. These sounds can still be heard in cities, says Kurt Fristrup, a senior scientist at the US National Park Service.

The problem is worse because many people listen to music with earphones instead of paying attention to nature. Traffic, music, and other noises can easily cover up natural sounds. Fristrup calls this “learned deafness.” He says we are teaching ourselves to ignore the sounds around us. We are born with the ability to hear things from far away, but we might lose this gift.

Fristrup warns that if we are around noise for too long, we stop listening. We also lose our natural connection to the environment. For the last ten years, the US National Park Service has measured sound levels at over 600 places in the US, including Yosemite, Yellowstone, and Denali. All these places had some noise from people, like planes, motorbikes, boats, or tour buses.

Fristrup’s team used these sound measurements and similar data from cities to make a map of noise levels across the US. They found that noise pollution more than doubles every 30 years.

Fristrup says it is not surprising that people use earphones or noise-cancelling headphones to try to make things quieter. He explains that when background noise goes up, it affects your hearing like fog affects your vision. You only notice sounds close to you, not the full range of sounds around you. Even in cities, there are birds and other things to enjoy, but we are losing the ability to hear them.

People quickly get used to changes, including more noise. Fristrup worries that we will accept much worse noise than we should and forget how quiet the world can be. If it becomes too hard to find peace and quiet, many children will grow up without this experience, which he thinks is a real problem.

Other scientists at the same meeting talked about health benefits from listening to natural sounds. Derrick Taff, a social scientist at Pennsylvania State University, described early experiments showing that listening to recordings of waterfalls, birds, and wind from national parks helped people recover from stress.

In one experiment, Taff asked people to give an unplanned speech in front of researchers. He measured their heart rate and stress hormone (cortisol) before and after the speech. People calmed down faster when they listened to nature sounds than when the recordings also had traffic, airplanes, or normal conversation.

Taff says natural sounds are very important to people. Many people visit protected areas to hear quiet, birds, wind, and water. He worries that people are losing this because they listen to their iPods all the time. He advises people to visit protected areas and experience what they are missing.

It is not clear why natural sounds help people relax, but Fristrup thinks that, over millions of years, humans have learned to connect peaceful natural sounds with safety. He believes these sounds remind our brains of a safe place.

Today, many people do not hear the sounds of nature because they block out the noises around them, says a US researcher.

When there is a lot of background noise, people do not notice the nice sounds of birds singing, water flowing, and trees moving in the wind. You can often hear these sounds even in cities, said Kurt Fristrup, a senior scientist at the US National Park Service.

The problem is worse because people listen to music with earphones instead of listening to birds and other nature sounds. Natural sounds are easily covered by traffic, music, and other noises, Fristrup said.

“This learned deafness is a real problem,” Fristrup told a science meeting in San Jose. “We are teaching ourselves to ignore the sounds that come into our ears.”

“We are born with a gift – the ability to hear things far away, all these amazing sounds – but we might lose it,” he said.

The problem is that we hear so many noises that we stop listening.

For the last ten years, the US National Park Service has measured sound levels in more than 600 parks in the US, including Yosemite in California, Yellowstone, and Denali in Alaska. There was noise from people in all the parks, such as airplanes, motorbikes, motorboats, and tour buses.

Fristrup’s team says that noise pollution more than doubles every 30 years. “It’s not surprising people use earphones,” he said.

“More background noise affects your hearing like fog affects your vision – you only notice a small area around you,” he said. Even in cities, there are birds and other things to enjoy in nature, but we are losing the ability to hear them.

People quickly get used to changes in their environment, including more noise. Fristrup worries that we will forget how quiet the world can be. “If it becomes too hard to find peace and quiet, many children will grow up without this experience, and I think it is a very big problem,” he said.

Other scientists say that listening to natural sounds is good for your health. At the same meeting, Derrick Taff, a social scientist at Pennsylvania State University, said that listening to recordings from national parks, like waterfalls, birdsong, and wind, helped people feel less stressed.

“We know that natural sounds are very important to people. They are some of the main reasons people visit protected areas. People want to hear the quiet, the birds, the wind, and the water,” Taff said. “We may lose this because people listen to their iPods all the time. My advice is to go to protected areas and experience what you are missing.”

Race engineer  
A race engineer communicates between the driver and the mechanics.  
Typical salary: New graduates start at £25,000 to £30,000. After a few years, junior engineers earn over £40,000. Senior race engineers earn £50,000 to £90,000.  
What the job involves: A race engineer listens to the driver, looks at the data, and decides how to set up the car for best performance. Then, the engineer tells the mechanics what to do.  
Qualifications: You need a university degree, usually in automotive or mechanical engineering, or motorsport technology. Practical experience is very important.  
To succeed as a race engineer, you need to handle pressure well.  
Worst thing about the job: The long hours. Race engineers often work all day and night.

Ethical hacker  
Typical salary: A new ethical hacker earns at least £35,000 to £50,000. Team leaders earn £60,000 to £90,000.  
What the job involves: Companies pay ethical hackers to try to break into their computer systems to check how strong their security is.  
Qualifications: You do not always need a computer science degree. The industry accepts people with many different backgrounds and skills.  
To succeed as an ethical hacker, you need to love technology and details. You should also enjoy solving difficult problems.  
Worst thing about the job: Sometimes, when you check a new customer’s network, you find out they have already been hacked.

Bomb-disposal diver  
Typical salary: In private companies, you can earn up to £100,000 by working two months out of every three.  
What the job involves: You dive to the sea floor to look for unexploded bombs, shells, grenades, and landmines. You then safely collect or get rid of these weapons.  
Qualifications: You need diving qualifications to work offshore. You also need a qualification in bomb disposal and many years of experience.  
To succeed as a bomb-disposal diver, you must stay calm in stressful situations. You work alone underwater, often with no visibility. If you do not like living in small spaces with many people, this job is not for you.  
Worst thing about the job: You will be away from home for at least six months each year.

Social engineer  
Typical salary: Graduates start at £25,000. With more qualifications and experience, salaries rise quickly to £50,000–£80,000.  
The job: Companies pay social engineers to try to trick employees into giving away secret information. This information can help the engineer access company data or computer networks.  
Qualifications: Most social engineers have a degree in IT, but understanding psychology also helps.  
To succeed as a social engineer, you need to be confident when lying and able to fit in anywhere. You also need strong personal ethics and knowledge of the law.  
Worst thing about the job: People often misunderstand your job. Social engineers are not spies, but many people think they are.

Power-line helicopter pilot  
Typical salary: £65,000  
The job: You fly a helicopter close to high-voltage power lines so they can be checked with a camera. This helps the power company find any problems.  
Qualifications: You need a private helicopter pilot’s licence, a commercial pilot’s licence, and about 2,000 hours of low-level flying experience.  
To succeed as a power-line helicopter pilot, you need steady hands and to stay calm. Pilots often fly as close as 20 feet from the power line and just 30 feet above the ground.  
Worst thing about the job: There are no negatives, according to helicopter pilot Robin Tutcher.

Private butler  
Typical salary: £60,000 to £90,000  
The job: A private butler does many things for their employer, such as managing clothes, driving, caring for pets, managing other staff, serving meals, running errands, looking after guests, booking restaurants, house security, cleaning, cooking, and anything else needed in the house.  
Qualifications: You do not need special qualifications, but you can take a special course.  
To succeed as a butler, you need to enjoy taking care of other people.  
Worst thing about the job: The long and unpredictable hours make it hard to have a family life. Butlers can also feel lonely, have cultural differences with their employer, and sometimes work for people who are not nice.

A recent report says that the richest people in India will be four times richer by 2018. Hundreds of thousands of new business owners and people who inherit money will become multimillionaires. The report is based on interviews with 150 rich people. It comes at a time when business confidence is coming back in India, the world’s biggest democracy.

In recent years, India had slow economic growth, higher prices for basic foods, and the value of the Indian currency went down. But in May 2014, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won a big election with promises to make the economy better. Even though the economy was slow, there are now almost 17% more Indians worth more than $3.75 million than in 2013, the report says. Cities are growing fast, the middle class is getting bigger, there are many more opportunities, and the political situation has improved a lot in recent months, says Murali Balaraman, one of the report’s authors.

Together, India’s rich people have assets worth one trillion dollars, which is about 20% of all the wealth in the country. By 2018, this could reach $4 trillion, the report says, and three times more people will be multimillionaires.

A fast-growing luxury market is serving these new rich people. They like to show their wealth in a quiet way, and buying luxury goods is a good way to do this, Balaraman said. Abhay Gupta, the CEO of Luxury Connect, said the market for luxury goods and experiences will keep getting bigger. There are many people who want to be like the very rich and copy what they do, he said.

Cars are some of the most popular things the rich buy, the report says. In 2009, rich people showed off Indian-made SUVs, but now only foreign cars impress others. Mercedes had a 47% increase in sales in India in 2013. BMW has started selling a new $200,000 model in Delhi.

However, India’s poor roads and traffic make it hard to use luxury cars. In 2013, Lamborghini’s CEO, Stephan Winkelmann, said that India’s roads are not good for their $450,000 sports cars. In India, Lamborghini sells two models: the Gallardo and the Aventador, which can go up to 217 mph. Winkelmann said that Lamborghini’s Indian customers are much younger than in Europe, usually in their 30s. Still, the most popular investments for the rich are real estate, mostly in India, and jewelry.

India’s super-rich are known for spending a lot of money. Mukesh Ambani, the richest man in India, built the world’s most expensive home in Mumbai. The 27-floor building has helicopter pads, cinemas, and more than 600 staff. It is worth $1 billion.

Lakshmi Mittal, a steel businessman in the UK worth $16 billion, paid $80 million for his niece’s three-day wedding. Hundreds of guests were flown to Barcelona, and the party was held in a museum.

But buyers of luxury goods are becoming more demanding, the report says. One person bought nine cases of Japanese whisky, each bottle costing over $750, for a wedding. The whisky was special because guests would not know where to buy it in India. Another person bought many Louis Vuitton bags, then cut up half of them to make clothes that matched her accessories.

Even weddings are changing. In the past, people sent gifts like silver plates, dried fruit, or sweets with wedding invitations. Now, these gifts are being replaced by expensive western designer brands. Today, people give Rolex watches and Louis Vuitton bags, says Gupta.

Almost half of the new multimillionaires live in smaller cities, and many give a lot to charity. Balaraman says that more rich people will not cause social problems because in India, people accept that some are rich and some are poor. People know about the differences and continue with their lives, he explains.

Even though the economy is not good, there are now almost one-sixth more Indians with more than $3.75 million than in 2013, the report says. “Cities are growing fast, the middle class is getting bigger, there are more chances for people, and Indian politics have become better in the last months,” says Murali Balaraman, who helped write the report.

The richest people in India have money and houses worth one trillion dollars. This is about one-fifth of all the wealth in India. By 2018, this could be $4 trillion, and there will be three times more multimillionaires, the report says.

New rich people are buying many expensive things. “They want to show their wealth, and buying luxury things is a good way to do it,” Balaraman said. Abhay Gupta, who works for Luxury Connect, said that more people want to buy luxury things and experiences. “Many people want to copy the very rich,” he said.

Cars are very popular for rich people to buy, the report says. In 2009, rich Indians bought Indian SUVs to impress friends, but now they buy foreign cars. Mercedes sold 47% more cars in India in 2013. BMW started selling a new $200,000 car in Delhi.

But companies sell fewer luxury cars because India’s roads and traffic are very bad. Lamborghini’s boss, Stephan Winkelmann, said in 2013 that the roads and traffic in India “are not so good” for their $450,000 sports cars. In India, Lamborghini sells two cars: the Gallardo and the Aventador, which can go up to 217 miles per hour. Winkelmann said Lamborghini’s Indian customers are much younger than in Europe. In India, a normal buyer is in his 30s. But the most popular things to buy are still houses—mostly in India—and jewellery.

India’s super-rich often surprise the world with their big spending. Mukesh Ambani, India’s richest man, built the world’s most expensive home in Mumbai, the business capital. The 27-floor building has helicopter pads, cinemas, and more than 600 workers. It is worth $1 billion.

The three-day wedding of the niece of Lakshmi Mittal, a steel businessman who lives in the UK and has $16 billion, cost $80 million. Hundreds of guests flew to Barcelona for the wedding and party, which was in a museum.

But the report says that rich people are harder to please. One very rich person bought nine boxes of Japanese whisky for a wedding party, with each bottle costing more than $750. The whisky was special because no one else in India could get it. Another rich person bought many Louis Vuitton bags, then cut up half of them to make clothes to match her bags.

Even Indian weddings are changing. Before, people sent gifts like silver plates, dried fruit, or sweets with wedding invitations. Now, rich people like to send gifts from famous western designers. “These days, it’s Rolex watches and Louis Vuitton bags,” says Gupta.

Almost half of the new multimillionaires live in small cities, and many give a lot of money to charity. Balaraman says that more rich people will not make more social problems because a big difference between rich and poor is “normal” in India. “People know some are rich and some are poor, and they continue with their lives,” he explains.

Margaret Thatcher, the most famous British prime minister since Winston Churchill in 1940 and a strong supporter of free market economics, has died. The British government said she would have a ceremonial funeral at St Paul’s Cathedral.

The current British prime minister, David Cameron, said he was very sad to hear about Lady Thatcher’s death. He said, “We have lost a great leader, a great prime minister, and a great Briton.” He also said that as the first woman prime minister, Margaret Thatcher succeeded even when it was very difficult. He believed she would be remembered as the greatest British prime minister in peacetime.

President Barack Obama said in a statement that many Americans would always remember her working closely with President Reagan. He said she showed the world that people can change history with strong beliefs, courage, and determination.

Margaret Thatcher was the first woman to lead a major western country. She was prime minister for 11 years at 10 Downing Street, but in 1990, members of her own party removed her from office.

Thatcher was 87 years old and had been sick for several years with dementia. After her death, politicians from all parties gave tributes.

Ed Miliband, the Labour Party leader, said she would be remembered as a unique person who changed politics for a whole generation. She was Britain’s first woman prime minister and a very important figure in the world. The Labour Party disagreed with many of her actions, and she will always be a controversial person. But, he said, people can disagree and still respect her achievements and personal strength.

Deputy prime minister Nick Clegg said Margaret Thatcher was one of the most important people in modern British politics. He said that no matter which party people support, everyone can agree that she made a unique and lasting mark on the country.

Former Conservative prime minister Sir John Major called her a political phenomenon. He said people who worked with her would always remember her courage and determination in politics, and her kindness and generosity in private.

Thatcher, known as the Iron Lady, was a close ally of US president Ronald Reagan during the last years of the Cold War against the Soviet Union. The Soviet Union broke up because of reforms led by Mikhail Gorbachev, a leader Thatcher said she could work with. Because of this, many people in former Soviet countries saw her as someone who supported their freedom.

Thatcher was not well known in the Conservative Party until she suddenly became party leader in 1975. Within ten years, she became famous around the world, both admired and disliked, for her support of free market reforms in the UK and her strong positions in foreign policy. She also fought against the IRA, who almost killed her with a bomb in 1984.

In Britain, Thatcher was known for selling state-owned industries to private owners. The word “privatization” became popular in many countries. She also defeated powerful trade unions, especially the National Union of Miners, whose one-year strike from 1984 to 1985 was very difficult for the country. With money from Britain’s North Sea oil, Thatcher changed the old industrial economy and used this chance to defeat her enemies, including some members of her own party.

In the European Union, she got a rebate for Britain, which she called “my money.” She was less successful in stopping the European Commission from trying to centralize power in Europe, especially when it was led by the French socialist Jacques Delors.

As the British economy improved after a very bad recession caused by her policies, she seemed unbeatable for a short time. But having too much power and losing her supporters led to mistakes and more people not liking her. When her deputy disagreed with her, mainly about Europe, his resignation speech caused a leadership challenge. After Conservative MPs did not support her in a vote, John Major became the new party leader.

After she retired, Thatcher wrote very successful memoirs and worked hard for the Thatcher Foundation, which tried to spread her ideas around the world.

When the children at a primary school in Stirling, Scotland, hear the words "daily mile," they stop what they are doing and go outside to run around the school field. For three and a half years, all the students at St Ninians Primary School have walked or run a mile every day. They do this at different times during the day. Even though childhood obesity is increasing in the UK, none of the children at this school are overweight.

The daily mile has helped the children become fitter, behave better, and concentrate more in class. Because of this, many other schools in Britain are doing the same thing. They ask students to leave their desks and spend 15 minutes walking or running around the school or a nearby park.

Elaine Wyllie, the headteacher of St Ninians, said, "I get at least two emails a day from other schools and local authorities asking how we do it. It is amazing to think that children across the country are running every day because of something we started."

According to the Health & Social Care Information Centre, one in ten children are obese when they start school at age four or five. In the summer of 2015, a study found that schoolchildren in England are less fit than ever before. Because of this, primary schools see the benefits of the daily mile. Schools in different parts of the UK have started the daily mile, and others plan to start it during the 2015-16 school year. In Stirling alone, 30 schools have already started or will soon start the daily mile.

The daily mile is a simple and free way to help children get fit. The most important thing is that the children enjoy it; otherwise, it would not continue. "They come back inside with bright eyes and red cheeks, like children used to look," said Wyllie. At St Ninians, teachers take their students out to a special track around the school field for their daily mile whenever it fits best in the day. Only ice or very heavy rain stops them.

We do not know all the benefits yet, but researchers from Stirling University have started a study to find out about the physical, mental, and emotional benefits of the daily mile. Dr Colin Moran, who leads the study, said, "The children do not seem to have problems with obesity; they seem happier, and staff say they settle into lessons faster, so we designed a study to test all these things." The students at St Ninians will be compared with children from another school in Stirling that has not started the daily mile yet.

Kevin Clelland, a primary school teacher from Leeds, visited St Ninians and then convinced his colleagues that it was a great idea. He said, "It is such a simple thing to do but seems to have an amazing effect. We are really committed to improving our students' fitness." His school is now building a track.

Active Cheshire, a sports and fitness group in Cheshire, is taking some senior people from the local authority to Scotland to see the results of the daily mile. If a test programme is successful, they hope to start it in all 450 schools in their area.

Paralympian Tanni Grey-Thompson, chair of ukactive, a health group for physical activity, said, "All children need to be active for 60 minutes every day, whether in a lesson, walking to school, or playing outside. It is great to see projects like the daily mile, showing real leadership from schools to improve children's fitness and thinking skills, and to make a real difference to schools, teachers, parents, and young people. We know sitting still is bad for health; moving helps children build skills for life."

The Scottish government also supports the daily mile. A spokesperson said, "Learning in PE is better with projects like the daily mile, which can help and encourage parents to teach healthy habits to their children from a young age. We are happy to see so many Scottish schools taking part or planning to do so."

Canadian tennis player Frank Dancevic criticized the Australian Open organizers for making players play in very hot and unsafe conditions. He collapsed on the court when the temperature reached 41°C.

Dancevic fainted during the second set of his first-round match against France’s Benoit Paire on court six, which had no cover. He was unconscious for about a minute. He said the heat was dangerous for players and made him see things that were not real. He said, “I was dizzy from the middle of the first set and then I saw Snoopy. I thought, ‘Wow, Snoopy, that’s strange.’”

He said, “I think it’s inhumane. It’s not fair to anyone—the players, the fans, or the sport—when you see players quitting matches or passing out. I have played five-set matches all my life, but after only one and a half sets, I passed out from heat stroke. That’s not normal.”

He added, “Many players have problems and complain to the tournament that it’s too hot to play. I don’t think it’s fair, and I know many other players agree.”

Other players also agreed. British number one Andy Murray said, “It’s definitely something we need to look at. Even if people say the conditions are safe, it only takes one bad thing to happen. It looks bad for the sport when players, ball kids, and fans are collapsing. That’s not good.”

Murray also said, “When I went out before my match at 2:30 pm, the conditions were very, very hard. I don’t know if it’s safe or not. In other sports, players have had heart attacks.”

Caroline Wozniacki said, “I put my water bottle on the court and the bottom started to melt a little. So you know it was hot.”

John Isner said, “It was like opening an oven when the potatoes are done. That’s what it felt like.”

Defending champion Victoria Azarenka said, “It felt very hot, like you’re dancing in a frying pan.”

In 2014, the rules changed so that the tournament director, Wayne McKewen, decides if matches should stop because of the heat.

Organizers said the temperature reached 42.2°C on Tuesday evening, but it was never high enough to stop matches. McKewen said that, although it was hot and uncomfortable, the low humidity meant play could continue.

Dancevic, who felt dizzy from the middle of the second set, continued playing after getting medical help, but he lost the match 7-6, 6-3, 6-4. He said, “I was very close to stopping completely. I wasn’t running much at the end. I wasn’t tired, but my body temperature was too high.”

A ball boy also needed medical help after collapsing during Milos Raonic’s 7-6, 6-1, 4-6, 6-2 win over Daniel Gimeno-Traver on court eight, which was also not covered. After this, the tournament only let ball boys work for 45 minutes at a time. China’s Peng Shuai said the heat made her cramp and vomit, and she needed help to leave the court after losing 7-5, 4-6, 6-3 to Japan’s Kurumi Nara.

Officials said the health risks were not serious. They said most matches finished without anyone needing medical help.

Tim Wood, the tournament’s chief medical officer, said, “Of course, a few players had heat problems or felt uncomfortable, but none needed serious medical treatment after their matches.”

Roger Federer said the conditions were tough, but the same for both players. He said, “It’s a mental thing. If you have trained hard and believe you can do it, you can get through it. If you can’t handle it, you give up.”

Dancevic disagreed. He said, “Some players are used to the heat because their bodies can handle it, but others can’t. It’s dangerous. It’s been an hour and a half since my match and I still can’t pee.”

Sir Alex Ferguson, the manager of Manchester United, will retire at the end of the season after 27 years. He is the most successful manager in British football history. After retiring, he will become a director of the club. Someone new will have to replace him. During his time as manager, Ferguson won 13 English Premier League titles, two Champions Leagues, the Cup Winners Cup, five FA Cups, and four League Cups.

Ferguson said he thought a lot about his decision to retire and believes now is the right time. He wanted to leave the club in a strong position, and he thinks he has done that. He said the team has good players of different ages, which is good for the club’s future success. The youth system is strong, so the club will continue to do well in the long term.

He also said that Manchester United’s training facilities are some of the best in the world, and their stadium, Old Trafford, is one of the top venues. Ferguson is happy to become a director and ambassador for the club. He is looking forward to the future and thanked his family for their love and support.

Ferguson thanked all his players and staff, past and present, for their hard work and professionalism. He said their efforts helped the club win many important trophies. He also thanked the board of directors for supporting him in his early years, which gave him the time and confidence to build a strong football club.

In the last ten years, the Glazer family helped Ferguson manage Manchester United as well as possible. He also said he was lucky to work with David Gill, the chief executive, who is talented and trustworthy. Ferguson thanked everyone and said it was an honour and a great privilege to be the manager of Manchester United. He enjoyed his time at the club.

Ferguson’s retirement happened suddenly, just as he had always said it would. He first talked about retiring in the 2001/2 season but changed his mind then. This time, he called the players into the changing room after they arrived for training and told them in an emotional speech that he was retiring.

Joel Glazer, one of the club’s owners, said that Ferguson is not only a fantastic manager but also a wonderful person. He praised Ferguson’s determination and dedication to the club and said he would never forget the great memories, like the famous night in Moscow.

Avie Glazer, Joel’s brother, said he was happy that Ferguson would stay at the club as a director. He said Ferguson’s work over the last 27 years was amazing and that he wanted Ferguson to be part of the club’s future.

David Gill said he enjoyed working closely with Ferguson for 16 years. They had many wins and signed many players together. He said they had been planning for Ferguson’s retirement by making sure the team and club were in great shape. Gill said Ferguson’s vision, energy, and skill helped build some of the best and most loyal teams in the world. He admired how much Ferguson cared for the club, the staff, and the football community. Gill said working with Ferguson was the best experience of his career and that it was an honour to call him a friend.

First-team coach René Meulensteen explained how Ferguson told the staff about his decision. He said he found out that morning when Ferguson called the staff into his office and told them he was retiring. Meulensteen said Ferguson thinks very carefully about his decisions, so he was sure Ferguson had thought a lot about this. He wished Ferguson well and said he had been fantastic for the club. He also hoped the fans would support the new manager as much as they supported Ferguson.

Lego’s profits went up a lot in the first half of 2014, helped by the success of The Lego Movie, which was very popular in cinemas in the US and UK.

The Danish toy company’s sales increased in Europe, the Americas, and Asia because children bought products connected to the film. The movie, which came out in February 2014, made more than $250 million in the US and £31 million in the UK by the first weekend of April.

The movie cost about $60 million to make and has been called almost perfect marketing. It is fun to watch and made for people who are likely to buy Lego products.

Lego’s finance director, John Goodwin, said that products from The Lego Movie helped profits in the first half of 2014. They are now waiting to see how these products will do after the movie is released on DVD in the second half of 2014.

Jørgen Vig Knudstorp, Lego’s chief executive, said the results are very good and show strong growth in recent years, even though the economy is difficult. He said the good results in the first half of 2014 are because Lego can create, launch, and sell products that children around the world really want.

Lego, which is based in the small town of Billund, started making its plastic bricks in 1949 and became a popular children’s toy around the world by the 1970s. But the company had problems and almost went out of business in 2003. Knudstorp became chief executive, ending 70 years of family leadership, and removed hundreds of extra products. He then focused the company back on its bricks.

In April, the company opened its first factory in China and opened an office in Shanghai to start growing in the world’s second-biggest economy.

Lego made much more money in the first half of 2014. This happened because the Lego Movie was very popular in the US and UK. The Danish toy company sold many more toys in Europe, North America, South America, and Asia because children wanted toys from the movie.

He liked the things that most millionaires like. He had a gold and silver Rolex watch and many expensive cars. He enjoyed buying modern art. But even though this Chinese businessman owned several companies and a big house in Madrid, he had almost no money in the bank. This made the Spanish authorities interested in him.

Gao Ping supplied 4,000 Chinese shops across Spain. But the authorities thought he was not paying taxes on the clothes, furniture, and other goods he brought from China.

When the police searched his warehouses in 2012, they found piles of cash. There were 100, 200, and 500 euro notes tied with elastic bands. The police took away about 12 million euros, which was the largest amount of cash ever found by Spanish police. Gao’s group is accused of cleaning up to 300 million euros a year of illegal money, selling fake goods, and selling toys with fake safety marks.

Police have worried about 500 euro notes for a long time. These notes are small and easy to carry, but they are worth a lot of money. People who avoid taxes, clean illegal money, and drug dealers like to use them. One million euros in 500 euro notes can fit in a small laptop bag. The same amount in 50 euro notes would need a small suitcase.

The UK stopped giving out 500 euro notes in 2010 because almost only criminals used them. In 2009, Italy’s central bank said that mafia and terrorists used these notes a lot. Other countries have also stopped using their own high-value notes because of crime. For example, Canada stopped its $1,000 note in 2000 after police advice.

Now, with electronic payments and contactless cards, people are asking if we still need these notes. Peter Sands, the former head of Standard Chartered Bank, said we should stop using high-value notes like the 500 euro, the $100, the 1,000 Swiss Franc note, and the £50. In a report for Harvard Kennedy School, Sands said it is time to stop using these notes because they help criminals. If criminals have to use smaller notes, gold, or diamonds, it will be harder for them because these are bigger and easier to trace. This means they are more likely to get caught.

At a meeting about terrorist money in London, the Head of Europol, Rob Wainwright, asked the European Central Bank to think about whether to keep making these notes. These notes help criminals and terrorists hide their money and pay for illegal things. According to Europol, the purple 500 euro note is 30% of the value of all euro notes, even though most people have never seen one.

The 500 euro note was first made in 2002 when the euro started. It replaced the 1,000 Deutschmark, the 10,000 Belgian franc, and the 500,000 Italian lira. In Germany and Austria, more than half of all payments are still made with cash.

Europol wants central banks to take more responsibility for what happens with 500 euro notes. For example, Luxembourg gave out more than twice its yearly GDP in banknotes in 2013. Europol asked Luxembourg’s central bank to explain. The bank said they just give out the notes people ask for and do not know why people want them. Jennifer MacLeod, a financial expert at Europol, said she is surprised that a central bank does not feel responsible for this.

This may change soon. EU finance ministers have asked leaders to think about limits on high-value notes and to report back by 1 May 2016.

Gao Ping sold goods to 4,000 Chinese markets in Spain. But the authorities thought he was not paying taxes on the clothes, furniture, and other things he brought from China.

When police went to his warehouses in 2012, they found a lot of cash: €100, €200, and €500 notes. Police took about €12 million, the most cash ever found by Spanish police.

Police have worried about €500 notes for a long time. These notes are small and easy to carry, so criminals like them. €1 million in €500 notes can fit in a small laptop bag. The same amount in €50 notes would need a small suitcase.

McDonalds is the biggest burger chain in the world and is a symbol of American business. However, McDonalds is having problems now. After growing for ten years, fewer people around the world are eating at McDonalds. The company said that global sales dropped by 3.3% since 2013. The results were called awful.

McDonalds has problems in many countries. In China, sales dropped by 23% because news showed that a local supplier used old beef and chicken in food for McDonalds and KFC. In Europe, sales fell by 4%, mainly because of problems in Ukraine and because people in Russia are less interested in Western brands. About 200 of McDonalds’ 450 restaurants in Russia are being checked by health inspectors, and ten have been closed.

The biggest problem is in the US, where McDonalds has about 40% of its restaurants. Almost 60 years after Ray Kroc opened the first McDonalds in Des Plaines, Illinois, people in the US are not as interested in eating Big Macs and fries. McDonalds has had 12 months in a row of falling sales in the US, with a 4.1% drop in the latest quarter. Young people are leaving McDonalds to eat at other places like Chipotle Mexican Grill. The number of 19-to-21-year-olds who visit McDonalds once a month has dropped by 13% since 2011.

McDonalds also has a bad reputation for its hamburgers. In a survey of over 32,000 Americans, people said McDonalds had the worst hamburgers in the country. They preferred to eat at Five Guys, Smashburger, or Fuddruckers. Many people also think McDonalds is less healthy than other restaurants, especially Chipotle, which uses meat without antibiotics and local, seasonal ingredients, even though “local” can mean up to 350 miles away.

People do not trust McDonalds’ food. In October, McDonalds started a website in the US to answer questions from customers. One question was, “Have you ever used pink slime in your burgers?” Pink slime is a type of beef filler used in dog food and sprayed with ammonia to make it safe for people. McDonalds has not used this meat since 2012, but the company’s boss, Don Thompson, said they need to work harder to show people their food is fresh and good quality.

At the same time, McDonalds is losing customers who want to pay more for fresher, healthier food, and it is also losing its reputation for fast, cheap food. After adding $2 items to its dollar menu, people now think McDonalds is more expensive than other fast-food places, and many say the service is slower.

Mary Chapman from Technomic, a food research company, said that McDonalds is not really more expensive. Prices have gone up, but not as much as at other fast-food chains in the US. Since 2009, McDonalds prices have increased by 4.8%, while the average fast-food price went up by 19.4%. Fast casual restaurants like Chipotle went up by 16.9%. US consumer prices rose 11% in the same time.

However, people are right about longer waiting times. McDonalds has a bigger menu than some other places, and some items are harder to make. For example, the chicken McWrap takes 60 seconds to prepare. Chapman said, “I think it is worth waiting, but the person behind me who wants a cheap double cheeseburger might not.”

In the UK, McDonalds has improved its business, making Britain a good place for the company. A better breakfast menu, improved coffee, and free Wi-Fi have made McDonalds more popular in the UK. Consultant Peter Martin said that 56% of British adults have visited McDonalds at least once in the last six months.

McDonalds leaders say they will try to change people’s minds about their food in the US. Thompson promised more organic food and burgers that customers can make themselves. To make lines shorter, he also wants simpler menus. Experts are not sure how McDonalds can have both simpler menus and more choices for fillings.

Mark Kalinowski from Janney Capital Markets said, “They want to make the menu simpler but also let people customize their food, and that is difficult.” Only four out of McDonalds’ 14,000 US restaurants have tested the “build your own burger” idea. He said, “Right now, we are not sure it will work; we want to see more details.”

Even though sales are going down, McDonalds is still opening new restaurants around the world. By the end of 2014, it plans to have 1,400 new restaurants. Kalinowski thinks McDonalds’ share of the market will keep getting smaller, but he also said people should not count the company out. He believes McDonalds will stay number one for many years, even decades.
