Tea, baked beans on toast, and fish and chips have been important foods in Britain for a long time. However, what people like to eat has changed over the years. This change is shown in the National Food Survey, which started in 1940 because the government was worried about health and food supply.

Many people know that British people love tea, but they now drink less than half as much as they did in the 1970s. Tea drinking went down from 68 grams per person per week to only 25 grams. Now, people in Britain drink about eight cups of tea a week, compared to 23 cups in 1974. Tea is still the most popular hot drink in the UK, but people now spend more money on coffee.

The survey used information from 150,000 households between 1974 and 2000, and more data from 2000 to 2014. It shows that people are eating healthier foods, such as low-calorie soft drinks, skimmed milk instead of whole milk, and more fresh fruit. However, people are also eating more chips, pizza, crisps, and ready meals.

People now eat more brown bread instead of white bread, but the total amount of bread eaten has dropped from 25 slices a week to 15 slices over the last 40 years. People eat 20% less baked beans, even though they eat more other easy-to-prepare foods, especially Italian dishes. Adults in the UK now eat about 75 grams of pizza each week, but they did not eat pizza at all in 1974. Pasta eating has almost tripled in the same time.

Fresh potatoes are not as important as before. People now eat 67% less than in 1974, when adults ate about 188 grams every day. But people now buy more vegetables like cucumbers, courgettes, aubergines, and mushrooms. Takeaway food eating has almost doubled since 1974, from 80 grams per person per week to 150 grams. Of this, 33 grams are chips and 56 grams are meat. Kebabs (10 grams), chicken (7 grams), burgers (5 grams), and meat-based meals (32 grams) are especially popular.

Some changes show that British people are more careful about their food. The average amount of fruit eaten has gone up by 50% since 1974. In 2014, adults in the UK ate about 157 grams of fruit each day. Bananas have been the most popular fruit since 1996, with 221 grams per adult per week in 2014, more than apples (131 grams) and oranges (48 grams). In 2014, half of all soft drinks were low-calorie for the first time. People in Britain now spend a smaller part of their income on food—11% compared to 24% in 1974.

The UK Environment Secretary, Elizabeth Truss, said that food is very important in British society. The data shows what people ate 40 years ago and how culture has changed food habits. People now care more about where their food comes from, the internet makes it easy to buy good food, new restaurants show the latest food trends, and foods from around the world are now as common as fish and chips.

By looking at this data, we can see how and when people’s eating habits changed. There is still much more to learn from the National Food Survey. The data can help with local food projects, school lessons, and predicting new food trends. Elizabeth Truss hopes this information will help people learn about the past and help the UK’s food and farming industry in the future.

The Greek island of Agios Efstratios is very far away and forgotten by banks, the government, and most of the modern world. There is no ATM or credit card machine on the island. Before the economic crisis in Greece, people on this quiet island in the northern Aegean Sea lived well. They used the post office for banking, and the few rooms for rent were full every summer. Tourists came because they heard about the island’s empty beaches, clear sea, and fresh seafood.

But now, because the island only uses cash, the closing of Greek banks has been very hard for the people. Residents must travel nine hours to the nearest big island to get cash. Greek visitors say they cannot get enough money to visit. The number of tourists has dropped by 80% this year, said Mayor Maria Kakali. The village has about 200 people. Even people who were born on the island and now live in Athens are not coming back.

Mayor Kakali has asked the government and a big Greek bank to put an ATM on the island soon, but she thinks it may be too late for this tourist season. Tourism is the main way people make money on the island. She said, “We have almost no reservations in August, when usually we have many people calling to find a room and we cannot help them.” This winter may be a little better because 50 workers will come to the village to work on the harbour. But there is a bigger problem because the government will end a special tax break for islands.

The tax break was made to help island communities because many people were leaving. The lower sales tax made life cheaper on the islands, where everything must be brought in from outside, and it made tourism cheaper too. Popular islands like Mykonos are worried that losing the tax break will make it hard to compete with Turkey. For Agios Efstratios, it is an even bigger problem. Mayor Kakali said, “If we have to pay a tax of 23%, I am sorry to say it, but we will all die on the island.”

Food and fuel are already more expensive than on the mainland. Even in summer, the island has only three shops, two restaurants, and no official hotel. “This is an expensive island. Everything, even milk or bread, is bought and sold three or four times before it gets to us, and everyone takes a profit,” said Provatas Costas, a 58-year-old fisherman.

For Agios Efstratios and its nearest big neighbour, Lemnos, the crisis came at a very bad time. For years, the islands were hard to reach because the ferries were slow and not reliable. In 2015, the government gave the ferry contract to a new, better company, and many new visitors started to come. But then the bank controls started. “It began as the best season in 30 years and, in one week, it became the worst,” said Atzamis Konstantinos, a travel agent in Lemnos.

Lemnos has many wild beaches where you can swim and sunbathe almost alone, a small nightlife, and many cultural places. It is the eighth largest island in Greece, so it will get the first tax increases in autumn 2015, but it is not as rich as many smaller islands. Lemnos has just over 3,000 beds for visitors, while an island like Rhodes has tens of thousands. “We have had economic problems in recent years and now we will have more,” said Lemnos Mayor, Dimitris Marinakis. “When there is not enough money, people buy less and the whole economy gets worse.”

If taxes go up, even more young people will leave, warns Mayor Kakali. She has worked to improve education on the island to help keep families there. Because Agios Efstratios is one of the smallest islands, it has until 2017 before the tax rise starts. Kakali hopes that, because things change quickly in Greek politics, the island might avoid the tax. If not, she plans to go to Athens to remind the government what the tax rise would mean.

“The truth is, the government does not pay much attention to the islands of the north Aegean,” she said. “So I would take all the children from our school to the gates of parliament, to tell them: There is still life in these islands.”

It is the eighth biggest island in Greece, so it will have to pay the higher tax in autumn 2015. But Lemnos is not as rich as some smaller islands. It has just over 3,000 beds for visitors. For example, Rhodes has tens of thousands of beds. “We have had money problems in recent years and now it will get worse,” said Lemnos Mayor, Dimitris Marinakis.

If taxes go up, more young people will leave, says Mayor Kakali. Because Agios Efstratios is one of the smallest islands, it will not have to pay the higher tax until 2017. Kakali hopes things in Greece will get better before then. But if not, she plans to go to Athens to tell the government how bad the tax rise would be.

“The government does not pay much attention to the islands of the north Aegean,” she said. “So I would take all the children from our school to the parliament in Athens to tell them: ‘There is still life on these islands’.”

Scientists have connected the brains of two animals so they can share sensory information. This is an important step towards what the researchers call the world’s first organic computer.

A team in the US put special devices called brain-to-brain interfaces on two rats. These devices let the rats work together on simple tasks to get rewards, like a drink of water. In one important test, the scientists used the internet to connect the brains of two rats that were far apart—one in North Carolina, USA, and the other in Natal, Brazil.

The research was led by Miguel Nicolelis, who is known for making devices that help paralyzed people control computers and robotic arms with their thoughts. The team says their new work could make it possible to connect many brains to share information. Nicolelis said, “We have made a direct and advanced communication link between brains. We are basically creating an organic computer.”

First, the scientists showed that rats can share and use each other’s sensory information by connecting their brains with tiny electrodes that reach the part of the brain that controls movement.

The rats learned to press a lever when a light above it turned on. If they did this correctly, they got a drink of water. To test if the rats could share brain information, the scientists put them in two separate boxes. Only one box had a light above the lever. When the first rat pressed the lever, its brain activity was sent electronically to the second rat’s brain. In tests, the second rat pressed the lever correctly 70% of the time after receiving the brain signals.

Surprisingly, the communication worked both ways. If the second rat failed the task, the first rat did not get the water reward and seemed to change its behavior to help its partner do better. In other tests, the rats worked together on a task where they had to tell the difference between narrow and wide openings using their whiskers.

In the final test, the scientists connected rats on different continents and used the internet to send their brain activity back and forth. Even though the rats were far apart, they could still communicate, said Miguel Pais-Vieira, the main author of the study. This shows that it is possible to create a network of animal brains in many different places.

Nicolelis said the team is now trying to connect several animals’ brains at the same time to solve harder tasks. He said, “We cannot even guess what might happen when animals start working together as a brain network. Maybe a group of brains can solve problems that one brain alone cannot.”

Anders Sandberg, who studies the ethics of brain technology at Oxford University, said this work is very important for understanding how brains send information. But he also said the technology could be used for many other things in the future. He explained that humans are successful because we are very good at communicating and working together. Without this, even though we are smart, we would not be the most powerful species on the planet.

Sandberg said he is not worried about super-smart rats. There is a big difference between sharing sensory information and being able to plan. He does not think there will be an invasion of smart rats.

Very little is known about how people send thoughts and how these could be sent to another person’s brain, so this will not happen soon. Also, much of what is in our minds is just a draft of what we might do. Often, we do not want to share these drafts because it could be embarrassing or confusing. We also change our thoughts before we act. Most of the time, we would probably be glad not to be inside someone else’s mind.

Thousands of people protested on beaches in Australia against a shark cull happening in Western Australia. They asked the state’s prime minister to stop the policy. RSPCA Australia and Richard Branson, the owner of Virgin Atlantic, also spoke against it. The government started catching and killing sharks longer than three metres after what they called an unusual number of shark attacks on Western Australia’s coast. In November 2013, a 35-year-old surfer was killed, becoming the sixth person to die from a shark attack in two years.

However, in all of Australia, there has been an average of only one shark-related death each year for the last 50 years. Kate Faehrmann from the Sea Shepherd Conservation Society said at a protest in Perth, the state capital, that the policy would not work. She explained that drumlines, which are used to catch sharks, kill sharks of all sizes, as well as dolphins, turtles, and other animals. This is why the community does not want the policy.

Thousands of people protested on beaches in Perth, Sydney, Adelaide, and in Victoria and Queensland. Faehrmann said the protests showed that Australians want to protect sharks. She said it was amazing how many people in Australia love sharks. She said the protests showed that, even though people are afraid, thousands are coming out to say, “That’s their ocean. We respect them, we love them, and we don’t want them killed.” Anthony Joyce, a surfer who once had his foot caught in a shark’s mouth, said that killing more sharks would not make any difference.

The state government has not said how many sharks have been killed. There are reports that sharks smaller than three metres have been released after being caught on drumlines. Drumlines are floating drums fixed to the sea bed with bait on hooks underneath. Conservationists say there is no proof that the cull will reduce shark attacks on people, because no cull before has only used drumlines. Researchers at the University of Western Australia say the higher number of shark attacks is probably because the state’s population is growing faster than anywhere else in Australia, not because there are more sharks.

Richard Peirce from the UK charity the Shark Trust said the cull would not work and could bring more dangerous animals closer to the coast. He said the actions in Western Australia are making the problem of shark attacks worse. He said it is sad that the government ignored good advice and chose a method that does not work and could make things worse. He also said that drumlines catch all kinds of animals, not just sharks, and leaving them in the water at night could attract more predators.

In 2012, there were 80 shark attacks worldwide, and seven were fatal. In comparison, humans kill nearly 100 million sharks every year. RSPCA Australia said the cull is not justified. They said there is no proof that more shark attacks are because there are more sharks. Instead, it is because more people are in the water.

Richard Branson said the policy was not working. He thought the Premier of Western Australia, Colin Barnett, started it to help tourism, but Branson believes it will do the opposite. He said the policy is making people worry about a problem that is not as big as it seems, and it will stop people from visiting Perth and the beautiful areas around it. He said the only result will be to make people worry for no good reason.

More and more people are against Western Australia’s shark cull. Thousands of people went to beaches all over Australia to ask the state’s leader to stop killing sharks. RSPCA Australia and Richard Branson, the owner of Virgin Atlantic, also spoke against the cull. The government started catching and killing sharks longer than three metres after many shark attacks on the coast. In November 2013, a 35-year-old surfer died from a shark attack. He was the sixth person killed by a shark in two years.

But the Shark Attack File says that, in all of Australia, there has been only one shark-related death per year on average for the last 50 years. Kate Faehrmann, from the Sea Shepherd Conservation Society, said at a protest in Perth, “We have always said this policy will not work. Drumlines, which are used to catch sharks, kill many animals. They kill sharks of all sizes, as well as dolphins, turtles, and other animals. That is why people do not want this policy.”

Thousands of people protested at Cottesloe Beach in Perth and Manly Beach in Sydney. Hundreds also protested at Glenelg in Adelaide, and at beaches in Victoria and Queensland. Faehrmann said the protests showed that Australians want to protect sharks. She said, “It is amazing that so many people in Australia love sharks. Even though people are afraid of sharks because of movies like Jaws, thousands of people are coming out to say, ‘The ocean belongs to sharks too. We respect them, we love them, and we do not want them killed.’” Anthony Joyce, a surfer who was once bitten by a shark, said, “Killing more sharks will not make a difference.”

The government has not said how many sharks have been killed. Some reports say that sharks smaller than three metres are released after being caught on drumlines. Drumlines are floating drums with baited hooks that are anchored to the sea floor. Conservationists say there is no proof that killing sharks will stop attacks on people, because no other cull has only used drumlines. Researchers at the University of Western Australia say that more shark attacks may be because more people are living in the state, not because there are more sharks.

Richard Peirce, from the Shark Trust in the UK, said the cull will not work and may even bring more dangerous animals closer to the coast. He said, “What is happening in Western Australia is making the problem worse. The government could try better ways to keep people safe, but instead they chose a method that does not work and is harmful. Drumlines kill many animals, and if they are left in the water overnight, they can attract more predators.”

In 2012, there were 80 unprovoked shark attacks in the world, and seven people died. But humans kill almost 100 million sharks every year. RSPCA Australia said the cull is not right. “There is no proof that more shark attacks are because there are more sharks. It is more likely because there are more people in the water,” they said.

Richard Branson told the radio that the policy is not working. “I think the Premier of Western Australia, Colin Barnett, thought killing sharks would help tourism. But I think it will do the opposite. You are making people worry about a problem that is not very big, and you are making people not want to visit Perth and the beautiful places around it. You are only making people worry for no good reason.”

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has told the USA to fix its financial problems after the US avoided not paying its debts and hundreds of thousands of government workers went back to work after a 16-day government shutdown.

US President Barack Obama said, “We need to stop running the government by crisis.” The IMF’s leader, Christine Lagarde, also asked for more stability.

The Senate made a deal that gave almost nothing to the conservatives who had pushed the country close to a new financial crisis. The deal was approved by the House of Representatives, which is controlled by Republicans, at the last moment.

The World Bank was also happy that the world economy did not face a disaster. Its president, Jim Yong Kim, told politicians everywhere to keep making policies that help the economy grow and give jobs and chances to everyone.

Stock markets in Japan, China, Hong Kong, and South Korea first showed relief after the Republicans gave up their failed attempt to stop Obama’s healthcare reforms. But in Asia and Europe, stock markets did not change much, because traders think there will be another fight in Washington early in 2014.

The shutdown cost the US $24 billion. China’s official Xinhua News Agency said the US put other countries’ dollar investments at risk. China is the biggest lender to the US government.

Obama signed the new law just after midnight on Thursday. The bill passed easily in the Senate with support from both parties. It is only a temporary solution. It funds the government until January 15 and raises the debt limit until February 7.

But the president said he did not want another big budget fight or shutdown in 2014.

At the White House, Obama said he hoped the deal would remove the uncertainty that had worried the country in recent weeks.

“When this agreement comes to my desk, I will sign it immediately,” he said. “Hopefully, next time, it won’t be at the last minute. We need to stop running the government by crisis.”

A journalist asked Obama if the crisis would happen again in a few months. Obama said, “No.”

Earlier, Republican Senator Mike Lee said there could be more problems: “The media keeps asking: Was it worth it? My answer is, it is always worth it to do the right thing.” He added, “This is not over.”

However, the political deal was very bad for the Republicans. They did not get any of their goals, and polls showed that voters blamed them for the crisis.

But the deal on Wednesday was very bad for the Republicans. They did not get what they wanted, and most people blamed them for the crisis.

What is it like to see the last of something? Sudan is the last male northern white rhino in the world. If he does not have a baby soon with one of the two female northern white rhinos at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya, there will never be any more northern white rhinos, male or female. There is little hope because Sudan is old—he is 42 years old—and all attempts to help him have babies have not worked. Besides these three rhinos, there are only two other northern white rhinos in the world. Both are female and live in zoos.

It looks kind and caring that Sudan is protected by armed guards who stay with him. But really, it is a sad situation. Sudan is in danger from poachers who kill rhinos and cut off their horns to sell them as medicine in Asia. Sudan is still at risk, even though his horn has been removed to stop poachers from wanting to kill him.

Sudan does not know how special he is. His eye looks sad in his big, wrinkled face as he walks around the reserve with his guards. His head is amazing. It is large and strong, made of hard bone and thick skin. It looks powerful, but it is also very easy to hurt.

Sudan looks much like the rhinoceros that the artist Albrecht Dürer drew in 1515. Dürer was a Renaissance artist who drew a strange animal from far away. In 1515, a live Indian rhinoceros was sent from the ruler of Gujarat in India to the king of Portugal. The king sent it to the Pope, but the ship sank on the way and the rhino died.

Humans often destroy the things they love. We have done this since the Ice Age. There are beautiful pictures of European woolly rhinos in caves in France, painted up to 30,000 years ago. These ancient rhinos were related to Sudan and looked strong and gentle. A woolly rhino in Chauvet Cave looks young and full of life. But the same people who painted these pictures also helped to kill them.

Today, many people love rhinos, but more and more are being killed. The northern white rhino is the rarest type of African rhino. There are more southern white rhinos and black rhinos. But in some countries, people want rhino horn for traditional medicine, so poaching is increasing. Many people believe rhino horn can cure many things, from the flu to cancer. In 2007, poachers killed 13 rhinos in South Africa. In 2014, they killed 1,215 rhinos for their horns in South Africa.

The northern white rhino is almost extinct, even though people try hard to protect it with guards and guns. Other types of African rhinos are also being hunted by poachers—the problem is out of control. The Javan rhinoceros is also close to extinction. India has done a good job protecting the Indian rhinoceros, but poaching is still a problem there too. Sudan is a wonderful animal. Have we learned nothing since the Ice Age?

James Bond films are one of the world’s longest-running and most successful film series. There are 23 movies, and they have made more than $6 billion at box offices around the world. James Bond is still very popular. After the movie Skyfall, which broke records and became the biggest film ever at the UK box office in 2012, earning $1.1 billion, Bond became even more popular.

Because of this, many people were interested when the 24th Bond film was announced, especially its official title, Spectre. The main question is: can Spectre be as successful as Skyfall?

Charles Gant, a film editor for Heat magazine, says things look good. He says Skyfall was a smart move because it was both modern and old-fashioned at the same time. It attracted fans of Daniel Craig and also brought back older Bond fans who had lost interest. With the new title, he thinks Spectre will also be a success.

Eon Productions, the company that started in 1961 to make Dr No and has made all the official Bond films, is working hard to make Spectre another hit. They are using the same creative team from Skyfall. Daniel Craig will play Bond at least until the 25th film, and the same writers wrote the script.

Getting Sam Mendes as director again gives Bond fans a lot of hope. Mendes is known for movies about characters, like American Beauty and Revolutionary Road, but he has made the Bond series even better. Gant says Mendes was able to interest both new and old Bond fans, and he also brought in top actors like Ralph Fiennes. Actors like Fiennes only join a film if they like the director.

The Bond series was not in trouble before Mendes and Craig, but at the end of Pierce Brosnan’s time as Bond, the films were getting a bit boring. The series had run out of original Bond stories to use, and the movies were not like the Ian Fleming books anymore. They were missing energy.

This is not new for Bond films. The history of the series has always changed, mostly depending on who played Bond: first Sean Connery, then George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Brosnan, and now Craig. Each new Bond actor was chosen because of the state of the series, and some were more successful than others.

Lazenby only made one film, and Dalton made two films in the late 1980s, a time when Hollywood action movies were more popular than Bond. Gant says that the last Roger Moore films and the Dalton films did not excite audiences. Brosnan was more successful in making money, but Craig has made Bond even more popular. The early Bond films were also very successful, exciting, and different from other movies at the time.

Skyfall made more money than any other Bond film. But some Bond films from the 1960s were almost as successful if you adjust for inflation. The 1965 film Thunderball is just below Skyfall, and Goldfinger and You Only Live Twice did better than Craig’s other films. The 1970s films The Spy Who Loved Me and Live and Let Die also did better. Licence to Kill made the least money, and Moore’s last film, A View to a Kill, was the second least successful.

Even so, the Bond brand has stayed very strong over the years. Eon has had to stop other companies from trying to use the Bond name. Because of special rights, other versions of Casino Royale (in 1967) and Thunderball (as Never Say Never Again, in 1983) were made by other companies. After many years of legal fights, Eon now controls both stories.

Martin Campbell, another experienced British director, planned one of the biggest stunts in Bond history. In the famous opening scene of Goldeneye (1995), Bond jumps into a plane without a pilot. This scene helped make the series more modern and popular. Also, a new generation of fans discovered Bond through the very successful Goldeneye video game, which helped people see that Bond films were no longer old-fashioned.

This is not new. The Bond series has changed a lot, especially the main actor. First, Sean Connery played Bond, then George Lazenby, Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton, Pierce Brosnan, and now Daniel Craig. Each actor was different, and some were better than others.

An international agreement to make clothing factories in Bangladesh safer may face legal problems because factory owners want money to cover the costs of closing and repairing their factories. Some repairs will take months, and factory owners say they cannot pay workers while the factories are closed and also pay for the expensive repairs needed to make the buildings safe. These repairs are happening after the Rana Plaza building collapsed in Dhaka, Bangladesh, in 2013, killing 1,138 people.

The problems are happening as hundreds of Bangladeshi clothing factories are being checked every month for fire safety and building problems under the Accord on Fire and Building Safety in Bangladesh. This Accord is supported by more than 170 international brands, such as Primark and Marks & Spencer, and international trade unions like IndustriALL.

The owner of a factory in Dhaka called Softex Cotton said he will take legal action against the Accord because his factory was closed for having building problems. He wants $100 million in compensation. Another factory owner said that if a factory closes, even for a short time, it will lose orders and may have to close forever. He said there is no such thing as a temporary closure. He also said the Accord did not clearly say who should pay for the costs of closing factories because they wanted as many brands as possible to join the agreement after the Rana Plaza disaster. He said there is no clear plan for who will pay these costs.

Jenny Holdcroft, policy director for IndustriALL, which is involved in the Accord, said the agreement makes sure that factories will not lose orders during closure because brands have promised to keep giving orders to suppliers for two years. So far, the Accord has found twelve factories that need major repairs, but Holdcroft said many of these only need to close part of the building, and work can continue on other floors. The Accord also legally requires brands to make sure workers are paid during factory closures. She said the details about who pays were left open so that factory owners who can afford to pay for repairs and workers’ compensation will do so.

She said this was always going to be something to discuss. Brands do not want to pay so that rich factory owners, who have made profits for years without fixing their factories, can continue to do so. She said there was always going to be some problems and changes. A spokesman for the Accord said that arguments about payments and legal action will not stop their work to make factories safer.

However, there is more pressure on the Accord to help pay workers who lose their jobs during repairs because another group, the Alliance for Bangladesh Worker Safety, supported by US retailers like Walmart and Gap, has set aside $5 million to help pay workers for up to two months while factories are fixed. The Alliance has found five factories in four buildings where work had to stop.

The Alliance is sharing the cost of workers’ salaries with factory owners, which is causing confusion. Shaidullah Azim, a director of the Bangladeshi Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association, said, “We had a big meeting with the Accord to make them understand they have to help, or how will we help our workers?”

The owner of a factory in Dhaka called Softex Cotton said he will go to court against the Accord because his factory was closed for building problems. He wants about $100 million in compensation.

Another factory owner said that if a factory closes, even for a short time, it will lose orders and may close forever. He said, “There is no such thing as temporary closure.” He also said the Accord does not say clearly who will pay when factories close.

Jenny Holdcroft, who works for IndustriALL and helps with the Accord, said the agreement makes sure factories do not lose orders when they are closed. Companies agreed to keep giving orders to suppliers for two years.

The Accord found 12 factories that need a lot of repairs, but Holdcroft said many of these factories only need to close some parts, and work can continue on other floors. The Accord also asks companies to make sure workers get paid when factories are closed. She said factory owners who have enough money should pay for repairs and pay workers.

She said, “Companies do not want to pay so that rich factory owners can keep all the profits and not spend money on their factories for many years. It is not surprising that there are problems. If there were no problems, nothing would change.” A spokesman for the Accord said that talks about money and legal action will not stop their work to make factories safer.

But now, there is more pressure on the Accord to help pay workers when factories close. Another group, the Alliance for Bangladesh Worker Safety, which is supported by US companies like Walmart and Gap, has given $5 million to help pay workers for up to two months while factories are fixed.

Shaidullah Azim, a leader of the Bangladeshi Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association, said, “The Alliance is sharing workers’ salaries with factory owners, so now there is a lot of confusion. We had a big meeting with the Accord to tell them they must help, or how can we help our workers?”

Oxfam says that the huge amounts of money made by the world’s richest 100 billionaires are making inequality worse and stopping the world from fighting poverty. The charity explains that when a few people get richer, there are often fewer good jobs and lower wages for the poorest people. This makes it harder for people who live on aid or low pay to improve their lives and escape poverty.

Oxfam says that if the richest 100 billionaires gave away the money they made in 2012, the world’s poorest people could be lifted out of poverty several times. The charity says that the $240 billion made by these billionaires in 2012 would be enough to end extreme poverty four times.

Usually, charities do not criticize rich people because they often give money to good causes. For example, Bill Gates and Warren Buffett are two of 40 US billionaires who have promised to give away much of their wealth to help others, but there is not much information about how much they give each year. Billionaires from Russia, the Middle East, or China have not made the same promises.

Oxfam’s report, called "The Cost of Inequality: How Wealth and Income Extremes Hurt Us All," was published just before the World Economic Forum in Davos. In the report, Oxfam asks world leaders to promise to reduce inequality to the levels seen in 1990.

The report says that the richest 1% have increased their incomes by 60% in the last 20 years. The financial crisis has made this happen even faster. Barbara Stocking, Oxfam’s Chief Executive, says that studies show countries have less investment and growth when workers get a smaller share of the total income. She says we cannot keep believing that making a few people rich will help everyone, because often the opposite happens.

The report says this problem is happening everywhere. In the UK, inequality is quickly returning to levels last seen in the 1800s. In China, the richest 10% now earn almost 60% of all income. China’s inequality is now similar to South Africa, which is the most unequal country in the world. In the US, the share of national income going to the top 1% has doubled since 1980, from 10% to 20%.

The richest 1% are also estimated to cause up to 10,000 times more pollution than the average US citizen.

Oxfam says world leaders should learn from countries like Brazil, which has grown quickly while also reducing inequality. Stocking says we need to undo years of growing inequality. As a first step, she says world leaders should agree to bring inequality back to 1990 levels. She also says that closing tax havens, which hold up to $31 trillion (about a third of all global wealth), could bring in $189 billion more in taxes.

The UK prime minister, David Cameron, said there was a clear result in the Scottish independence referendum. Scotland voted by a margin of 10.6 points to stay in the 307-year-old union with England and Wales. Cameron promised big changes in how Great Britain is governed, as he welcomed Scotland’s choice to remain in the UK. He said, “There can be no arguments, no second votes – we have heard what the Scottish people want.”

Earlier, Scotland’s first minister, Alex Salmond, spoke at a Scottish National Party rally in Edinburgh. He said he accepted that Scotland had not chosen independence at this time. He called the referendum a great moment for democracy and said he would work with the government in London for the good of Scotland and the rest of the UK. He also said the campaign had reached people who had never been interested in politics before.

The yes campaign had some big wins: it got 53% of the vote in Glasgow, Scotland’s largest city, 57% in Dundee, and 51% in North Lanarkshire. However, the no campaign won in 28 areas. It won easily in places where it was expected, like Edinburgh, Aberdeenshire, and the Borders, but also in places that could have voted yes, like the Western Isles. In the final count, the no side got 2,001,926 votes (55.3%) and the yes side got 1,617,989 votes (44.7%).

In his speech, Cameron said there would be changes to the constitution, including in Scotland, but not until after the general election. He also said that changes in Scotland would happen at the same time as changes in England. “We have heard the voice of Scotland and now the millions of voices of England must be heard,” he said.

Cameron added, “The people of Scotland have spoken and it is a clear result. They have kept our country of four nations together and, like millions of others, I am happy. As I said during the campaign, it would have broken my heart to see our United Kingdom end. I know many people feel the same, not just in our country but around the world, because of what we have done together in the past and what we can do together in the future. Now, it is time for our United Kingdom to come together and move forward. A key part of this will be a fair agreement for people in Scotland and also for everyone in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.”

Ed Miliband, the leader of the Labour Party, said the referendum was a vote for change from the Scottish people. “We know our country needs to change. We will give stronger powers to the Scottish parliament, for a strong Scotland.” He also said this change would go beyond Scotland, and that there would be changes across England, Wales, and the whole UK.

Nick Clegg, the deputy prime minister, said the referendum was not only a new start for Scotland in the UK but also for bigger changes across the union. He said a vote against independence was not a vote against change. “We must now give Scotland the new powers we promised, on time and completely,” he said.

However, the result could cause more problems. Some MPs from Cameron’s Conservative Party are threatening to vote against the prime minister’s promise to quickly give more powers to the Scottish parliament and protect its spending.

Nigel Farage, the leader of the UK Independence Party, said Cameron’s offer of more powers for England did not go far enough. He said, “The English are 86% of this union by population. They have been left out for the last 18 years. We still have a situation where Scottish MPs can vote in the House of Commons on issues that only affect England. I think most English people want a fair agreement.”

Cameron will try to calm tensions when he makes another statement about the result. He will explain how he will give more powers to Scotland, including more control over tax and welfare for the Scottish Parliament in Edinburgh. The prime minister wants to act quickly to show that the three main UK party leaders will keep the promises they made during the referendum campaign.

Anitta is Brazil’s newest funk music star. She has made music from poor neighborhoods, called favelas, popular with many people. However, there is a debate about her skin color.

Some people who fight against discrimination and some writers say that Anitta had to change her appearance to become successful with Brazil’s mostly white, middle-class audience. The debate started when old and new photos of Anitta were published. In the first photo, before she was famous, her skin looked darker. In the second photo, after she became famous and signed with Warner, her skin looked lighter. This difference made people talk again about whether you need to have light skin to be successful in Brazil.

Jarid Arraes, a psychology student and blogger, wrote that the change in Anitta’s image shows discrimination in the media and marketing. She said that many people in Brazil do not want to admit there is racism, but statistics show that is not true. In Brazil, white people are seen as rich, successful, and good, while black people are seen as the opposite.

Anitta’s real name is Larissa de Macedo Machado. As a child, she sang in a church choir. When she was a teenager, she became known in Rio de Janeiro’s baile funk scene as a dancer and singer. Now, she has an album and a very popular song, “Show das Poderosas,” which was number one on the charts and has 52 million views on YouTube.

Many people like Anitta because she is a pop star with a strong message and catchy songs. Her marketing team wants people to see her as a link between the mostly black and mixed-race poor neighborhoods on Rio’s hills and the richer, whiter areas below.

Baile funk music often has gangster themes and strong language. Now, some people are asking if Anitta or her marketing team have changed her too much. Arraes says that if pop stars have curly hair, they want to straighten it. If they have a big nose, they want to make it smaller. This makes people feel bad about themselves.

This is a sensitive issue in Brazil, which has many people of mixed race. Brazil was one of the last big countries to end slavery and has the largest number of people with African roots outside Africa. In Brazil, skin color is more important than where your family comes from. There is a clear connection between skin color and inequality.

In Brazilian cities, white workers earn about twice as much as black workers. Until 2011, black or mixed-race students also spent two years less in school on average. Most business and government leaders are white, while most low-paid jobs are done by black and mixed-race people. In rich areas like Ipanema and Gávea, you often see black nannies with white children, but rarely white nannies with black children.

It is not easy to define color in Brazil. In the 2010 census, for the first time, people who called themselves white were a minority. Out of 197 million people, 82 million said they were mixed race (pardo), 15 million said they were black, two million were Asian, and 0.5% were indigenous.

Sylvio Ferreira, a psychology teacher at the Federal University of Pernambuco, thinks Anitta became popular with the middle class by making rebellious music more acceptable to everyone.

Maycon de Mattos Batista, a financial analyst who worked with Anitta when she was an intern, said Anitta’s image changed a lot, but not her skin color. He said, “I don’t think it’s about making her whiter; it’s more about how they use makeup, hair stylists, and clothes. I don’t think anyone forced her to change. She always liked to perform, sing, and dance. That is natural for her. I think it is because she is natural that she is successful today.”

Pope Benedict XVI became pope in 2005, calling himself a simple, humble worker in God’s vineyard. On a cold, grey, and windy Monday in February, he resigned in the same humble way, like an old worker who can no longer ignore his back pain or trust his own strength. He was a traditional pope and gave his reason for leaving in Latin. He was the first German pope in modern times and gave the exact time he would leave. He told a group of cardinals in the Vatican that from 28 February 2013, at 8:00 p.m., the seat of Rome, the seat of Saint Peter, would be empty and a new pope would need to be chosen.

One of the people there was a Mexican cardinal, Monsignor Oscar Sánchez Barba, from Guadalajara. He was in Rome for an official meeting. He said, “We were all in the Sala del Concistoro of the Apostolic Palace. The pope took a piece of paper and read from it.” Everyone was left speechless. Sánchez Barba looked around St Peter’s Square, trying to find the right word. He was as surprised as the other church leaders who had just heard the man they believe is God’s representative on earth give up his job. The cardinals just looked at each other, Sánchez Barba said.

Angelo Sodano, the Dean of the College of Cardinals, who probably knew about the resignation before, gave a short speech. He said that he and the others listened to the pope with confusion and could hardly believe it. After his speech, the pope blessed the people there and left. “It was so simple; the simplest thing imaginable,” said Sánchez Barba. Then everyone left in silence. There was complete silence and sadness.

John Thavis, who reported on the Vatican for 30 years and has a book called The Vatican Diaries coming out soon, said he had a feeling the pope might resign and returned to Rome from the US because of this. Thavis remembered that in a long interview in 2010, Benedict said he thought it would be right to leave if he felt he could not do the job anymore. Thavis asked himself, “If I were pope and wanted to resign, when would I choose?” Benedict had finished his books and most of his projects. Also, there were no important events in his calendar that he had to attend. Thavis thought the most likely date was 22 February, but he was wrong.

A few hours after the announcement, Vatican officials said the pope’s decision was brave. Thavis agreed, saying, “What I find especially brave is that he is ready to leave now, when he is not sick, and that he is doing it because he is tired, not because he is very ill.” But is that the whole story? Does he know more about his health than the Vatican has told the public?

Benedict’s own reasons show that he thought about both his physical and mental health. He said that being pope needed both a strong mind and a strong body, and in the last few months, he felt his strength was slowly getting weaker. There will probably be other ideas in the coming days and weeks, just like there were after Pope John Paul I died in 1978, only 33 days after becoming pope. Already, some people are guessing that some information about Benedict’s past was about to come out. The Vatican will probably say these stories are not true. But these ideas are understandable, because what Benedict has done is very important.

After leaving St Peter’s Basilica, Julia Rochester from London, who said she was a lapsed Catholic, was still thinking about what the pope’s resignation meant. “If you’re God’s chosen one, how do you choose not to be chosen?” she asked. This is a question many Catholics will ask their priests in the coming weeks.

The roof of the school is made of plastic and the desks are just old chairs, but the students at Chemin des Dunes school are working hard and hoping for a better life in France.

Learning French is very difficult, but we try our best. If we come to class every day, maybe our dreams will come true, says Kamal, a refugee from Darfur in Sudan. He comes to class for three or four hours every day. He says it is good to keep your mind active.

Kamal is 29 years old and used to be an electrical engineer. He is one of many refugees living in the jungle camp outside Calais who have asked for asylum in France and want to learn French, the language of their possible new home.

Like many other students, Kamal is unhappy with how the media talks about the camp. He says the news only shows people who use the camp as a place to stay while they try to secretly get on trucks or trains to go to the UK.

I want people in the UK to know that not everyone wants to go there. Many people here want to stay in France, Kamal said.

According to the United Nations, France already has more than 250,000 refugees. This is more than twice as many as the UK, even though both countries have about the same number of people. There are also 56,000 people in France waiting to find out if they can stay, which is the second highest number in Europe. In the UK, there are 36,000 people waiting.

But while these people wait for a decision, France does not give them money or let them work. The process is slow and can take many months. The jungle camp gives them one free meal a day and a plastic roof to sleep under. Many people choose to live in these simple conditions for a few more months, instead of risking their chance to stay in France by working illegally.

The idea for the school came from some asylum seekers at the start of the summer. They were bored from waiting and worried about starting a new life in France without being able to speak the language. The school opened a few weeks later, on July 11.

We started the school so people can learn French, said Zimarco Jones, the Nigerian founder of the school. He arrived in Calais in 2013 and is still waiting to find out if he can stay. Now, we need to build another school, he says with a smile.

The small classroom can fit 30 students, squeezed into five rows of desks in front of a big green chalkboard and pictures of cartoon animals for each letter of the French alphabet. There are also classes in English, art, and tai chi, but the French lessons, taught by volunteers from Calais and other towns, are the most popular.

French is not as easy as English, but two weeks ago, I decided I could not go to the UK, says George, another refugee from Darfur and a student. He wanted to go to the UK because he speaks English well, but now, with language classes, he is happy to stay in France.

Anywhere there is peace, I can stay, no problem, he says. He waits at the classroom more than half an hour before his teachers arrive.

He says he does not know much about France, but the classes are slowly helping him understand the country and the language.

Many of the volunteers at the jungle school are local teachers who are giving up their summer holidays. Jenny Flahaut, 33, works at a children’s home and volunteered after seeing an ad on Facebook. I saw these people in Calais every day and I wanted to help them, she said.

She is upset about how the media and politicians talk about migrants, especially those who have never visited the camp, like David Cameron, the British prime minister, who called them “swarms” of people trying to reach the UK.

They do not know these people; they are not like that, Flahaut said as she got ready for her afternoon lesson. Most of them are very good people. They are welcoming and friendly. They want to improve their lives, and learning is part of that.

The teachers and Zimarco are now working to set up a separate classroom for about 200 women and 24 children. There are ten times more men than women in the Calais camp. Most women do not feel comfortable going to classes with men they do not know, the volunteers say.

Zimarco’s work starting the school is remembered in its unofficial name—everyone in the camp just calls it Zimarco’s school. He wants to start a football team for migrants and even dreams of changing the camp’s name. He does not like the name “jungle” because he says it makes people think the residents are not human.

We have a disco, a house, a mosque, a school, and shops, he says. We are not animals.

In the Arctic areas of Canada, the summer sun shines for more than 20 hours each day. For some people, this is a nice change from the long, dark winter. But for the small and growing Muslim community in Iqaluit, Nunavut, living in the land of the midnight sun is very hard during Ramadan. During Ramadan, Muslims usually fast from sunrise to sunset.

Abdul Karim, who is 29 years old, is one of the few people in the area who follows the Arctic sun for his Ramadan fast. He moved from Ottawa in 2011. This year, he eats his pre-dawn meal at about 1:30am before the sun rises and breaks his fast at about 11pm when the sun sets. He says he will only stop fasting if it hurts his health.

Ramadan is almost over for Muslims around the world. Fasting is important, but during this holy month, Muslims also focus on helping the community, praying, and thinking about their lives. In Iqaluit and other Muslim communities in the Arctic, the long days have changed how they fast.

Most Muslims in Iqaluit follow the fasting times of Ottawa, which is about 1,300 miles south. Muslim scholars say that Muslims in the far north should use the timetable of Mecca or the nearest Muslim city. This still means fasting for about 18 hours a day, says Atif Jilani, who moved to Iqaluit from Toronto. The days are long, but it is easier to manage.

Many of the 100 Muslims in Iqaluit break their fast together. They meet in the city’s new mosque for dinner each night. As they eat traditional foods like dates and goat or lamb curries, the sun is still shining through the windows.

This is also true in other northern mosques in Canada during Ramadan, as Muslims deal with the country’s special geography. In recent years, many people have chosen to follow the Ramadan timetable of Edmonton, Alberta. Some follow the times of Mecca. For example, Awan, a father of two, including a 12-year-old who just started fasting, uses the Mecca timetable. He wants to make fasting easier for his son, with about 15 hours of fasting instead of 18 hours in Edmonton. He jokes that if he fasted using Edmonton times, his son might say, “Papa, you are really insane. What are you doing?”

For the 100 Muslims in Inuvik, a small town 125 miles north of the Arctic Circle, it is impossible to follow the local sun. They also use Edmonton’s timetable. “We currently have 24 hours a day of sun,” said Ahmad Alkhalaf. “There’s no sunrise or sunset.”

When Alkhalaf moved from Toronto to Inuvik in 2001, the community was already using Edmonton’s schedule. His first Ramadan there was in December, when it is dark all day and night. So they used Edmonton time.

Sometimes, it is hard to follow the clock instead of the sun, Alkhalaf said. You are supposed to break your fast at dusk, but they eat when the sun is still up. “It’s not usual to have iftar [the meal that breaks the fast] when the sun is up,” he said.

In Inuvik, where most people are Inuit, the Muslim community tries to mix Ramadan with local culture and traditions. The iftar meal includes dates and curries, but also local meat like reindeer. “We make a soup or curry, but instead of using beef, we use reindeer.”

In Iqaluit, as the Muslim community gets ready to end Ramadan, some people think that Ramadan in 2016, which happened during the longest days of the year, has been one of the hardest in recent years. This is especially true for people like Karim, who follow the local sunrise and sunset. But Karim says his hard work will be rewarded in the future because of the lunar calendar. Ramadan will one day happen in winter, when the sun rises and sets within a few hours each day in Iqaluit. “I’ll follow those hours, too,” he said with a laugh. “Oh yes, definitely.”

Google has made maps of the world’s tallest mountains, the ocean floor, the Amazon rainforest, and even a little bit of North Korea. Google wants to make maps of the whole world, but they have not made many maps of the Arctic.

Now, Google is starting an important update to maps of the polar areas. They hope this new map will help people understand life on the permafrost. A small Google team went to Iqaluit, the biggest town in Nunavut, Canada. They brought warm winter clothes, many laptop computers, and a special camera that weighs 18 kilograms and can be put on a backpack. The team spent four days taking pictures and collecting information. This will help the people in Iqaluit have something that people in cities around the world already have.

An Inuit mapping expert helped the Google team, and local people watched them work. Iqaluit has 7,000 people. Pictures of the town will be shown on Google’s Street View in July 2013.

Usually, Google uses a special camera on top of a car to make maps. In Iqaluit, this was not possible, so the team walked on the snowy roads and paths. Some roads are made of ice and disappear in the short summer. The team also walked on part of a 15-kilometer road called the Road to Nowhere, even though there were warnings about polar bears. The online map Google already had was mostly correct, but one new road was missing.

Another problem was how to show businesses and homes on the map. In Iqaluit, mail goes to the post office, not to people’s homes. If Google used the post office addresses, the map would show all the businesses, banks, and schools in the same place, near the post office in the center of town.

About 30 Inuit elders, business people, and high school students helped Google fix this problem. They got a laptop and learned how to make sure their homes, shops, and meeting places were shown in the right place on the map.

This project is not just for fun. Arif Sayani, the town’s Director of Planning, said that people who want to visit or move to Iqaluit can use the maps to see the area. The maps may also help the town make plans faster.

The Google project leader said he hopes to make maps of other northern towns. But it is very expensive to move people and equipment in the Arctic. In the future, Google may send equipment to the area and ask local people to help finish the maps.

The US Senate Intelligence Committee has approved a bill to make the National Security Agency’s (NSA) collection of US phone records more open, but it will still allow the collection to continue. The bill was introduced by Chairwoman Dianne Feinstein. It lets the NSA keep collecting phone metadata from millions of Americans and allows the government to keep this data. The committee passed the bill with 11 votes in favor and 4 against. Now, the full Senate will vote on it.

The bill allows analysts to search the data if they have a reasonable suspicion that someone is linked to international terrorism. It also lets the NSA continue to watch foreigners who start being watched outside the US if they come into the country, for up to 72 hours.

This bill is different from another bill by Senator Patrick Leahy, which would stop the collection of phone records in the US. Mark Udall, a leading member of the Intelligence Committee, also opposed Feinstein’s bill. He said it does not do enough. Udall said the NSA’s surveillance of Americans’ private information does not respect the US Constitution and needs big changes.

Feinstein defended the NSA’s collection program but said it is important to rebuild public trust. She said the NSA’s program is legal and helps national security. However, she also said more should be done to make the program more open and to protect privacy.

Feinstein said the bill would also improve transparency and control over the NSA. For example, anyone who accesses data collected under the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) without permission could go to prison for up to ten years. The bill would also limit the number of contacts an analyst can get when asking for bulk communication records.

After the committee’s hearing, Feinstein strongly supported the NSA’s main program for collecting phone records in the US. She said there is a big misunderstanding about the NSA’s database program and how important it is for protecting the country.

Some independent legal experts are worried about the committee’s bill. Elizabeth Goitein from the Brennan Center for Justice said the Intelligence Committee bill and the USA Freedom Act show two different ideas about the relationship between Americans and the national security state. The main question is: should the government need a reason to suspect someone before collecting Americans’ private information? Leahy says yes; Feinstein says no.

Democratic committee member Ron Wyden said that recent worries about the NSA spying on foreign leaders have taken attention away from the main issue of mass surveillance in the US. He said that what intelligence officials have said about collecting data from foreign leaders matches what he has known for years. This affects foreign policy, but his main goal is to end mass digital surveillance of millions of law-abiding Americans.

Surprisingly, Feinstein said she was completely against the NSA spying on foreign leaders like German Chancellor Angela Merkel, even though she supports the NSA’s collection of Americans’ phone records.

Wyden said Americans are making it clear that they never agreed to give up their constitutional rights for the appearance of security. He said they will keep fighting this issue, and it will take a long time.

Feinstein’s strong support for collecting domestic phone records shows she is not ready to criticize the NSA more, even though she opposed its spying on foreign allied leaders, which is a more traditional intelligence activity than collecting bulk phone metadata.

Wyden said that years ago, countries had their own communication systems. Now, because of global communications, there will be more challenges with spying on foreigners, which can also affect US citizens.

The US Senate Intelligence Committee has agreed on a new law. This law lets the National Security Agency (NSA) keep collecting phone records from people in the US. The law also tries to make the NSA’s work more open to the public.

Dianne Feinstein, the leader of the committee, introduced the law. The law lets the NSA collect and keep information about phone calls from millions of Americans. Eleven people voted for the law, and four people voted against it. Now, the whole Senate will vote on the law.

The law says that NSA workers can look at the phone data if they think someone might be involved in international terrorism. The law also lets the NSA watch foreigners who come to the US for less than 72 hours.

Another senator, Patrick Leahy, introduced a different law called the USA Freedom Act. This law would stop the collection of phone records in the US. Feinstein supports the NSA’s phone data collection, but she said that people do not trust the NSA anymore. She said, “The NSA program is legal and I think it keeps us safe. But we should do more to make the NSA’s work open and to protect people’s privacy.”

Feinstein also said the new law would make the NSA more open and add more rules. For example, if someone looks at secret data without permission, they could go to prison for up to ten years.

Feinstein said she strongly supports the NSA’s main program in the US. She said, “Many people do not understand this NSA database program. It is very important and helps protect our country.” But some legal experts are worried about the new law.

Elizabeth Goitein from the Brennan Center for Justice said, “The Intelligence Committee’s law and the USA Freedom Act are very different. The big question is: Should the government need a reason before collecting Americans’ private information? Leahy says yes; Feinstein says no.”

Ron Wyden, another committee member, said that people are worried about the NSA spying on foreign leaders, but the bigger problem is the NSA collecting data from people in the US. He said, “My main goal is to stop the collection of data from millions of innocent Americans.”

Feinstein said she does not agree with the NSA spying on foreign leaders, like German Chancellor Angela Merkel. But she does agree with the NSA collecting Americans’ phone records.

Wyden said, “Americans are saying clearly that they never agreed to give up their freedom just to feel safer. We will keep fighting this. It will be a long fight.”

Noise from ships may bother animals like killer whales and dolphins much more than people thought before. New studies show that underwater noise can disturb how these animals talk to each other and find food. For a long time, people knew that the low sounds from ships could bother big whales. But now, US researchers have found that ships also make noise at medium and high frequencies, including at 20,000Hz, which is the frequency killer whales, or orcas, hear best.

These noises may make it hard for killer whales to talk to each other and use echolocation to find food. Dolphins and porpoises, which also hear high sounds, may have the same problem. The research suggests that this noise could hurt the endangered killer whales that live near the busy shipping lanes on the west coast of the USA.

Scott Veirs, the leader of the research, said that even a small increase in noise can make echolocation harder for whales. Echolocation is when whales use sound to bounce off objects, like fish, to find where they are. This is worrying because their main food, chinook salmon, is already rare. Hearing the small sound a salmon makes is one of the hardest things a killer whale does, and it is even harder if there is a lot of noise.

The researchers used underwater microphones to measure the noise from about 1,600 ships passing through Haro Strait in Washington State, USA. The study lasted two years and recorded sounds from 12 types of ships, including cruise ships, container ships, and military ships. About 20 ships passed through the strait each day.

Some ships are quieter than others, but the average noise next to all ships was 173 underwater decibels, which is like 111 decibels in the air—the same as a loud rock concert. Whales are not usually right next to ships, so they would hear noise between 60 and 90 decibels, which is about as loud as a lawnmower or vacuum cleaner.

Veirs said that scientists already knew underwater noise affects big whales, but this new research shows it is also a problem for smaller whales, dolphins, and porpoises. People used to think ships only made low sounds, like trucks or trains. Most of the noise is low, but the background noise in the ocean is also higher at high frequencies. This could be a big problem that needs more study.

There are other problems with noisy oceans. Whales may have to stay closer together to hear each other. If they cannot find food easily, they will use up their fat stores, called blubber. This is bad because blubber often has manmade chemicals that are poisonous to whales if released into their bodies.

Veirs said more research is needed to see how much noise is hurting whales and to make ships quieter. He said it should be easy to reduce noise pollution. Military ships are already much quieter, and maybe commercial ships can use the same technology. Another way to make less noise is to slow down. If ships go six knots slower, the noise could be cut in half.

Some whale species, like blue whales, are safer now because people hunt them less, but other whales are still in danger from many things. The US government has recently protected almost 40,000 square miles of the Atlantic Ocean to help save a whale species with only 500 left.

In Europe, killer whales have very high levels of banned chemicals in their blubber. Scientists are still trying to find out if these chemicals caused the deaths of five whales found on beaches in eastern Britain in January 2016. Around Australia, whales are more at risk from ship accidents, oil and gas drilling, and Japan’s recent decision to start hunting whales again in Antarctic waters.

All six numbers match, so it’s time to buy that Audi, book a holiday in the US, and call the estate agent. This is what most lottery millionaires do, according to a study about how jackpot winners spend and invest their money.

Since the UK national lottery began in 1994, it has made 3,000 people millionaires. Together, they have won more than £8.5 billion, with each winner getting an average of £2.8 million. These winners have also helped create 3,780 more millionaires among their children, family, and friends, according to Oxford Economics, the authors of the study.

Most winners (59%) stop working right away, but 19% keep working, and 31% do unpaid voluntary work. The good news for the UK economy is that 98% of the money winners spend stays in the UK. By spending on houses, cars, and holidays, each winner helps keep six people in full-time jobs for a year.

Winners have added almost £750 million to the UK’s gross domestic product (GDP) and have paid more than £500 million in taxes. Most of the money was spent on property, with £2.72 billion used to buy main homes and £170 million to pay off debts and mortgages.

Winners spent £2.125 billion on investments. They gave £1.17 billion as gifts to family and friends, and spent £680 million on cars and holidays.

The study looked at 100 winners who each won more than £1 million. It found that the 3,000 winners together have bought 7,958 houses or flats in the UK, which is about 2.7 homes each, spending £3.3 billion. Most winners (82%) moved to a new main home, spending an average of £900,000.

The new homes often have luxury features. Almost a third (29%) bought a hot tub, 28% wanted a walk-in wardrobe, 24% chose a home with electric gates, 22% had a games room, and 7% installed a snooker table.

Bigger homes need more care, so 30% of winners hired a cleaner and 24% hired a gardener. A small number (5%) hired a beautician.

For cars, 16% of winners chose Audis, while Range Rovers and BMWs were also popular (11% each), as well as Mercedes (10%) and Land Rovers (5%). Winners spent £463 million on 17,190 cars, with their favourite cars costing an average of £46,116.

Holidays were also important. Most winners (68%) stayed in five-star hotels abroad. The US was the top choice for 27% of winners, followed by the Caribbean (9%). In the UK, caravan sales also increased, with 10% of millionaires buying a caravan in the last 18 years, spending about £7.4 million.

Some winners (15%) started their own businesses, 9% helped others start businesses, and 6% invested in or bought other people’s businesses. Businesses started or supported by lottery winners employ 3,195 people, according to the study.

Andy Logan, the author of the report, said: The effect of a lottery win is bigger than we thought. It changes the lives of friends and family, and each win also helps the UK economy, especially because so much money is spent in the UK.

DNA from the wisdom tooth of a European hunter-gatherer has helped scientists learn about modern humans before farming began. This man from the Mesolithic period lived in Spain about 7,000 years ago. His DNA showed he had blue eyes, black or brown hair, and dark skin.

He probably could not digest milk (lactose intolerant) and had more trouble digesting starchy foods than later farmers, whose diets changed after farming started. When farming began, people and animals lived closer together, and humans likely developed stronger immune systems to fight new diseases from animals. However, scientists now think farming may not have changed the immune system as much as they thought. The hunter-gatherer’s DNA already had genes that help the immune system, and some of these genes are still found in Europeans today.

Carles Lalueza-Fox, who led the study at the Institute of Evolutionary Biology in Barcelona, said that most of his ideas about what they would find were wrong.

The research began after cave explorers found two skeletons in a deep cave in the Cantabrian Mountains in northwest Spain in 2006. The remains, from two men in their early 30s, were very well preserved because of the cool cave. Carbon dating showed the bones were about 7,000 years old, from before farming reached Europe from the Middle East. Other items found at the site included reindeer teeth that were used as decorations on clothing.

Scientists were able to get the complete genome of one man from DNA in his third molar. This was the first time researchers had the full genome of a European who lived before the Neolithic (farming) revolution.

The DNA results were surprising. Lalueza-Fox found that the man had genes for dark skin. He said, “This man had to be darker than any modern European, but we do not know exactly how dark.” Another surprise was that the man had blue eyes. The results suggest that blue eyes appeared in Europe before lighter skin, which developed during the Mesolithic period.

Because of these findings, artists may need to change how they draw ancient people. Lalueza-Fox said, “You often see pictures of these people with light skin, but you never see a Mesolithic hunter-gatherer with dark skin and blue eyes.”

The Spanish team compared the hunter-gatherer’s DNA to modern Europeans from different regions. They found that his DNA was most similar to people living in northern Europe, especially Sweden and Finland.

Martin Jones, a professor at Cambridge University, said the most interesting result was about the immunity genes. He explained that people used to think moving from hunting and gathering to farming was bad for health, mainly because people and animals lived closer together and shared water sources.

Chemists have been waiting a long time for a new element to be found. Now, researchers from Japan, Russia, and the US have discovered four new elements. These are the first new elements added to the periodic table since 2011, when elements 114 and 116 were included. The new elements are all very radioactive and complete the seventh row of the periodic table. Because of this, science textbooks around the world are now out of date.

The International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC), which is the main group that controls chemical names and measurements, confirmed the new elements on December 30, 2015. They checked studies going back to 2004. The scientists who discovered the elements now need to choose official names to replace the temporary Latin names: ununtrium, ununpentium, ununseptium, and ununoctium. These names are based on their atomic numbers: 113, 115, 117, and 118. The atomic number is the number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.

IUPAC said that a team of Russian and American scientists at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna and the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in California had enough proof to claim the discovery of elements 115, 117, and 118. For element 113, which was also claimed by the Russians and Americans, IUPAC gave credit to a team from the RIKEN Institute in Japan. This means Japan is the first Asian country to name an element. According to IUPAC rules, new elements can be named after mythological ideas, minerals, places or countries, or scientists.

When elements 114 and 116 got their official names in 2012, they were called flerovium and livermorium. These names come from the Flerov Laboratory in Dubna and the Lawrence Livermore Laboratory in the US, where the elements were discovered. Kosuke Morita, the leader of the RIKEN team, said his group now plans to search for element 119 and even higher numbers. Jan Reedijk from IUPAC said that chemists are excited to see the periodic table finally completed to the end of the seventh row.

The Japanese team is thinking about three possible names for ununtrium: japonium, rikenium, and nishinarium. Nishinarium is named after the Nishina Center for Accelerator-Based Science, where the element was found. Polly Arnold, a chemistry professor at Edinburgh University, said the team has been thinking about the names for a long time. She said this work is very careful and slow. It helps scientists understand radioactive decay better. If we understand it more, we might improve how we handle nuclear waste and other important things. This research also helps us make better technology for these experiments.

The scientists also need to suggest two-letter symbols for the new elements. After IUPAC gets the suggestions, there will be a five-month public review. This gives other scientists and people a chance to object if they have a problem with the names or symbols. For example, in 1996, the symbol Cp was suggested for copernicium (element 112), but it was changed to Cn because Cp was already used for another substance.

To find the new elements, researchers at the three labs crashed lighter atomic nuclei into each other and looked for radioactive decays that would show a new element was made. Ununtrium and ununpentium are probably metals. Ununseptium might be a metalloid. The fourth element, ununoctium, could be a gas, like helium, neon, and argon. It is hard to know for sure because only a few atoms of each element have ever been made.

Paul Karol, the head of the IUPAC panel that confirmed the new elements, said it will be a long time before we can find practical uses for these new elements.
