Scientists must choose new names and two-letter symbols for the elements. When IUPAC gets the suggestions, they will tell the public so people can give their opinions. This helps scientists and others find any problems with the names. In 1996, someone suggested the symbol Cp for copernicium (element 112), but it was changed to Cn because Cp was already used for another substance.

To find the new elements, scientists at the three labs crashed lighter atomic nuclei together and looked for the radioactive decays from the new elements. Elements 113 and 115 are probably metals. Element 117 might be a metalloid, which means it has some properties of metals. Element 118 may be a gas.

Paul Karol, the leader of the IUPAC group that checked the elements, said, “It will be a long time before we can find practical uses for the new elements.”

Prince Harry has left Afghanistan after a four-month tour. While he was there, he said he killed insurgents while flying his Apache helicopter. He talked about how it is difficult to be a royal who wants a normal life away from the public eye.

He also said he does not like or trust some parts of the media. He explained that his father often tells him to act more like a royal family member.

As a commander of the army’s most advanced attack helicopter, Prince Harry said he shot at the Taliban during missions to help ground troops and to rescue injured Afghan and NATO soldiers. He said he was just doing his job.

During interviews at Camp Bastion in Helmand Province, he spoke about how hard it is to balance his different roles. In the army, he is called Captain Wales. He said he has three sides: one in the army, one in his private life, and one with his family.

He admitted that sometimes he behaves badly, which he thinks is because he is more like a soldier than a prince. But he also said he deserves privacy.

In another interview, he criticized the media, especially the Sun, the Daily Mail, and the Daily Telegraph, which usually support the royal family. He was upset by articles that compared his job as an Apache co-pilot gunner to Spitfire pilots in World War II. He said, “No, it’s not like that at all.”

Prince Harry said he does not trust the media because of how they treated his family when he was a child. Still, he cannot stop reading stories about himself. He said, “Of course I read them. If there’s a story about me, I want to know what is being said. But it just makes me upset and angry that people can write these things and get away with it. Not just about me, but about everyone.” His father always tells him, “Don’t read it. It’s always rubbish.”

Four years ago, Prince Harry had to leave Afghanistan early during his first tour because an Australian magazine broke a media silence. This time, the Ministry of Defence told the public about his deployment, but asked newspapers and TV not to report on his daily life so he could do his job. The BBC, Sky, and ITN each sent two-person teams to report on his visit once.

When asked if he feels more comfortable as Captain Wales than as Prince Harry, he said yes. He explained that his father always reminds him who he is, but it is easy to forget when he is in the army because everyone wears the same uniform and does the same work. He said he gets along well with the other soldiers and enjoys his job.

Before going to Afghanistan, Prince Harry was photographed naked at a private party in Las Vegas. He said he let himself, his family, and others down, but also blamed the media. He said, “I was in a private area and should have expected some privacy.”

When asked why he and his brother like helicopters, he said it is probably because only a few people can fit in a helicopter, so no one, including the media, can follow them.

A new scientific study says that if global warming is not controlled, temperatures could rise more than many experts thought. The lead scientist said that if we do not reduce greenhouse gas emissions, the Earth will get at least 4°C hotter by the year 2100. This is twice as high as what world governments say is dangerous.

The study shows that as the planet gets warmer, fewer clouds form. This means less sunlight is reflected back into space, so the Earth gets even hotter. How clouds affect global warming has been the biggest question for scientists studying climate change.

Professor Steven Sherwood from the University of New South Wales in Australia led the study. He said the research is important for two reasons. First, it explains what causes changes in clouds. Second, it shows that the lowest predictions for future warming are probably wrong, and the higher, more dangerous predictions are more likely.

Sherwood said that a 4°C rise would be catastrophic, not just dangerous. For example, it would make it very hard or even impossible for people to live in many tropical areas. It would also cause the Greenland ice sheet and parts of the Antarctic ice sheet to melt, making sea levels rise by many meters.

Other scientists who read the study, which was published in the journal Nature, said it helps us understand better how much warming is caused by more carbon emissions. Experts from Japan’s National Institute for Environmental Studies said the explanation about clouds was convincing. They agreed that future climate change could be worse than we thought.

Scientists measure how sensitive the Earth’s climate is to greenhouse gases by guessing how much the temperature will rise if the amount of CO2 in the air doubles compared to before the industrial age. This could happen in the next 50 years. For 20 years, scientists thought the temperature could rise between 1.5°C and 5°C—a wide range. The new study says the real range is between 3°C and 5°C, because it looked closely at clouds, which are the biggest cause of uncertainty.

Scientists use computer models to predict future temperatures. It is important that these models show how clouds really form. When water evaporates from the ocean, the vapor can rise more than nine miles to make rain clouds that reflect sunlight, or it can rise just a few miles and fall back down without making clouds. Both things happen in real life. Models that include the second process predict much higher future temperatures than those that only include the nine-mile-high clouds.

Sherwood said that climate skeptics often say climate models are wrong, and he agrees they are not perfect. But he said the models that predict less warming are the ones making mistakes, not the ones that predict more warming. He also said that skeptics talk about the pause in temperature rise since the end of the 20th century, but there is more and more evidence that this pause is not seen in other parts of the climate system and is probably only temporary.

Since 1998, global average air temperatures have not risen quickly. The high temperature in 1998 was caused by El Niño, a natural ocean event. But measurements show that greenhouse gases are still trapping more heat, with over 90% of it going into the oceans. Also, a study in November 2013 said the pause in warming may not be real, but instead is because there are not enough temperature readings from the polar regions, where warming is happening fastest.

Sherwood agrees that his team’s work on clouds cannot completely rule out the chance that future warming will be lower. But for this to happen, there would have to be something very important missing from current knowledge, and there is no evidence for this. He added that a 4°C rise in global temperatures would have a very serious effect on the world and on many countries’ economies if emissions are not reduced.

There are many unusual ideas to help make our cities better places to live, like trees that glow in the dark, underground bike storage, and bins that use solar power. Living in a city has many good things, but it is not always easy to live in a way that is good for the environment. People in cities often have to deal with problems like pollution, traffic, and losing green spaces. Here are ten unusual ideas to make cities nicer places to live.

Pop-up parks
Today, cities often seem to be made more for cars than for people. A pop-up park is a simple idea. You take an empty parking space, a little money, and a few plants, and you make your own small park. The PARK(ing) project started as an art experiment in San Francisco. Now, it has spread to many places around the world. Some ideas from the project include temporary city farms and ecology demonstrations. Every September, the project has a special day of action.

Subterranean storage
Not everyone in the city owns a car. More and more people are using bikes. But where can you keep your bike safe? A company in Tokyo called Giken has an answer: an underground bike park. This round storage space is only seven meters wide, but it goes deep underground and can hold 204 bikes. You can get your bike back by pressing a button, and the automatic system brings it up in about 13 seconds.

Glow-in-the-dark trees
Most people think of Christmas trees when they hear about trees that glow in the dark. But Dutch designer Daan Roosegaarde has made a special glowing plant. This new technology mixes DNA from glowing sea bacteria with the DNA of a plant, so the plant glows like a jellyfish. Roosegaarde hopes that one day, this technology can be used instead of normal street lights.

Footfall harvesting
Every day, hundreds of people walk on a raised walkway near the West Ham underground station in east London. Most people do not notice that the floor feels a bit springy. Even fewer know that this springy floor helps power the streetlights above. The floor has smart tiles that collect energy from people’s footsteps and turn it into electricity. The UK company Pavegen made this idea and has put similar systems in London’s Heathrow Airport and other places around the world.

Supertrees
Now there are even man-made trees. In Singapore’s Gardens by the Bay, there are special trees called supertrees. These metal trees can be up to 50 meters tall. Flowers grow on them, and their metal tops take in and spread heat. They also collect rainwater and help bring fresh air to two big greenhouses below. Eleven of the 18 supertrees also have solar panels on their branches.

Most people do not know that the path uses the energy from people’s footsteps to make electricity for the streetlights above. There is a similar system at Heathrow Airport in London.

We do not have flying cars yet, like in the 1985 movie Back to the Future II, but smartphones and new technologies are making transportation more exciting and advanced. Experts say that changes in the economy, population, technology, and the environment are all changing how we travel. Robert Puentes, a transport expert, says that transportation is now more closely linked to the economic health of cities and affects people’s lives.

As old transport systems wear out, cities in the US must rethink what transportation means. Urban planners, transport experts, and scientists now see that just trying to reduce traffic is not enough to solve problems like more people living in cities and pollution. Transportation is now important for protecting the environment.

Big cities like Los Angeles and Chicago are improving their streets by adding more bus lanes and walkways for people, and by expanding train networks. They are also working on new technologies, like cars that can drive themselves and talk to other cars and the environment. Puentes says the best places to live are those with many types of transport.

Here are three main ideas that experts think will shape transportation in the future:

Connectivity: Ride-sharing services like Uber, which you can book with your phone, and apps like Waze, which shows the fastest routes using real-time traffic data, are changing how people travel and how traffic moves in cities. Communication between riders and drivers, between vehicles, and between cars and the roads is starting a new era in transportation, says Allan Clelland, a transport technology expert.

A recent study shows that people born in the 1990s drive less than older generations. They make 4% fewer car trips and travel 18% fewer miles each year than people of the same age did in the past.

People who still drive are facing less traffic because of Waze. Experts say Waze has reduced traffic jams on highways and made trips faster. However, it has also caused more cars to drive through quiet neighborhoods, which can be a problem.

This trend may continue as cars and roads start to share more information. Right now, a traffic light only knows when a car is near. Companies are working on technology so cars can tell traffic systems where they are going and how fast they are moving.

Automation: Driverless cars have been in the news since Google started testing them in 2012, but no one knows when they will be common. However, some automation is already happening. Automation will likely come in steps: first, we might see automated buses with their own lanes, then trucks in ports or mining towns that travel in a line and are connected electronically.

A fully automated transport system is interesting because it could make travel safer by removing human mistakes. It could also lower pollution and traffic jams, and help more people use cars. But even if driverless cars were ready now, it would take a long time for everyone to use them because the average car on the road is 11.5 years old.

Environmental concern: As the world tries to stop dangerous climate change and countries set big goals to reduce pollution, these rules will also change transportation. Worry about the environment could lead to more zero- and low-emission vehicles and apps that help people walk, bike, or share rides more often.

When thinking about the future of transportation, it is important to remember why people travel: to go to work, meet friends or family, or go shopping. Technologies that help people avoid these trips, like virtual meetings or working from home, could also change transportation a lot.

In the past, flying cars were seen as the best new idea, but the technologies being developed now may be even more advanced and helpful for solving social and environmental problems in the future.

The world is trying to slow down climate change, and cities want to lower emissions. This could change transportation a lot and lead to cars that make little or no pollution, and apps that help people walk, bike, or share rides more.

Every morning, before it gets hot in India’s capital, a small group of old friends meet. They gather on the dry grass near the India Gate monument in the center of Delhi to stretch, breathe, and meditate.

“This is the best way to start the day. It’s healthier than eating an egg, a sandwich, or drinking tea,” said Arvind Singh at 6:15 am while doing breathing exercises on a bench.

Singh, who is 42 years old and works as a salesman, is not alone. All over India, in crowded cities, people use any green space they can find to do the same thing.

On June 21, which is now the International Day of Yoga, India’s prime minister, Narendra Modi, hopes people around the world will join in. Near India Gate, up to 45,000 people will join a 35-minute yoga class. They hope it will be the biggest yoga session ever.

People taking part will include 64-year-old Modi, most of his government, and, they hope, some famous people.

Modi wants to encourage Indians and people in other countries to do yoga. He led his Bharatiya Janata Party to a big election win in 2014. In May 2015, schools were told to make sure students joined yoga events at the same time as the big event in Delhi, even though it is on a Sunday.

Indian police officers are known for not being very fit. So, the government wants to make yoga classes compulsory for them. The government also said that three million civil servants and their families will get free daily yoga lessons. Air India, the national airline, said it will start yoga classes for new pilots.

Modi, who lives simply, is a vegetarian and loves yoga. He suggested an international yoga day when he spoke at the United Nations in New York in 2014.

Modi said yoga is a valuable gift from India’s ancient tradition. He said yoga helps unite the mind and body, thoughts and actions, and brings harmony between people and nature. He said yoga is not just exercise, but a way to feel connected with yourself, the world, and nature.

Yoga is between 3,000 and 6,000 years old. It started somewhere in the Indian subcontinent, maybe among religious people who lived simply. Yoga’s meditation and physical exercises have long been part of local religions like Buddhism, Jainism, and Hinduism. Hinduism is followed by 80% of Indians.

Some people have criticized Modi for showing Indian culture in a way that does not include other traditions. One person called the June 21 event a mix of cultural pride and business.

However, others mention a recent US court decision that said yoga is not always religious. A court in California said that yoga classes in the San Diego district are not religious, mystical, or spiritual. This decision came after two Christian parents said they thought yoga in schools was a Hindu practice.

Amish Tripathi, a writer of popular books set 4,000 years ago in India, said the characters in his stories do yoga.

“In ancient India, yoga was part of daily life, both for the body and the mind. Every culture has given something to the world, and this is our gift,” Tripathi said.

Suneel Singh, a yoga teacher in south Delhi, also said yoga does not belong to one religion. “Is tai chi only Chinese? Is football only English? It is the same with yoga—yoga is for everyone. It is a cheap way to stay healthy.”

According to Harvey Goldsmith, a top British music promoter and manager, the time of big summer music festivals in Britain, like Glastonbury, is ending. Goldsmith has worked with many of the world’s biggest music stars, such as The Who, The Rolling Stones, Queen, Madonna, Bob Dylan, and Luciano Pavarotti. He says the main problem is that there are not enough new big bands to replace the old famous ones.

Goldsmith said that the best time for festivals was about two years ago. He spoke about this at the Hay Festival of Literature and Arts in Wales. He explained that there are too many festivals now, but not enough big music acts to perform at them. This is a big problem for the music industry. He also said that we are not creating a new generation of big bands like The Rolling Stones, Muse, or even the Arctic Monkeys, who can be the main act at festivals.

In 2014, there were about 900 music festivals in the UK between May and September. Goldsmith said it is impossible for all of them to continue. He thinks there will be more events that mix music with other things, like poetry, books, or magic shows. There will be many small festivals that offer something extra, not just people standing in a big field, afraid to go to the toilet because they might miss the band.

Goldsmith also said that the way people listen to music has changed. People do not want to listen to a whole album anymore. Most rock bands became famous because of their albums, and it often took them three albums to become really good. But young people today do not want that.

Goldsmith, who is 69 years old, also said he is working with Robin de Levita, a Dutch producer, on a new 1,100-seat theatre in Wembley, London. In June 2016, this theatre will show the first stage version of The Hunger Games, a popular teen book and movie series.

At the Hay Festival, Goldsmith shared some stories from his long career. He said that Keith Moon once put dynamite in a hotel toilet in Sydney to unblock it. He also said that John Lennon had stage fright before a show at Madison Square Garden in 1974. Lennon was so nervous that he was vomiting, but he was pushed onto the stage anyway. Goldsmith said it is strange how many artists are afraid before going on stage, but once the music starts, they are fine.

Goldsmith also solved a mystery about Elvis Presley. He explained why Elvis never performed outside North America. Elvis’s manager, Colonel Tom Parker, told Goldsmith that the real reason was that Parker was an illegal Dutch immigrant. He did not want to leave the US because he was afraid he would not be allowed back in. So, it was Parker’s problem, not Elvis’s.

Goldsmith said that Freddie Mercury was the best live performer he had ever seen. At Live Aid, Mercury took control of the audience and gave a great show. But Goldsmith said that no one has found the next Queen yet. He thinks Coldplay is probably the last big band, and that was ten years ago.

So, because there are no new big acts to headline, there are no big shows. Glastonbury cannot find enough big acts anymore, and that is the top festival. Goldsmith believes the time of big festivals is really over.

Elvis’s manager, Colonel Tom Parker, told Goldsmith that the real reason was because Parker was an illegal Dutch immigrant. He did not want to leave the US because he was afraid he could not return.

Goldsmith said his best rock performer was Freddie Mercury. “Freddie Mercury was the best live performer we ever had.” But he said there is no new group like Queen. “We are not making a new generation of bands like this. Coldplay is probably the last one, and that was ten years ago.”

He finished by saying, “So, with no big bands to headline, there are no big shows. Glastonbury cannot find any more big bands. The time of big music festivals is really ending.”

When two people from the Marshall Islands saw a small fibreglass boat on the beach of a faraway Pacific island, they went to look at it. Inside the boat, they found a very thin man with long hair and a beard. He said he had been drifting on the sea for 16 months after leaving Mexico, which is more than 12,500 km away.

The man was only wearing underpants. He told the people who found him that he had been in the 7.3-metre fibreglass boat since he left Mexico for El Salvador in September 2012. The boat’s engines did not have propellers. He also said that another person had been with him, but that person died at sea several months earlier.

His health is not good, but he is getting better, said Ola Fjeldstad, a Norwegian student studying on Ebon Island, one of the Marshall Islands. The man said his name was José Ivan. He survived by catching turtles and birds with his hands. There was no fishing equipment on the boat, but there was a turtle inside when the boat arrived. The boat looked like it had been in the water for a long time, Fjeldstad told reporters.

Fjeldstad said the islanders took the man to a nearby island. This island is so far away that it has only one phone line and no internet. There, he met the mayor, Ione de Brum. The mayor called the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Majuro, the capital of the Marshall Islands. Officials said they were waiting for more information and expected the man to be brought to the capital.

Officials are thinking about sending a boat to pick up the man. He is staying at the local council house, and a family is giving him food, said Fjeldstad. The man had a basic health check. He has low blood pressure, but he does not have any life-threatening problems and he can walk. We have been giving him a lot of water and he is getting stronger.

Fraser Christian, who teaches people how to survive at sea, said the man’s story, if true, would be amazing but not impossible. He said it is possible to catch turtles or small fish by hand because they are curious and come close to boats. Christian said that if you have to eat turtles, you should start with their eyes because they have a lot of liquid, then eat the blood.

The biggest dangers for people lost at sea are sun exposure and not having enough water. The main rule is: no water, no food. You need water to digest protein. If you do not have fresh water and it does not rain for a few days, you cannot survive. Some people’s bodies can survive longer than others.

Stories about people surviving in the big Pacific Ocean are not rare. In 2006, three Mexicans were found drifting in a small fibreglass boat near the Marshall Islands. They said they survived for nine months at sea by drinking rainwater and eating raw fish and seabirds. But Cliff Downing, who teaches sea survival, said he does not believe the latest story. He said there are many dangers at sea, so it is very unlikely someone could survive for so long.

Other stories about people lost at sea:
- Poon Lim, a Chinese sailor from a British ship, survived 133 days on a wooden boat in the South Atlantic in 1942. Brazilian fishermen saved him.

SeaWorld has lost 84% of its profits because many customers have stopped visiting. People left the famous aquatic theme park after claims that it treated orca whales badly.

SeaWorld trains dolphins and killer whales to do tricks for large crowds. Fewer people are coming to the parks, and sales and profits have dropped because people believe the animals are not treated well.

SeaWorld has been in the news since the 2013 documentary "Blackfish" said that the way it treated orca whales made the whales act violently, which led to the deaths of three people. After the documentary, fewer people visited, and the company lost more than half of its value on the stock market. The old CEO also had to leave.

Animal rights activists say that orcas in tanks die younger than wild orcas. SeaWorld started a marketing campaign to say this is not true.

SeaWorld lowered ticket prices and spent $10 million on marketing, but CEO Joel Manby said the company is still having trouble convincing people that it treats its whales well.

Manby said, "We know we have a lot of work to do." He also said that early feedback on their campaign was good, but fixing their image in California will be hard. He added, "We will keep fighting with the facts because the facts are on our side."

Manby became CEO in 2015 to help the company recover. He said he would share his plans for the future at a special event on November 6.

SeaWorld already has plans for a new shark exhibition in Orlando and a new attraction in San Antonio where people can swim with dolphins in a more natural setting.

The company’s financial report, released on August 6, showed that profits in the second quarter fell from $37.4 million in 2014 to $5.8 million in 2015, an 84% drop. Revenue went down from $405 million to $392 million. Attendance dropped by more than 100,000, from 6.58 million to 6.48 million.

Experts will watch SeaWorld’s sales and attendance in the third quarter, which is usually the company’s best time because of the summer holidays. Attendance might drop more because of a new scandal in July 2015, when it was said that a SeaWorld worker joined animal rights protest groups against the company.

Jared Goodman, a lawyer for People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA), said: "SeaWorld has a spying scandal, animals are dying in its tanks, and many people are against its plan to build a new orca tank. Families do not want to buy tickets to see orcas going crazy in small tanks. SeaWorld’s orcas and profits will not recover until it empties its tanks and builds sanctuaries by the sea."

SeaWorld’s shares, which were worth $39 in 2013, fell to just under $18 in August 2015.

It was a beautiful summer evening when I decided to go swimming near Doolin Pier in County Clare, Ireland, where I had moved in 2012. In the water, there was a woman with Dusty, a dolphin who often swims with a group of people she knows well. Dusty came to Doolin around 2008, and since then, hundreds of people have swum with her. Because of this, many people think she is completely tame.

That evening, the woman was tickling Dusty’s stomach, and it looked very nice. About 20 tourists and local people were on the pier, watching this lovely scene. After I got into the water, Dusty left the woman and suddenly became very aggressive. Later, I learned that Dusty is very protective when she is with someone. Her tail was moving wildly. At first, I thought she was just showing off, but then I realized she was angry. I knew I had to get out of the water, so I swam towards the pier. But in just a few seconds, Dusty hit me hard with her nose. It was very strong and painful, and she was very fast. I was pushed forward violently.

Everyone on the pier was looking at me with their mouths open. Dusty was still next to me in the water, her tail moving crazily. That was the scariest part. I thought if she hit me with her tail, I could go under the water and drown.

I reached the pier, but I could not get out because I was hurt. I was very scared. I shouted for help, and a man reached down and pulled me onto the steps. Then another man came and said he was an orthopaedic surgeon. He had been driving into Doolin when he saw what was happening. I was very cold and worried because I did not know how badly I was hurt. My biggest fear was that I was bleeding inside. The doctor checked me and said he could not feel any signs of bleeding, but I probably had broken bones. Later, I found out I had six broken bones in my spine, three broken ribs, and a damaged lung.

I stayed in the hospital for five days and could not work for five months because I was in pain and could not move well. Later, I was told I had post-traumatic stress. After almost dying, I became anxious about everything. I felt people were looking at me strangely, I had trouble with loud noises, and I started to forget things. Three months before the accident, I had opened a health-food shop, but I had to close it because I could not work anymore.

It was the hardest year of my life, but now it is over. I had therapy, osteopathy, and massage, and now I am starting my own osteopathy business. I understand my patients better now because I have been a patient myself.

I am thankful that I am healthy, and I want to stop other people from getting hurt. People think dolphins are always friendly and safe—who would think a dolphin could attack a person? If you see a dangerous animal coming at you with its teeth showing, you get scared, but dolphins always look like they are smiling.

I am not angry at Dusty. I respect her. I was in her space, and she is a wild, unpredictable animal. People need to know this. Many people come here to swim with her, but they do not understand how dangerous it can be. Several other people were hurt that summer.

After the man pulled me out of the water, Dusty swam away, but then she came back and looked at me. Our eyes met, and I felt she was sorry. She was a completely different dolphin; she was not angry anymore. The people on the pier were amazed. When I had that moment with her, my fear ended. I made peace with her.

We often see our colleagues and friends using e-cigarettes. But is vaping becoming less popular? Statistics show that vaping among smokers and recent ex-smokers, who make up most vapers, may already be going down. Major e-cigarette companies, who have spent millions of pounds on this technology, will study these numbers closely because they thought vaping was becoming more popular.

In 2014, the health charity Action on Smoking and Health (ASH) said that the number of adults in Britain using e-cigarettes, which do not have tobacco and make vapour instead of smoke, had tripled from 700,000 in 2012 to 2.1 million in 2014.

However, the Smoking Toolkit Study, a research group that gives updates on smoking trends every three months, shows that vaping may be less popular now. Vaping rates among smokers and ex-smokers went up until the end of 2013, when 22% of smokers and ex-smokers were vaping. But in 2014, this number stopped rising and then fell to 19% in the last three months of the year. Professor Robert West, who collects the numbers for the Toolkit, said this drop is important.

Smokers are the main group for e-cigarette companies because seven out of ten vapers are smokers. Only about 1% of people who have never smoked have tried an e-cigarette. The number of people who use e-cigarettes while still smoking is going down, West said. We have only been studying vaping for just over a year, so it is a short time, but we do not see more long-term ex-smokers or people who never smoked using e-cigarettes. Vaping rates might change, but right now, they seem to be staying the same.

The fact that vaping has stopped growing in the UK is different from what is happening in the US, where e-cigarettes are advertised a lot and reports say they are becoming more popular. However, West questioned the US data, which did not clearly show the difference between people who only tried an e-cigarette once and those who use them regularly.

Experts think it is not likely that vaping will become popular among young people who do not smoke. The ASH study found that only 1.8% of children use e-cigarettes regularly. Instead, e-cigarettes are most popular with adults who want to quit smoking. James Dunworth from ecigarettedirect.co.uk said that while the numbers from Smoking In England show that e-cigarette use by smokers has stopped rising, the data also shows a big increase in use since May 2011. He said their customers are still happy with the product, and new technology is making e-cigarettes better and helping people switch from normal cigarettes.

West agreed that e-cigarettes work like nicotine patches. They are more popular than nicotine patches and may or may not work better. One-third of people who try to quit smoking use e-cigarettes, making them the most popular way to stop smoking.

Hazel Cheeseman, policy director at ASH, said it is too early to say if vaping has reached its highest point. Even though the market has not grown in the UK for about a year, there does not seem to be a drop in the number of people using e-cigarettes to help them quit smoking.

The European Commission (EC) is thinking about raising taxes on e-cigarettes, which could make them less popular. A new EC tobacco law will start in 2016 and will limit the amount of nicotine in e-cigarettes to less than it is now. This could mean that vapers will have to use more e-cigarettes to get the same effect, which could make them more expensive.

West said that lawmakers should see e-cigarettes as a way to help people stop smoking and not treat them the same as cigarettes. He said some local authorities and organizations treat e-cigarettes like cigarettes and ban them in public places and outside. He said this makes it seem like people are attacking vapers and this hurts the public health messages they are trying to share. He said we must be careful not to make e-cigarettes look bad.

Scarlett Johansson is suing a French writer for 50,000. She says his fiction book makes false claims about her personal life.

The book, "La première chose qu’on regarde" (The First Thing We Look At) by Grégoire Delacourt, is about a French model who looks so much like the American actress that the main male character thinks she is Johansson. In the story, men only see the model as a sex object, and women are jealous of her. The model has many adventures as Johansson and, in the end, dies in a car accident.

Johansson is not happy about the popular book. Her lawyer, Vincent Toledano, told the newspaper Le Figaro that Delacourt’s novel used Johansson’s name, reputation, and image without permission. He said the book makes damaging statements about her private life. The lawyer has gone to court to try to stop the book from being translated or made into a movie.

Delacourt explained that he used Johansson’s name because she is seen as a symbol of beauty today. He said, “I wrote a fiction story. My character is not Scarlett Johansson.”

On French radio, Delacourt said the lawsuit was sad. He said, “It scares me to think that judges can get involved when you write about a character in a novel.”

Delacourt is a very popular author in France. His last book, "My List of Desires," was translated into 47 languages and is being made into a film. He said he was shocked when he learned Johansson was suing him.

“I thought she would contact me to have coffee together. I didn’t write a book about a celebrity,” he said. “I wrote a real love story about female beauty, especially inner beauty.”

He added, “If writers can’t mention things around us—a beer brand, a monument, an actor—it will be hard to write fiction. I’m not sure she has even read the book because it hasn’t been translated yet.”

Emmanuelle Allibert, a spokeswoman for the publisher JC Lattès, said the lawsuit was crazy. “We have never seen anything like this. It is even more surprising because the book is not about Scarlett Johansson. It is about a woman who looks like her.”

Ironically, the author’s legal problem would be easier if he had published the book in Johansson’s home country, the United States, instead of France. Lloyd Jassin, a lawyer from New York, said the case would probably not go to court in the US because the book would be protected by the First Amendment.

He said that if there is a good reason to use her name in the book, the First Amendment would protect the author’s right to do so. But in France, the law is more complicated and people’s rights to their own image are taken more seriously.

Delacourt said, “I thought she might send me flowers because the book was a declaration of love for her, but she didn’t understand.”

Hundreds of young people in Cuba are using the first free, open internet service on the island. This is possible because of one of Cuba’s most famous artists. A small cultural center in Havana, the capital, now offers free wi-fi. The Cuban artist Kcho is giving this service. Surprisingly, the state-owned phone company, Etecsa, has approved it.

People say the internet is very slow, especially when many people are there. But in Cuba, only about 5% of people have full access to the internet, so a place that is free and without restrictions is very welcome.

Now, people can visit international news websites, talk to friends and family in other countries, and use Facebook and Twitter. This has made many people excited. “I come as often as I can,” said Adonis Ortiz, 20, while video-chatting with his father in the US, whom he has not seen in nine years.

As relations between the US and Cuba get better, big American tech companies like Google and Apple are expected to come to Cuba when they are allowed. For now, Cuba has a high-speed fiber-optic cable under the sea from Venezuela, and internet users can use some Chinese equipment.

Another estimate says that a quarter of Cubans have internet access, but this is still one of the lowest rates in the Western Hemisphere. This number includes people who only use a limited Cuban intranet, which has only some websites and limited email.

Kcho has opened his own internet connection to the public. But he is not against the government or a supporter of free markets. Kcho was probably chosen by the government to show a friendly face as they accept that the internet is important.

Kcho, who is close to the Cuban government, said the Ministry of Culture approved his actions. He said he wants Cubans to get used to the internet. “It’s only possible if you are determined and pay the costs,” Kcho told the Associated Press. “It is expensive, but the benefit is huge. I have something great and powerful. I can share it, and I am doing so.”

Kcho’s real name is Alexis Leiva Machado. He became famous for his paintings, sculptures, and drawings after winning a big art prize in South Korea. He is now preparing for the Havana art event in May. He was born on one of Cuba’s islands and is known for modern art with simple, seaside, and patriotic themes.

In the center’s courtyard, young people who know about technology spend the day there or sit outside when it is crowded, using laptops, tablets, or smartphones.

Cuba has some of the lowest internet access in the world. Dial-up accounts are very limited, and home broadband is almost impossible to get, except for foreigners. Foreigners pay hundreds of dollars a month for internet, while the average Cuban salary is only $17 to $20 a month. Kcho is believed to pay $900 a month to provide the free wi-fi.

Since 2013, the Cuban government has opened hundreds of internet centers, where one hour online costs $4.50, and the speed is much slower than at Kcho’s studio, which is about 2mbps. In 2014, the average internet speed was 10.5mbps in the US and 23.6mbps in South Korea, the fastest in the world. The world average was about 3.9mbps.

When many people use Kcho’s wi-fi at the same time, the signal gets weaker. One user said he sometimes comes in the middle of the night, when no one else is there, and then the internet is very fast.

Hundreds of young people in Cuba are using free, open internet on the island. A small cultural center in Havana, the capital city, now gives free wi-fi. A famous Cuban artist named Kcho is giving this service. The government company Etecsa is also allowing it.

The internet is slow, especially when many people are there. But in Cuba, only about 5% of people can use the open internet, so free and open internet is very special.

People are happy because they can visit news websites, talk to family and friends in other countries, and use Facebook and Twitter. Adonis Ortiz, who is 20 years old, comes often. He talks to his father in the US by video. He has not seen his father for nine years.

The US and Cuba are starting to have better relations. Big American companies like Google and Apple may come to Cuba soon. Cuba now has a fast internet cable under the sea from Venezuela, and people can use some Chinese equipment.

Some people say that 25% of Cubans can use the internet, but this is usually a special Cuban network with only some websites and limited email.

Kcho, who is close to the Cuban government, says the Ministry of Culture allows his internet service. He wants Cubans to learn about the internet. Kcho says, “It is only possible if you really want it and pay for it. It is expensive, but it is very good. I have something great, and I am sharing it.”

Kcho’s real name is Alexis Leiva Machado. He is famous for his art. He won a big prize in South Korea. He was born on a Cuban island and makes modern art about the sea and Cuba.

At the center, young people who know about technology relax or wait outside when it is busy. They use laptops, tablets, or smartphones.

Cuba has very low internet use. Home internet is very rare and expensive. Only foreigners can pay for it, and it costs hundreds of dollars each month. In Cuba, most people earn only $17 to $20 a month. Kcho pays $900 each month for the free wi-fi.

Since 2013, the government has opened many internet centers. One hour costs $4.50. The internet is much slower there than at Kcho’s center. At Kcho’s place, the speed is about two megabytes per second (mbps). In the US, the average speed is 10.5mbps. South Korea has the fastest internet in the world at 23.6mbps. The world average is about 3.9mbps.

Himalayan lakes, spacewalks, and the US presidential campaign helped Scott Kelly stay mentally healthy during his 340 days in space, the astronaut told reporters after returning to Earth from his record-breaking mission. "It seemed like I lived there forever," Kelly said. He had been on other missions before, but this one felt much longer to him. "Maybe, sometimes, you do go crazy," he joked.

Kelly and his Russian colleague, Mikhail Kornienko, spent almost a year on the International Space Station (ISS) to study how weightlessness, radiation, and living in a small space affect humans. NASA thinks this research is very important for future missions to Mars.

Kelly said the hardest part of the mission was how long it lasted. He felt much more pain in his body when he returned to gravity than after shorter trips. Kelly and his twin brother, Mark, who is a retired astronaut, have spent the last year doing physical and mental tests. These tests will continue to help NASA learn how the human body deals with the tough conditions of space.

Kelly said that feeling uncomfortable after returning to gravity did not take away the amazing feeling he had when he landed back on Earth. When the Russian capsule opened in the cool air of Kazakhstan, Kelly said he smelled something like a plant blooming. It was the fresh air mixed with the sweet, burnt smell of the spacecraft after it came through the atmosphere.

As he left the spacecraft, Kelly started to realize how important the mission was: 340 days on a 15-year-old space station that weighs a million pounds and is as big as a football field, with as much space inside as a six-bedroom house. The ISS, he said, uses solar power and was built by an international team.

"There are things we will discover about our time in space on the space station that we don't even know now," Kelly said. He compared the research from more than 450 missions there to the work done by NASA computer scientists in the 1960s and 1970s. He also said, "The view is great, too."

Kelly enjoyed the view and posted amazing photos on social media of Earth's cities, landscapes, oceans, and atmosphere. "The Earth is a beautiful planet," he said, talking about the clear waters around the Bahamas and the rainbow colors of the lakes in the northern Himalayas. He said he would like to visit that area, but first he would need to find out which country owns the lakes. But mostly, he noticed how thin the atmosphere is. "That, together with these large areas of pollution, is kind of alarming," Kelly added.

The astronaut said he could see whole systems of pollution: smoke from wildfires covering parts of the US, and areas in Asia with pollution that is visible almost all year. He said the message "we need to save the planet" is not completely correct: The planet will recover; it is us who will not survive if we destroy the environment. Spending so much time looking down at Earth made him care more about the environment, especially because the atmosphere is so thin.

"It is up to us to take care of the air we breathe and the water we drink. I believe we can change things if we decide to," Kelly said. He was very active on social media, which made many people follow him online, but he said he did not really notice it. Instead, he watched the 2016 US presidential election.

Besides watching the news, Kelly said that having regular work helped him stay sane: "I tried to have small goals, like when the next crew would arrive, the next spacewalk, the next science experiment. That helped me—it kept me sane." Being back on Earth with everyone else did not feel real yet, he said. He remembered how surprised he was to see a crowd of people after a past mission. "I'll soon start feeling that kind of culture shock," he said.

Kelly said he probably would not fly again with NASA. But he added, "I don't think I would ever say I'm absolutely, 100% finished," because private space companies like SpaceX are doing well. "They might need a guy like me someday," he said. "Maybe, in the next 20 years, you'll be able to buy a cheap ticket and just go for a little visit."

Junior Smart knows a lot about gangs. He is now 36 years old, and his life has two parts. When he was a teenager, his mother died, and he joined a gang in south London. At that time, the gang gave him support that he needed.

“They became my new support group,” he says. At first, it was just for fun, but later it became more serious and focused on making money. The gang started doing crimes. That was how things were. After college, Junior got a full-time job in administration and also worked as a DJ. But at the same time, he was making money illegally with the gang.

Finally, he was arrested for serious drug crimes and sent to prison for 12 years. “The first night after I was arrested was the biggest wake-up call of my life,” he says. “I had been living a double life. I was one person with my friends and another person with my enemies. I spent a long time trying to fix myself.”

Now, Junior Smart leads a team of 12 full-time workers and six volunteers. Their goal is to help young criminals and gang members leave crime behind. Most of the team are ex-criminals like Junior. Some are still in prison but can leave during the day to help. They work with the police, the probation service, and other organizations to help people who feel trapped and scared in London’s violent gangs.

Junior’s journey from gang member to mentor started in prison. “I was touched by the people who kept coming back to prison,” he says. “I couldn’t believe nothing was done to help them. I talked to prisoners, and they knew what changes they needed, but the prison system only looks at the main crime.”

He tells a story about one man who spent £300 a week on cocaine, paid for by burglary. The man would even break into houses when people were home. But his drug problem was never solved. Junior was shocked that prison was like a “revolving door,” with people coming back again and again.

Junior started working as a prison listener, which means he helped new prisoners during their first days. Then he had an idea to start his own project after leaving prison—using ex-offenders’ experience to help others avoid returning to prison. He was released early, after five years, and got the chance to start his project.

What does Junior think now? Does he think things are getting better? He says some good things about the police and their work arresting gang members. But he is very critical of the government’s approach. He says the government thinks that arresting a gang leader solves the problem, but it does not. He agrees with a report that says arresting gang leaders can even make things worse. Removing the leader often makes the whole gang unstable.

“When you arrest the top guy, everyone starts fighting for power. Who was the most loyal? Who had the most respect? It’s a bit like a family. They are more likely to be violent. Arresting the leader does not have a long-term effect.”

Can this make the streets more dangerous? “It can,” he says. People take sides. If one gang knows a leader has been arrested, they think the gang is weak, and this causes fights. When the leader is in prison, he makes new friends with other gang members, or when he is released, he tries to take control again. That is when violence happens.

To spread the risk, gangs now recruit children in primary schools. The youngest members are called “tinies.” In recent years, there are more and more tinies, who can be just eight to eleven years old. The young members protect the older ones from risk. They often do street dealing or even stabbing, Junior says.

Junior says the challenges are very big, especially with today’s economic problems. “I try to help a young person who has been earning £300 a week illegally. It was hard before to convince him to stop. But now, with high unemployment and less government help, it is even harder.” However, his project, which has over 1,000 clients, is getting results. Fewer than 20% of those who get help commit crimes again. Junior believes everyone deserves a second chance.

Wales will be the first country in the UK to assume that people agree to donate their organs after death unless they say no. The Welsh Assembly voted for this new "opt-out" policy. This means hospitals can think that people who die want to donate their organs unless they have clearly said they do not want to.

The policy passed with 43 votes in favor, 8 against, and 2 people did not vote. Some religious groups did not agree with the policy for moral reasons. Others worried it could make families who are already sad feel worse.

The Welsh Health Minister, Mark Drakeford, said this is a very important day for Wales and for the 226 people in Wales waiting for an organ transplant. He said he is proud that Wales is the first country in the UK to do this. He believes this will help more people get the organs they need and give hope to those waiting for a transplant.

One big reason for low organ donation is that families often say no because they do not know what their loved one wanted. The new law tries to respect what the person who died wanted, but family or friends can still say no if they believe the person did not want to donate.

When families know that the person wanted to donate, they usually agree. The new law will help make people’s wishes about organ donation clearer and should increase the number of people who agree to donate.

Some people do not agree with the new law. They worry that because there is a big need for organs, hospitals might ignore what the person or their family wants. But the government says that people’s wishes will be respected. Families will have the right to object and can show that the person did not want to donate.

Wales made this change because there are not enough organs for people who need them. Drakeford said that about one person every week dies in Wales while waiting for an organ transplant.

About one third of people in Wales are on the organ donor register, but more than two thirds say in surveys that they are happy to donate. The other third are people who have not found time to sign up.

The new law will apply to anyone over 18 who has lived in Wales for at least one year before they die. The donated organs can go to people in Wales or anywhere in the UK.

Doctors are happy about the new policy. The British Medical Association has wanted an opt-out system for a long time because more and more people need transplants. In recent years, there have been big efforts to get more people to carry an organ donation card, and hospitals have improved how they organize transplants. They also talk more with families when it is not clear what the person wanted. But the number of donated organs is still not enough.

Some religious groups do not agree with the new law. They say it could make families even more unhappy. The Muslim Council of Wales and the South Wales Jewish Representative Council have both said they are worried. The Archbishop of Wales, Barry Morgan, said that organ donation should be a gift of love and generosity. He said that if organs can be taken unless someone has clearly said no, it is not really a gift of love, but just a medical use of the body.

The Welsh Assembly voted for this new rule, called the “opt-out” system. This means if someone dies and did not say they do not want to donate, hospitals can use their organs.

Mark Drakeford, the Welsh Health Minister, said, “This is a very important day for Wales and for the 226 people in Wales who are waiting for an organ transplant. I am proud that Wales is the first country in the UK to do this. We want to help more people get organ transplants and give hope to people who are waiting.”

He also said, “When families know that the person who died wanted to give their organs, they usually agree. The new law will help everyone know what people want, and this will help more people get organs.”

Some people do not agree with the new rule, but the government says they will respect what the dead person and their family want. Families will have a “clear right of objection.” This means they can show that their family member did not want to give their organs.

Drakeford said Wales needs more organs for people who are sick. Every week, about one person in Wales dies while waiting for an organ. About one third of people in Wales have signed up to be organ donors, but more than two thirds say they are happy to donate. The other third are people who want to donate but have not signed up yet.

The new law is for people over 18 who have lived in Wales for at least one year before they die. The organs can go to people in Wales or anywhere in the UK.

Doctors are happy about the new rule. In the last few years, more people have started to carry organ donor cards, and hospitals are better at talking to families about organ donation. But there are still not enough organs for everyone who needs them.

Some religious groups do not like the new rule. The Muslim Council of Wales and the South Wales Jewish Representative Council are not happy. The Archbishop of Wales, Barry Morgan, said, “Donation should be a gift of love and kindness. If organs can be taken unless someone says no, it is not really a gift. It is just using the body for medicine.”

John Lewis’s 2015 Christmas advert is about a lonely old man living on the moon. Many people are excited about this advert, which often marks the start of Christmas shopping. John Lewis wants to raise hundreds of thousands of pounds for Age UK, a charity that helps older people. The store also asks staff and customers to work with their local Age UK branch to help elderly people who might be alone during the holidays.

John Lewis spent £7 million on the campaign. It includes a TV advert, a smartphone game, and special products like glow-in-the-dark pyjamas. In 11 stores, they have made areas that look like the moon’s surface.

In the past two years, John Lewis adverts showed cute animals—a bear and a hare, then a penguin. This year, the advert tells the story of a young girl named Lily. She sees an old man living alone on the moon through her telescope. Lily tries to send him a letter and even uses a bow and arrow to send a note. Finally, she sends him a present—a telescope tied to balloons. This gift helps them connect.

The advert’s message is: “Show someone they’re loved this Christmas.” This is similar to Age UK’s message: “No one should have no one at Christmas.” Profits from three products—a mug, a gift tag, and a card—will go to Age UK.

Rachel Swift, head of marketing at John Lewis, said the advert makes people think about lonely people in their own street. The campaign uses the song “Half the World Away” by Oasis, sung by Norwegian artist Aurora.

The advert cost £1 million to make. The moon scenes were filmed at Warner Bros Studios, where the Harry Potter films were made. The set was built by someone who worked on the latest Star Wars film, The Force Awakens.

Like in past years, John Lewis created excitement for the advert with a teaser campaign on TV and social media using the hashtag #OnTheMoon. There will be a full moon on Christmas Day 2015, which is just a coincidence.

In 2014, John Lewis also spent £7 million on a campaign with a realistic animated penguin and a young boy, using the song “Real Love” by John Lennon, sung by Tom Odell. By early January, it had 22 million views on YouTube, more than Sainsbury’s Christmas advert, which had 16.6 million views.

Rachel Swift said that, even with all the excitement, John Lewis has used the same plan for the last five years. She said it is about giving thoughtful gifts and doing something special for someone you love at Christmas. They do not try to make the advert huge, but want to do something right for the brand and for customers.

Sarah Vizard, news editor of Marketing Week, said John Lewis made things simpler this year, even though there are more Christmas adverts from other brands. She said many brands tried to copy John Lewis by making emotional adverts, but now most focus on what you can buy in the store. She thinks John Lewis is still the best at making emotional adverts and that people will find this year’s advert very cute.

To help reduce air pollution, Europe will be the first region in the world to require car makers to use real-world emissions tests. These new rules will check how much pollution cars produce when driving on real roads and in traffic, not just in perfect laboratory conditions like before.

The European Commission has approved these tests. The goal is to make sure cars do not produce more than 80mg of nitrogen oxide per kilometre. Right now, only one out of every sixteen cars meets this limit. Other countries, such as China and Korea, are also thinking about using real-world emissions tests and will watch what happens in Europe.

Pollution from diesel engines, like nitrogen oxide, carbon monoxide, and small particles, is believed to cause at least one quarter of the 29,000 deaths related to pollution each year in the UK.

The current laboratory test for car emissions in Europe is 25 years old. Because of new technology in cars, this test is no longer good enough. Studies show that car makers can easily cheat these lab tests. They do this by taping up doors and windows to reduce air resistance, driving on very smooth roads, and testing at high temperatures.

Lucia Caudet, a spokesperson for the Commission, said they want to introduce a new emissions test that will check cars properly in real driving conditions.

Greg Archer, who works for Transport and Environment, said that one main reason air pollution kills 400,000 people each year is because car makers cheat the tests for diesel cars, causing much more pollution on the road. He said the new real-world driving emission test is an important step to fight air pollution in cities. He also said that EU countries should support the Commission’s proposals and not listen to car makers who say the rules are too strict.

A study by the International Council on Clean Transportation in 2014 found that real nitrogen oxide emissions from cars are seven times higher than the 80mg per kilometre standard. Some cars are even 22 times above the limit. Only one out of sixteen cars met the 80mg target. About one third of all nitrogen oxide pollution comes from road transport, mostly diesel cars, and in cities, this can be as high as 64%, according to the European Environment Agency.

Some campaigners say the car industry has tried to delay changes to the car test rules. But car industry groups say they need five more years for technical and economic reasons. Cara McLaughlin, a spokesperson for the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA), said that Real Driving Emissions (RDE) is a completely new rule that will require big changes to cars. However, ACEA agrees that RDE will apply to new types of cars from September 2017.

ACEA sent their own draft regulation to the European Commission. Their version would have covered fewer pollutants and delayed the new rules until 2020. They also wanted to shorten the test distance from 1,300m to less than 700m, raise the minimum test temperature from -7°C to -3°C, and use more rural roads.

The Commission rejected ACEA’s draft. The new regulation will now go to commissioners for approval and is expected to start in September. By 2017, the first real-world CO2 emissions tests should begin. The world will be watching closely as the EU introduces these new emission tests.

Some cities have pigeons, but Lima has black vultures. These birds fly together in the sky and sit on buildings. With their wrinkled heads and small eyes, they remind people in Lima of the city’s problems, like poverty and dirt.

However, the vultures’ love for eating dead and rotting things is now useful. Environmental officials are putting GoPro cameras and GPS trackers on the birds. The vultures now help find places where people dump rubbish illegally.

Samuel is one of ten healthy black vultures in the project. He wears a tracker and flies over the city to find hidden rubbish dumps. The GPS shows the exact places on a live map.

USAID and the Peruvian Environment Ministry are working together on this project to solve Lima’s rubbish problem. A funny video with a dramatic voice says the vultures are fighting disease while people ignore the danger.

The project is serious. Lima has almost ten million people but only four official landfills. Many illegal dumps exist. A new report warns that up to one billion people will still live in extreme poverty by 2030 unless countries deal with the social, economic, and cultural reasons that keep people poor. The report, from the Chronic Poverty Advisory Network, says that many people may earn more than $1.25 a day for a while, but can fall back into poverty if they face problems like drought, illness, insecurity, or conflict.

The report found that in some parts of rural Kenya and South Africa, 30 to 40% of people who escaped poverty became poor again. In some areas of Ethiopia, this number was as high as 60% between 1999 and 2009. Even in successful countries like Indonesia and Vietnam, 20% of people who left poverty later returned to it.

There are real-life examples of how easy it is to fall back into poverty. Amin, from rural Bangladesh, lost his way of earning money because of his and his wife’s illnesses, the cost of his son’s wedding, his father’s death, and losing things like fishing nets. Lovemore, from Zimbabwe, became one of the poorest in his village after losing his job due to bad health and having to care for his five grandchildren after his daughters died.

We need to make sure that people who escape poverty stay above the poverty line for good. Too many families fall back into poverty because they cannot recover from personal or bigger problems. Governments should not think their job is done just because someone’s income reaches $1.25 a day, said Andrew Shepherd, the main author of the report.

A UN high-level panel said it is possible to end extreme poverty by 2030. However, the report says that doing the same things as before will not be enough. Even though extreme poverty fell from 1.9 billion people in 1990 to 1.2 billion in 2010, the report says that making progress in the next 15 years will be much harder. Big improvements in China are not likely to happen in other countries, and problems like climate change and deep poverty in parts of sub-Saharan Africa will slow progress.

The report says we should focus on the chronically poor—people who are poor for many years or all their lives—and on stopping people from becoming poor again. Governments have been good at helping people cross the poverty line because that is easier. But they have avoided the harder job of solving long-term poverty, said Shepherd.

The report says that progress in reducing poverty has helped people who were already close to the poverty line more than it has helped the chronically poor. It says we cannot end poverty unless development policies focus on the chronically poor. The report suggests three main policies, all needing large global investment.

First, social assistance is needed to help the poorest people reach a decent standard of living. Second, education from early childhood to starting work is important so people can escape poverty and not return to it. Third, economic growth policies should make sure that the benefits of a richer country reach the very poorest people.

All of this will cost money. The report says countries will need to collect more taxes. Aid will also be needed to pay for starting social assistance, universal health care, and education, including scholarships for the poorest children. Aid will still be very important in the next 20 years, as many developing countries spend less than $500 per person each year. Even Nigeria, which has oil wealth, spends only $650 per person, Shepherd said.

With current crises in Syria, South Sudan, and the Central African Republic, the report says it is very important for governments to reduce the risk of conflict and to create peace.

The report also says that if countries fix the inequalities that affect the poorest people—like access to land, jobs, and the power differences between men and women—this will help reduce both long-term poverty and inequality.

The authors ask governments to make a national development plan that includes everyone and to work with civil society to make sure the poorest people have a political voice. They also say governments should try to stop harmful social traditions, like dowries and witchcraft, that add to extreme poverty. This often means challenging the way things are done now.

The bestselling book on Amazon in the US is by Johanna Basford, a Scottish illustrator. She is number one with her colouring books for adults.

Basford’s book Secret Garden has detailed drawings of plants and animals. It has sold 1.4 million copies around the world. Her next book, Enchanted Forest, has already sold almost 226,000 copies. Many famous people like her books, such as Zooey Deschanel, who shared a link to the book on Facebook, and South Korean pop star Kim Ki-Bum, who posted a picture of it on Instagram for his 1.6 million followers.

“It’s been crazy. The last few weeks have been very busy, but in a good way,” said Eleanor Blatherwick, head of sales and marketing at Laurence King, the small British publisher of the books. “We knew the books would look beautiful, but we didn’t expect them to be such a big success.”

Other people are also making popular colouring books for adults. In the UK, Richard Merritt’s Art Therapy Colouring Book is number four on Amazon’s bestseller list. Millie Marotta’s Animal Kingdom, which has detailed animal pictures to colour, is number seven. A mindfulness colouring book is number nine. Basford’s books are in second and eighth place. This means half of Amazon UK’s top ten books are colouring books for adults.

At Michael O’Mara, an independent UK publisher, almost 340,000 adult colouring books have been sold. Ana McLaughlin, head of publicity, marketing, and online, says the trend is because colouring books are now sold as a way to relax. “The first one we did was in 2012, called Creative Colouring for Grown-Ups. It sold well, but in 2014, Art Therapy made the trend much bigger. Selling it as an anti-stress book made adults feel it was okay to enjoy something they thought was just for children,” she said.

The Mindfulness Colouring Book really focuses on being anti-stress. Its publisher tells readers that the book has beautiful scenes and detailed patterns. It suggests people take a few minutes each day to colour and feel calm and peaceful.

“I think it is really relaxing to unplug,” said Basford. “And it’s creative. For many people, a blank page is scary, but with a colouring book, you just add colour. Also, it reminds people of their childhood. Many people told me they used to secretly colour when their children were in bed. Now, it’s normal for adults to colour. These are books for adults. The art in my books is very detailed.”

Basford, who lives in Aberdeenshire, was surprised by the reaction since she released Secret Garden in 2013. “I drew a children’s book and then said I wanted to make one for adults. It wasn’t a trend then. I drew the first story and they said, ‘Let’s do it.’ I just wanted to make a book I would like. So it’s a big surprise to see how popular it has become.”

She is now working on a third book. “It’s a big trend and it doesn’t look like it will stop,” said McLaughlin. “The pictures are everywhere on Twitter and Instagram. People are very proud of their colouring because the pictures are so detailed. You don’t need to be an artist, but what you make is special. People send us their pictures. I think people are taking their children’s pictures off the fridge and putting up their own.”

Not many exercise classes have a tea break in the middle, but Margaret Allen’s class does. After a gentle warm-up and some quick exercises, the 93-year-old great-grandmother lets her group relax with a cup of tea and a short rest.

Some of the eight people in the class look like they need the rest more than others. Allen herself, wearing a thick shirt, a knitted vest, comfortable trousers, and sensible shoes, is not even sweating. Even though she has a very painful trapped nerve in one leg and a knee that needs to be replaced, she looks like she could keep going for hours.

Usually, people say you should not eat just before doing sports, and especially not in the middle of a class. But, on the afternoon I visit Allen’s class in Saltburn-by-the-Sea near Middlesbrough, slices of fruitcake are being shared during the break. The cake was baked by Allen’s 89-year-old sister, Joan, to celebrate Allen’s recent birthday.

The ladies have just finished their cake when Allen stands up again and leads the group through a lively Scottish song with lots of toe pointing and leg kicking. Forty-five minutes later, the class finally ends.

Allen, who used to volunteer for the Red Cross charity, has been leading classes in the northeast town for 45 years. She was not very sporty at school, but she started playing the piano for a fitness class during the Second World War. She took over the class in her 40s when the previous teacher retired.

At one time, Allen’s class had more than 18 regular members, each paying £1 per class. But now, the group is getting smaller. During the tea break, the ladies talk about a funeral they had attended that week for one of the younger members, who had just died at age 68.

Allen is the oldest in the group, followed by her sister. The youngest is 60-year-old Jean Cunion, who feels a bit embarrassed to say she is probably the least fit in the group. “I remember, the first time I came, Margaret said, ‘Who’s that huffing and panting?’ and I had to admit it was me.” Ruth Steere, 76, says Allen always knows what is happening, even though her back is to the class: “She always shouts at us if we go wrong. She is very good at knowing what we are doing.”

Allen loves dancing but has never had formal training to be a fitness teacher. Instead, she makes up her own moves based on five tapes from the BBC’s first fitness expert, Eileen Fowler. Allen thinks her good health is mostly because she keeps busy, especially since her husband died in 1997. She started writing poetry when she was 80.

“I write poems about everything. I write a lot. I just can’t stop,” she says, when she calls me a few days after the interview to read a poem she wrote about the joys of exercise. One of the class, 84-year-old former teacher Winnie Robertson, thinks the secret to staying fit is to keep active: “Use it or lose it, that’s what I say.”

Allen still plays the piano and gives speeches. She took a computer course when she was 88. Getting older is not fun, she admits, reading me a few lines from a poem she wrote called “That Beast Called Age.” She happily remembers a doctor who saw her for the first time a few years ago and said she could not possibly be more than 78: “I said, ‘Thank you, doctor. You can go now.’”

She also has a simple view about gaining weight: “I just think people shouldn’t eat too much. Whenever I hear someone say, ‘Oh, I can’t lose weight,’ I say: Sellotape.” She pretends to tape her mouth shut. “I said this just the other day to a big fat man. Everything in moderation is my motto.”

Earlier in 2013, Allen was watching the news and saw a woman getting the British Empire Medal. The woman said, “I’m 80 and I’m the oldest fitness instructor in the country!” Allen thought, “No, you’re not.” But she says she will not write to Buckingham Palace about it.

The scandal started with a fake scallop, but now it has affected some of Japan’s top hotels and department stores, and it could hurt Japan’s food reputation around the world.

It began when a luxury hotel chain admitted it lied about the ingredients on its menus. After this, Japanese news reported similar problems in restaurants in other famous hotels and department stores.

The first case was with the Hankyu-Hanshin hotel chain in Osaka. They admitted that from 2006 to October 2013, they gave false information about many menu items in some of their restaurants. About 78,000 customers were affected.

One of the worst cases was a dish that was supposed to have red salmon caviar, but actually had the cheaper eggs of flying fish.

The president of the hotel group, Hiroshi Desaki, went on TV and said he would take a 20% pay cut, and other top managers would take a 10% pay cut. However, this did not stop customers from being angry.

A few days later, Desaki quit his job, saying the hotel group had betrayed its customers. One of the hotel’s top chefs also refused to accept a medal of honour from the government.

So far, the company has given back 20 million yen to more than 10,000 customers. In the end, they expect to pay back 110 million yen.

Some customers who thought they ate expensive kuruma shrimp were told they actually ate the much cheaper black tiger shrimp.

The scandal started when a customer wrote in a blog that a scallop dish he ordered at the Prince Hotel in Tokyo was actually made with a cheaper type of shellfish. The hotel investigated and found more than 50 menu items at many of its restaurants were wrong. This report made Hankyu-Hanshin and other hotels admit they also lied to customers who thought they were paying for the best ingredients.

The Hotel Okura chain, which has had guests like Barack Obama, said they injected beef with fat to make it juicier and wrongly said tomatoes were organic.

“We deeply apologize for betraying our customers’ trust,” the hotel said in a statement.

The list of fake ingredients keeps growing: orange juice from cartons sold as freshly squeezed, Mont Blanc desserts with Korean chestnuts instead of French ones, shop-bought chocolate cream called homemade, and imported beef sold as expensive wagyu.

Even the government’s top spokesman, Yoshihide Suga, spoke about the scandal. He said this wrong labelling made customers lose trust.

The scandal happened at a bad time. Japan is trying to get South Korea and other countries to allow Japanese food imports again after the Fukushima nuclear accident. Also, UNESCO is thinking about adding Japanese food to its cultural heritage list.

One local newspaper wrote, “Japan’s proud food culture in tears,” and the Yomiuri Shimbun newspaper said it was shocked by the industry’s lack of morals.

Experts said the 2008 global financial crisis made luxury hotels try to save money, but they still wanted to attract customers with detailed menu descriptions.

Hiroshi Tomozawa, a hotel and restaurant consultant, told Kyodo News, “Menu descriptions were made to match what customers wanted, and when hotels couldn’t get the right ingredients, they just used food from other places.”

The biggest problem for the industry will come from Japan’s demanding customers. In 2009, 72% of diners in Japan said the most important thing when choosing from a menu was where the food came from, followed by the number of calories and other nutrition information.

A menu scandal at some of Japan’s best hotels and department stores is hurting the good name of Japanese food around the world.

One expensive hotel group said it lied about the food on its menus. After this, other famous hotels and department stores in Japan had similar problems.

A few days later, Desaki quit his job. He said the hotel group had broken the trust of its customers.
