Illegal downloading is a kind of stealing, just like taking someone’s wallet from their pocket, says author Philip Pullman. In an article for Index on Censorship, Pullman, who is president of the Society of Authors, strongly supports copyright laws. He criticizes people who download music or books from the internet without paying.

Pullman writes that technology is so impressive that people forget what they are doing is wrong. He says it is shocking that anyone can steal an artist’s work and not be punished. He repeats that illegal downloading is theft, just like stealing a wallet.

His article was published after music industry leaders met with British Prime Minister David Cameron at Downing Street to talk about web piracy.

Pullman, who wrote the His Dark Materials trilogy, says that authors and musicians often work for years in poverty and are not well known. When they finally succeed, their chance to earn money is taken away by illegal downloading. He says the rule is simple and does not change with technology: if we want to enjoy someone’s work, we should pay for it.

Pullman’s article is part of a discussion with Cathy Casserly, head of Creative Commons, which gives creators more control over their copyright. Casserly says there are many problems with copyright, which was made before the digital age. She writes that copyright stops people from sharing, building on, and remixing each other’s work, things that were not possible when the laws were made. She says artists need to find new ways to share and earn money from their work. She quotes science fiction writer Cory Doctorow, who said, “My problem is not piracy, it’s obscurity.”

Index on Censorship agrees. The magazine’s editor, Rachael Jolley, says current copyright laws do not work in the digital age and may make ordinary people into criminals. She says we need new ways for artists, writers, and musicians to earn money from their work.

The debate is active, and illegal downloading is very common. Data from Ofcom, the UK’s communications regulator, shows that between November 2012 and January 2013 in the UK, people illegally downloaded 280 million music tracks, 52 million TV shows, 29 million films, 18 million ebooks, and 7 million software or game files.

Ofcom says 18% of internet users over age 12 admit they have recently downloaded content illegally, and 9% say they are afraid of being caught. Pullman writes that it is still amazing how easy and fast it is to get music as MP3 downloads, especially for people who have been collecting music for a long time.

After the Downing Street meeting, Cameron chose Conservative MP Mike Weatherley to advise him on this issue. A spokesman for the BPI, the record industry group, said that Mike Weatherley strongly supports copyright and the artists it protects. They hope his advice and the prime minister’s support will influence the UK’s intellectual property office.

When Larry Pizzi first heard about electric bikes almost 20 years ago, he wondered why anyone would want to change a bike by adding a motor and batteries. Many people still ask this question. In the US, most bicycle shops do not sell electric bikes, even though they have existed since the late 1990s.

Pizzi is now the CEO of Currie Technologies, the top seller of electric bikes in the US. He thinks this situation will change soon. Other people in the bike industry agree. Well-known brands like Trek, Raleigh, and Specialized now sell electric bikes, and they believe the market will grow quickly.

The US is different from other countries when it comes to electric bikes. In 2014, almost 32 million electric bikes were sold, mostly in China, where people use them for transportation. Electric bikes are also popular in many parts of Europe. They are common in the Netherlands and Switzerland. In Germany, postal workers use them, and BMW sells an electric bike for about $3,000.

Electric bikes are not the same as motorcycles or mopeds, which only use a motor. Electric bikes can be pedaled with or without help from the motor. Riding an electric bike feels like riding a normal bike with a strong wind pushing you; the motor helps you go faster or climb hills. Unlike mopeds, electric bikes are usually allowed on bike paths and cannot go faster than 20 miles per hour.

To be successful in the US, electric bikes must overcome legal, cultural, and financial problems. Electric bikes are banned in some states, like New York. Some bike shop owners and workers do not like putting motors on bikes because it makes them heavier. Some electric bikes weigh almost 30 kilograms.

Electric bikes are also expensive. Cheaper models cost about $700, but Court Rye, who runs ElectricBikeReview.com, says people should pay at least $1,500 for a good electric bike with a good battery. The best models cost more than twice as much.

Companies that make and sell electric bikes say they can solve these problems. The technology, especially the batteries, is getting better. Batteries are becoming smaller, lighter, more reliable, and last longer, says Don DiCostanza, the founder and CEO of Pedego, an electric bike company.

Big companies like Bosch from Germany and Shimano, a top maker of bike gears, are joining the electric bike business. This should help bike shops accept electric bikes. Larry Pizzi from Currie says this has made bicycle dealers more interested. Pedego and a new company called ElectroBike are not waiting for bike shops to change; they are opening their own stores.

Another important reason for growth is that more cities are building bike lanes and other cycling infrastructure. This makes commuting by bike more popular. According to the US Census Bureau, the number of people biking to work grew from about 488,000 in 2000 to 786,000 in 2012. Electric bikes make commuting easier and more enjoyable because they help with hills, wind, tiredness, and sweating.

Don DiCostanza from Pedego says most of their customers are older people, called baby boomers, who want to enjoy cycling like they did when they were young. The main reason they stopped riding was because of hills. Pedego has opened almost 60 stores in the US and has sold bikes to tour companies in San Francisco and Washington, DC.

ElectroBike, which has 30 stores in Mexico, opened its first US store in Venice Beach, California, in autumn 2014. It hopes to have 25 US stores in one year. CEO Craig Anderson says they want to help reduce traffic, lower pollution, and encourage a healthy lifestyle. He tells customers, "Ride this once and try not to smile."

New companies like Pedego and ElectroBike will have to compete with big companies like Trek and Currie. In 2012, Currie was bought by the Accell Group, a large company from the Netherlands that leads the European electric bike market. Accell owns the Raleigh brand and Haibike, a well-known German electric bike.

Larry Pizzi from Currie says Accell has high hopes for electric bikes in North America. While older people are still important customers, many younger people are now using electric bikes instead of cars for transportation.

Accell’s Yuba brand even sells a cargo bike with a stronger motor and a rear rack. Pizzi says you can carry two children or 45 kilograms of shopping. It is like a small minivan.

Is this the time when streaming becomes truly popular? According to the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI), there were only 41 million people using music streaming services worldwide in 2014. Streaming is the fastest-growing part of the music business, but it is still not very big. Also, many of these users get streaming as part of their mobile phone plan, so it is not clear how many people really use it. Some reports say Apple wants to reach 100 million subscribers. If each pays $120 a year, this would make $12 billion every year. For comparison, the total value of recorded music worldwide in 2014 was just under $15 billion. Apple is good at making products popular, but even for Apple, this is a big challenge.

Is this the end of downloading music? The iTunes Store started in 2003 (2004 in Europe) when music piracy was common. Apple convinced people to pay for downloads and became very successful, with about 70% of the market. In 2014, downloads were still 52% of all digital music income, according to IFPI. Apple is the biggest music seller in the world. But download sales in the UK reached their highest point in 2013 at £283 million and dropped to £249 million in 2014. Download sales also started to fall in the US in 2013. Because of this, Apple bought Beats in 2014 for $3 billion to enter the premium headphone market and to move from music ownership (downloads) to music access (streaming subscriptions). Apple and the music industry cannot stop selling downloads yet, so streaming and downloading will both continue under the Apple brand. Most people like music, but not enough to pay $120 a year for it. For example, in the UK in 2014, the average music buyer spent only £39.52. Even Apple will find it very hard to make most people spend three times more on recorded music each year.

Has Apple Connect made Apple the most artist-friendly service? Apple has tried to be artist-friendly before with iTunes, but it did not work. Apple Connect is different. It is a mix of YouTube, Facebook, and SoundCloud. It lets artists post music, videos, photos, and more on their profile pages. Apple usually has good relationships with the music industry and with artists, and most artists think well of Apple. In comparison, Spotify has been criticized by artists like Thom Yorke from Radiohead and Taylor Swift. There is a feeling that big changes are coming, and Apple wants to be on the winning side.

Where are the artist exclusives? This will be interesting when the service starts. Getting exclusive rights to big albums is very important for streaming. Spotify paid a lot of money to have Led Zeppelin and Metallica only on their service. Apple watched this closely and took notes. Apple already has AC/DC and the Beatles’ music for download on iTunes. But can Apple get these artists to allow streaming too? Apple also got the surprise Beyoncé album in 2013 before anyone else, so it will want more deals like that. It was easy for artists to give iTunes exclusive rights to sell downloads because iTunes controlled most of the download market. But doing this with streaming is different. Also, streaming now counts towards the album charts in places like the UK and US. Artists who want to do well in the charts will not want to limit their audience by choosing only one streaming service.

Will this destroy Spotify? Some people say Apple Music will kill competitors like Spotify. But it is not that simple. Apple is joining a market where other companies have been working and learning for years. Apple has a lot to catch up on. The winner will not be the company with the best service, but the one with the most money. Apple’s competitors started earlier, but they are losing a lot of money. For example, Spotify lost €93.1 million in 2013. Apple, on the other hand, became the most profitable company in history in early 2015, with $178 billion in the bank. If Apple Music loses money, Apple will not keep it for long, but the company will not stop trying to beat the competition without making a serious effort.

Is this the time when streaming becomes popular for everyone?
In 2014, only 41 million people in the world paid for music streaming services, says the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI). Streaming is growing faster than other parts of the music business, but it is still small. Also, many people get streaming with their mobile phone plan, so we do not know if they really use it. Apple wants to have 100 million people paying for its streaming service. Each person would pay $120 a year, so Apple could make $12 billion every year. But in the UK, money from downloads was highest in 2013 at £283 million, and then dropped to £249 million in 2014.

Apple Connect is a mix of YouTube, Facebook, and SoundCloud. It lets artists share music, videos, photos, and more on their pages. Apple has good relationships with the music business and with artists. Artists like Apple. This is different from Spotify, which some artists like Thom Yorke from Radiohead and Taylor Swift have criticized. There may be big changes soon, and Apple wants artists to support it.

Artist exclusives will be interesting when Apple Music starts. It is important for streaming services to have special rights to big albums. Spotify paid a lot to have Led Zeppelin and Metallica only on their service. Before, it was easy for artists to give iTunes the only right to sell downloads, because most people used iTunes. But it is not the same for streaming.

When we talk about climate change, we often only talk about the problem. We usually forget that there are many solutions. These solutions include recycling more, reducing pollution, and finding better options instead of using plastic, air conditioning, smartphones, and fast fashion.

The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change recently met in Copenhagen to share its latest report about how climate change is affecting the world and how fast it is happening. Climate change is now happening on every continent. We need to work harder to reduce pollution so that climate change does not get worse. In Copenhagen, they talked about the risks and problems, but also about the solutions.

To focus on solutions, the Sustainia Award, led by Arnold Schwarzenegger, celebrated ten top sustainable solutions used in 84 countries. These solutions were in areas like food, fashion, energy, transport, education, and health. The awards showed that there are better options than the negative future we often hear about.

For example, in California, people are now making plastic from greenhouse gases, and this plastic is as good and as cheap as normal plastic made from oil. In Switzerland, people are recycling and reusing old clothes and shoes in better ways. In Canada, smartphones are making bike-sharing easier.

Each of the ten projects had a special way to help with sustainability problems, but the Nigerian project called Wecyclers won the main prize, the Sustainia Award 2014.

Wecyclers helps poor communities earn money from the waste in their streets. They use bicycles to collect and recycle waste in Lagos. Families can exchange their garbage for goods by using a point system with SMS messages.

Recycling companies buy the sorted waste from Wecyclers and turn it into products like mattresses, pillows, and trash bags. Wecyclers helps solve local waste problems, as only about 40% of the city’s rubbish is collected. The World Bank says only 46% of city waste in Africa is collected. More than 5,000 families are part of Wecyclers, and there are plans to bring the project to other cities in Nigeria.

Many solutions for climate change use new technology to reduce pollution. But to solve all the different problems, we need many different solutions. Sustainability is not only about reducing pollution. It is also about using our natural resources wisely and making our lives healthier. Some of these projects use simple technology, but they make a big difference for whole communities.

Because there are many solutions for many problems, we should focus more on the positive part of the story. This can help people feel excited and help us make real, positive changes.

These solutions help us recycle faster, make less pollution, and find better choices for things like plastic, air conditioning, smartphones, and fast fashion. These new choices are better for the environment.

The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change met in Copenhagen to share its newest report. Now, climate change is happening on every continent. The Sustainia Award chose the ten best solutions to climate change. These solutions are used in 84 countries. The awards showed ideas from food, fashion, energy, transport, education, and health. This shows that the future can be better.

In California, people can now make plastic from greenhouse gases. This plastic is good quality and not too expensive. In Switzerland, people found a better way to recycle and reuse old clothes and shoes. In Canada, smartphones help people share bikes more easily.

Wecyclers helps poor communities make money from the waste on their streets. Families in Lagos collect rubbish from the streets. Then, bicycles come to pick up the waste. Families get points for the rubbish they collect. They can use these points to get things they need.

Recycling companies buy the waste from Wecyclers. They use the waste to make things like mattresses, pillows, and trash bags. Wecyclers helps solve the waste problem in Lagos, where only 40% of the city’s rubbish is collected.

In Africa, only 46% of rubbish in towns and cities is collected. More than 5,000 families are part of the Wecyclers program, and there are plans to start the project in other cities in Nigeria.

BB King was famous for playing blues music, but he was also interested in other types of music. He brought together different musical styles and cultures with kindness and talent. It may be too soon to say he was the last great bluesman, but it is hard to think that anyone in the future will be as important as King. He inspired thousands of musicians and millions of fans during his 65-year career.

Riley B King (the "B" did not stand for anything) was born in Mississippi. His parents were African-American farm workers. He learned to play guitar from a family friend and improved his singing with a gospel group. In his early twenties, he moved to Memphis.

Soon after, he played regularly at a bar in West Memphis and became a radio DJ in Memphis. He was called "The Beale Street Blues Boy," which was later shortened to "Blues Boy King" and then just "BB." After recording once in 1949 for a Nashville company, King started recording for Modern Records in 1950.

His first big hit was "Three O’Clock Blues" in 1952, which was number one on the R&B chart for 15 weeks. This was the first of many hits. On these and many other songs, most of which he wrote himself, King created a new style that was still based on traditional blues. He often talked about the musicians who influenced him, especially T-Bone Walker. He also mentioned blues guitarists Blind Lemon Jefferson and Lonnie Johnson, and jazz players Charlie Christian and Django Reinhardt.

King once said his guitar style came from not being able to play in the "bottleneck" style. He liked that sound but could not do it, so he started to bend notes instead. He was also humble about his singing, which was a mix of ballad singers like Nat King Cole and blues singers like Joe Turner and Dr. Clayton. His favorite singer and songwriter was probably Louis Jordan, whose music he honored in his 1999 album "Let the Good Times Roll."

During the 1950s, King was the top blues artist, playing many shows, sometimes one every night. In 1956, he played 342 concerts. In 1962, he tried to change his busy schedule by signing with a big record company, ABC, but his first records with them were not very successful.

However, his 1965 album "Live at the Regal" became very famous and inspired many young musicians. He had more R&B hits with songs like "How Blue Can You Get" and "Paying the Cost to Be the Boss." In 1969, he almost reached the top of the pop charts with "The Thrill Is Gone," something no blues artist had done for many years.

It took some time for King to become popular with rock music fans, but musicians who admired him helped introduce him to new audiences. In 1969, he said that young people started calling him the greatest blues guitarist in the world because musicians like Mike Bloomfield and Eric Clapton told them so. King said he owed his new popularity to these young fans.

After that, King became a well-known blues artist around the world. With help from his manager, Sidney Seidenberg, he went on concert tours to places like Japan, Australia, China, and Russia. He also played concerts for prisoners in Chicago’s Cook County jail and at San Quentin, which led him to work with rehabilitation programs.

In 1990, King found out he had diabetes and reduced his touring, but fans outside the US could still see him every year or two. He started performing sitting down, but his singing and guitar playing were still very strong. For his 80th birthday in 2005, he released an award-winning album with Eric Clapton, Mark Knopfler, Roger Daltrey, Gloria Estefan, and others. Many musicians, including Bono, Amadou Bagayoko, and Elton John, paid tribute to him, and he went on a farewell tour that was not really a farewell.

In 2009, King won a Grammy for best traditional blues album for "One Kind Favor." In 2012, he played at a concert at the White House, where President Barack Obama joined him to sing "Sweet Home Chicago." King was married and divorced twice. He had 11 children with different partners, and four other children died before him.

BB King was most famous for playing blues music, but he liked other kinds of music and different cultures too. Some people say he is “the last of the bluesmen,” but it is hard to think that any new blues artist will be as important as BB King. He influenced thousands of musicians and millions of fans during his 65-year career.

Kenton Cool can barely talk. Climbing at high altitude has made his voice weak. He is now in Kathmandu, the capital of Nepal, after flying down from Everest base camp that morning. Cool is talking about a surprising series of climbs he finished the weekend before. Early Saturday morning, he reached the top of Nuptse, which is the first and lowest of the three main peaks in the Everest horseshoe that surrounds the Western Cwm, a glaciated valley.

On the same day, he climbed to the top of Everest, reaching the summit in complete darkness early Sunday. He and his climbing partner then went on to climb Lhotse, the third peak in this impressive three-peak challenge, on Monday morning.

He says he used a rare chance. For the first time since the late 1990s, there were fixed ropes on all three mountains. He says this does not take away from the physical achievement of what he did. He has set a new standard. But he thinks that in the future, someone else will do it even better, maybe without ropes or bottled oxygen.

Sixty years after Everest was first climbed, many news stories are remembering Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay and their time, which was different from today’s era of commercial climbing and environmental problems. Cool is asked to think about what top climbers might do 60 years from now.

He says he does not like to think about it, but he mentions Swiss climber Ueli Steck, who left the mountain in April after an argument with a group of Sherpas at Camp 2. Steck had planned to climb Everest’s west ridge, which was first done in 1963, then go down to the South Col and immediately climb Lhotse by a new route, all without fixed ropes. Cool says Ueli had trained very hard. He is a great climber, very skilled, and in top physical condition. Cool says it would have been amazing to see what Steck could have done.

What will tourism look like in the Everest region in the future? One clue is in the dramatic helicopter rescue by Simone Moro, Steck’s climbing partner, whose bad language started the argument at Camp 2. Moro flew back to Everest on Tuesday, piloting a powerful helicopter to rescue a climber at 7,800 meters.

This was the highest rescue ever done on Everest and shows the big increase in helicopter flights in recent years. By 2073, there might even be a helipad on the South Col to bring tourists. For now, helicopters are making it easier to rescue both climbers and the many trekkers who go to base camp.

It is not clear if the Everest region can handle the fast-growing tourism industry, says mountain geographer and environmentalist Alton Byers. He says that climate change and tourism together are putting new pressure on the Sherpa homeland. Glaciers in the Everest region are shrinking or disappearing, which is already having a big effect. People everywhere are talking about having less water. There is less water for farming and for all the new lodges being built.

In the Sherpa town of Namche Bazaar, a new five-mile pipeline is being built to bring water for the growing number of tourists who want showers and flush toilets. The local stream is now polluted with human waste and does not have enough water for the town, which is very crowded in the busy season. Every village is digging a pit just outside the houses for garbage. Khumbu has the highest landfill sites in the world. Human waste at base camp is now managed well and taken away in plastic barrels. But Byers says these barrels are emptied into a big pit a few hours down the valley, which could leak into the water supply.

Byers says these problems can be solved, but people need to take them seriously. One climber can spend $85,000 to climb Everest, and that is fine. But at some point, people will have to focus on these other important issues. For half a million dollars a year, most of these problems could be fixed.

Climate change is another problem. Byers works with local conservation groups to find and plan for the effects of climate change, usually by finding new water sources or collecting rainwater. The fast growth of glacial lakes is a constant danger—they could burst and flood the Sherpa homeland. In the future, people may have to move out of the way.

Changing weather is also affecting tourism. More clouds during times that are usually clear are closing Lukla Airport, the main entry point to the Everest region, more often. A new road for 4x4 vehicles is being built to Lukla to make sure tourists and their money can still come, but Byers is worried that building roads quickly and cheaply in Nepal is causing soil erosion and landslides.

Everest is a famous symbol, he says. It is the perfect place to learn how to solve problems like the effects of climate change and tourism.

A new international survey in 33 countries shows that people around the world are often wrong about important facts in their countries.

For example, British people think the richest 1% of households own 59% of the country’s wealth, but the real number is only 23%. Americans believe that 33% of people in the US are immigrants, but it is actually just 14%. Brazilians think the average age in their country is 56, but it is really 31. Russians think 31% of their politicians are women, but the real number is only 14%.

In Britain, people think 43% of young adults aged 25-34 still live with their parents, but the real number is 14%. In India, people who use the internet think 60% of the country has internet access, but only 19% really do.

Why do people make these mistakes? One reason is that many people have trouble with basic maths or misunderstand the questions. For example, in most countries, people think that 37% of people are not religious, but the real number is only 18%. This is because people think about how many practise their religion, not how many say they have a religion.

People also use mental shortcuts. They use information that is easy to remember, even if it is not correct. For example, people overestimate how many people live in the countryside because rural areas are large, not because they count the people carefully. Psychologist Daniel Kahneman calls this “fast thinking” instead of “slow thinking.”

People see things from their own point of view and forget that their experience is not the same as everyone else’s. For example, in India, people who answered the survey online thought many more people had internet access than is true. This is because online surveys in developing countries are answered by richer, more connected people, not by everyone. People often think their own situation is normal, but it is not.

Social psychologists call this “emotional innumeracy.” This means that when people guess numbers, they are also showing what worries them, not just trying to be correct.

In Britain, people worry about how much the richest own, how many young people live at home, and how many immigrants there are. For example, people think 25% of the population are immigrants, but the real number is 13%. Because people worry about these things, they think the problems are bigger than they are.

But sometimes people are not worried enough. For example, in most countries, people think fewer people are overweight or obese than really are. In Saudi Arabia, people think 28% are overweight or obese, but the real number is 71%. In Britain, people think it is 44%, but the real number is 62%.

The real facts from the survey are also interesting. In Russia, the richest 1% own 70% of the country’s wealth, but in New Zealand, they own only 18%. In Italy, half of young adults aged 25-34 still live with their parents, but in Norway, only 4% do. The average age in India is 27, but in Japan, it is 47. Only 10% of politicians are women in Brazil, Hungary, and Japan, but in Sweden, 44% are women.

When the real facts are so different and surprising, it is not strange that people are often wrong.

Our new international survey looked at 33 countries. It shows that people in many countries are wrong about some important facts.

For example, people in Britain think the richest 1% own 59% of the country’s wealth, but they really own 23%. Americans think 33% of people in the US are immigrants, but the real number is 14%. Brazilians think the average age in their country is 56, but it is really 31. Russians think 31% of their politicians are women, but it is only 14%.

In Britain, people think 43% of young adults aged 25-34 still live with their parents, but the real number is 14%. In India, people who answered the survey think 60% of the country has internet, but only 19% really do.

Why do people know so little about these things? Some people do not understand the questions. For example, in 33 countries, people think 37% are not religious, but the real number is 18%. This is because people think about how many people practise their religion, not how many say they have a religion.

People also think more people live in the countryside because rural areas are big. We often think about our own lives and forget that other people live differently. For example, in India, people who answered the survey online are probably rich, so they think more people have internet than really do.

There are also big differences between countries. In Russia, the richest 1% own 70% of the wealth, but in New Zealand, they own only 18%. In Italy, half of young adults aged 25-34 live with their parents, but in Norway, only 4% do. The average age in India is 27, but in Japan, it is 47. Only 10% of politicians are women in Brazil, Hungary, and Japan, but in Sweden, it is 44%.

Because the truth is so different in each country, it is not surprising that people are often wrong.

We all know about wildlife emergencies, like tigers in India, orangutans in Indonesia, and pandas being close to extinction. These are popular animals that people do not want to lose. But now, scientists are more worried about the loss of common animals, like ladybirds, because this could be a bigger problem for nature.

Climate change, fewer animals, more people, and fast extinction rates make many scientists believe we are now in the Anthropocene age. This is a time when humans control nature and many species are disappearing.

A recent World Wildlife Fund (WWF) report showed that the world’s wildlife population is dropping fast. The report said that the number of vertebrates (animals with backbones) has gone down by 52% in the last 40 years. The loss of biodiversity is now very serious. Some groups, like mammals, birds, reptiles, and amphibians, have lost even more, with freshwater species dropping by 76% in the same time. Scientists are especially worried about animals that help nature work well. For example, three-quarters of the world’s food depends on bees and other pollinators. Pandas and tigers are famous, but worms help turn waste into nutrients, and bats eat mosquitoes, which helps stop diseases like malaria.

Dr. Nick Isaac, a macroecologist, says that losing common species will affect people more than losing rare animals, because we depend on common species more. He and his team found that insects and other small animals in Britain are disappearing as quickly as bigger animals, which is dangerous for humans. He also says it is not just about species going extinct, but also about the number of animals in each species getting smaller. This is a new and important idea.

He also said that between 23% and 36% of all birds, mammals, and amphibians used for food or medicine are now at risk of extinction. In many places, wild animals are an important food source, especially for poor people.

Most people agree that the main reason for this problem is that humans use too many resources, damage nature, cause climate change, and destroy habitats much faster than before. This time, it is not just big animals we need to worry about, but also small creatures like insects and worms. They may not disappear right away, but if their numbers go down, it will affect everyone. We will feel the results of these losses. In the UK, the pattern is the same for small animals as for big ones. Dr. Isaac says the problem is not simple, like “fish die and people starve”—it is more complicated.

In 2013, TV naturalist Sir David Attenborough said humans are a plague on earth. But the WWF says there is still time to stop the decline. The UK Chief Executive, David Nussbaum, said the destruction shown in the report should be a warning for everyone. He said that politicians, businesses, and all people have a responsibility to protect what we all care about: a healthy future for people and nature.

Nussbaum also said that humans are cutting down trees faster than they can grow back, catching more fish than the oceans can replace, taking water from rivers and underground faster than rain can refill them, and putting more carbon into the air than forests and oceans can absorb.

Many people know about animals like tigers in India, orangutans in Indonesia, and pandas that might disappear forever. Everyone likes these animals and does not want them to go extinct. But now, scientists are more worried about small animals like ladybirds. Losing these small animals is a bigger problem for nature.

We also need to worry about small animals like insects and worms. They may not disappear soon, but if their numbers go down, it will hurt us all. “We will feel the loss of these animals. Women have usually had a small part in professional football, but this is starting to change. France has just chosen its first female manager for a professional football team. It did not matter that the team was in the second division. It also did not matter if some people thought it was just a way to get attention for a small team, Clermont Foot 63, which is now 14th out of 20 teams in its league.

The important thing is that Helena Costa got the top job. This made football history because she is the first woman to be manager in the top two divisions of any professional European league. Vronique Soulier, the president of the club’s supporters group, told reporters, “As a woman, this makes me happy. At first, I was surprised, but then we all agreed it is good news. We think having a woman leading a group of men is not a bad thing.”

The new manager of Clermont Foot 63, which has about 3,800 fans at home games, was born in Alhandra, Portugal. She has a master’s degree in sports science and is a UEFA-licensed coach. She has coached Benfica’s male youth teams, the Qatar women’s team, and, more recently, the Iranian women’s national team, which she left in September 2013.

Costa, who is 36 years old, was given a two-year contract by the president of Clermont Foot 63, Claude Michy. Michy is known for getting attention for his club. In 2013, he said the team had signed Messi. They had, but it was not Lionel Messi from FC Barcelona. It was Junior Messi Enguene, a 20-year-old midfielder from Cameroon. France’s women’s minister, Najat Vallaud-Belkacem, wrote on Twitter: “Well done to Clermont Foot for understanding that giving women a place is the future of professional football.”

Carolina Morace, an Italian who was the only other woman to coach a men’s professional team, said, “I don’t know Helena, but if a team hired her, it means she knows how to do her job. I hope that one day this will be normal.” Morace was a great player for Italy, playing 153 international games. In 1999, she became coach of the men’s team Viterbese, but she left after only two games because she disagreed with the club’s owner. She also said, “Right now, I see too many men, even in women’s football, who have jobs without the same skills as women, who are not working.”

Raymond Domenech, a former manager of the French national team, said, “Women know how to play football and manage teams well. Why shouldn’t they manage men’s teams? The opposite happens and it’s not a problem. It’s a natural choice and shows that women are equal to men in our society. Well done to President Michy. I told myself that if I managed a club again, I would hire a woman as my assistant. He did it before me.”

A statement on Clermont Foot 63’s website said Costa’s hiring would help the club start a new chapter. On the club supporters’ website, people reacted with surprise and some doubt. One fan wrote, “I think it’s just a way to get people talking about the club and she won’t last the season. I find it hard to believe the players will respect her, especially since she is the same age as the oldest players.” Another said, “Her CV is not bad, but now the question is: will she be good enough?” A third wrote, “I wish her success, but I think it will be hard for her to stand out as a woman in such a male-dominated business.”

But Soulier was hopeful. She said, “Hopefully, with the new manager, the club can find the motivation they are missing now. The boys in the team can be hard to manage. With a woman in charge, maybe they will be less demanding.”

If Costa’s reputation is true, she will be the one making the demands. She did work experience at Chelsea when her fellow Portuguese, José Mourinho, was manager between 2004 and 2007. People called her “Mourinho in a skirt.” Costa quickly said she was not the same. She said, “Like Mourinho, I always want to win. In that way, I am happy to be compared with him.”

The team is not in the top league, but this does not matter. Some people think the team, Clermont Foot 63, only hired a woman to get attention because they are not a famous team. Right now, Clermont is 14th out of 20 teams in their league.

Loneliness is now a popular topic. The Office for National Statistics says that Britain is the loneliest country in Europe. British people are less likely to have close friends or know their neighbours than people in other European Union countries. Research from the University of Chicago shows that loneliness is twice as bad for older people’s health as being very overweight, and it is almost as dangerous as being poor.

This is surprising, but these studies do not look at loneliness in younger adults. In 2010, the Mental Health Foundation found that young people worry about loneliness more than older people. People aged 18 to 34 said they often feel lonely, worry about being alone, and feel sad because of loneliness more than people over 55.

Loneliness is a known problem for older people, and there are day centres and charities to help them, says Sam Challis from the mental health charity Mind. But when young people turn 21, they are too old for youth services. This is a problem because loneliness is closely linked to mental health issues. It can cause more stress, depression, paranoia, anxiety, addiction, and it can even lead to suicide.

So, what can young people do to stop feeling lonely? A researcher at the Oxford Internet Institute says that social media and the internet can help, but they can also make things worse. They are good when they help us talk to family and friends who are far away, but not when they replace meeting people in person. People show a perfect version of themselves online, and we expect our social lives to be like those we see in the media, says Challis. Comparing our lives to these perfect images can make us want to avoid others.

Meditation and apps like Headspace are popular solutions for mental health problems, but they may not help with loneliness because they make us spend more time alone with our thoughts. It is better to find out why you feel lonely and what stops you from going out and meeting people, says Challis.

A 2013 study from the University of Michigan found that using technology to meet new people can help. If you cannot go out, the internet can still help you. For example, Mumsnet, an online group for parents, can help you feel less alone when raising young children.

Helplines can also help with loneliness, at least for a short time. One in four men who call the charity Samaritans talk about feeling lonely or isolated. Get Connected is a free, private helpline for young people, where they can get help with emotional and mental health problems often linked to loneliness. There are also support services on websites like Mind that remind you that you are not alone.

At work, it can help to tell your boss how you feel. John Binns gives advice to businesses about mental health. In 2007, he went to the hospital for depression caused by stress and took two months off work. He felt like he had no one to talk to and was not close enough to his coworkers for them to notice his problems. Being more open with his boss and coworkers made it easier for him to return to work. Talking with colleagues may seem unimportant, but it helps protect us from the emotional and mental effects of work stress.

We often think our social networks are not important, but they are very important for our well-being, says Nicky Forsythe, a psychotherapist and founder of Talk for Health, an organization that trains people to support each other in groups. The most important thing is to have a regular time and place to think about your life and to have someone who listens and understands.

Recent research shows that loneliness is killing older people, and as more people get older, we should try to reduce loneliness before it is too late. Getting older does not have to mean getting lonelier, says Ruth Sutherland, the head of the relationship counselling service Relate. But it is very important to build good relationships earlier in life.

A new, high-tech computer-assisted autopsy system is becoming more popular in European hospitals. Its inventor says this technique could make it impossible to commit a perfect murder.

The method, called Virtopsy, is now used in some forensic medical institutes in Europe. It was first developed by scientists at the University of Zurich. In a traditional autopsy, doctors use a knife to make a Y-shaped cut in the chest. But now, with Virtopsy, pathologists can look at the dead body in 3-D on computer screens.

Michael Thali, Director of Zurich’s Institute for Forensic Medicine and one of the inventors of Virtopsy, said this method could change criminal investigations. He said there will be no perfect murder anymore because a virtual autopsy lets you find every piece of evidence.

Virtopsies use images from strong magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), and surface scans of dead bodies. Together, these machines are called a Virtobot. This technique helps find injuries that are not seen in a traditional autopsy, as well as air pockets, heart attacks, and even cancer.

Richard Dirndorfer, a pioneer of DNA analysis in criminology and a developer of Virtopsy, told the German science magazine PM that Virtopsy might one day replace the traditional autopsy. He thinks this will happen slowly, just as DNA analysis slowly replaced blood group analysis.

The computer imaging techniques let doctors see deep inside dead bodies. The method has already helped find injuries that traditional autopsies missed. At first, the goal is to use the new method together with the traditional autopsy.

Dominic Wichmann, an internal medicine specialist at Hamburg’s University Hospital, told Spiegel that this will help forensic scientists plan their autopsies much better. Criminologists from around the world have visited Switzerland in recent years to see the new method.

The method was developed over many years. Then, a donation from a rich eye doctor helped the project grow quickly. The new generation of forensic scientists and pathologists do not see Virtopsy as a threat. They see it as something that will work with traditional methods and maybe even replace them one day, but probably not completely.

Lars Oesterhelweg, Deputy Director of the Institute of Forensic Medicine at the Charité Hospital in Berlin, which uses a version of Virtopsy, said that to analyze the color of blood, the thickness of body fluids, or smells, doctors still need to make traditional cuts.

He also said the new method is very helpful for looking again at cases where the cause of death is not clear. It allows experts to get third opinions, review investigations, and reopen cases.

Scientists using the new method said that families of the dead often do not like autopsies because they change the body’s appearance. They are much happier with the non-invasive method.

In Iceland, you can have names like Aagot, Arney, sfrur, Baldey, Bebba, Br, Dgg, Dimmbl, Etna, Eybjrt, Frigg, Glds, Hrn, Ingunn, Jrlaug, Obba, Sigurflj, rana, and Vagna. But if you are a girl, you cannot be called Harriet.

Tristan Cardew thinks this is very silly. He and his Icelandic wife, Kristin, are fighting a decision from the National Registry in Reykjavik. The Registry will not renew their ten-year-old daughter Harriet’s passport because her first name is not accepted.

Harriet’s twelve-year-old brother, Duncan, also has a name that is not accepted. Until now, both children have traveled with passports that call them Stlka and Drengur Cardew, which means Girl and Boy Cardew. But this time, the authorities are following the law exactly. Cardew, who is a British cook and moved to Iceland in 2000, explained that the law says no official document will be given to people who do not have an approved Icelandic name.

Because of this, the family from Kpavogur almost missed their holiday in France. They had to ask the British embassy for an emergency UK passport, which should now let them travel.

Names are very important in Iceland. The country has only 320,000 people, and the phone book lists people by their first name. This is because most Icelandic last names just show that you are your father’s or mother’s son or daughter. For example, Jn Einarsson’s children might be called lafur Jnsson and Sigrur Jnsdttir.

The law says that children born in Iceland must have their names sent to the National Registry within six months, unless both parents are foreign. If the name is not on a list of 1,853 female and 1,712 male names, the parents must ask the Icelandic Naming Committee for approval.

About 5,000 children are born in Iceland each year. The committee gets about 100 applications each year and rejects about half. This is because of a 1996 law that tries to protect the Icelandic language. The rules say that names must be able to have Icelandic grammar endings, must not go against Icelandic language rules, and must be spelled in the normal Icelandic way.

This means that names with letters not in the Icelandic alphabet, like c, are not allowed. Names that cannot have the right endings for Icelandic grammar are also not allowed. This was the problem with the name Harriet, said Cardew.

Some people have criticized these naming laws. In 2013, a girl named Blr (which means Light Breeze) Bjarkardttir Rnarsdottir won the right to use her real name instead of just Girl, after a court said the law broke the Icelandic constitution. The former mayor of Reykjavik, Jn Gnarr, has also said the naming law is unfair, stupid, and stops creativity.

The Cardews could solve Harriet’s problem by giving her an Icelandic middle name. But Cardew says it is too late and too silly. He asks, “Are they saying they don’t want us here?”

In Iceland, you can have names like Aagot, Arney, Ásfríður, Baldey, Bebba, Brá, Dögg, Dimmblá, Etna, Eybjört, Frigg, Glódís, Hörn, Ingunn, Jórlaug, Obba, Sigurfljóð, Úranía, and Vagna. But if you are a girl in Iceland, you cannot be called Harriet.

The committee wants to protect the Icelandic language. The law says names must be able to use Icelandic grammar endings and must be spelled with normal Icelandic letters.

Some people do not like Iceland’s naming laws. In 2013, a girl named Blær Bjarkardóttir Rúnarsdottir won the right to use her real name, not just “Girl”. The former mayor of Reykjavik, Jón Gnarr, also said the naming law is “unfair, stupid and against creativity”.

The Cardews could fix Harriet’s problem by giving her an Icelandic middle name. “But it’s a bit late for that and much too silly,” said Cardew. “Are they saying they don’t want us here?”

Google has already mapped the world’s highest mountains, the ocean floor, the Amazon rainforest, and even parts of North Korea. But Google has mostly avoided mapping the cold and difficult Arctic.

Now, Google is starting an important new project to update maps of the polar regions. This project could help millions of people understand life on the permafrost. Google sent a small team to Iqaluit, the biggest town in Nunavut, Canada. The team brought warm winter clothes, several laptop computers, and an 18-kilogram telescopic camera that they could carry on their backpacks.

With help from an Inuit mapping expert and watched by interested local people, the team spent four days collecting images and information. This will allow the isolated community on Baffin Island to have the same map features that people in cities around the world already have.

The town, which has 7,000 people, will appear on Google’s popular Street View application in July 2013.

In most places, Google uses a special camera on top of a car to make maps. But in Iqaluit, the team had to walk through the town’s snowy streets and along little-known trails, some made of ice that disappear in the short summer. The team also walked part of a 15-kilometer dead-end road called the Road to Nowhere, even though there were warnings about polar bears and other wild animals.

John Graham, the mayor of Iqaluit, understands why local people were excited to watch Google’s team work. He said the Street View project follows the history of explorers like Martin Frobisher, who sailed into the bay in 1576 looking for the Northwest Passage, and Captain Elliott Roosevelt, who flew there in 1941. Roosevelt’s flight led to the building of a military airbase and the founding of modern Iqaluit.

Google’s existing map, made with satellite images, was already quite accurate, but it was missing a road built in the last year.

One problem was that many businesses and homes in Iqaluit do not get mail delivered to their address. Instead, they use the local post office. If Google used the post office box addresses, the map would show all the companies, banks, and schools in the same place, near the Canada Post building in the center of town.

One night, about 30 Inuit elders, business people, and high school students came to help fix these problems. They used laptop computers and learned how to make sure their homes, shops, and meeting places would appear correctly on the map.

The project is not just for fun. Arif Sayani, the town’s Director of Planning, said the new maps could help attract visitors or new residents. The maps might also help the town make planning decisions faster.

The Google project leader said he hopes to continue this work in other northern towns. However, because it is expensive to send people and equipment to the Arctic, they may need to use cheaper ways in the future, such as sending equipment and asking local volunteers to help finish the maps.

Governments in Europe hope to find an easy way to stop unemployment from rising. But in the areas of the EU with the most problems, more and more people are losing their jobs, and talking about solutions is not helping.

In one part of Italy, a mayor thinks he has found a way to help his town, which has very high unemployment. Valter Piscedda is the mayor of Elmas, a small town near Cagliari, the capital of Sardinia. He wants to pay people to leave the town. The local government will pay for ten unemployed people to take intensive English classes, buy a cheap plane ticket, and look for work in other parts of Europe.

The mayor told the Guardian that this idea comes from common sense and his own experience. In the last year and a half, especially in the last few months, he has seen many young people who are very sad because they cannot find work. Some ask for help to find a job in Elmas. Others have tried everything and feel so hopeless that they do not want to stay. They want to go abroad to get work experience and life experience.

So, the mayor’s idea is to help those who want to go abroad to do so.

The economy in Italy is still weak, and Sardinia, like much of southern and central Italy, has high unemployment. In the second quarter of 2014, unemployment was 17.7%, according to Italy’s National Institute of Statistics (Istat). More than 54% of people under 25 do not have jobs.

For the “Adesso Parto” (“Now I’m leaving”) program, the Elmas council will give €12,000 to each person, first-come, first-served, to people aged 18 to 50. To get the money, they must be unemployed, have lived in Elmas for three years, and have an annual income of no more than €15,000. They do not need a university degree.

The idea of paying people to leave is controversial, especially now when many Italians, including many smart young graduates, are leaving the country every year. But Piscedda, who is a member of the Democratic Party of Prime Minister Matteo Renzi, thinks that the people who leave might come back and give much more to the town in the future. Most importantly, he wants to help those who need it most.

He said, “It’s a program for people who have no other options; it’s their last chance. It lets them keep their dignity, so they don’t have to ask friends for money or depend on their families.”

Earlier in 2014, the council started another program for businesses. They gave money to businesses to hire young people from Elmas. “We advertised 20 jobs,” the mayor said. “We got 120 applications.”

People in Elmas have different opinions about the new program. Alessandro Macis said, “There is not much work here. Going abroad to learn about work and other cultures can be very good. The son of a friend of mine, who did not study much, is in London. He started as a waiter, now he is a cook and learning English.”

Others do not agree. Consuelo Melis, who works in a local café, said, “I heard about it, but I thought it was strange. If you have money to pay people to leave, why not use it to help them stay?” On Twitter, some people were shocked. Marco Patavino said, “The state is admitting it cannot solve the problem.” Carlo Mazzaggio said, “The government is giving up.”

Piscedda answered his critics by saying, “Probably, these people are not in need. Every day, I see people’s problems and I have to try to help. If these people had another choice, they would not ask for help.”

He also said, “The jobs I can create as mayor are only temporary. I can pay people to clean the square or the streets, but these jobs only last a few months and do not help in the long term. I want to do more than that.”

Governments in Europe want to find an easy way to stop unemployment from rising. But in the poorest parts of the European Union, more and more people do not have jobs.

He wants to pay people to leave the town. The town will pay for ten people without jobs to take English lessons, buy a cheap plane ticket, and look for work in other countries in Europe.

Piscedda said, “This idea comes from common sense and experience.” He explained that in the last year and a half, he has seen many young people lose hope of finding work. Some ask for help to find work in Elmas. Others have tried everything and now want to go abroad to get work and life experience.

So, he decided to help people who want to go abroad.

Sardinia, and much of southern and central Italy, has a big problem with unemployment. In the second quarter of 2014, unemployment was 17.7%, according to Italy’s National Institute of Statistics. More than 54% of people under 25 do not have jobs.

For the “Adesso Parto” (Now I’m leaving) program, Elmas will give €12,000 to the first ten people who apply. They must be between 18 and 50 years old, not have a job, and have lived in Elmas for three years. They do not need a university degree, and they must not earn more than €15,000.

Helping people to leave is a sensitive idea because many Italians, especially young people with university degrees, are already leaving the country every year. But Piscedda thinks that the people who leave might come back one day and help the town even more. He also wants to help the people who need it most.

In Elmas, people have different opinions about the program. Alessandro Macis said, “There is little work here. Going abroad to learn about work and other cultures can be very good. The son of a friend of mine, who did not study much, is in London and is doing well. He started as a waiter. Now he is a cook and is learning English.”

Other people are not sure about the idea. Consuelo Melis, who works in a café, said, “I heard about it but I thought it was strange. If you have money to pay people to leave, why not use the money to help them stay?”

But Piscedda says, “The jobs I can create as mayor are only for a short time. I can ask someone to clean a square or the streets, but these jobs only give a little money for a few months.”

Besides volcanoes, hurricanes, and earthquakes, there are two main things that can destroy a city or make it disappear: water and sand.

A hundred years ago, Venice, one of the world’s most beautiful and low cities, used to flood about ten times a year. Now, its lowest area, Piazza San Marco (only three feet above sea level), is covered with water about 100 times a year.

Rising sea levels are not the only reason. In many places, the land is also sinking. In Venice, the ground sank by 20 centimeters between 1950 and 1970 because of industrial activity. Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam is sinking by about 2 centimeters a year, but Jakarta is sinking much faster—10 to 20 centimeters each year. In the last 30 years, Jakarta has sunk about four meters.

Jakarta has taken so much groundwater for its people that the land above is drying and sinking, making a bowl shape. Rivers that used to flow through the city to the sea have been changed because they cannot flow uphill.

There are many plans to save Venice, and Ho Chi Minh City and Jakarta are also working on the problem. But in Miami, politicians do not want to admit the city has a serious environmental problem.

Miami has three big problems. It is less than ten feet above sea level. More tropical storms are flooding the city. Also, it is built on rock that lets water through, so rising seawater fills the city’s foundations and comes up through drains and pipes. This pushes sewage up and pollutes the fresh water. One day, Miami might not be a place where people can live.

In the Maldives, people on some islands are thinking about leaving their homes. The capital, Malé, has 153,379 people and is only four feet above sea level. It has built a ten-foot sea wall for $63 million, but in the long run, only stopping sea levels from rising will save it and the other islands.

In Africa, desertification is making the Sahara Desert move south by 30 miles each year, threatening towns in northern Mauritania. In the last 20 years, the desert has grown by more than 260 acres around Chinguetti, a trading and religious center. The population there has dropped from 20,000 in the mid-1900s to just a few thousand now. Trading has almost stopped because sand is piling up in the streets.

The Californian resort of Rancho Mirage, near Palm Springs, may also have to be left in the next ten years. This is not just because of global warming, but because people have expanded too much. California’s plan to farm the desert worked when there were only about half a million people in 1870, but now there are 38 million people and 32 million vehicles.

People in Rancho Mirage use more than 200 gallons of water each day, causing a man-made drought. Water use has been cut by 25%, but this probably will not save the resort, which is surrounded by sand and dust. In the long term, some cities in California’s desert may have to be abandoned.

Fire is also a growing danger for American cities. Forest fires cause the most damage after big storms, with 800 major fire disasters between 1953 and 2014. A new report from the USDA Forest Service shows that more and more cities are at risk from wildfires.

In Australia, some resorts in Victoria and some suburbs of Melbourne are on a list of the 52 most at-risk places for bushfires because long droughts make trees easy to burn. It is unlikely that a forest fire will destroy a whole city, but many fires could make a city unlivable.

Many cities are struggling against nature, but can we say which city is the most at risk? Natural disasters are very hard to predict, but Malé’s future looks especially bad. Even if its new sea wall keeps working, the islands around the Maldives’ capital will disappear soon. If they disappear, Malé will lose its reason to exist.

Volcanoes, hurricanes, and earthquakes can destroy a city completely. But water and sand can also make a city disappear.

One hundred years ago, Venice, a beautiful city that is very low, flooded about ten times each year. Now, its lowest place, Piazza San Marco (only three feet above the sea), floods about 100 times a year.

The sea is getting higher, but that is not the only problem. In many places, the land is also going down. In Venice, the city went down by 20 centimeters between 1950 and 1970. Ho Chi Minh City in Vietnam is also sinking by about 2 centimeters every year. Jakarta is sinking even faster—10 to 20 centimeters every year. In the last 30 years, Jakarta has gone down four meters.

Jakarta has taken so much water from under the ground that the land above is now too dry. This makes the city like a bowl.

There are many plans to help Venice, and Ho Chi Minh City and Jakarta are also working on the problem. But in Miami, politicians do not want to say that the city has a big problem.

Miami has three main problems. It is less than ten feet above the sea. More and more tropical storms are flooding the city. Also, the city is built on rock that lets water through. The sea water goes into the ground and comes up through pipes and drains. This pushes dirty water up and makes the city’s clean water dirty. One day, people may not be able to live in Miami.

In the Maldives, people on some islands may have to leave their homes. The capital city is Malé. It has 153,379 people and is only four feet above the sea. Malé built a sea wall that is ten feet high. It cost $63 million. But in the future, Malé and the other islands will only be safe if the sea stops rising.

In Africa, the Sahara Desert is getting bigger. It moves south 30 miles every year. This is a problem for people in northern Mauritania.

People may have to leave Rancho Mirage, a city in California near Palm Springs, in the next ten years. The problem in California is not global warming. The problem is too many people. In 1870, only half a million people lived in California. Now, there are 38 million people and 32 million cars.

Each person in Rancho Mirage uses more than 200 gallons of water every day. This is causing a drought made by people. They have used 25% less water, but this may not help much. In the future, people may need to leave some cities in California’s desert.

Fire is also a bigger problem for towns and cities in America. Forest fires cause the most damage after big storms. There were 800 big fire disasters between 1953 and 2014. A new report from the USDA Forest Service says more towns and cities are in danger from wildfires.

Many cities are losing the fight against nature. Is it possible to say which city is in the most danger? Natural disasters are very hard to predict, but the future for Malé looks very bad. The new sea wall may help for a while, but the islands near Malé may disappear soon. If they disappear, Malé may also disappear.

Some people call it the “hotel of mum and dad.” One in five young adults stays in their family home until they are at least 26 years old, and the same number do not pay anything for living there. A recent survey showed that the number of adults living at home is different in each part of the country. In the East Midlands, just under 9% live at home, but in London, where house prices and rents are highest, it is more than double that. Many young adults help with money, but 20% do not pay anything.

Young adults have problems because their wages are low and rents are high. Those who want to buy a home find it hard to save money because renting costs so much. Recent research showed that half of tenants cannot save any money for a deposit, and a quarter can only save £100 or less each month. Mortgages are cheaper than ever because interest rates are very low, but the best deals are only for people who have saved a lot for a deposit.

Because of this, more young adults are moving back to their family homes to save money. Parents who cannot give their children a lot of money are happy to help in this way. The survey found that 28% of adults live at home because they are trying to save for a deposit. However, it also found that 30% are not saving any money.

Michael Day, 30, lives with his parents in Bristol. He says he is stuck between paying high rent and saving for a mortgage deposit. Renting a one-bedroom home in Bristol costs between £500 and £800 a month, but buying a similar home costs about £130,000. He says, “I don’t really want to rent because it costs more than a mortgage, but you need a big deposit to get a mortgage, so it’s a vicious circle.”

He does not want to share a home with strangers, so he does not have many choices. At home, he pays a small amount to help with bills and keeps the rest of his earnings from his job. He admits that instead of saving, he spends his extra money on golf and holidays. He says, “You need so much money that I will have to save for a long time. Because it’s been so difficult, I’ve been going on holiday and enjoying it.”

Sue Green, from Saga, a company that sells insurance to people over 50, said most parents did not plan to have their children living with them in their 20s or 30s. But most parents are happy to let their children live at home for free because it might help them buy a home sooner. Children who do not pay rent may help in other ways, like buying food, getting takeaways for the family, or doing jobs around the house.

Angus Hanton, from the Intergenerational Foundation, said older generations caused the housing crisis, so children should not be blamed for staying at home. He said that people under 30 have lost about 20% of their average income since the 2008 financial crisis. Rents and car insurance are higher than ever, and it is harder for young people to get a mortgage, but not for older people who buy homes to rent out. Many jobs for young people are zero-hour or short-term contracts, which makes life harder for them. He said we should help young people so they can afford to build their own lives, instead of blaming them.

Jenna Gavin, 29, lives in Southport, Merseyside, in her family home. She works as a medical receptionist nearby, so she wants to stay in the area. Renting a one-bedroom flat would cost more than £420 a month, not including bills, which would use a lot of her earnings. She says, “I don’t want to rent. I don’t want to spend all that money and have nothing at the end.” She has looked at buying a home and talked to mortgage advisers, but she cannot borrow enough money to buy a home.

Gavin is trying to save for a deposit. She says, “It’s difficult to save enough money—even a 5% deposit is a lot, and I would like to have a bigger deposit.” Her parents are happy not to charge her rent. They want her to save, and she helps in other ways, like buying food and doing things around the house.

Gavin gets along with her parents and has her own room, which she moved into when she was 14. But she always thought she would have her own place by the time she was 30. She says, “I don’t see that happening, as it’s next year. But hopefully, in a couple of years, I’ll move out.”

David Bowie, who died of cancer, was always surprising people. His last album, Blackstar, was released on his 69th birthday, January 8, 2016. It showed that he still knew how to make dramatic and challenging music.

In the 1970s, Bowie led new music and fashion trends. He started as a singer-songwriter, became a leader of glam-rock, then tried a style he called "plastic soul," and later moved to Berlin to make new electronic music. He was special because he often changed his music and image in ways no one else did.

Bowie was born David Robert Jones in south London. In 1953, his family moved to Kent, where he showed he could sing and play the recorder. Later, he studied art, music, and design.

At 15, David started his first band, the Kon-rads. It was clear he was talented and wanted to be a solo artist. He changed his name to Bowie so people would not confuse him with Davy Jones from the Monkees.

His first album, called David Bowie, came out in June 1967. In July 1969, he released Space Oddity, which became his first big hit. The song came out at the same time as the Apollo 11 moon landing and reached the top five in the UK.

In March 1970, Bowie married art student Angela Barnett. His album The Man Who Sold the World was released in the US in late 1970 and in the UK in 1971. This album showed his strong songwriting and performing skills, with songs about immortality, insanity, murder, and mysticism. Bowie was writing songs that were different from normal pop music.

Next, he released Hunky Dory in 1972, which had complex songwriting. It was a good album but only had moderate success. Everything changed with The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars later that year.

For this album, Bowie became a science-fiction character, a glam-rock star from space visiting Earth. The hit single Starman made the album very successful.

Bowie became very popular. His first UK number 1 album was Aladdin Sane (1973), which had the hit songs The Jean Genie and Drive-in Saturday. But Bowie was already thinking about his next steps.

He became more interested in funk and soul music, which you can hear on the album Young Americans (1975). The song Fame, with John Lennon singing with him, became a number 1 hit in the US.

With the album Station to Station (1976), Bowie created a new character, the Thin White Duke. This character was similar to his role as a sad space traveler in the film The Man Who Fell to Earth by Nicolas Roeg.

Bowie’s marriage was having problems because of his success, and he and Angela divorced in 1980. That year, he made another great album, Scary Monsters (and Super Creeps), with the hit single Ashes to Ashes. He also played the main role in the Broadway play The Elephant Man.

In 1981, he had a number 1 single with Queen called Under Pressure. He started working in other areas too. He acted in the German movie Christiane F (1981) and wrote music for it. He had another hit with Cat People (Putting Out Fire) from the movie Cat People (1982).

In 1983, he focused on the album Let’s Dance and went on tour. Let’s Dance made Bowie a global rock star. The album and its singles Let’s Dance, China Girl, and Modern Love were big international hits.

This was the time when MTV was very popular, and Bowie’s interesting music videos made him even more famous. His Serious Moonlight tour lasted six months and had huge crowds. This was the most successful time in his career.

At the 1985 Live Aid concert at Wembley Stadium, Bowie was one of the best performers. That year, he also worked with Mick Jagger to record Dancing in the Street, a charity single that quickly became number 1.

A few days after performing at the Freddie Mercury tribute concert at Wembley Stadium in April 1992, Bowie married Somali model Iman. They bought a home in New York.

For his 1993 album Black Tie White Noise, Bowie used soul, electronic, and hip hop music. The album was number 1 in the UK and had a top 10 single, Jump They Say.

New technology also influenced his music. His 1999 album Hours was based on music he wrote for a computer game called Omikron, where Bowie and Iman appeared as characters. Bowie and Iman’s daughter, Alexandria, was born in August 2000.

Bowie, now living in New York, was the first performer at the Concert for New York City in October 2001, a benefit show six weeks after the 9/11 attacks. He performed with Paul McCartney, Jon Bon Jovi, Billy Joel, the Who, and Elton John.

During his Reality tour in 2004, Bowie had chest pains while performing in Germany and needed emergency surgery in Hamburg.

He saw this health problem as a warning and started to slow down. In February 2006, he received a Grammy lifetime achievement award. He was added to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1996.

The Next Day (2013) was his first new album in ten years. The single Where Are We Now? gave him his first UK top 10 hit since 1993. The album was number 1 in the UK and many other countries. In 2014, Bowie won the Brit Award for Best British Male, becoming the oldest person to win this award.

He is survived by his wife Iman, their daughter Alexandria, his stepdaughter Zulekha, and his son Duncan from his first marriage.

At the 1985 Live Aid concert in Wembley Stadium, Bowie was one of the best performers. That year, he and Mick Jagger made the charity song Dancing in the Street, which became number 1.

In April 1992, after performing at the Freddie Mercury tribute concert, Bowie married Iman, a model from Somalia, and bought a home in New York.

In 1993, he made the album Black Tie White Noise, which had soul and hip hop music. The album was number 1 in the UK, and the song Jump They Say was a top 10 hit.

In October 2001, Bowie performed at the Concert for New York City, a benefit show after the 9/11 attacks, with other famous musicians.

In 2004, during his Reality tour in Germany, Bowie had chest pains and needed emergency surgery in Hamburg. After this, he slowed down his work.

In February 2006, Bowie got a Grammy lifetime achievement award. He was added to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1996.

In 2013, Bowie released The Next Day, his first new album in ten years. The single Where Are We Now? was on this album, which was number 1 in the UK and other countries. In 2014, Bowie won the Brit Award for Best British Male. He was the oldest person to win this award.

Bowie leaves behind his wife Iman, their daughter Alexandria, his stepdaughter Zulekha, and his son Duncan from his first marriage.

At Addis Ababa airport, visitors see pictures of golden grains, small red seeds, and men around a big pancake. The sign says: Teff: the best gluten-free crop!

Ethiopia is one of the poorest countries in the world and is known for food problems. But it is also the home of teff, a very healthy ancient grain. Now, teff is sold in health-food stores and supermarkets in Europe and America.

Teff seeds are very small, like poppy seeds. They are rich in calcium, iron, protein, and amino acids. Teff does not have gluten, so people can use it instead of wheat flour to make bread, pasta, waffles, and pizza bases. Like quinoa from South America, teff is very healthy and could become popular and profitable in western countries.

In Ethiopia, teff is very important. About 6.3 million farmers grow it, and teff fields cover more than 20% of all farmland. Teff is made into flour and used to make injera, a flatbread that is a basic food in Ethiopia. Teff is also important in many religious and cultural events. In Ethiopia and Eritrea, people eat together from large pieces of injera. They use the bread to pick up stews and feed each other as a sign of friendship or loyalty. This tradition is called gursha.

More people around the world want traditional crops, and the health-food and gluten-free markets are growing. This is making teff more popular. People now call teff Ethiopia’s second gift to the world, after coffee.

Sophie Kebede, a businesswoman in London who owns a company that sells teff in the UK, was very surprised when she learned how healthy teff is. She said, “I didn’t know it was so popular. I am from Ethiopia and have eaten injera all my life.”

However, the growing demand for ancient grains is not always good for poor communities. In Bolivia and Peru, farmers earn more money from selling quinoa, but there are also problems like malnutrition and fights over land because farmers sell all their crops to other countries.

In Ethiopia, the growing middle class also wants more teff. Prices are rising, so the poorest people cannot afford teff. Now, most small farmers sell most of their teff to people in the cities.

This has helped some farmers earn more money, but it has also caused nutrition problems. Teff is the healthiest grain in Ethiopia. In cities, people eat up to 61 kg of teff each year. In the countryside, people eat only 20 kg. Rich people eat the expensive magna and white teff. Poor people eat cheaper red and mixed teff, and more than half mix it with cheaper grains like sorghum and maize.

The Ethiopian government wants to double teff production by 2015. The government says teff could be important for school meals and emergency food programs, and could help reduce malnutrition, especially in children and teenagers.

Even though Ethiopia’s economy is growing fast, it is still on the UN’s list of least-developed countries. About 20% of children under five are malnourished.

The government’s Agricultural Transformation Agency wants to increase teff crops by making better types of teff and using new planting methods and tools.

The government does not allow the export of raw teff grain, only injera and other processed foods. But this could change. The goal is to produce enough teff for Ethiopia and for export.

Mama Fresh is a family company that has sold injera to top restaurants and hotels in Ethiopia’s capital for years. It also exports injera to Finland, Germany, Sweden, and the US, mostly for Ethiopians living there. The company wants to double its exports to America in 2014 and will soon start making teff-based pizzas, bread, and cookies.

Regassa Feyissa, an Ethiopian agricultural scientist and former head of the National Institute for Biodiversity, warns that if teff production for export increases without good planning, farmers may stop growing other important crops.

Because there is not much Ethiopian teff on the world market, farmers in the US have started growing teff. Farmers in Europe, Israel, and Australia have also tried growing it.
