George W. Bush, Benedict Cumberbatch, and Stephen Hawking have done the Ice Bucket Challenge. David Cameron, Barack Obama, and Pamela Anderson have refused to do it. The Ice Bucket Challenge started in the US in July and has raised $100 million for the ALS Association, a US charity for motor neurone disease, and £4.5 million for a British charity. It has also raised thousands more for charities in Hong Kong and Australia.

However, not everyone likes the Ice Bucket Challenge. Some people, animal rights groups, and environmentalists have criticized it. They say it wastes water and that some people just have fun but do not give money to charity.

The challenge is still getting more popular. For those who do not know, the challenge works like this: someone talks to the camera about the charity, then pours a bucket of ice water over their head or asks a friend to do it. After that, they choose three other people to do the same or to donate money.

It was bad timing that World Water Week was from 31 August to 5 September, when people from around the world met in Stockholm to talk about the world’s water problems. The charity WaterAid asked people to use recycled water from bathtubs, garden water tanks, or to use sea water.

Douglas Graham, the fundraising director of the UK Motor Neurone Association, said: “The criticism is normal, but this is a wonderful surprise and we are very thankful. We did not expect it, but suddenly, the donations started coming in.” The extra money is a big help to a small charity that supports people with a serious, little-known disease that has no cure and kills five people a day in the UK.

Pamela Anderson, a former Baywatch star and animal rights activist, wrote a public letter to the ALS Association. She said she could not support them because they test on animals. Some US stars refused the challenge because of California’s drought. Actor Matt Damon used water from his toilet to save water. Actor Verne Troyer used milk for environmental reasons. The challenge was also blamed for a water shortage on the Scottish island of Colonsay.

In Australia, a TV news presenter apologized after saying a strong “no, thanks” to the challenge. Lincoln Humphries said: “Instead of wasting fresh water and ice, here is a list of charities that help people in real need around the world. I want to ask everyone who has more than they need to give what they can to people who need it most. That is what charity is about, not making yourself uncomfortable with a bucket of icy water.”

Another criticism is that small charities cannot handle the extra money, but the MND Association disagrees. Graham said, “We can handle it. We pay for world-class research to find a treatment or cure. We give care and support to 3,500 people, and they need it because this disease gets worse quickly and is expensive to manage. Over 50% of people die within two years of being diagnosed. It is heartbreaking to see people get worse in just a few months.”

For many people connected to the disease, the awareness from the challenge is as important as the money. Graham says it is priceless. Usually, the MND Association’s website gets about 300,000 visits a year. On one day recently, it got 330,000.

“We could not have made this happen ourselves. All charities are important, and I understand if some people want to give to a different one. In 2013, British people gave £62 billion to charity—we should be proud of that. It is wonderful for us to get this extra money. In the next few weeks, we will decide how to use it in the best way, but I promise, every penny will be used for good.”

Dan Sullivan was late to breakfast with the Guardian because the police stopped him while he was riding his motorcycle. Sullivan says he works too much. He often misses dinner dates and forgets to buy presents.

Like many people in Silicon Valley, 27-year-old Sullivan, who works in finance, started a company called BetterBoyfriend.me. This service sends a present every month to girlfriends and wives for about $70. Sullivan has tested the service himself and has about 350 boyfriends signed up. Most of these are his friends from Harvard or people who work as venture capitalists, start-up founders, or employees at companies like Apple, Google, and Facebook. For the past year, the girlfriends of these men have been getting presents from Sullivan.

Each month, members of BetterBoyfriend.me can choose one gift from a list of seven options, such as chocolate, tea sets, or manicures. The package is sent to the boyfriend without any company name or label.

Sullivan tests his business ideas by buying Facebook ads to see if people are interested. BetterBoyfriend.me became popular, and people seemed to like it.

Another company, InvisibleBoyfriend, lets users create a fake boyfriend who can text with them all day and is always available to talk. The founder, Kyle Tabor, started it to help people avoid unwanted attention, but he found that many users became attached to their imaginary boyfriends. Most users want someone to talk to, not just to show others they are in a relationship.

Both Sullivan and Tabor were surprised that they built real relationships with their customers. Sullivan now sees himself as a kind of relationship advisor for the boyfriends.

Sullivan admits he made mistakes. At first, he sent packages with receipts that had his name, Dan Sullivan, on them. One boyfriend told him that his girlfriend, Cynthia, found out, but she was not angry.

About half of the women who get packages from BetterBoyfriend.me know about Dan Sullivan’s role. Sullivan says this depends on age. After being married for a while, people do not keep many secrets.

Over the year, Sullivan has gotten to know the boyfriends very well. They even sent a package to a hospital delivery room. Sullivan says the most important thing is to remember that his main relationship is with the boyfriend.

When he started the company, Sullivan put BetterBoyfriend.me tags on flower bouquets and went to Dolores Park in San Francisco. He gave the flowers to women in couples, but the boyfriends did not like it. He understood why and changed his plan. After that, he gave the bouquets to the boyfriends instead.

Scientists have designed a special mirror that sends heat into cold space. This mirror could replace air-conditioning units that keep buildings cool. Researchers think the mirror could greatly reduce the energy used to control air temperature in offices and shopping centers because these places would not need as much cooling.

About 15% of the energy used by buildings in the US is for air conditioning. The researchers say that, in some cases, the mirror could completely remove the need for extra cooling.

In a test on a rooftop in Stanford, California, scientists found that a black-painted roof became 60°C hotter than the air in sunlight, and an aluminum roof became 40°C hotter. But the mirror was up to 5°C cooler than the air around it.

“If you cover large parts of the roof with this mirror, you can see how much power it can save. You can greatly reduce the electricity used for air conditioning,” said Shanhui Fan, a light expert at Stanford University who led the mirror’s development. “In some situations, you will be able to completely remove the need for air conditioning.”

Buildings get warm in several ways. Hot-water boilers and kitchens release heat into the building. In hot countries, warm air comes in through doors and windows. Also, sunlight and infrared radiation from the sun heat up buildings.

The Stanford mirror was made to reflect 97% of the visible light that hits it. More importantly, it works as a thermal radiator. When the mirror gets warm, it releases heat at a special wavelength of infrared light. This light passes easily through the atmosphere and goes out into space.

To cool something, you need a “heat sink,” which is a place to put unwanted heat. The heat sink must be cooler than the thing you want to cool. For example, a bucket of ice cools a bottle of wine because the ice takes in the heat from the wine. The Stanford mirror uses the best heat sink: the universe itself.

The mirror is made from several very thin layers. The first layer is reflective silver. On top of this are layers of silicon dioxide and hafnium oxide. These layers make the mirror a thermal radiator. When silicon dioxide gets hot, it sends out heat as infrared light at a wavelength of about ten micrometers, and the heat goes straight out to space. The total thickness of the mirror is about two micrometers, or two thousandths of a millimeter.

The scientists wrote in the journal Nature that the cold darkness of the universe can be used as a renewable resource, even during the hottest part of the day. In tests, the mirror had a cooling power of 40 watts per square meter at outside temperatures.

Fan wrote in the journal that the cost of the mirrors is between $20 and $70 per square meter. He calculated that a three-story building could save 100 megawatt-hours of electricity each year.

Fan said the mirror could cool buildings, but it would not slow down global warming. Roof space is only a small part of the Earth’s surface, so the mirror is not a solution to global warming. But, he said, the mirror will help reduce greenhouse gas emissions by lowering electricity use.

Marin Soljačić, a physicist at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, said, “I’m really excited by the potential it has. You could use this on buildings and spend much less money on air conditioning, or maybe you wouldn’t need it at all. You could put it on top of shopping malls.”

The business idea is to make a cheap light that uses gravity for power. This light could replace dangerous kerosene lamps in Africa and India.

British designer Patrick Hunt invented this light. He tried to get money from banks and investors to start his business, but it was difficult. He said getting funding was slow, complicated, and risky, so nobody wanted to help.

Instead, he used crowdfunding on a US website called Indiegogo, which is now also in the UK. In just five days, he reached his goal and raised £36,200. His campaign was so popular that after 40 days, he had raised £400,000 from the public.

The light uses an LED powered by a dynamo. The dynamo works when a 10kg bag of rocks is attached to the light and lifted about 2 meters high. As the weight slowly falls, it creates enough power for 30 minutes of light.

Hunt is now getting ready to produce the lights in China. He will first send 1,000 lights to Africa to test the market before making millions more.

Hunt is part of a new group of business people who use crowdfunding to get money. Another new site, InvestingZone, connects rich people with new business owners.

Indiegogo does not give shares, but people who give money can get rewards. For example, people who helped fund Hunt’s light felt good about helping others and also got a light for themselves.

Danae Ringelmann, co-founder of Indiegogo, says the gravity light is a good example of how fair crowdfunding can be. It lets entrepreneurs show their ideas to the public, not just to banks or investors. If people like the idea, they give money to support it.

Even if an idea does not get enough money, it is still useful. You learn quickly if your idea is not good, and you save time, says Ringelmann.

Ringelmann started her career as a Wall Street analyst in the US. In 2008, she left her job to help friends in the arts raise money.

Five years later, Indiegogo was raising about $2 million a week for new businesses. In December 2012, it started using euros and pounds to grow in Europe. Britain is now its third biggest market, and international activity has grown by 41% since December.

There are many other crowdfunding sites, like Kickstarter, Seedrs, and Funding Circle. But Indiegogo is the only one where anyone can start a campaign, no matter how unusual the idea.

Indiegogo charges a 4% fee for successful campaigns. If a campaign does not reach its goal, users can return all the money for free or keep the money but pay a 9% fee.

A British woman used Indiegogo to raise £100,000 to open a cat café in London called Lady Dinah’s Cat Emporium. It is not open yet, but it will be a place where people can relax with tea, a book, and a cat.

Ringelmann says that sometimes investors reject ideas because they do not know if people want them. But if entrepreneurs use Indiegogo and get support, it can prove there is a market for the idea.

Crowdfunding lets you test your market, your prices, your product features, and get important feedback, says Ringelmann.

With her experience on Wall Street and helping 100,000 businesses raise money, Ringelmann has advice for new entrepreneurs. She says ideas are common, but success depends on how well you make your idea real. If you are afraid someone else will do it better, you may not be the right person for the job. You need confidence to move fast and learn.

Crowdfunding is growing as an alternative to banks, but it is not very attractive to big investors who want to own part of a business. This may change in the UK with the launch of InvestingZone.

JMW Turner, one of Britain’s greatest painters, will be on the new £20 note after a vote across the country.

This is the first time an artist will appear on a British banknote. The governor of the Bank of England, Mark Carney, asked the public to choose a famous cultural figure who has died and who they think should be on the banknote.

Turner, who is well known for his dramatic paintings of the sea, was chosen over 590 other people. These included painters, sculptors, fashion designers, photographers, film-makers, and actors. About 30,000 people from the public suggested names.

Some of the other names on the list were Alfred Hitchcock, Alexander McQueen, Derek Jarman, Laura Ashley, William Morris, and Vanessa Bell. A group of artists, critics, and historians chose the final five from this list.

The final five were Barbara Hepworth, Charlie Chaplin, Josiah Wedgwood, William Hogarth, and Turner. They were chosen because they made important contributions to art and British society, and their influence is still strong today.

The new banknote was announced at the Turner Contemporary gallery in Margate. Mark Carney and the artist Tracey Emin, who grew up in Margate, made the announcement together.

Carney said it was very important to do this properly and to involve the public. He also said that banknotes are not just useful for buying things—they can also be like a small piece of art that everyone can carry.

Emin said that having Turner on the £20 note shows that British people value creativity and the arts.

The note will show Turner’s self-portrait from 1799 and one of his most famous paintings, The Fighting Temeraire. This ship was important in Nelson’s victory at the Battle of Trafalgar in 1805.

The note will also have a quote from Turner: “light is therefore colour,” and his signature. The signature comes from his will, where he left many of his paintings to the nation.

Historical figures first appeared on British banknotes in 1970. Turner will join Winston Churchill and Jane Austen on the new polymer notes, which are made from a type of plastic. Churchill is on the £5 note and Austen is on the £10 note. The new £20 note will be available by 2020.

Turner was born in 1775 in London. His father was a barber. Turner started at the Royal Academy Schools when he was 14. In 1786, he was sent to Margate, where he began to love painting and drawing the north-east Kent coast. He returned there many times and painted some of his best oil and watercolour paintings. He said the skies there were the most beautiful in Europe.

Turner was a very productive artist. He made more than 550 oil paintings and 2,000 watercolours in his life. In 2014, a film about his life was made by Mike Leigh, with Timothy Spall playing Turner.

Victoria Pomery, the director of Turner Contemporary, said that choosing to celebrate JMW Turner, one of the greatest technical pioneers in British art, is amazing. She said this shows that Turner is the nation’s favourite artist.

The announcement about the new banknote was made at the Turner Contemporary gallery in Margate. Mark Carney and the artist Tracey Emin, who grew up in Margate, made the announcement together.

Carney said that banknotes are not only useful, but they “can be a piece of art in everyone’s pocket.”

The new note will show Turner’s self-portrait from 1799 and one of his most famous paintings, The Fighting Temeraire. This painting shows a ship that was important in Nelson’s victory at the Battle of Trafalgar in 1805.

The note will also have a quote from Turner – “light is therefore colour” – and his signature. The signature comes from his will, where he gave many of his paintings to Britain.

Famous people first appeared on banknotes in 1970. Turner, Winston Churchill, and Jane Austen will be on the new plastic notes. Churchill is on the £5 note and Austen is on the £10 note. The new £20 note will come out by 2020.

Turner was born in 1775 in London. His father was a barber. Turner went to the Royal Academy Schools when he was 14. In 1786, he went to Margate, where he started to love painting and drawing the north-east Kent coast. He went back to the Kent coast many times and painted some of his best pictures there. He said the skies there were “the loveliest in all Europe.”

Turner painted more than 550 oil paintings and 2,000 watercolours in his life. In 2014, a film about Turner was made, with Timothy Spall playing Turner.

Victoria Pomery, the director of Turner Contemporary, said: “The vote shows that Turner is Britain’s favourite artist.”

For almost 100 years, police and intelligence agencies around the world have used lie detectors to help catch criminals, spies, and traitors. But the polygraph, which is the most common lie detector, might soon not be used anymore. Researchers in Britain and the Netherlands have created a new method that works better. In tests, it was correct more than 70% of the time. This new method could be used in police stations around the world in the next ten years. 

The new method does not look at facial movements, talking too much, or waving arms, which are signs of lying. Instead, it watches the whole body’s movements to see if a person feels guilty. 

The polygraph is used a lot in the United States for criminal cases and for security checks for the FBI and CIA, but it is not popular in Europe. Many scientists and lawyers do not think the polygraph is reliable. The new method, however, has done well in experiments.

The main idea is that people who lie move their bodies more. The new method uses a special suit, like the ones used in movies to make computer characters. The suit has 17 sensors that record movement 120 times per second in three directions for 23 joints.

Ross Anderson, a professor at Cambridge University, is part of the research team. He said that after many years of research, interviewers can only tell if someone is lying about 55% of the time. The new method, however, is correct more than 70% of the time, and sometimes even more than 80% in some tests. Anderson said, “Guilty people move more, and we can measure this.”

Anderson also said this research is important now because of a recent US Senate report about the CIA using torture. Torture is not only wrong, but it also does not work well to get true information. Anderson said, “We have known for a long time that torture does not work. The new method is a good alternative to interviews.”

The research paper was written by Dr. Sophie van der Zee from Cambridge University, Professor Ronald Poppe from Utrecht University, Professor Paul Taylor from Lancaster University, and Anderson.

The polygraph was invented in 1921 by a policeman named John Larson. It checks changes in pulse, blood pressure, sweating, and breathing to see if someone is lying. In movies, the polygraph is always correct, but in 1998, the US Supreme Court said that people do not agree that the polygraph is reliable. The US National Academy of Scientists agreed with this in 2003.

Anderson and his team did an experiment with 180 students and workers at Lancaster University. Half of them were told to tell the truth, and half were told to lie. Each person was paid £7.50 for the 70-minute experiment, which had two tests.

In the first test, some people played a computer game called Never End for seven minutes and were interviewed about it. Others only read about the game and lied about playing it. In the second test, there was a lost wallet with £5 inside. Some people were asked to put the wallet in a lost-and-found box. Others hid the wallet and lied about it.

The report says that, by looking at how people moved their arms and legs, the researchers could tell if someone was lying or telling the truth 82.2% of the time (truths: 88.9%; lies: 75.6%).

Anderson said that when they only looked at how much people moved their arms, they could tell if someone was lying about 60% of the time, which is similar to the polygraph. The best results came when they looked at the whole body’s movement. This showed if someone was lying or telling the truth more than 70% of the time. Anderson believes they can make it even better by using the best questions during interviews.

Another good thing about this method is that it works the same for people from different cultures and for people who are more or less nervous. These things can confuse other lie detectors, but not this one.

The special suits are expensive—they cost about £30,000—and they can be uncomfortable. So, Anderson and his team are now looking at cheaper ways to do this, like using motion-sensing technology from computer games, such as the Kinect from Microsoft’s Xbox.

Anderson said that intelligence agencies like the CIA could teach their agents to trick the new method by keeping their bodies very still. But he also said that staying completely still would also show that someone is lying.

After being told again that the beer she wanted was too dark and too strong for her, and that she should have something sweeter, Rebecka Singerer became very annoyed. She said, “No, I don’t want a fruit beer. Women can drink whatever they want.”

Now, Singerer, who works as a childminder, has joined FemAle, a group of women in Gothenburg who like to drink beer. Together, they have made and are selling Sweden’s first beer made by women.

Their beer is called We Can Do It. It is a bottled pale ale and is now being sold in stores all over Sweden. The label on the bottle looks like Rosie the Riveter, a famous picture from the United States during the Second World War. Rosie became a symbol of women’s strength at work.

The group was started by Elin Carlsson, who is 25 years old and paints cars at the Volvo factory near the city. She says, “We Can Do It is not a beer just for women. It is a beer made by women, but anyone can drink it. It’s not about feminism; it’s about equality. We wanted to show that we can do it.”

FemAle faces many years of prejudice in the beer world. Big companies like Carlsberg have spent millions of dollars trying to sell beer to women. They tried to make beers that they thought women would like, such as Carlsberg’s Eve and Copenhagen, Foster’s Radler, and Coors’ Animee. These beers were lighter, had different flavors, and were supposed to not make you feel full, but they were not successful.

FemAle does things differently. They have beer tastings only for women, where women can try different flavors and styles of beer that they might not usually taste. The group says this is a good way to teach more women about beer. They invite people to bring their mothers, sisters, girlfriends, aunts, and grandmothers so everyone can learn more about beer.

The idea for FemAle started when the women kept seeing each other at beer festivals. The idea for We Can Do It came from Felicia Nordström, who works in a bar. She was tired of men telling her, “What do you know about beer, sweetie?” She talked to FemAle, and together they worked with Ocean, a small local brewery. One weekend, they made the recipe, and the next weekend they brewed 1,600 liters of beer.

Thomas Bingebo, the head brewer at Ocean, says, “This is not a beer made just for women. It is our hoppiest beer.” He also says that when big companies try to make beer for women, it usually does not work. “This is something completely different,” he says.

The first bottles of We Can Do It were sold out almost as soon as they were made. Other breweries have already asked FemAle to make new beers with them.

Carlsson says, “Women often choose wine because they don’t know much about beer or what to order. We help them discover new things.”

The women are part of a big change in Sweden, where more people are starting to like craft beers. The usual large strong lager is now almost gone in Gothenburg, as pubs and bars are offering more special beers instead of big brands.

Emma Henriksson, 22, who works at a garden equipment company and is a member of the group, says, “All the girls are different—there is no typical woman who likes beer. Anyone can do it.”

Singerer adds, “Every pub wants to know how to attract women. And Elin has found the way. It’s great. We feel very proud.”

"Unless we win, it doesn’t mean anything," said billionaire Donald Trump, who wants to be the Republican presidential nominee, at a campaign rally in South Carolina. He said this even though he has been leading the opinion polls for four months in a row. "I want to choose my own date for the election. I want it next Tuesday," he told the crowd of 11,000 people. He has a lot of support from ordinary people, which he needs to keep until March 2016 if he wants to win the nomination to be the presidential candidate in November’s general election.

Trump is not the only one who thinks his surprising campaign could last until the end, especially because recent controversies have only made his lead over his rivals stronger. Usually, any one of these incidents would have ended a politician’s career by now.

First, he made prisoners of war angry by questioning the heroism of Vietnam veteran John McCain because McCain was captured. Then, during the first television debate, he insulted Fox News moderator Megyn Kelly because she asked him difficult questions.

Making prisoners of war, Fox News, and women angry was not enough. Trump has also insulted Mexican immigrants to the US, said that a Black Lives Matter protester who was violently removed from a rally deserved to be treated roughly, seemed to laugh at a New York Times journalist for his disability, and falsely accused Muslim Americans of supporting the 9/11 attackers.

Trump has said that many of these incidents were made worse by the political media, 70% of whom, he says, are "scum." But he has refused to take back any of his comments.

Some of his rivals still hope that, in the end, even Trump’s supporters will get tired of his attacks on minorities. One poll shows his support among Republicans has dropped by 12 points, but at 31%, he is still in the lead.

"He is an egomaniac; he’s a narcissist. He’s not a conservative, he’s not a liberal—he believes in himself," said former presidential rival Bobby Jindal to the Guardian, before he left the race.

But there is more to Trump than just saying shocking things. As he often tells his supporters, the three things he is most against—immigration reform, free-trade deals, and Barack Obama’s national security policy—have become some of the most important issues in the election.

His plans to deport every undocumented immigrant in the US and to make Mexico pay for a border wall—"A real wall. A very tall wall, taller than that ceiling"—might sound unrealistic, but they have hurt the campaign of Jeb Bush, who supports immigration reform.

So what can stop Trump? One reason for hope among his opponents is that polls this far from election day can be wrong, because most people have not decided how to vote yet. Among Americans who say they are Republicans, current polls suggest he has 25-30% of the vote.

In the political fight for people’s support, it will be hard to change the minds of Trump’s passionate supporters. It is hard to imagine anyone being a better Trump than Trump himself.

This situation can be best understood by looking at answers to the question: Which candidates would you definitely not support for the Republican nomination for president? While 20-30% of voters say they would support Trump, another 20-30% say they definitely would not.

Steve Deace, a conservative from Iowa, said that Trump’s behavior is both good and bad. On one hand, it creates loyal fans who like his personality. On the other hand, it makes it hard for him to get more supporters.

Top Republican pollster Frank Luntz believes Trump speaks for voters who, for the first time, feel like they have someone to speak for them and like that they feel heard. He says, "Trump says what they’re thinking, and the more outrageous he is, the more they agree with him. He’s saying what no politician would say, and that’s another reason they like him."

This is also how ordinary supporters feel at his crowded campaign events.

"I like the way he speaks," says Sandra Murray of Dubuque, Iowa. "This country is a big mess and, honestly, he could be the man to help us."

Other supporters give a simpler reason: "He’s not afraid of anybody or anything. That’s pretty cool."

Strangely, recent problems have made him even more popular.

First, he upset prisoners of war when he said he did not think Vietnam veteran John McCain was a hero because he was captured by the enemy. Then, in the first TV debate, he was rude to a woman who asked him hard questions.

A long time ago, people watched movies that took them to a galaxy far, far away. This was in 1977. In 2015, the Star Wars series was getting ready to release its seventh movie, and people were still very interested in Star Wars. There was also news about a new movie about Han Solo and that Darth Vader would return.

Paul Dergarabedian, a senior media analyst, said that many fans around the world are always waiting for new posters, trailers, and other news. He said it is hard to think of any other movie series that makes people so excited.

The new Star Wars excitement started after Disney bought Lucasfilm, the company that made Star Wars, from its creator George Lucas in 2012. Disney paid $4 billion for Lucasfilm and quickly said there would be three more Star Wars movies—Episodes VII, VIII, and IX—as well as other spin-off and stand-alone movies.

Now, details about the second spin-off movie are public. This movie is about Han Solo, the space smuggler played by Harrison Ford in the first three movies. This new Han Solo movie will come out in May 2018.

Before that, Episode VII, called Star Wars: The Force Awakens and directed by JJ Abrams, will be released in December 2015. Episode VIII, which does not have a name yet, will come out in 2017. Another spin-off, Rogue One, will be in cinemas in 2016.

Rogue One will tell the story of a rebel mission to steal the plans for the Death Star, which is an important part of the first movie from 1977. Many people are interested in the rumor that Darth Vader, the main villain in the original movies, will return in Rogue One. This shows how strong Star Wars nostalgia is.

By making many stories and characters in the Star Wars universe, Lucasfilm and Disney are copying the very successful Marvel movies. Disney also bought Marvel Studios in 2009.

Disney has made Star Wars even more popular with smart marketing. Dergarabedian says that making all six Star Wars movies available on streaming services is a great way to get fans excited for the new movie and remind them about Star Wars.

But maybe Star Wars does not need more excitement. The huge number of Star Wars books, comics, video games, and merchandise over the years shows how much people love it.

Michael Rosser, news editor for Screen International, says that the shared universe and nostalgia make Star Wars the top movie series. He says the original movies created a big universe of characters and possibilities that made people imagine new stories.

For years, people have wondered how all the parts of the story fit together. The new movie goes back to Han Solo and Luke Skywalker, so fans hope it will connect with the original Star Wars movies. The prequels did not do this.

Rosser is talking about the three movies George Lucas made between 1999 and 2005—The Phantom Menace, Attack of the Clones, and Revenge of the Sith. These movies were about Luke Skywalker’s father, Anakin, who becomes Darth Vader. Even though the prequels got bad reviews, they still made $2.5 billion at the box office worldwide.

Rosser said this shows how powerful Star Wars is, because even the disappointing movies made a lot of money.

In movies, branding and a successful series are very important. Some people worry that movie studios will only care about brands and not about making good movies.

Rosser does not think this will happen. He says studios want to keep the series going and make sure the new movies are good. They also want people to go to the cinema, even though many people now stay home for entertainment. He says you do not want to watch Star Wars on your iPhone.

Dergarabedian thinks The Force Awakens will make a lot of money when it comes to cinemas in December 2015. He expects it will have a record opening for December and make at least a billion dollars worldwide. Star Wars is truly the biggest movie brand.

In 2010, police in the old city of Srinagar only went in wearing body armour. This area was the centre of violent protests by separatists who wanted Kashmir to be independent. More than 100 people died.

Now, things have changed quickly. The same streets are full of tourists. The Nowhatta mosque, where young people used to throw stones at security forces, will now be part of an official walking tour about the city’s history, crafts, and markets. Visitors can take photos in the beautiful gardens by the lake. When there was still snow, the ski resorts nearby were full of rich Russian tourists.

In 2002, just over 27,000 tourists visited the Kashmir Valley because people were scared of the anti-Indian violence, which has killed almost 70,000 people. In 2012, almost one million tourists have come to the area, including more than 23,000 from outside India. But fewer than 150 were from Britain, mostly because the UK’s Foreign Office warns people about security problems in the region.

Omar Abdullah, the Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, was born in the UK. He asked the British High Commission in Delhi to change its travel advice, but they have not agreed. Abdullah said it is frustrating because, because of this advice, people’s travel insurance does not work if they visit. The last time foreign tourists were killed in Jammu and Kashmir was in 1995, when six westerners, including two Britons, were kidnapped by Al-Faran, a Kashmiri militant group. Only one survived.

Abdullah pointed out that British people have been killed more recently in other countries, but the UK did not stop people from visiting those places. He said, “How many British citizens died in 9/11? Did you stop people from visiting New York? You lost people in Spain and Bali. We lost Indians in London. There is still a chance that al-Qaida could do something, but we have not stopped Indians from going to London. There is no reason to say Jammu and Kashmir, or Srinagar, is unsafe.”

Germany changed its travel advice in 2011, saying foreigners are usually not direct targets. Many people thought this was a brave decision, because the 2010 violence had only just ended. On 15 August, India’s Independence Day, there was a celebration in the state. In the past, this day was dangerous in Kashmir, but this time there was no trouble.

Abdullah believes tourists are safe if they take normal precautions. For example, do not go trekking near the border between Indian and Pakistani parts of Kashmir. Syed Ali Shah Geelani, who leads a pro-independence party, disagrees with Abdullah’s politics, but both men agree about tourism. At the start of summer, Geelani wrote a letter to tourists saying: “Whatever your faith, language, or region, you are our honoured guest. Respecting and protecting guests is our duty and part of our faith.”

Some visitors may worry about enjoying themselves in a place where local people have high levels of anxiety and mental health problems. But people in Srinagar seem to support tourism. Amjid Gulzar, 26, said Abdullah should work for peace and also encourage foreign visitors. “He must do both, but without tourism, our economy will be in chaos,” he said.

“We need better infrastructure, better roads, and reliable electricity. We need more things for tourists to do in the evening—we don’t even have one cinema in this city,” he said. But will tourists feel welcome? In June, a local Islamic group made a dress code for foreign tourists. Abdullah sighed when asked about this. “Nobody wants tourists to cover their faces. I think the main point was: be sensitive to our culture and dress properly. That’s just common sense.”

Abdullah said tourism would help the economy. Jammu and Kashmir’s economy is in a very bad state after more than 20 years of conflict. The state gets only 72 million each year in taxes, but pays 155 million in salaries to 500,000 public workers. It is clear why he needs more money quickly. But for now, he is happy to see tourists return. “I’m not saying that one million tourists means everything is normal,” he said. “But it makes me happy that people can come, enjoy themselves, and go home safely.”

Abdullah says tourists are safe in Kashmir if they are careful. For example, tourists should not go hiking near the border between the Indian and Pakistani parts of Kashmir.

Some visitors may feel it is wrong to have fun in a place where many local people have anxiety and mental health problems. But people in Srinagar like tourism. Amjid Gulzar, 26, said Abdullah should invite more foreign tourists. “Without tourism, our economy will be in chaos,” he said.

“We need better roads and reliable electricity. We need more things for tourists to do in the evening – we do not even have one cinema in this city,” he said. But will tourists feel welcome? In June, a local Islamic group wrote a “dress code” for foreign tourists. Abdullah said, “Nobody wants tourists to cover their faces. But they should respect our culture and dress properly. I think that is common sense.”

Abdullah said tourism will help the economy. Kashmir’s economy is weak after more than twenty years of fighting. The state gets only £72 million each year in taxes, but it pays £155 million in salaries to 500,000 government workers. This is why Abdullah needs more money. He is happy to see tourists return. “I am not saying that one million tourists means everything is normal again,” he said. “But I am happy that people can come, enjoy themselves, and go home.”

James Hamblin, a senior editor at The Atlantic magazine, did an experiment. For his series called If Our Bodies Could Talk, Hamblin tried not showering to see what happens when people clean their bodies too much. He took fewer showers and did not use shampoo or soap when he did shower.

He found out something that many others have also noticed: the more we clean ourselves with soap and body wash, the more our skin tries to fix itself, and this makes us want to clean again. Showering removes oil and bacteria from our skin. Many people think this is good, but sometimes it works too well, especially if you use hot water and strong cleaning products.

After a shower, if your skin feels tight, it is because you have washed away your skin’s natural moisture. Our skin, like our stomach, has millions of good bacteria. Showering too much destroys these good bacteria because of all the rubbing and scrubbing. When the bacteria come back, the ones that make bad smells often return first. So, showering too often can actually make you smell worse. However, if you stop showering and using soap, your skin will go through a short, possibly unpleasant, period of change. After that, your skin usually becomes balanced again, makes less oil, and the good bacteria grow back.

By doing this experiment, Hamblin learned what other people who do not use soap or shower often already know: the human body can take care of itself quite well. It is not just about smell or looks—skin experts say that using less soap can help with skin problems like eczema. Also, taking fewer showers and using fewer cleaning products is better for the environment. The average shower lasts seven minutes and uses 65 litres of water. That is 65 litres of clean water that we fill with soap and send down the drain every day, sometimes more than once.

Clean water is becoming more important, especially as places like California have more droughts. It is clear that clean water is very valuable, and soon we may not have enough. Also, all the bottles from body wash products are bad for the environment. These are good reasons to let your body be more natural.

If the idea of showering less and using less soap makes you uncomfortable because you remember being near people who did not shower enough, do not worry. Many people who shower less still use deodorant if they need it. Everyone’s natural smell is different and can change because of things like diet, drinking water, and exercise. Washing your hands with soap is still very important to stop the spread of diseases.

You do not have to stop showering completely like Hamblin did, but you also do not need to shower three times a day. There is a middle way. The simple advice is: reduce. Skip some showers, use less soap, and let the good bacteria on your skin grow.

Since Moses King, 48, found out he was HIV positive, he has had one big problem. He could handle the shame that many people in Liberia feel about HIV, and he could get antiretroviral medicine from the government. But King and his six children could not get enough good food. He is a small farmer who grows vegetables and buys rice, but he cannot afford meat and fish. These foods are very expensive in Liberia, but they are important because they give protein.

Pate K Chon, a counselor who helps people with HIV in Liberia, found a surprising answer. She saw a film about a fish farm in Thailand and thought about starting a similar project in Liberia. This would give people with HIV both jobs and a steady source of protein.

“I saw this film about fish in a cement pool and thought it was a good idea,” said Chon, who also has HIV since 1992. “Many people I help cannot afford a balanced diet with enough protein. Fish is a clean source of protein. It does not cause health problems like some other foods, and we can farm it ourselves.”

Chon started to build a pool to farm fish. In June 2012, she met John Sheehy, a man who gives money to good causes. Sheehy raised money for a non-profit fish farm in the northeast of Monrovia, the capital of Liberia. He also learned about fish farming by taking an online course at Cornell University and talking to other fish farmers in Africa.

“I raised the money and built the farm, and learned how to set up the tanks and water system,” said Sheehy. “I taught myself a lot, and now I want to write a guide to help others.”

Now, the project is called Grow2Feed Liberia Fish Farm. It has 12 tanks, and each tank can hold 5,000 fish when full. This means the farm can produce up to 200,000 fish each year. The fish help feed a community of 1,200 people, most of whom have HIV, including King and his family.

The waste from the fish tanks is used to water crops, which also gives food and money to the community.

“The people in the community live near the farm and have agreed to work together as a group,” said Sheehy. “Many work on the farm and get fish in return. They can eat the fish or sell them in the market to get money for other important things. The fish farm helps people with HIV become part of society again, because now they trade with others in the market every week.”

A health survey in Liberia says that 1.5% of the country’s 3.5 million people have HIV, and 60% of them are women or girls. There is still a lot of shame and discrimination about HIV, and about half of the people with HIV do not get treatment.

Good nutrition is very important for people with HIV. Studies show they need much more protein to stay healthy and grow well. “Nutrition is very important if you take antiretroviral drugs,” said Chon. “The drugs are strong, and if you do not have enough food, they can make you very sick. But food in Liberia is very expensive. We buy costly imported rice, even though we should grow it ourselves, and most people cannot afford fish.”

“Fish farming is definitely possible in Africa,” said Paul White, who owns the HydroFish fish farm in Ivory Coast, which produces 3,000 tonnes of fish each year. “A lot of fish in the market comes from China and is imported frozen. It is not good enough to be sold in Europe or America.” He said there was not enough investment in fish farming before, but now things are getting better.

Some people do not trust farmed fish. They say farmed fish can be inbred and have high levels of toxins. But Sheehy said these problems can be controlled with good methods. “A lot of farmed fish is inbred, which causes problems, but we use local fish from Liberia, not from other places,” said Sheehy. “We do not use lakes where fish can get toxins. We use tanks, so we can control the environment, test the water, and watch it all the time.”

Sheehy wants to open more fish farms in Liberia and nearby countries. “A rice-growing group in Sierra Leone asked us to start a fish farm on their land so they can feed their workers. We also have interest from Nigeria and Central America,” said Sheehy. “But we are always 100% non-profit and will stay that way.”

For 85 years, Pluto was just a grey spot on maps in classrooms. But on July 15, Pluto was seen clearly for the first time. The new pictures show big mountain ranges made of solid water ice, as large as the Alps or the Rockies.

These amazing pictures of Pluto and its large moon, Charon, were sent back to Earth from the New Horizons spacecraft, which is 4 billion miles away. This is the high point of a mission that has been working quietly for almost ten years.

Alan Stern, the main scientist for the mission, said New Horizons is giving us wonderful results. The data looks beautiful, and Pluto and Charon are incredible.

One big surprise was finding mountains in the Kuiper belt, which is the solar system’s third zone where Pluto is found. The Kuiper belt has about 100,000 smaller icy objects. John Spencer, another scientist, said the mountains are about 3,000 meters high and several hundred miles wide.

A close-up picture of one part of Pluto showed no craters. This tells scientists that there has been recent geological activity on Pluto’s surface. This activity could include geysers shooting ice into the air or volcanoes that erupt with ice instead of lava.

Pluto used to be the ninth planet, but since 2006, it has been called a dwarf planet. The NASA press conference started with amazing pictures of the sun and the eight official planets. “We have made what was once a blurry spot into a clear image,” said Dwayne Brown, a NASA spokesman, as everyone waited to see the new picture.

Stern said there will be many more pictures and we will learn much more about Pluto in the next year. The pictures have already surprised scientists. They think the mountains are made of water ice with a thin layer of other ices, like methane and nitrogen.

Water ice is strong enough to make big mountains, and that is what we see here. This is the first time we have seen this. The methane and nitrogen are just a thin cover. The mountains on Pluto probably formed less than 100 million years ago, which is very recent in the 4.56 billion-year-old solar system. This means the area, which is about 1% of Pluto’s surface, may still be active. These are the first ice mountains seen outside the moons of giant planets.

The pictures are so clear that, if the spacecraft was flying over London, we could see the runways at Heathrow airport.

Because Pluto is 5 billion kilometers away, it takes New Horizons hours to send back a picture, and it will take 16 months to send all the data. The team also said that the heart-shaped area on Pluto will now be called Tombaugh Regio, after Clyde Tombaugh, who discovered Pluto in 1930.

The new picture of Charon shows a line of cliffs about 1,000 kilometers long. This means there are cracks in Charon’s surface, which could also be from geological activity. The picture also shows a deep canyon, about 7 to 9 kilometers deep.

Cathy Olkin, a mission scientist, said, “Charon really surprised us when we saw the new picture today. The team is very excited. There is so much interesting science in just this one picture.” Scientists think Pluto is two-thirds rock, covered by a lot of ice, with surface temperatures around minus 230°C. As the $460 million mission continues into the Kuiper belt, scientists hope it will help us learn more about the early solar system and how planets formed. It may even help explain how Earth was formed.

Andrew Coates, head of planetary science at the Mullard Space Science Laboratory, said, “These Kuiper belt objects are the building blocks of the outer solar system. They are all very cold, like a cosmic freezer. This is the best way to keep the history of the solar system safe. That is why this is so interesting. It is a very exciting time for exploring the solar system.”

In August 2015, mission scientists will choose which of two objects to visit next. NASA thinks the spacecraft can keep working and sending data until the mid-2030s. After that, its plutonium power will run out, and it will drift towards the edge of the solar system and into deep space.

New Horizons also looked at Pluto’s smaller moons: Nix, Hydra, Styx, and Kerberos. “New Horizons is a true exploration mission, showing us why basic scientific research is so important,” said John Grunsfeld, a NASA science leader.

The pictures also suggest that Hydra’s surface is probably covered with water ice. Future pictures will give more clues about how this moon and the others formed billions of years ago.

Roger McKinlay, who used to be president of the Royal Institute of Navigation, says that using GPS (global positioning system) too much could harm our natural ability to find our way. He wrote that if we do not take care of these skills, they will get worse as we depend more on technology.

McKinlay thinks we need to spend a lot of money before navigation systems are good enough for things like self-driving cars. Until then, he says we need better research into navigation systems. He also says children should learn to find their way using traditional methods. Schools should teach navigation and map reading as important life skills.

According to Ofcom (the Office of Communications), about 66% of adults in the UK had a smartphone in 2015, up from 39% in 2012, so GPS is now very common. But McKinlay, who is an expert in satellite communication and navigation, says we should not let our devices do all the navigation for us. If we do not practice our navigation skills, we will lose them, he wrote.

There are not many scientific studies on this topic, but research from 2009 supports McKinlay’s ideas. Dr. Hugo Spiers, a neuroscientist at University College London, said they studied current London taxi drivers and retired taxi drivers who had stopped working for about four years. The retired drivers did worse on navigation tests than the current drivers. This showed that their skills got worse when they stopped using them.

Spiers also thinks it is risky to depend on GPS, but he says the biggest danger is that technology can lead drivers into dangerous situations. For example, in 2010, a driver in Spain died when his car fell into a lake because he followed his satnav (satellite navigation device). Spiers said there is a real danger in trusting satnavs too much. However, we do not know if not using your brain for navigation is bad for your health.

Spiers says the way we use navigation technology can also change how it affects us. Audio instructions from GPS mean drivers do not have to think about where they are going. But using smartphone apps as digital maps is different. When you use a digital map, you have to think about your route and interact with the device. Modern technology is not making us completely less intelligent, he said.

McKinlay says navigation technology needs to improve a lot before things like driverless cars and smart cities can really happen. For very important jobs, like landing or navigating aircraft, GPS is still not good enough, he said.

Spiers thinks that artificial intelligence using machine learning could create new types of navigation tools, but McKinlay is not sure. He says we will see smarter machines that are good at specific tasks, but the big change will come when they can understand what we are thinking and what we want to do.

In the end, McKinlay says it is very important that people can still control their own navigation. He asks, do you really want people to be helpless if the technology stops working or the battery dies? Technology is not magic—it is just a tool.

We asked five people with unusual jobs how much they earn, what the hardest parts are, and why they like their work.

1. Dog-food taster
The job: Tasting dog food to make sure it meets high quality standards.
What it involves: Opening tins of dog or cat food, smelling them, and eating the food. Even though dogs taste things differently than humans, tasting is important to check that all the ingredients are balanced correctly, says Philip Wells, the main taster for Lily’s Kitchen pet food.
Typical salary: A beginner in the quality department earns about £20,000. An experienced technical director can earn £50,000 or more.
Worst part of the job: For Wells, the hardest part is meeting deadlines. He actually likes the taste of the food. The meat in pet food must come from animals safe for humans to eat, according to the Animal Feed Regulations 2010. Wells says some pet foods smell so bad that it makes him feel sick, even if he doesn’t taste them.
Job satisfaction: Every day is different. Wells feels good knowing his work helps pets become happier and healthier. He also says that Lily, the border terrier, is an important part of the tasting team.

2. Hygiene technician
The job: Cleaning and disinfecting places that may have dangerous germs or chemicals.
What it involves: Cleaning up crime scenes, road accidents, suicides, and houses full of rubbish, rats, and waste. The job is about keeping people safe, says Richard Lewis, a hygiene technician for Rentokil. They work in very dirty places.
Typical salary: Beginners earn about £14,500. The highest salary is about £22,000.
Worst part of the job: Cleaning up after suicides. Lewis says you get used to the dirty work, but the emotional side is still hard. You also need a sense of humour because some days are tough.
Job satisfaction: Lewis enjoys the different tasks. One day he cleans after a dead body, another day he is in a prison cell or cleaning inside a silo. He feels proud to make dangerous places safe again, which helps society.

3. Biogas engineer
The job: Building biogas plants in developing countries.
What it involves: Connecting toilets to a system filled with human and animal waste to make biogas for cooking and lighting. You need to know the right size and shape for the mixing pit, how to keep the right temperature, and where to build the plant, says Baburam Paudel, chief technical officer in Nepal for the charity Renewable World.
Typical salary: Beginners earn about £10,000. A chief technical officer earns about £30,000.
Worst part of the job: Paudel finds it hard to see people living with very little money. You must be ready to get dirty during building and inspections. The process, called anaerobic digestion, smells like rotten eggs and can be disgusting. There is no room for mistakes.
Job satisfaction: Paudel feels happy knowing he helps people earn more money and lets girls go to school instead of collecting firewood. His work improves health and hygiene for whole communities.

4. Eel ecologist
The job: Protecting the endangered European eel.
What it involves: To check the size of the eels, ecologists walk into rivers like the Thames, sometimes up to their armpits, and catch eels with their hands from nets. Adult eels can be a meter long or more and weigh up to 2kg. They are not dangerous but are strong and slippery, says Stephen Mowat, an eel conservationist for the Zoological Society of London. They have to weigh and measure the eels, which move a lot. It is hard to look professional when chasing an eel on the grass.
Worst part of the job: Eels are difficult to work with, says Mowat. You also have to switch between projects quickly. Once, he had to cut up dead eels to check for parasites just before a meeting. But for Mowat, the worst part is not handling the eels—he thinks baby eels are as cute as pandas. The hardest thing is learning how much damage people are doing to the environment.
Job satisfaction: Mowat enjoys working outside and seeing British wildlife up close. He thinks eels are beautiful, and helping them also helps rivers and coastal areas. He believes this work is important.

5. Shopping channel presenter
The job: Selling and showing many products on live TV.
What it involves: Presenting for many hours on TV, showing products, and acting excited and knowledgeable about everything. Shaun Ryan, a presenter for Ideal World TV, says he prepares by learning all the technical and practical information about each product before the show.
Typical salary: A new presenter starts at a minimum of £30,000. An experienced presenter can earn over £55,000.
Worst part of the job: The difficult working hours, says Ryan. Experienced presenters often work weekends, holidays, late evenings, and sometimes start at 5am.
Job satisfaction: Ryan loves the excitement of live TV and thinking quickly. He also enjoys knowing that thousands of viewers might buy the product he is showing.

A car that can go up to 25 miles per hour, has two seats, and no pedals or steering wheel might not seem special at a car show. But Google in the US surprised the car and taxi industries when it showed its newest driverless car.

This electric car, which Google is testing near its office in Mountain View, California, does not have normal controls like foot pedals. Instead, you use a smartphone app to call the car and tell it where to go. There is only one STOP button between the two seats in case passengers need to stop the car.

The car does everything by itself: it finds the way, steers, speeds up, and slows down.

Google is making about 100 of these cars to test them for two years. Sergey Brin, one of Google’s founders, said at a conference in California that the car is still a prototype, but the project is about helping people who do not have good transportation now.

He said about the car: “You just sit there; no steering wheel, no pedals. For me, it was very relaxing. After about ten seconds, I forgot I was in the car. I really enjoyed it.”

Google says the main goal is to make roads safer. The car has soft foam at the front and a plastic windscreen, so it should be safer for people walking on the street than other cars.

The cars are made by a company in Detroit, but Google did not say which one. The cars will help Google learn how to make driverless cars work best. Google will run a test program with these cars, but they are not for sale yet.

One problem is that the cars need very detailed maps of the roads before they can drive on them, because they cannot collect and use enough information quickly while driving. Right now, there are detailed maps for about 2,000 miles of roads in California, but the state has more than 170,000 miles of public roads.

Google says it wants to let other car companies use this technology after it is improved.

Some people are worried that driverless cars could replace taxis with human drivers. Dennis Conyon from the UK National Taxi Association says that taxi drivers could lose their jobs. London has about 22,000 black cabs, and Conyon thinks there are about 100,000 taxi drivers in the UK.

Other car companies like Volvo, Ford, and Mercedes are also working on cars that help the driver, but these cars still have normal controls. Google’s car is different because it has no steering wheel or pedals.

Chris Urmson, the leader of Google’s self-driving car project, said they removed the steering wheel and brakes because a person might not be able to take control in an emergency. It is easier to just have an emergency stop button.

Urmson said: “The cars will be very simple. We want to learn from them and change them quickly. But they will take you where you want to go with the push of a button. This is an important step to make roads safer and help millions of people move around more easily.”

So far, Google’s self-driving cars have driven 700,000 miles without any accident caused by the computer. Google says thousands of people die on the roads every year, and about 80% of crashes are caused by human mistakes.

Valdevaqueros is one of the last natural beaches in southern Spain. Right now, the beach only has a road where camper vans from Germany, France, Italy, and Britain park. These vans bring windsurfers and kitesurfers who come for the strong winds.

For many years, Valdevaqueros has been different from the crowded, built-up beaches of Torremolinos and Marbella. But in 2012, the local council in Tarifa agreed to plans to build a tourist complex next to the beach. Environmental groups protested, saying the project would harm the homes of protected animals. However, most of the council thinks the main issue is jobs. Tarifa has 18,000 people, and 2,600 are unemployed, as Spain is going through its worst economic crisis in at least 50 years.

Traditional jobs like fishing are disappearing, so tourism seems to be the only answer. But it must be sustainable, said Sebastin Galindo, a councillor from the Socialist party. His party is not in power in Tarifa, but he still voted with the ruling Peoples Party to support the project. Galindo says the complex will follow environmental rules. There is a law to stop more ugly buildings like those that ruined many Spanish beaches in the 1960s and 1970s. This law says the complex must be at least 200 metres from the coast, but this one will be much farther—800 metres away.

People against the complex say Spain already has a million empty homes, so more housing is not needed. The Socialist opposition in Madrid also criticized the idea. Galindo said the plan was unfair to migrant workers who came to Spain during the economic boom, many from Morocco, which is only 14km away and can be seen from Tarifa.

Surfers worry that new buildings in Valdevaqueros will make the famous wind weaker but will not bring in normal holiday tourists. "It's not really a family place. Just wait until they see how strong the wind is," said Henning Mayer, a German who has visited every year for 20 years. "Ten years ago, they said they would build a new highway here. It didn't happen, so I think it will be impossible to build new hotels."

Tarifa is at the southernmost point of Spain, where Africa and Europe meet, and where the Mediterranean Sea meets the Atlantic Ocean. Campaigners say the area is also very important for migrating animals.

The campaign to save the beach started just hours after the Tarifa council voted for the project. The campaign has a Facebook page and is supported by groups like Greenpeace, the World Wide Fund for Nature, and the Spanish branch of Birdlife. The Andalusian College of Geographers also opposes the project, saying it would harm two wildlife conservation areas and cross into a national park.

"Money is once again more important than city laws and European environmental rules," said Ral Romeva, a member of the European Parliament. He also said the project is a problem because the area does not have enough water, especially in the hot Andalusian summer, when the town already has water shortages.

Many local people also ask why the resort should be built 10km away, and not on empty land near Tarifa’s old town, which has white walls, small streets, and a 10th-century Moorish castle. "We agree with the complex if it creates jobs in the town, but we are against it if it only helps a few people," said Cristbal Lobato, who has worked at the same beach bar in Tarifa for 30 years. "If they build it in the centre of Tarifa, where there is space, then visitors could go to shops, tapas bars, and restaurants."

Looking at the green fields where the resort will be built, biologist Aitor Galn said, "Anywhere else in Europe, this place would be fully protected, but here they want to destroy it and build on it. They want to turn this into Benidorm, but people come here for the wildlife and the wind. By using the current crisis and unemployment, builders and mayors can justify any amount of destruction."

Scientists have made a map of the brain that shows where the meanings of words are found in different brain areas. The map uses rainbow colors to show how words with similar meanings are grouped together in the brain.

Jack Gallant, a brain scientist at the University of California, Berkeley, said their goal was to make a big map showing how one part of language—semantics, or word meanings—is shown in the brain.

No single part of the brain holds just one word or idea. Each small area is linked to many related words, and each word activates many different areas. These areas work together as networks to show the meaning of words like life, love, death, and taxes. Each of these words lights up its own network.

One researcher who did not work on the study said the map was a great achievement. The map shows how new brain imaging can help us understand how the brain does important jobs. If scientists keep improving this technology, it could have a big effect on medicine and other fields.

Alexander Huth, the main author, said this method might help us find out what words a person is hearing, reading, or even thinking. One possible use is a language decoder that could help people who cannot speak, because of illness, to talk using a computer.

To make the map, scientists recorded people’s brain activity while they listened to stories. They matched the words from the stories with the brain activity to see how groups of related words made the brain respond in 50,000 to 80,000 small spots across the brain’s surface.

Huth used short, interesting stories so people would pay attention. Seven people listened to two hours of stories each. Each person heard about 25,000 words and more than 3,000 different words while lying in a brain scanner.

The map shows how words and related terms light up the same brain areas. For example, on the left side of the brain above the ear, there is a small area for the word “victim.” This area also responds to “killed,” “convicted,” “murdered,” and “confessed.” On the right side, near the top of the head, there is an area for family words like “wife,” “husband,” “children,” and “parents.”

Each word is shown in more than one area because words often have more than one meaning. For example, one part of the brain responds to the word “top” and other clothing words, but “top” also lights up areas for numbers, measurements, and buildings. The scientists made a website where people can explore the brain map.

Interestingly, the brain maps were similar for all the people in the study. This means their brains organized word meanings in the same way. But the study only scanned five men and two women, all native English speakers. People from other backgrounds or cultures might have different brain maps for word meanings.

With this map, researchers can now study how the brain shows very different ideas, from numbers to murder and religion. Gallant said the idea of murder is shown in many parts of the brain.

Uri Hasson, a brain scientist at Princeton University, said the work was excellent. He said most studies only look at brain activity for one word or sentence, but Gallant’s team showed how the brain works in real-life situations. The next step is to make a more complete and detailed brain map for word meanings. In the future, Hasson thinks it may be possible to find out what words a person is thinking from their brain activity, but this raises big ethical questions.

Lorraine Tyler, a brain scientist at Cambridge University, said the research was a great achievement. However, the current brain map does not show small differences in word meanings. She said this research is new and important, but there is still much to learn about how word meanings are shown in the brain.

A Canadian man became famous after he offered a free trip around the world to a woman with the same name as his ex-girlfriend. He has now returned from the trip with the woman he chose. Many people hoped they would fall in love, but they did not.

Jordan Axani, a 28-year-old man from Toronto who started a charity, came back to Canada with Elizabeth Quinn Gallagher. He said they had a relationship like a brother and sister.

In 2014, Axani became well-known because he offered a plane ticket to any Canadian woman named Elizabeth Gallagher. He had planned a three-week holiday with his girlfriend, but they broke up, and he could not change the name on the tickets.

Elizabeth Gallagher, a 23-year-old student from Cole Harbour, Nova Scotia, answered Axani’s online post and was chosen for the trip. She calls herself Quinn and said before the trip that she already had a serious boyfriend. Still, many journalists hoped the two travelers would fall in love, but it did not happen.

Axani said clearly after they returned to Toronto, “This was never a romantic trip. It was only friendship. I do not think of Quinn in a romantic way at all. There is no romantic future for us. She is a good friend. I think of her as a little sister, and that is all. She feels the same way.”

It took some time and effort for them to become good friends. It was not easy or quick. Axani said it took about a week for them to understand each other. They had to learn what was okay and not okay when traveling together. In the end, they became good friends, made inside jokes, and knew when the other person needed some time alone.

Even though they did not fall in love, Axani said the trip was amazing. They visited Milan, Venice, Vienna, Prague, Khao Lak in Thailand, and Hong Kong. Axani’s favorite place was Prague, where they met more people than anywhere else.

“In just two and a half days, we met about 24 people. That’s a lot of stories and a lot of love for Prague,” Axani said.

Many people followed their journey on Twitter and Instagram. In Hong Kong, people even recognized them on the street. Axani said, “It was a real adventure. We had a lot of fun. We learned a lot about ourselves and each other. I can’t imagine the trip going any better.”

When Axani returned to Toronto at 3 a.m., he went straight to a meeting at his charity, A Ticket Forward. He started this non-profit group after his story became popular online. He wants to give trips around the world to people who have survived abuse, cancer, or war.

Axani is also talking about making his story into a TV show or movie, but he did not give details. He said, “There is a lot of interest from many production companies. We are making good progress.” About his love life, Axani said he is not looking for another Elizabeth Gallagher. “I’m not looking for anything, but life happens and we’ll see,” he said. “As always, life is a journey.”

American researchers say that a nasal spray with the "love hormone" oxytocin might help children with autism act more normally in social situations. Brain scans of autistic children showed that one dose of oxytocin helped their brains respond better to facial expressions. This could make social interactions feel more natural and enjoyable for them.

The researchers said oxytocin could make behavioral therapies for autism work better. These therapies already help people with autism learn to handle social situations. Over time, children might show more normal social behavior, be more interested in talking to others, make more eye contact, and have more conversations, said Kevin Pelphrey from Yale University.

Autism is a developmental disorder that affects more than one in 100 people. It affects people in different ways, but usually causes problems with social interaction and communication. There is no proven treatment yet for the social problems caused by autism.

Researchers at Yale studied oxytocin as a possible treatment for these social problems because it is important for bonding and trust. However, results have been mixed. One recent study found no clear benefit for young people who took oxytocin for several days. But Pelphrey said oxytocin might help the brain learn from social experiences, and it could work best when used with therapies that help people with autism interact more.

The scientists scanned the brains of 17 young people with autism, aged 8 to 16, while they looked at pictures of cars or the eyes of people showing different emotions. The scans were done 45 minutes after the young people used a nasal spray with either oxytocin or a placebo.

The scans showed that the reward centers in the children's brains worked more normally after taking oxytocin. The reward centers were more active when the children looked at faces and less active when they looked at cars. The study was published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences in the United States.

Pelphrey said the study suggests oxytocin might help with the main social problems in autism, for which there is no treatment yet. However, he warned that it is too early to use oxytocin as a treatment for autism's social difficulties, and people should not buy oxytocin online. He said, "We don't want them trying oxytocin at home. It's impossible to know what they are buying. We are not ready to say this is a treatment. More research is needed."

Simon Baron-Cohen, director of the Autism Research Centre at Cambridge University, said this is an important new study because it shows changes in brain activity in key areas.

However, a surprising result was that oxytocin nasal spray did not improve how well the children recognized social cues. It is also not clear if oxytocin only helps people with autism or if it has any unwanted side effects. Also, the effects of oxytocin only last about 45 minutes, so it may be difficult to use as a treatment.

From a scientific point of view, this study has strong evidence from both animal and human research, so it deserves serious attention. But more research is needed. Doctors should be careful about using this hormone until we know much more about its benefits and risks from larger studies, said Simon Baron-Cohen.

Uta Frith, who studies autism at University College London, said that according to this study, oxytocin may make faces more interesting to people with autism. However, this effect was only seen in brain activity, not in behavior. She said that showing a change in behavior will be very important if the nasal spray is to be useful as a treatment.
