Cathal Redmond was swimming near the coast of Greece. He thought he had taken some great photos of colorful fish with his first underwater camera. But when he looked at the photos later, they were brown and unclear. He took the pictures while holding his breath underwater and thought the problem was that he did not have enough time to set up the shots. He believed that if he had a little more time underwater, he could take better photos of the fish in their natural home.

He decided to invent something to give people more time underwater. His invention is called the Express Dive. It is a refillable air storage device that you hold in your mouth. It lets people swim underwater for two minutes. This device is between snorkelling, which has limits, and scuba diving, which lets you breathe underwater but needs heavy and expensive equipment. The first version of the Express Dive looks like a mix of a scuba mouthpiece and a water bottle.

Redmond, who is 27 years old, said, “I wanted people to do more than just go underwater and hold their breath for 30 seconds. I wanted them to stay longer.” In 2006, Redmond, who is from Ireland, finished a scuba-diving course. He loved being able to breathe underwater and watch fish in their natural place. But he did not like all the equipment he had to use.

He said, “I knew I had about 50kg of equipment on me. It felt strange to go underwater when you are used to staying at the surface. It was a very strange experience.” The real problem, he said, is that scuba diving is limiting. Even though you can stay underwater longer, you have to plan your whole day around it. You have to carry 20kg to 50kg of gear, so you cannot just walk on the beach and decide to go in the water. Planning is a big part of scuba diving.

Redmond made the Express Dive during his final year project for his product design degree. The device has two main parts. When you are above the water, the device takes in air through a vent in the mouthpiece. The air is pushed through valves and stored in a tank. The tank has a light that flashes green when it is full. When the device is not taking in air, the vent closes. When the person dives, air comes back through the mouthpiece.

The light changes from green to red when the air is almost gone. The device can hold enough air for two minutes underwater and takes about two minutes to refill. Redmond said the hard part was making the device small enough to fit in the mouth, because it also needs batteries and electronics.

Redmond says the mouthpiece feels like using a snorkel. He says it is like an extension of the lungs, because the user takes a deep breath and then uses it underwater. It helps the body store more air. The first version of the device has been tested in parts. Redmond has shown that the motor can put two minutes of air into the device and that the design can be held in the diver’s mouth.

He has not yet tested the device on a diver who is fully underwater for two minutes. But Redmond is sure that, with enough testing, he can make a safe device for swimmers. He thinks the device will cost about €280 and will weigh between 1kg and 3kg, depending on the safety features.

Some people think that two minutes of air is not much better than snorkelling. But Redmond says it can make a big difference underwater. He says the average swimmer can hold their breath for about 40 seconds. Two minutes is not a long time, but it is much longer than that.

Cathal Redmond was swimming in the sea near Greece. He used his first underwater camera to take pictures of colorful fish. He thought the photos would be very good. But later, when he looked at them, the photos were brown and not clear. The photos were bad because he had to hold his breath underwater and did not have enough time to take good pictures. He thought he needed more time underwater to take better photos of the fish.

To solve this problem, he invented the Express Dive. This is a small air tank that you can fill again and again. You hold it in your mouth. It lets you stay underwater for two minutes. It is better than snorkelling, which only lets you stay near the surface, but it is easier than scuba diving, which needs heavy and expensive equipment. The first model of his invention looks like a mix of a scuba mouthpiece and a water bottle.

Redmond, who is 27 years old, says, “I wanted people to do more than just go underwater and hold their breath for 30 seconds.” In 2006, he finished a scuba-diving course and liked being able to breathe underwater and watch fish. But he did not like all the heavy equipment.

He says, “I did not like carrying about 50kg of equipment. It felt strange to go underwater when I was used to staying at the surface. It was a very strange feeling. The real problem is that scuba diving makes things difficult. You can stay underwater longer, but you need to plan a lot. You have 20kg to 50kg of gear, so you cannot just walk to the beach and go in the water. You need to plan everything.”

Redmond made the Express Dive during his last year at university. The device has two main parts. When you are above the water, the device takes in air through a hole in the mouthpiece. The air is pressed into a small tank. There is a light that flashes green when the tank is full. When the tank is full, the hole closes. When you go underwater, the air comes back through the mouthpiece. The light changes from green to red when the air is almost finished. The device gives you enough air for two minutes underwater and takes about two minutes to fill with air again.

Redmond says the mouthpiece feels like a snorkel. They have tested the first model in parts. Redmond says the motor can put two minutes of air into the device and a person can hold it in their mouth.

But they have not yet tested the device with a person underwater for two minutes. Redmond thinks that with more tests, the device will work well and will be safe for swimmers. He says the device will probably cost £280 and will weigh between 1kg and 3kg.

Some people may think that two minutes of air is not enough and is not much better than snorkelling. But Redmond says two minutes is a big difference underwater. Most people can only hold their breath for about 40 seconds. “Two minutes is not a long time, but it is much longer than that,” he says.

On a normal day, Starbucks stores are used for many things, like business meetings and reading groups. All these people come for their morning coffee. But Starbucks needs to be careful.

The protest group UK Uncut plans to turn many Starbucks stores in the UK into places like nurseries, shelters, and homes for homeless people. They want to show how Starbucks avoids paying taxes.

UK Uncut announced this protest while Starbucks was being questioned by the House of Commons Public Accounts Committee. The committee asked why Starbucks did not pay any corporation tax in the UK in the last three years, even though the company made good profits in Britain.

When he speaks to the committee, Starbucks Chief Financial Officer, Troy Alstead, will try to fix the company’s reputation.

Members of Parliament (MPs) said that HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC), the UK’s tax office, is too friendly with big companies. Conservative MP Richard Bacon said about Starbucks’ tax arrangements: “It smells. And it doesn’t smell of coffee – it smells bad.”

UK Uncut wants to show that government spending cuts, especially those that hurt women, are connected to big companies avoiding taxes.

Sarah Greene, a UK Uncut activist, said that money for shelters and rape crisis centers will be cut unless companies pay their fair share of tax. HMRC says about £32 billion was lost because of tax avoidance in 2011.

Greene said the government could easily collect billions of pounds to pay for important services if it was stricter about tax avoidance.

UK Uncut became famous for protests at Vodafone, Topshop, and Fortnum & Mason stores. Now, they are focusing on Starbucks because an investigation found that Starbucks paid only £8.6 million in corporation tax since it started in the UK in 1998, even though it made £3 billion in sales.

Anna Walker, a UK Uncut campaigner, said, “We want to show how the cuts affect women. So we will turn Starbucks into services that the government is cutting, like shelters and nurseries.”

She also said Starbucks is a good target because it is on every high street in the country, so people can protest in their own towns.

Other international companies have also been criticized for paying little or no corporation tax in the UK. These companies include Amazon, eBay, Facebook, Google, and Ikea.

Starbucks says it pays the right amount of tax. The group’s Chief Executive, Howard Schultz, said, “Starbucks has always paid taxes in the UK. In the last three years alone, we have paid more than £160 million in different taxes, including National Insurance, VAT, and business rates.”

Margaret Hodge, who leads the Public Accounts Committee, told parliament last month that Apple, eBay, Facebook, Google, and Starbucks avoided almost £900 million in tax. The Prime Minister, David Cameron, replied, “I am not happy with the current situation. I think HMRC needs to look at it very carefully. We want these businesses to invest in our country, but they should pay fair taxes too.”

A Starbucks spokeswoman said, “Tax law can be very complicated, but Starbucks follows tax laws and accounting rules in all 61 countries where we do business, including the UK. We have put information about our tax practices on our website.”

She also said Starbucks’ effect on the UK economy is bigger than just its stores and workers. Starbucks spends hundreds of millions of pounds with local suppliers for things like milk, cakes, sandwiches, and store design. When you include the jobs created by Starbucks’ investments, the company’s total effect on the UK economy is more than £80 million a year.

The group UK Uncut wants to turn many Starbucks cafés into places for children, safe spaces, and shelters for homeless people. They want people to see that Starbucks does not pay enough tax.

The House of Commons asked Starbucks why the company did not pay corporation tax in the UK in the last three years.

UK Uncut wants to show that government cuts, especially cuts that hurt women, are connected to big companies that do not pay enough tax.

The High Court in London has decided that three elderly Kenyans who were detained and tortured during the Mau Mau rebellion can sue the British government. Now, the British government is worried that thousands more people who were imprisoned and say they were treated badly at the end of the British Empire might also make legal claims.

The government’s lawyers argued that too much time had passed since the seven-year rebellion in the 1950s, so it would not be possible to have a fair trial. However, the court did not accept this argument. In 2011, the same judge also said that the three Kenyans did not have to sue the Kenyan government, even though the British government said Kenya took over Britain’s legal responsibilities after independence in 1963.

Human rights activists in Kenya believe that more than 5,000 of the 70,000 people detained by the British colonial authorities are still alive. Many of them may now try to sue the British government. This court decision may also help victims of colonial violence in other countries to sue.

The Foreign Office said the decision could have important legal effects and that it plans to appeal. Normally, people have three to six years to start a civil case, a spokesman said. In this case, more than 50 years have passed, and many important people involved are now dead and cannot say what happened.

This important win for Paulo Muoka Nzili, 85, Wambugu Wa Nyingi, 84, and Jane Muthoni Mara, 73, came after three years in court. Their lawyers said they suffered terrible cruelty. In Nairobi, Nyingi and Mara heard the news on their mobile phones. They were sitting quietly with supporters in a garden and were very happy when they heard the result. They hugged, danced, and raised their hands to the sky to pray.

Nyingi, who was detained for about nine years, beaten until he was unconscious, and still has scars, said: “For me, I just wanted the truth to come out. Even my grandchildren should know what happened. People should get compensation so they can start to forgive the British government.” Mara said: “I’m very happy and my heart is clean.” When asked what she would tell her four children, she said: “I will tell them I won.”

The judge said in 2011 that there was a lot of evidence that there may have been systematic torture of prisoners. On Friday, he said a fair trial was possible, especially because thousands of secret files from the colonial period were found in 2011.

The British government’s lawyers tried to stop the claims, but they agreed that all three Kenyans were tortured by the colonial authorities. The claimants’ lawyer said: “The British government has admitted that these three Kenyans were brutally tortured, but they have tried to avoid legal responsibility. There will be victims of colonial torture from places like Malaya, Yemen, Cyprus, and Palestine who will be very interested in this decision.”

Some veterans from the rebellion in Cyprus in the 1950s watched the case closely. One has already met the Mau Mau claimants’ lawyers. Cypriot claimants could use British documents and also records from the International Committee of the Red Cross in Geneva. These files are kept secret for 40 years and then made public. The Red Cross recorded hundreds of torture cases in Cyprus.

There may also be claims from Malaysia, where many people were detained during the 12-year war with communist fighters and their supporters that started in 1948. Families of 24 unarmed rubber plantation workers killed by British troops are now asking the British courts for a public investigation. Many former prisoners of the British in Aden may also have claims, but Aden is now part of Yemen, and British lawyers may have trouble finding possible clients there.

In the past, not sleeping much was seen as a sign that you were busy, important, and needed by others. People thought sleep was only for weak people. But now, Arianna Huffington’s book, The Sleep Revolution, which says it can change your life by helping you sleep better, is a best-seller in The New York Times.

At the same time, businesses have found ways to make money from people wanting better sleep. Many companies are changing how, where, and when we sleep, and how much we are willing to pay for it. Expensive hotels now offer special sleep retreats. For more than $1,000, you can get dinner and watch a movie about sleep. If you stay at home, you can buy things like a mattress cover with a sensor that checks your sleep for $249, or a sleep mask that checks your brainwaves and helps you nap better for $299.

Sleep is now a big business and is also becoming important in companies. Some companies already have special rooms for sleeping, and Huffington thinks that in the next two years, nap rooms in offices will be as common as meeting rooms. But how did sleep become so popular? Why is something humans have always done now seen as fashionable?

Today, many people think it is normal to pay $10 for a healthy juice or $34 for an indoor cycling class. Getting enough sleep fits into this healthy lifestyle. There is also new technology you can wear to track your body and make it work better, and now people also track their sleep. Huffington says sleep is not just for rest, but it helps you recover and perform better. She says getting eight hours of sleep is now a sign of success.

How does Arianna Huffington get her eight hours of sleep? She has about nine assistants, called her A-Team, who do everything for her. They run her errands, plan her trips, and even open The Huffington Post on her computer in the morning. The New York Times says most of her assistants can only do the job for about a year because it is so hard. They are paid little, so many have to get second jobs. In other words, they do not sleep so that Huffington can, and she can sell books about sleep.

Getting enough sleep is not just about wanting to go to bed on time. It also depends on living in a safe place and having a healthy body. Many studies show that poor people sleep worse. It is hard to sleep if you are worried about safety or do not have enough food. It is also hard if you are one of the 15 million Americans who work at night or have changing work hours. Research also shows there is a difference in sleep between black and white people. One study found that white people sleep about 6.85 hours a night, but African Americans sleep about 6.05 hours and have worse sleep quality. Researchers say this is partly because of the stress from racism.

Who sleeps the most and has the best sleep in America? Rich white women. These are probably the people Huffington wrote her book for. She calls her work a sleep revolution, but really, it is just a new way to talk about sleep. The real problem is not that a few rich people think sleep is a waste of time, but that most people cannot afford to spend time sleeping.

Sleep may help you perform better, but it is not very efficient. The real goal is to find a way for people to work well with less sleep. The military is leading this research. In 2008, the Pentagon wrote a report called Human Performance. It looked at the idea that soldiers could do their best with only a few hours of sleep. Imagine if humans could sleep as little as a giraffe (1.9 hours a night). This would mean fewer soldiers would die, and the enemy would need 40% more soldiers to keep up.

In the future, humans may find a way to not need sleep at all. Sleeping for a third of your life will not be a luxury anymore; only poor people will have to do it. When that happens, we might need a new kind of sleep revolution.

Today, many people think it is normal to pay $10 for green juice or $34 for an indoor cycling class. These people also think getting enough sleep is important for their lifestyle. People now watch their bodies like machines to work better, and sleep is another thing they measure.

People call him the Robin Hood of the banks. He took out many loans, almost half a million euros, and never planned to pay them back. Instead, Enric Duran gave the money to projects that tried to create and support new ways of living without capitalism.

After hiding for 14 months, Duran does not feel sorry for what he did, even though he could go to jail. “I’m proud of what I did,” he said in a Skype interview from a secret place.

From 2006 to 2008, Duran took 68 loans from 39 banks in Spain. He gave the money to social activists. They used it to pay for speaking tours against capitalism and to buy TV cameras for a media group. Duran said he saw that these social movements were trying to build new systems, but they did not have enough money. At the same time, the economy was growing in a way that created money from nothing.

He said that taking money from banks was his way to protest and show what was wrong with the system. He started slowly. “I filled out a few credit applications with my real information. They said no, but I just wanted to see what they were asking for.”

After that, the former table-tennis coach made a confusing system of accounts, payments, and transfers. “I was always learning.” By summer 2007, he learned how to make the system work. He applied for loans using the name of a fake television company. “Then, I managed to get a lot. 492,000 euros, to be exact.”

Duran was arrested in Spain in 2009. Six of the 39 banks that gave him money brought charges against him. He spent two months in prison before being released on 50,000 euros bail. In February 2013, when he could have faced up to eight years in prison, he decided to run away instead of going to court. He said this was because he does not accept the authority of the court system.

He said his actions were an important part of a worldwide discussion about the economic crisis. His timing helped the anti-capitalist movement become more visible, just when many people in Spain were looking for new ways to live because the old system had caused problems in their lives.

Today in Spain, the anti-capitalist movement and groups like the Indignados have support from thousands of people.

Now, Duran is also focusing on Spain’s justice system. He is promoting restorative justice. “The people in Spain who think banks are bad, they believe I don’t owe anything. I have already done my part,” he said. “But there are some people who do not agree with us, and I think I should answer to them.”

He said he could offer banks the knowledge he gained from years of taking loans in a dishonest way. He could share his ideas about which banking practices work well and which do not, for both the public and bank workers.

People call him the Robin Hood of the banks. He is a man who took loans for almost half a million euros and did not pay the money back. Enric Duran gave this money to projects that tried to find new ways instead of capitalism.

Duran has been hiding for 14 months. He does not say he is sorry, even though he might go to prison for what he did. He said, “I’m proud of what I’ve done,” in an interview by Skype from a secret place.

From 2006 to 2008, Duran took 68 loans from 39 banks in Spain. He gave the money to social activists. These people used the money for speaking tours against capitalism and to buy TV cameras for a media group. He said these activists did not have enough money, but at the same time, banks made money from nothing because of constant economic growth.

He said that taking loans dishonestly from banks was his way to show that this situation was wrong. At first, he tried to get loans using his real name, but the banks said no.

Then, he learned how to get money from the banks. “I was learning all the time.” By summer 2007, he learned how to use the system. He took loans using the name of a fake television company. In this way, he got a lot of money—€492,000.

Duran was arrested in Spain in 2009. He spent two months in prison, then they let him out after he paid €50,000 bail. In February 2013, when he could go to prison for eight years, he decided to run away.

His actions from 2006 to 2008 made many people notice the anti-capitalist movement for the first time. This happened when many people in Spain were looking for new ways because the system caused problems in their lives.

Today in Spain, thousands of people support the anti-capitalist movement and groups like the Indignados.

Duran says he does not want to give the money back to the banks, but he can offer them something else. He learned a lot when he was taking loans dishonestly, so he can show the banks how to make things better for people and for bank workers.

A group of experts says that fake allergy tests are making thousands of people take treatments they do not need and put themselves or their children on diets that are not good enough. This can cause malnutrition. Allergies and food intolerances are rising quickly, but people often confuse the two, and wrong diagnoses are causing real harm, said the charity Sense About Science, which made a guide with help from allergy specialists.

“This is probably the biggest problem for science communication. There are myths, misunderstood studies, and bad medical practice. This leads to both too many and too few diagnoses,” said Tracey Brown, director of Sense About Science. “The costs are huge—some people do unnecessary things, while others do not get the help they really need.”

Experts worry that restaurants and caterers hear so many people say they have allergies (which can be dangerous), when they really have a food intolerance (which is not dangerous), that they may not take enough care when serving someone with a real allergy.

“It is very important,” said Moira Austin from a charity that helps people with anaphylaxis. “If a caterer thinks someone is just avoiding a food because they do not want to feel bloated, they may not be careful enough. There have been deaths where people told restaurant staff they had an allergy, but were still served food containing the allergen.”

The guide says that most allergy tests bought online or in shops are not based on science. One example is a home test that looks for special antibodies called immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood. These antibodies are part of the body’s response to infections, but good medical evidence shows that high IgG levels do not mean someone has an allergy. The results are often positive in people who do not have an allergy or food intolerance.

Another unscientific test is a mix of acupuncture and homeopathy. It tries to measure electrical resistance on the skin while the person holds the suspected food. Testing hair samples is also useless, the guide says, because hair is not involved in allergic reactions, so testing it cannot give any useful information about allergies.

“I often see children who have been put on very limited diets. Their parents believe, with good intentions, that they have allergies to many foods because of allergy tests that are not scientific,” said Paul Seddon, a children’s allergy doctor. “This needs to stop, and it will only stop if we show these tests are not scientific.”

Another children’s allergy doctor, Adam Fox, said, “I see many patients who come after sending their hair for testing or after removing many foods from their children’s diets. It is very hard to deal with this. There are two problems. Children need proper diets, but avoiding foods that are not harmful can greatly affect their quality of life. A child who cannot eat wheat or drink milk cannot go to parties.”

Believing that a child’s tiredness, headaches, or eczema are caused by an allergy takes a long time and many tests to prove or disprove. It is tempting to go to an alternative therapist who will do one test and give a quick, but wrong, answer.

Allergies are increasing in developed countries. The number of children diagnosed with allergic rhinitis and eczema has tripled in the last 30 years. This makes more people think allergies are the reason for their own or their children’s health problems. The guide lists several myths about what causes allergies, such as E numbers in food colorings, toxic overload, and fast food.

A group of experts say that thousands of people are taking medicines they do not need and eating bad food because of fake allergy tests. Allergies and food intolerances are becoming more common, but people do not know the difference between an allergy and a food intolerance. This is causing problems, says the charity Sense About Science, who wrote a guide about allergies.

“It is very confusing,” said Tracey Brown, director of Sense About Science. “Some people take action when they do not really have allergies, and some people with real allergies do not get enough help.”

Many people tell waiters in restaurants that they have an allergy. But some of these people do not have an allergy—they have a food intolerance, which is not dangerous. Experts worry that if restaurants hear too many people say they have allergies (when it is not true), they may not be careful enough for people with real allergies.

“It is very important,” said Moira Austin from an allergy charity. “If a restaurant thinks someone just does not want to eat a food because it makes them feel bad, the restaurant may not be careful. Some people have died after telling a waiter they have an allergy, but the food still had the thing they were allergic to.”

The guide says most allergy tests you can buy on the internet or in shops do not work. One test you can use at home looks for special antibodies in the blood. These antibodies are part of the body’s way to fight infections, but “the best medical evidence shows that high antibody levels do not mean you have an allergy,” the guide says. The test often says people have an allergy or food intolerance when they do not.

Another test also does not work. It uses acupuncture and homeopathy together. Testing hair is also useless, the guide says. “Hair cannot show if you are allergic or not, so testing hair does not give any useful information about allergies.”

“I often see children who eat very few foods because their parents think they have allergies after using ‘allergy tests’ that do not work,” said Paul Seddon, a children’s allergy doctor. “This must stop, and it will only stop if we show these ‘tests’ do not work.”

Allergies can cause tiredness, headaches, and eczema in children. But you need to check carefully if they have an allergy, and this takes a long time and many tests. It may seem like a good idea to do just one test and get a quick answer, but this answer will be wrong.

Allergies are increasing in rich countries. There are three times more children with some allergies now than 30 years ago. The Sense About Science guide lists some myths about what causes allergies, for example, the myth that fast food or E numbers in food colorings cause allergies.

It is now illegal to smoke a cigarette inside a bar in New Orleans, Louisiana, which is known as the world’s drinking capital. Many other cities have banned smoking indoors, but New Orleans is special because it attracts tourists with its “let the good times roll” attitude. A smoking ban inside bars in New Orleans could have special effects.

Since Hurricane Katrina in 2005, the city government has tried to make things quieter. With help from neighborhood groups, the city has started to watch bars and nightclubs more closely and is also trying to make a new rule about noise.

Bar owner William Walker does not like the anti-smoking law. He says, “This is just the wrong time for something like this.” He thinks that making people go outside to smoke will make things more tense.

Many of the best bars and live music places in New Orleans are in quiet neighborhoods. This friendly way of living together is a big part of what makes New Orleans different and charming. But lately, some people do not like this anymore, and people worry that New Orleans’s special music culture is in danger.

Martha Wood lives next to a loud bar with live music. She says, “I bought the house partly because of the bar, so I won’t ever complain about the noise.” She also manages a live-music bar. Her bar was one of the first in New Orleans to be banned from selling drinks to go, after noise problems in 2013, including complaints about loud smokers outside.

The Maple Leaf club stopped allowing smoking by choice in 2014. The same thing happened at another club where artists wanted smoke-free nights. Zalia BeVille, manager of the All Ways Lounge, says, “Many music places were already starting to think about performers, so I wish the city had let that happen instead of forcing the ban on every small bar that doesn’t have music.”

Luckily, All Ways has an outdoor patio, but Lost Love Lounge does not. Its owner, Geoff Douville, likes the ban. Before, he felt he had to allow smoking to keep his bar open. Douville says, “There’s no way I could have banned smoking in my bar without a citywide ban. People think I have that choice, but if I make that rule, customers just go to another bar that allows smoking.”

Many small business owners are afraid they will lose money if they cannot allow smoking. Neil Timms, who smokes and owns an English pub, saw the smoking ban in England. He remembers, “Back home in England, every pub I knew closed within a year of the smoking ban,” which started in 2007. He does not want his pub to close, so he is spending money to build a patio.

But Douville thinks the ban could be good for business. He says, “There are many people who would like to come to our bar and eat our food, but they never came because they didn’t want to smell like smoke for a week. Now, we are an option for those people.” Douville is not worried about noise complaints. He says, “No court will say a bar is a problem after the city has made a smoking ban that makes people go outside!”

Councilwoman LaToya Cantrell, who started the ban, disagrees. She says, “Bar owners must make sure their customers are respectful outside too. Owners and bartenders need to tell people to smoke outside but be respectful to the neighborhood. The idea that we can’t have clean air because it will cause noise problems is silly. We can have clean air without noise problems. It’s about talking and working together between the community and businesses.”

Cantrell knows that New Orleans is different. She says, “How is New Orleans different from the rest of the country? New Orleans is known as a place where you can relax and have fun. New Orleans needs to show that we care about our people. The most at-risk people working in smoky places are the backbone of our hospitality industry, which is very important for Louisiana’s economy.”

Many people worried that the police would not have time to enforce the ban. So, the health department will give warnings and fines to bars. Bar customers are asked to fill out a form or call 311 and send photos of illegal smoking. Because of this, Neil Timms says he will follow the ban: “I don’t want someone to be sitting in the corner smoking, and then someone takes a photo and gets hurt.”

Geoff Douville is not worried and says he is used to noise complaints. He says, “You will see: the neighbors who complain about noise now are the same ones who wanted the smoking ban.” In the end, Douville agrees with Cantrell’s positive view. He says, “Of course they’re going to complain, but it doesn’t mean they’re going to win.”

It is now illegal to smoke a cigarette inside a bar in New Orleans, Louisiana, which is famous for its bars. After Hurricane Katrina in 2005, the city government started to try to make bars and nightclubs quieter. The city now has stricter rules about noise and has also made new rules about noise.

Bar-owner William Walker does not like the new anti-smoking law. He says, “This is the wrong time for this.” He thinks that if people have to go outside to smoke, it will make things more tense.

Many of the best bars in New Orleans are in quiet neighborhoods. Martha Wood lives next to a loud bar with live music. She says, “The bar was one reason I bought the house, so I will never complain about the noise.” She also manages a live-music bar.

The Maple Leaf club stopped allowing smoking in 2014. Another club also stopped smoking because performers wanted smoke-free nights. Zalia BeVille, manager of the All Ways Lounge, says, “Many places were already starting to think about the performers. I wish the city let this happen naturally, instead of forcing every bar to stop smoking, even bars without music.”

All Ways Lounge is lucky because it has an outdoor patio. Another bar, Lost Love Lounge, does not have a patio. The owner, Geoff Douville, likes the smoking ban. Before, he felt he had to allow smoking to keep his bar popular. He says, “I could not ban smoking in my bar unless the whole city did it. People think I can choose, but if I make a no-smoking rule, customers will go to another bar where they can smoke.”

A degree in Spanish helped me get my first job as a journalist with an international news agency in Mexico City, but it did not stop me from making mistakes as a young reporter.

I had just arrived in Mexico City after taking a Greyhound bus all the way from New York. The job interview tested my language skills. In my new job, I spent my days outside at political rallies and my nights alone in the office, organizing news from places with fighting in El Salvador, Nicaragua, Guatemala, and other parts of Central America. I also had to report on disasters like fires, floods, and explosions at firework factories.

As a reporter, I quickly learned that I was as bad at understanding numbers in Spanish as I was at doing math in English. One time, when I wanted to call the police, I woke up a Mexican grandmother at 2 a.m. because I dialed the wrong number. Even worse, I often reported the wrong number of victims in my stories. For example, I said almost 83 people died in a fire at 6 p.m., but by 7 p.m. it was only 38. I also said 12 people were hurt in a bus accident, but later it was only two. This happened many times. Finally, I got a call from the main office in Washington. An editor shouted, "I don’t know what training you have had, but has no one ever told you a death toll can’t go down?!"

Why are numbers in another language so difficult? It might be because of different ways of saying numbers. For example, in German, which is related to English, 2:30 p.m. is "halb drei" (half of three) and 21 is "einundzwanzig" (one and twenty). These different systems can cause confusion.

Some experts think there is a connection between dyscalculia (trouble with math) and problems learning foreign languages, especially if you learn by memorizing. But some students who have trouble learning languages from grammar books do better when they learn naturally, without focusing on grammar rules. For me, I always found languages easy, except for the numbers.

Maybe it is also because you often hear numbers in a foreign language without any context. The listener might not be paying attention and cannot suddenly understand. I talked to friends who speak many languages and found that many can speak French or Italian well when ordering food, but they freeze when they have to say numbers, especially on the phone. Numbers seem to be difficult, but no one really knows why.

For me, my problems with numbers in a foreign language followed me from Mexico to other countries and from Spanish to German and Portuguese. But in that first journalism job, getting the numbers wrong did not always mean failure.

One night, a Mexican coworker learned that the American consul in the port city of Veracruz was being held hostage at gunpoint in his office. There was no senior English-speaking reporter in the office, so I had to try to call the consulate. I got the phone number wrong and was connected to a different extension in the building. The person who answered was clearly the gunman. I talked to him for 15 minutes. I did not convince him to put down his gun, but my reputation as a reporter became much better overnight.

I got a degree in Spanish. This helped me get my first job as a journalist with an international news company in Mexico City. But my degree did not stop me from making mistakes.

I arrived in Mexico City after taking a bus all the way from New York. In my new job, I spent my days outside at political events and my nights alone in the office. In the office, I helped organize news from places with fighting, like El Salvador, Nicaragua, Guatemala, and other countries in Central America. I also had to report on disasters, such as fires, floods, and explosions at fireworks factories.

While I was working as a reporter, I learned that I was not good at understanding numbers in Spanish. One time, I wanted to call the police, but I called a Mexican grandmother by mistake at 2am because I got the phone number wrong. Even worse, I often made mistakes with numbers in my news stories. For example, 83 people died in a fire at 6pm, but by 7pm, I wrote that only 38 people died. In another story, 12 people were hurt in a bus accident, but later I wrote that only 2 people were hurt. This happened many times. Finally, someone from the main office in Washington called me. An editor shouted, “I don’t know what training you have had, but has no one ever told you that the number of dead people can’t go down?!”

Why are numbers in another language so difficult? Maybe it is because different languages have different ways to say numbers. For example, in German, 2:30pm is “half three” and 21 is “one and twenty.” These differences can make things confusing.

Some experts think there is a connection between dyscalculia (trouble with math) and problems learning foreign languages, especially if you learn by repeating things. But some students who find it hard to learn languages from a grammar book may learn better in a foreign country, where learning is more natural. For me, I always found languages easy, except for numbers.

Maybe it is also because we often hear numbers in another language without any context. You might stop listening to the foreign language and suddenly not understand. I talked to friends who speak many languages. They said they can speak French or Italian well when ordering food in a restaurant, but they freeze when they have to say numbers, especially on the phone. Numbers seem to be difficult, but no one knows exactly why.

For me, my problems with numbers in a foreign language followed me from Mexico to other countries, and from Spanish to German and Portuguese. But in my first journalism job, making mistakes with numbers did not always mean I failed.

One night, a Mexican coworker told me that a man with a gun was holding the American consul as a hostage in his office in the city of Veracruz. There was no senior English-speaking reporter in the office, so they asked me to call the consulate. I got the phone number wrong and reached another phone in the building. I quickly knew who I was talking to: I spoke for 15 minutes with the gunman. He did not put down his gun after talking to me, but my reputation as a reporter became much better right away.

No one knows if the economic crisis in Greece started before shisha, a drug now called the "cocaine of the poor," or after. But everyone knows that shisha is very dangerous. It only costs 2 euros or less for one dose.

Shisha is a very bad drug. It burns your body inside, makes you angry, and can make you lose your mind, said Maria, who used to be addicted to heroin. But it is cheap, easy to find, and many people are using it.

This drug problem is making things even harder for health workers in Athens, who already have less money because of budget cuts.

Many homeless Greeks, who lost their homes because of poverty and sadness, use shisha. Both drug users and officials say shisha is similar to crystal meth. It is a man-made drug, often mixed with dangerous things like battery acid, engine oil, and even shampoo. It can make people very violent. Even worse, it is easy to find and easy to make.

It is a killer, but it also makes you want to kill, said Konstantinos, a drug user. You can kill someone and not even know you did it. It is spreading very fast. Many users have died.

Charalampos Poulopoulos, the head of Kethea (Greece’s anti-drug center), says shisha shows how bad the crisis is, with more people poor and without jobs than ever before. He calls it an "austerity drug"—a drug made by dealers for people who cannot pay for expensive drugs like heroin and cocaine.

The crisis has helped dealers sell a new, cheap drug—a cocaine for poor people, said Poulopoulos at a center for drug users in Exarcheia, Athens. Shisha can be sniffed or injected, and it can be made at home without special skills. It is very dangerous.

In Greece, six years of economic problems have been very hard. Depression, drug and alcohol use have increased a lot. Crime has also gone up because people have less money—most Greeks have lost 40% of their income. Prostitution, which is often used to pay for drugs, has also increased a lot.

Many women agree to have sex without protection because they get more money, said Eleni Marini, a psychologist at Kethea. Shisha is linked to a strong sexual desire, but it also makes it hard to think clearly. Now, there are more pregnancies among drug-addicted women who work as prostitutes. In 2012, two sex workers gave birth on the streets of Athens.

Suicides have also increased, and HIV is spreading. Drug users (about 25,000 people) are hurting themselves more and more. Experts say young Greeks, who have the highest unemployment rate in the EU (64%), are using drugs the most.

The crisis has made many people feel hopeless, said Poulopoulos. People who might have stopped using drugs now have no reason to stop. There is a feeling of sadness, and people who know they cannot find work are hurting themselves more. In Athens, where the crisis is worst, shisha is part of this problem.

At the same time, when help is needed most, government organizations like Kethea have lost a third of their money because of orders from the European Commission, European Central Bank, and International Monetary Fund. These groups are trying to save the Greek economy.

Since the crisis started in 2009, Kethea has lost 70 out of 500 workers. This happened even though studies show that for every euro spent on anti-drug programs like Kethea, the Greek government saves about 6 euros in police and health costs. The cuts are a big mistake, said Poulopoulos.

On the streets of Athens, where shisha is becoming more popular, people are afraid that austerity is not only failing—it is killing people.

No one knows if the economic crisis in Greece or shisha, a drug called the “cocaine of the poor,” came first. But everyone agrees that shisha is very dangerous. It costs only €2 or less.

Maria, who used to take heroin, said, “It is the worst drug. It burns your body inside, makes you angry, and makes you crazy. But it is cheap, easy to find, and many people use it.”

This drug problem is making things harder for health workers in Athens, who already have less money because of budget cuts.

Thousands of homeless Greeks, who live on the streets because they are poor and have lost hope, are using shisha. Shisha is similar to crystal meth. People often mix it with battery acid, engine oil, and even shampoo. It can make people violent. Even worse, it is easy to buy and easy to make.

Konstantinos, a drug addict, said, “It is a killer, but it also makes you want to kill. You can kill someone and not know you did it. Many users have died.”

Charalampos Poulopoulos, the head of Kethea, Greece’s anti-drug center, said shisha is an “austerity drug.” Drug dealers make it for people who cannot pay for heroin or cocaine anymore.

Poulopoulos said, “The crisis has helped dealers sell a new, cheap drug, a cocaine for the poor. You can sniff or inject shisha, and you can make it at home. You do not need special skills. It is very dangerous.”

All over Greece, there is a lot of depression, and more people are using drugs and alcohol. Crime has gone up because government cuts have reduced the money of normal Greeks by 40%. More people are working as prostitutes to pay for drugs.

There are more suicides and more people with HIV. About 25,000 drug addicts in Greece are hurting themselves more and more. Sixty-four percent of young people in Greece do not have jobs – this is the highest youth unemployment in the European Union.

When groups like Kethea need more help, the Greek government has cut their money by one third. The European Commission, European Central Bank, and International Monetary Fund told them to do this to help the Greek economy.

They have less money, but studies show that for every euro the government spends on anti-drug programs like Kethea, it saves about €6 because there is less crime and fewer health problems. According to the UN, if the world reduced food waste by just 25%, there would be enough food to feed all the people who do not have enough to eat. Every year, 1.3 billion tonnes of food, or about one third of all food produced, is wasted. This includes about 45% of all fruit and vegetables, 35% of fish and seafood, 30% of cereals, 20% of dairy products, and 20% of meat. At the same time, 795 million people suffer from serious hunger and malnutrition.

The UN says that food waste is a big problem for food security. By 2050, food production will need to increase by 60% compared to 2005 to feed the growing world population. Reducing food waste would help meet this future need.

Food waste is a global problem, but it looks different in different places. In developing countries, most food loss happens by accident, often because of poor equipment, bad transportation, and weak infrastructure. In rich countries, there is less accidental food loss, but more food is thrown away by consumers who buy too much or by shops that reject food because it does not look perfect.

In developed countries, people and shops throw away between 30% and 40% of all food they buy. In poorer countries, only 5% to 16% of food is thrown away.

Robert van Otterdijk, who works for the UN Food and Agriculture Organization’s Save Food programme, says that food waste is almost not seen in developing countries. Food waste happens in countries where people can afford to throw food away. But in developing countries, there is a lot of food loss because of poor conditions.

Food loss and waste have a big effect on the environment. The carbon footprint of food that is produced but not eaten is about 3.3 gigatonnes of CO2. If food waste were a country, it would be the third largest emitter of greenhouse gases after the US and China. About 30% of farmland is used to grow food that is later wasted. More water is used to produce wasted food than is used for farming by any single country, even India or China.

Van Otterdijk says that climate change is caused by our way of producing and using things, which is not balanced with what the Earth can give. Food production is one of the biggest industries in the world, and if one third of all food is wasted, it has a huge effect on natural resources like land, water, energy, and greenhouse gas emissions.

The countries that waste the most food are the US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, where people waste 39% of all food they buy. Next is Europe, where about 31% of food bought by consumers is thrown away. In the UK, 15 million tonnes of food is lost or wasted each year. British consumers throw away 4.2 million tonnes of edible food each year. This means that 11.7% of all food bought is wasted, costing each family £700 a year.

The foods most often found in British bins are bread, vegetables, fruit, and milk. The most wasted food by weight is bread, with 414,000 tonnes (22.4%) of all bread bought being thrown away. By percentage, the most wasted food is lettuce and leafy salads, with 38% (64,000 tonnes) of all bought being thrown away.

The UK has made progress in the last ten years after a campaign to reduce waste. Van Otterdijk says the UK has been very successful in fighting food waste. Between 2007 and 2012, the amount of food waste from UK households went down by 21%, from 5.3 million tonnes to 4.2 million tonnes, mostly because people are more aware.

Van Otterdijk says there is a strong and growing interest in reducing food waste, which helps campaigns around the world. He says we need to do much more, and both the public and private sectors must help. But if this continues, maybe in ten years we will see important results worldwide.

If we wasted 25% less food in the world, there would be enough food for all hungry people. Every year, we waste 1.3 billion tonnes of food. This is about one third of all food we make. We waste about 45% of all fruit and vegetables, 35% of fish and seafood, 30% of cereals, 20% of dairy products, and 20% of meat. We waste this food while 795 million people do not have enough to eat.

Food waste is a problem everywhere, but it is different in each place. In poor countries, a lot of food is lost because of bad equipment and transport. In rich countries, people do not lose much food this way, but they throw away a lot of food because they buy too much or shops do not want food that does not look nice.

In rich countries, people and shops throw away 30% to 40% of all food they buy. In poor countries, people throw away only 5% to 16%.

Robert van Otterdijk, from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization, says, “In poor countries, there is almost no food waste. Food waste happens in rich countries where people have more money and can throw away food. But in poor countries, there is a lot of food loss because of bad conditions.”

Wasting food is also bad for the environment. Food that is made but not eaten causes 3.3 gigatonnes of CO2. If food waste was a country, it would make more greenhouse gases than any country except the US and China.

Van Otterdijk says, “We cause climate change because we make and use too much. We are not living in balance with the Earth. Making food is one of the biggest industries in the world. If we waste one third of it, it has a big effect on land, water, energy, and greenhouse gases.”

The US, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand waste the most food. People in these countries waste 39% of all the food they buy. In Europe, people throw away about 31% of the food they buy. In the UK, 15 million tonnes of food is lost or wasted every year. British people throw away 4.2 million tonnes of food that could be eaten. This is 11.7% of all food people buy, and it costs each family £700 a year.

The foods most often thrown away in the UK are bread, vegetables, fruit, and milk. The food wasted most by weight is bread – people throw away 414,000 tonnes (22.4%) of all bread they buy. By percentage, the most wasted food is lettuce and leafy salads – people throw away 38% (64,000 tonnes) of all they buy.

The UK has improved in the last ten years because of a campaign to reduce waste. Van Otterdijk says the UK has done very well. From 2007 to 2012, UK homes wasted 21% less food, from 5.3 million tonnes to 4.2 million tonnes.

Van Otterdijk says more people now care about food waste, and this is good. “We must do more, and companies and governments must help too,” he says. “But if we keep going like this, maybe in ten years, the world will be better.”

Sometimes life is not fair. Mark Zuckerberg created Facebook and is now worth about $48 billion. James Goodfellow also invented something used by millions of people every day—the cash machine—but it did not make him rich. In fact, he earned only £10 from the patent and has not made any more money from it since then.

Goodfellow says, “You can imagine how I feel when I see bankers getting £1 million bonuses. What have they done for the banking industry, compared to me, to deserve a £1 million bonus?” He invented something that made banks billions of pounds, but he got nothing.

For years, people have argued about who invented the ATM. In 2005, a man named John Shepherd-Barron received a UK honor as the inventor of the automatic cash dispenser. But now, the UK government says it was Goodfellow who invented the ATM, so after all the arguments, he finally has his place in history.

In the mid-1960s, Goodfellow was working as a development engineer. He was asked to find a way for customers to take out cash from banks on Saturdays. Most people worked during the week and could not go to the bank. They needed a solution. Goodfellow says, “The solution was a machine that would give cash to a recognized customer. To make this possible, I invented the PIN (personal identification number) and a coded token.”

This token was a plastic card with holes in it. The patent described a system with a card reader and buttons on the outside wall of the bank. After Goodfellow made a model to show how the machine would work, prototypes were built and the first machines were installed in 1967. At the same time, Shepherd-Barron was developing a different machine. His machine did not use plastic cards. Instead, it used cheques with carbon-14, a slightly radioactive material. The machine detected the carbon-14, checked the cheque with a PIN, and gave out cash.

Most people agree that Shepherd-Barron’s ATM was the first in the world to be installed and used by the public. The first one opened at a bank in north London on 27 June 1967, a month before Goodfellow’s ATM appeared. However, Goodfellow’s patent was filed on 2 May 1966, 14 months before Shepherd-Barron’s ATM was first used.

Shepherd-Barron received an official honor for his work. Goodfellow says, “My one big regret is that I never said anything about it until John Shepherd-Barron received the OBE in 2005 for inventing the automatic cash dispenser. That really upset me and I complained.”

Shepherd-Barron is no longer alive, but in a 2005 interview, he was critical of Goodfellow. He said, “I don’t know him, but the difference between Goodfellow and us was that we thought about the whole system, and that was important to the banks. His invention reminds me of the hovercraft, an elegant failure.”

Today, the cash machine is used all over the world, and nothing—like contactless payments, bitcoin, or wearable technology—is stopping its growth. There are now 3 million ATMs worldwide, and by 2020, there will probably be 4 million.

The good news for Goodfellow is that people are starting to recognize his invention. The website ATMInventor.com says: Who invented the idea of an ATM? We believe it was Luther George Simjian. Who invented the ATM as we know it? We think it was James Goodfellow, because he had a patent in 1966. Who invented the ATM design we see today? We think it was John D White in the US.

Even better for Goodfellow, his achievement is now officially recognized in the latest edition of a 180-page guidebook called Life in the United Kingdom. In the section about great British inventions of the twentieth century, it says: In the 1960s, James Goodfellow (1937–) invented the cash-dispensing automatic teller machine (ATM) or cashpoint.

So after all these years, Goodfellow is finally among a group of famous British inventors like John Logie Baird (the television), Alan Turing (the Turing machine), Sir Frank Whittle (the jet engine), and Sir Tim Berners-Lee (the World Wide Web). When asked what he did with the £10 he received in the 1960s, Goodfellow says he thinks he spent it on a night out. He added, “It didn’t change my life.”

Life is not always fair. Mark Zuckerberg made Facebook and now has $48 billion. James Goodfellow also invented something that millions of people use every day—the cash machine (ATM)—but he did not become rich. He only got £10 from the patent and has not made any more money from it.

Who invented the ATM? People have argued about this for years. In 2005, a man named John Shepherd-Barron got an award in the UK as the “inventor of the automatic cash dispenser.” But now, the UK government says Goodfellow invented the ATM.

In the middle of the 1960s, Goodfellow’s bosses asked him to find a way for people to get cash from banks on Saturdays. Most people worked during the week and could not go to the bank. They needed a solution. Goodfellow thought of a machine that would give cash to customers. He also invented the PIN (personal identification number) and a coded token to make it work.

Goodfellow’s first machines were put in banks in 1967. At the same time, Shepherd-Barron was making a similar machine. His machine did not use plastic cards. It used cheques.

Most people agree that Shepherd-Barron’s ATM was the first in the world to be used by the public. The first one was in a bank in north London. It opened on 27 June 1967, one month before Goodfellow’s ATM. But Goodfellow registered the patent for his machine on 2 May 1966, 14 months before Shepherd-Barron’s ATM was used.

Shepherd-Barron got an official award for his invention. Goodfellow said, “My one big regret is that I never said anything until John Shepherd-Barron got the award in 2005. The Queen gave him this award for inventing the automatic cash dispenser. That made me very angry and I complained about it.”

Shepherd-Barron is dead now, but in a 2005 interview, he said bad things about Goodfellow. He said Goodfellow’s invention was not good.

Now, cash machines are used all over the world. Every year, there are more and more. There are now three million ATMs in the world, and there will be four million by 2020. The good news for Goodfellow is that people are starting to know he invented the ATM. The website ATMInventor.com says, “Who invented the idea of an ATM? We think it was Luther George Simjian. Who invented the ATM as we know it? It was James Goodfellow, because he had the patent in 1966.”

So after many years, Goodfellow is finally with other famous British inventors like John Logie Baird (the television), Alan Turing (the Turing machine), Sir Frank Whittle (the jet engine), and Sir Tim Berners-Lee (the World Wide Web). When people asked Goodfellow what he did with the £10 he got in the 1960s, he said he spent it on a night out. “It didn’t change my life,” he said.

Dr. Ben Brabon from Edgehill University teaches a MOOC, which is a massive open online course, in literature. This course is one of only two accredited MOOCs currently available in the UK. Brabon says that many students join MOOCs because they are free and they like talking with other students. MOOCs do not have entry requirements or fees, so students act differently compared to those in traditional university courses.

MOOCs are a new idea to make higher education available to everyone. A lot of money is being spent on new online platforms that offer advanced and interactive courses to tens of thousands of students. Investors hope to find a way to make money from MOOCs, but so far, universities have paid for their best teachers to design and teach these courses online. One possible way to make money is to study data about how, why, and when millions of students join, use the course materials, send messages, do their assignments, and leave the course.

There are questions about who really benefits from MOOCs. Do they help universities attract international students who pay fees by showing their best courses online? Do they help students in developing countries who want to study at top universities? Do they help workers who want to learn more for their jobs? Do they help people without qualifications who want to use MOOCs to get into higher education? Or do they just help hobby learners who are interested in a subject?

MOOCs are popular at first, but very few students finish them, says Brabon. His literature course had 1,000 students sign up, but only 31 finished. Almost all of those who finished already had a university degree or similar education. So, MOOCs may not be helping new groups of people get into higher education.

Learning online is different and needs advanced study skills, says David Kernohan, who manages eLearning Innovation at a charity that supports digital technology in UK education and research. With MOOCs, there is very little support: students do not get personal help. Instead, they get help from other students in online discussion forums. This means online study can be hard for people without high-level qualifications, but it also means MOOCs could be good for continuing education.

Now, the number of part-time students has dropped because university degrees are more expensive. Could free and open courses like MOOCs offer a new way to get a university education? Could a whole degree be taught through MOOCs? Brabon does not think this is how MOOCs work. He suggests a mixed approach, combining campus learning with MOOCs. He also thinks it might be possible to use MOOCs to create a global degree, where students take courses from different countries.

But this is still in the future. Right now, MOOC completion certificates do not have quality checks for course content or assessment, so employers do not value them. Brabon says that accreditation is now necessary for MOOCs if they want to be respected by universities and employers.

Some people have high hopes for MOOCs—they want to bring the best teaching from developed countries to students in poorer countries. But some people are doubtful and think universities use MOOCs to advertise their campus courses to more international students who pay higher fees.

Mike Sharples, chair of Educational Technology, does not agree with this negative view.
